text: Ginpanindugan ni Miss Margaret Ruth Florete nga nakasentro ang bangko sa responsible growth kun sa diin indi lamang ang kita ang ginahatagan importansya kundi pati ang klaro nga katuyoan.
english: Miss Margaret Ruth Florete insisted that the bank is focused on responsible growth where not only revenue is given importance but also a clear purpose.

text: Lakip sa mga tikang sang Queenbank amo ang pagduso sang organic growth, pag-invest sa mga empleyado, digital capabilities kag sa mga physical spaces nga mas makabulig sa mas epektibo nga pagsuporta sa mga kliyente.
english: Queenbank’s measures include driving organic growth, investing in employees, digital capabilities and in physical spaces that can better support clients more effectively.

text: Bisan pa sang indi maisip nga mga nalab-ot sang Queenbank, nagapati ini nga mas madamo pa gid ang oportunidad nga nagahulat sa Queenbank agud mas mapalapad pa ang serbisyo kag epekto sini sa mga komunidad nga ginapangalagaran sini.
english: Despite Queenbank’s countless achievements, he believes that even more opportunities await Queenbank to further extend its service and impact to the communities it serves.

text: Ang tema sang Top Level Management Conference subong nga tuig amo ang Building Relationships, Building Business, nga nagapakita sang commitment sang Queenbank sa paghatag prayoridad sa papel sini sa komunidad.
english: The theme of this year’s Top Level Management Conference is Building Relationships, Building Business, reflecting Queenbank’s commitment to prioritizing its role in the community.

text: Ang Queenbank gina-regulate sang Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas kag miyembro sang Philippine Deposit Insurance Corporation, Chamber of Thrift Banks, kag Florete Group.
english: Queenbank is regulated by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas and is a member of the Philippine Deposit Insurance Corporation, Chamber of Thrift Banks, and Florete Group.

text: Gin-umpisahan sa operational testing ang newly renovated courts sang Rizal Memorial Tennis Center duha ka semana antes ang opisyal nga pagsugod sang Philippine Women’s Open.
english: The newly renovated courts of the Rizal Memorial Tennis Center were put into operational testing two weeks before the official start of the Philippine Women's Open.

text: Ini ang una nga WTA 125 event sang Pilipinas.
english: This is the Philippines' first WTA 125 event.

text: Antes sini, magahampang anay ang top female players sang Pilipinas para sa national ranking points kag para sa coveted wildcard entry.
english: Before that, the top female players of the Philippines will play for national ranking points and for the coveted wildcard entry.

text: Ini ang makabulig nga ma-test ang pasilidad kag magaserbe man nga qualifying event sa local players.
english: This will help test the facility and will also serve as a qualifying event for local players.

text: Indi na mag-intra sa playoffs ang top two players sang Pilipinas nga sanday Alex Eala kag rising star nga si Tennielle Madis sang M’lang, Cotabato bangud nahatagan na sila sang wildcards.
english: The top two players of the Philippines, Alex Eala and rising star Tennielle Madis of M'lang, Cotabato, will not participate in the playoffs because they have already been given wildcards.

text: Magadepende pa sa resulta sang Australian Open kun makahampang si Eala diri sa Pilipinas.
english: It will depend on the result of the Australian Open if Eala can play here in the Philippines.

text: Ini bangud ang main draw sang Philippine Women’s Open ang dungan man sa ikaduha nga semana sang Grand Slam sa Melbourne.
english: This is because the main draw of the Philippine Women's Open will also coincide with the second week of the Grand Slam in Melbourne.

text: Nagtanyag ang United States Department of State sang $10 million ukon P595.9-million nga reward sa kun sin-o man ang makahatag sang impormasyon kaangot kay Supreme Leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei kag iban pa nga mga matag-as nga opisyal sang Iran.
english: The United States Department of State has offered a $10 million or P595.9-million reward for information on Supreme Leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei and other senior Iranian officials.

text: Gintawag sang State Department nga “Rewards for Justice” ang amo nga pograma nga nagatuyo nga matultulan ang Iranian officials.
english: The State Department called the program “Rewards for Justice” which aims to track down Iranian officials.

text: Yara man sa listahan sanday Iranian Interior Minister Eskandar Momeni kag Minister of Intelligence and Security Esmail Khatib.
english: Iranian Interior Minister Eskandar Momeni and Minister of Intelligence and Security Esmail Khatib are also on the list.

text: “These individuals command and direct various elements of Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), which plans, organises and executes terrorism around the world,” suno sa ahensya.
english: “These individuals command and direct various elements of Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), which plans, organizes and executes terrorism around the world,” the agency said.

text: Pananglitan may yara sang impormasyon suno sa ahensya, mahimo ini mapadala via Tor ukon Signal agud nga mangin eligible para sa reward.
english: If the agency has information, it can be sent via Tor or Signal to be eligible for the reward.

text: Si Mojtaba amo ang bag-o nga Supreme Leader sang Islamic Republic matapos napatay ang anay lider sang pungsod nga amo ang iya amay nga Ali Khamenei sang nag-atake ang US kag Israel sang Pebrero 28.
english: Mojtaba is the new Supreme Leader of the Islamic Republic after the country’s former leader who was his father Ali Khamenei was killed during the February 28 US-Israel attack.

text: Una na nagguwa ang reports nga napilasan man kag na-coma si Mojtaba sa gyera apang wala pa sang opisyal nga kumpirmasyon halin sa Tehran.
english: Earlier reports surfaced that Mojtaba was also wounded and in a coma in the war but there has been no official confirmation from Tehran.

text: Sang nagligad nga adlaw, ginbasa sa Iranian state media ang iya mensahe — wala sang audio kag wala sang video nga nagapakita sang itsura ni Mojtaba.
english: The previous day, his message was read out on Iranian state media — no audio and no video showing Mojtaba’s appearance.

text: Nagpasalig sini nga itimalos nila ang tanan nga Iranians nga nagkalamatay sa pagpamomba sang US kag Israel Defense Forces.#
english: He promised to take revenge on all Iranians who died in the bombing of the US and Israel Defense Forces.

text: Magapasakop ang Filipina tennis star nga si Alex Eala sa Kooyong Classic sa Melbourne bilang ulihi sini nga paghanda bag-o ang una sini nga maindraw appearance sa Australian Open.
english: Filipina tennis star Alex Eala will participate in the Kooyong Classic in Melbourne as his last preparation before his first maindraw appearance at the Australian Open.

text: Pagkatapos sang Semifinal finish sini sa ASB Classic sa Auckland gilayon nga nagkadto ang Filipina netter sa Autralia.
english: After her Semifinal finish at the ASB Classic in Auckland the Filipina netter immediately went to Australia.

text: Sa karon ika-53 sa WTA rankings si Eala kag ginalauman nga magataas pa ang iya career-best sa No.
english: Eala is currently 53rd in the WTA rankings and is expected to raise her career-best to No.

text: Kaupod sini sa Kooyong Classic sanday Donna Vekic, Priscilla Hon, kag Daniela Hantuchova.
english: With her at the Kooyong Classic were Donna Vekic, Priscilla Hon, and Daniela Hantuchova.

text: Pagkatapos sa Kooyong, magapasakop si Eala sa Australian Open nga isa sa Grand Slam nga wala pa sini mahampangan sa main draw.
english: After Kooyong, Eala will compete in the Australian Open, one of the Grand Slams she has never played in the main draw.

text: Isa ka izakaya bar sa Nagoya, Japan ang nagapangatubang sang kontrobersyal bangud sang ila pinasahi nga serbisyo nga ginahatag sa mga customer.
english: An izakaya bar in Nagoya, Japan is facing controversy for its exceptional customer service.

text: Ang bar, nga kilala sa ila manamit kag krispy nga chicken karaage, naghatag man sang libre kag literal nga “crispy spankings” sa mga bisita.
english: The bar, known for their delicious and crispy chicken karaage, also provided free and literal “crispy spankings” to guests.

text: Suno sa manager sang nasambit nga bar, ang pagtampa nagahatag interes sa ila negosyo, gani nangin epektibo ini nga paagi agud makapaganyat sang mas madamo pa nga customer.
english: According to the manager of the said bar, slapping generates interest in their business, so it has become an effective way to attract even more customers.

text: Sa una, isa lang ka waitress ang nagatampa — kag ginahimo lang ini kun ginapangayo sang customer.
english: At first, only one waitress slaps — and only does so when the customer asks for it.

text: Apang samtang nagadamo ang mga interesado nga makaeksperyensya sang serbisyo, ang bar nag-hire sang mas madamo nga mga babayi nga handa magtampa sa balor nga 100 yen ukon P37 kada isa.
english: But as more and more people were interested in experiencing the service, the bar hired more women willing to slap for 100 yen or P37 each.

text: Sang primero, isa lang ka waitress ang nagahimo sang pagpanampa sa customer, apang bangud sa madamo na ang nagapangita sang ini nga klasi sang serbisyo kag nangin in-demand pa ini, nag-hire pa ang amo nga bar sang pila ka mga babayi nga nagapanampa sa balor nga 100 yen ukon P37.
english: Initially, only one waitress was doing the spanking to the customer, but because many people are looking for this kind of service and it has become in-demand, the bar hired some women who slap for 100 yen or P37.

text: Suno sa report sang Liberty Times Net, may mga customer pa nga nagabayad sang 500 yen agud lang makapili kun sin-o nga waitress ang gusto nila nga magatampa sa ila.
english: According to a report by Liberty Times Net, some customers even pay 500 yen just to choose which waitress they want to slap them.

text: Gani indi lang mga local nga Japanese ang naga-interes, kundi pati mga foreigners ukon foreign tourists nagapila man agud lang tampaon.
english: So not only local Japanese are interested, but also foreigners or foreign tourists line up just to be slapped.

text: Pagkatapos nga maglapta ang amo nga video sa social media, ang bar nakabaton sang nasari-sari nga mga reaction kag kritisismo, sa bagay nga nga nagdesisyon ang manager sang amo nga ilimnan nga untaton na ang amo nga klase sang serbisyo.
english: After the video went viral on social media, the bar received mixed reactions and criticism, so much so that the manager of the bar decided to stop the service.

text: Wala pa klaro kun san-o gid nila gin-untat ang serbisyo, apisar bisan wala na ini, padayon gihapon nga ginadumdom sang kadam-an, bilang isa sa mga pinaka-‘extraordinary’ nga paagi sang customer engagement sa bar scene sang Japan.
english: It is not clear when exactly they stopped the service, although even though it is no longer there, it is still remembered by many, as one of the most 'extraordinary' ways of customer engagement in Japan's bar scene.

text: Nagsentro sa pag-antos kag pagbangon ang istorya sang inagihan sang isa ka corporate professional nga tumandok sang Anini-y, Antique apang naggradwar sa West Visayas State University sa Iloilo City.
english: The story of a corporate professional who is a native of Anini-y, Antique but graduated from West Visayas State University in Iloilo City focuses on the suffering and recovery.

text: Ini amo si Ivy Jean dela Serna nga bata pa lamang nabuksan na ang kaisipan nga tuman kabudlay ang pagkabuhi sa kalibutan.
english: This is Ivy Jean dela Serna who at an early age was opened to the idea that life in the world is very difficult.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay dela Serna, iya ginpahayag nga tatlo ka tuig pa lang siya, nagaupod na ini sa iya iloy nga nagapanglaba agud makakwarta.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, dela Serna said that when he was three years old, he accompanied his mother to do laundry to earn money.

text: Ang iya naman nga amay, wala sang permanente nga trabaho gani ini ang nangin inspirasyon niya nga maghimakas gid ini nga makatapos sa iya pag-eskwela.Apang indi gid nangin paborable ang kapalaran para sa ila.
english: His father, on the other hand, did not have a permanent job so this inspired him to struggle to finish his education. But fate was not favorable for them.

text: Sang tuig 2015, isa ka masakit nga hitabo ang nagpabudlay pa gid sa sitwasyon sang ila pamilya kun sa diin napatay ang iya iloy bangud sa balatian.
english: In 2015, a painful incident made the situation of their family even more difficult where his mother died due to illness.

text: Matapos naman ang pila ka tuig, napreso ang iya amay sa sala nga wala man sini nahimo.
english: Years later, his father was imprisoned for a crime he had not committed.

text: Sa pihak sini, bisan may mga tion kun kaisa nga ginadumdom ni dela Serna nga kaangay ginadalukan sila sang isa ka malipayon nga pangabuhi, ini tanan naghatag pa gid sang kaisog sa iya agud maghimakas.
english: However, although there are times when dela Serna remembers that they are afraid of a happy life, all this gave him more courage to fight.

text: Nagbunga ini tanan matapos naggradwar ini sa kolehiyo bilang isa ka Magna Cum Laude nga suno sa iya bangud man sa bulig sang programa sang gobyerno sa ila.
english: All this came to fruition after he graduated from college as a Magna Cum Laude which he said was also due to the help of the government program to them.

text: Para kay dela Serna, bangud man sa bulig sang Ginoo sa iya kabuhi nangin posible ang mga bagay nga suno sa iya, kaangay nga nangin imposible sini nga malampuwasan.
english: For dela Serna, it is also because of the Lord's help in his life that things have become possible that, according to him, it seems impossible for him to overcome.

text: Nagbilin man ini sang pahanumdom sa iban nga tawo nga dapat magpadayon lang, mag-focus sa kun ano man ang gusto mo nga malab-ot kag magsalig sa Ginoo bangud wala gid ini nagapabaya.
english: It also left a reminder to other people to just keep going, focus on whatever you want to achieve and trust the Lord because he never lets you down.

text: Paborito mo man bala ang tropical fruit nga sandiya?
english: Is watermelon your favorite tropical fruit?

text: Nakahibalo ka bala nga kaangay sang cucumber, edible ukon makaon ang sandiya tubtob sa iya panit?
english: Did you know that like the cucumber, the watermelon is edible or edible right down to its skin?

text: Suno kay Dr. Atli Arnarson, licensed nutritionist sa Iceland, nagakadapat nga indi pag-ihaboy ang panit sang watermelon ukon sandiya bangud manggaranon ini sa fiber, nagapanubo sang blood pressure, naga-boost sang workout kag nagapasanyog sang libido.
english: According to Dr. Atli Arnarson, licensed nutritionist in Iceland, it is advisable not to throw away the skin of watermelon or watermelon because it is rich in fiber, lowers blood pressure, boosts workout and promotes libido.

text: Natukiban nga ang panit sang sandiya ang concentrated ukon puno sang libido-boosting powers nga amino acid nga ginatawag nga citrulline.
english: It was discovered that the skin of watermelon is concentrated or full of libido-boosting powers amino acid called citrulline.

text: Ini nga chemical ang makabulig sa mga kalalakihan nga may yara sang mild tubtob sa moderate nga erectile dysfunction.
english: This chemical can help men with mild to moderate erectile dysfunction.

text: Natural diuretic man ang watermelon rind ukon ang panit sang sandiya kag manggaranon ini sa vitamins A kag C, potassium, kag magnesium nga nagabulig balanse sa blood pressure sang isa ka indibidwal.
english: Watermelon rind is also a natural diuretic and is rich in vitamins A and C, potassium, and magnesium that help balance an individual's blood pressure.

text: Magluwas diri, ang mataas nga fiber content sang panit sang sandiya ang nagapabuhin sang risgo sa pag-angkon sang balatian sa colon kag nagapa-maintain sang healthy weight.
english: Besides, the high fiber content of watermelon skin reduces the risk of developing colon diseases and maintains a healthy weight.

text: Ang panit sang sandiya suno sa nutritionist ang mahimo ilakot sa nanuhay-tuhay nga potahe, kag pwede man himuon nga shake ukon juice.
english: Watermelon rind, according to nutritionists, can be added to a variety of dishes, and can also be made into a shake or juice.

text: Magataas naman ang presyo sang gasolina subong nga semana, ini na ang ika-pito nga sunod-sunod nga semana nga nagtaas ini.
english: Gasoline prices will rise this week, the seventh consecutive week.

text: Samtang, ika-siyam naman nga sunod-sunod nga semana ang pagtaas para presyo sa diesel kag sa kerosene.
english: Meanwhile, the price of diesel and kerosene increased for the ninth consecutive week.

text:
Gasolina-magataas sang P0.60Diesel- magataas sang P1.20Kerosene-magataas sang P1.20

Epektibo ini las sais buwas nga adlaw sang Martes, Pebrero 24

Una na nga nag-project ang Department of Energy–Oil Industry Management Bureau (DOE-OIMB) sang pagtaas sang produktong petrolyo bangud sa geopolitical tensions kag supply expectations.
english:
Gasoline-to rise by P0.60 Diesel- to rise by P1.20 Kerosene-to rise by P1.20

It is effective at 6:00 pm tomorrow, Tuesday, February 24

The Department of Energy–Oil Industry Management Bureau (DOE-OIMB) had earlier projected an increase in petroleum products due to geopolitical tensions and supply expectations.

text: Nakatalana nga dagdagan sang mga subpoena sa masunod nga semana sanday Senador Jinggoy Estrada kag anay Senador Bong Revilla may kaangtanan sa mga kaso nga plunder batok sa ila bangud sa ginapahayag kickback gikan sa mga flood control project.
english: Senator Jinggoy Estrada and former Senator Bong Revilla are scheduled to face additional subpoenas next week in connection with plunder cases against them for alleged kickbacks from flood control projects.

text: Ini nga tikang ang kabahin sang pagsugod sang imbestigasyon sang Department of Justice agud mahibaluan kun may yara sing nagakaigo nga ebidensya agud nga mapasaka ang kaso sa korte, matapos nga ini ang nag-agi na sa fact-finding sang National Bureau of Investigation kag ginrepaso sang Office of the Ombudsman.
english: The move is part of the launch of an investigation by the Department of Justice to determine if there is sufficient evidence to prosecute the case, after it has already undergone fact-finding by the National Bureau of Investigation and review by the Office of the Ombudsman.

text: Suno sa DOJ, ang ginaalegar nga ilegal nga pagtipon sang manggad sang duha ka akusado ang naglab-ot sa maosbra ₱50 Million kag indi lamang ini natabo sa probinsya sang Bulacan kundi pati sa nagkalain-lain nga rehiyon sa bilog nga pungsod.
english: According to the DOJ, the alleged illegal accumulation of wealth by the two defendants amounted to more than ₱50 million and occurred not only in Bulacan province but also in various regions nationwide.

text: May yara man sang mga anay opisyal sang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) nga nagpahayag nga may ginpanagtag nga daku nga kantidad sang kwarta nga naghalin sa mga proyekto sa flood control, nga ginaalegar ginpadala sa balay ni Revilla.
english: There are also former officials of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) who said that there was a distribution of large sums of money that came from flood control projects, which were allegedly sent to Revilla's house.

text: Sa pihak sini, hugot nga ginpanginwala ni Revilla ang tanan nga alegasyon, samtang gintawag naman ni Senador Estrada nga baseless ukon wala sing basehan ang mga akusasyon batok sa iya.
english: Meanwhile, Revilla strongly denied all the allegations, while Senator Estrada called the accusations against him baseless.

text: Nagturong ang mata sang isa ka walo ka bulan nga lapsag matapos ginbakol sang iya lola sa Camarines Sur.
english: An eight-month-old baby lost his eyesight after being beaten by his grandmother in Camarines Sur.

text: Suno sa impormasyon, naospital ang bata matapos ginkombulsyon kasunod sang pagbakol sang iya lola bangud nga wala ini nagauntat sa paghibi.
english: According to reports, the child was hospitalized after suffering a convulsion following his grandmother's beating because he did not stop crying.

text: Nag-angkon ini sang mga lagob sa lawas kag ginabulong subong sa ospital.
english: He sustained bruises on his body and is currently being treated at the hospital.

text: Nagagwa sa imbestigasyon nga wala ang ginikanan sang bata sang natabo ang insidente.
english: Investigation revealed that the child's parents were not present when the incident occurred.

text: Ginaimbestigaran na sang otoridad ang lola sang bata.
english: Authorities are investigating the child's grandmother.

text: Naglunsar ang Government Service Insurance System (GSIS) sang bag-o nga microloan program nga ginatawag nga “Ginhawa Go” para sa mga empleyado sang gobyerno.
english: The Government Service Insurance System (GSIS) has launched a new microloan program called “Ginhawa Go” for government employees.

text: Ginatuyo sang programa nga mahatagan sang madasig kag masarangan nga pautang ang mga miyembro sa oras sang kinahanglanon.
english: The program aims to provide members with quick and affordable loans in times of need.

text: Sa sini nga programa, ang mga kwalipikado nga miyembro sang GSIS ang sarang makapangutang halin ₱1,000 tubtob ₱50,000.
english: Under this program, eligible GSIS members can borrow from ₱1,000 to ₱50,000.

text: Ang mga short-term loan nga tubtob ₱4,000 sarang mabayaran sa sulod sang 30, 60, ukon 90 ka adlaw, samtang ang mas mataas nga kantidad halin ₱5,000 tubtob ₱50,000 ang hulugan halin tatlo (3) tubtob 24 ka bulan, nga may interes nga 6% tubtob 7% kada tuig.
english: Short-term loans of up to ₱4,000 can be repaid in 30, 60, or 90 days, while higher amounts from ₱5,000 to ₱50,000 are in installments from three (3) to 24 months, with an interest rate of 7% to 6% per annum.

text: Kaupod man sa programa ang insurance nga maga-cover sang nabilin nga balance sang utang kun magtaliwan ang borrower, basta updated ang iya account.
english: The program also includes insurance that will cover the remaining balance of the loan if the borrower passes away, as long as his or her account is updated.

text: Suno kay Frederick D. Go, makabulig ini nga programa agud malikawan sang mga empleyado sang gobyerno ang pagpalapit sa mga nagapautang nga may mataas nga interes.
english: According to Frederick D. Go, this program will help government employees avoid approaching lenders with high interest rates.

text: Ang aplikasyon ginahimo lamang paagi sa GSIS Touch app kag automatic nga ginakaltas sa sweldo ang bayad sa utang
english: The application is made only through the GSIS Touch app and the loan payment is automatically deducted from the salary

text: Nagpahanumdom si Most Rev.
english: Most Rev. Fr.

text: Midyphil B. Billones, Arsobispo sang Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral sang matuod nga kahulugan sang Palm Sunday ukon Domingo de Ramos.
english: Midyphil B. Billones, Archbishop of Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral of the true meaning of Palm Sunday or Domingo de Ramos.

text: Ini nga indi dapat malipatan sang Kristiyanong katilingban ang dako nga sakripisyo nga ginbuhat ni Hesus para sa kaluwasan sang mga tawo.
english: This is that the Christian community should not forget the great sacrifice that Jesus made for the salvation of mankind.

text:
Sa iya homily kaina sang aga, ginpunto sini ang importansya sang paghinulsol kag pag-reflect sang tagsa ka tumuluo sa ila mga sala, ilabi na sa pagsugod sang Holy Week nga ginatawag man sini nga “the holiest of all weeks.”

Suno kay Billones, ang pagsakripisyo ni Hesus nagapakita sang iya paghigugma sa katawhan nga asta sa iya kamatayon gindumdum sini ang iya pagpalangga sa iya mga anak.
english:
In his homily this morning, he pointed out the importance of repentance and reflection of each believer on their sins, especially at the beginning of Holy Week which he also called “the holiest of all weeks.”

According to Billones, Jesus' sacrifice shows his love for mankind that until his death he remembered his love for his children.

text: Gin-agda man niya ang mga tumuluo nga ini nga tyempo, tion agud maghinulsol kag paghibalo sa kayo sang Diyos sa katawhan.
english: He also invited the faithful that this time is a time to repent and know God's goodness to mankind.

text: Nagpangabay man si Billones nga ang tagsa ka Kristiyano makapamalandong kag makabatyag sang matuod nga kahulugan sang sakripisyo ni Kristo samtang ginasaulog ang sini nga semana.
english: Billones also asked that every Christian reflect and feel the true meaning of Christ's sacrifice while celebrating this week.

text: Ka-Bombo, mahilig ka bala magkaon sang mantikaon nga pagkaon kaangay sang french fries?
english: Ka-Bombo, do you like to eat greasy food like french fries?

text: Maghalong bangud mahimo maapektuhan ang imo performance sa kama.
english: Be careful as your performance in bed may be affected.

text: Suno sa Medical Daily, ang mga trans fats nga makit-an sa fried foods ang amat-amat nga nagabuhin sang male kag female libido.
english: According to Medical Daily, trans fats found in fried foods gradually reduce male and female libido.

text: Ini man ang makatuga sang abnormal sperm production sa lalaki kag nagatuga man sang problema sa female gestation.
english: It can also cause abnormal sperm production in males and also cause problems in female gestation.

text: Gani kun mahimo pa lang, likawan ang mga pagkaon nga ginprito kag madamo sang mantika ilabi na sa panyapon antes kamo maghulid sang imo nga partner.
english: So if possible, avoid fried and fatty foods especially for dinner before you have sex with your partner.

text: Napaslawan ang Filipina Tennis Star nga si Alex Eala sa iya hampang sa semifinals sang ASB Classic sa Auckland, New Zealand.
english: Filipina Tennis Star Alex Eala lost her match in the semifinals of the ASB Classic in Auckland, New Zealand.

text: Nalutos si Eala sang Chinese player nga si Wang Xinyu sa score nga 7-5, 5-7, 4-6.
english: Eala was defeated by Chinese player Wang Xinyu 7-5, 5-7, 4-6.

text:
Nagpost naman si Eala pagkatapos sang hampang sa iya social media account nga may caption nga “’ So close yet so far.”

Nagpasalamat naman ini sa tournament hosts kag sa siyudad sang Auckland sa mainit nga pagbaton sa iya.
english:
Eala posted after the game on his social media account with the caption “’ So close yet so far.”

He thanked the tournament hosts and the city of Auckland for the warm welcome.

text: Tuman ang kalipay ni “Star for All Seasons” Vilma Santos-Recto matapos nga naangkon sini liwat ang ika- 10 sini nga Best Actress award sa ginpatigayon nga 41st Philippine Movie Press Club Star Awards for Movie.
english: “Star for All Seasons” Vilma Santos-Recto is very happy after she won her 10th Best Actress award at the 41st Philippine Movie Press Club Star Awards for Movie.

text:
Ang ini nga award nabaton niya bangud sa performance sini bilang aktres sa iya pelikula nga “Uninvited.”

Suno pa sa beterana nga aktres nga mabug-at sa gihapon ang iya nga katungdanan bisan pila na ka dekada ini sa industriya nga nagatrabaho.
english:
She received this award for her performance as an actress in her film “Uninvited.”

The veteran actress said that her responsibilities are still heavy even though she has been working in the industry for decades.

text: Madamo naman sa iya mga fans ang nagrekomendar nga himuon siya nga National Artist apang wala na naghatag sang komento ang beterana nga aktres natuhoy sa nasambit nga pasidungog.
english: Many of her fans recommended that she be made a National Artist but the veteran actress did not comment on the award.

text: Suno pa sa iya nga tuman na kadamo ang blessings nga iya nabaton nga tuman gid ang iya nga pagpasalamat sa Ginuo.
english: He said he has received so many blessings that he is very grateful to the Lord.

text: Ginkumpirmar man sini nga may ginapreparahan siya nga bag- o nga pelikula.
english: He also confirmed that he is preparing a new film.

text: ANG FILIPINAS isa sa duha ka pungsod, upod ang Vatican City sa diin nagapuyo ang Roman Catholic pope, kon diin indi tugot ang diborsyo.
english: THE PHILIPPINES is one of two countries, along with Vatican City where the Roman Catholic pope lives, where divorce is not allowed.

text: Ang tugot lang diri ang Legal Separation kag Annulment.
english: Only Legal Separation and Annulment are allowed here.

text: Sa Legal Separation gabulagay ang mag-asawa apang indi makapakasal liwat.
english: In Legal Separation, the couple separates but cannot remarry.

text: Sa Annulment lubos ang pagbulagay sang mag-asawa kag pwede na sila liwat magpakasal.
english: Annulment is a complete separation of the couple and they can remarry.

text: Sa mag-asawa nga luyag na tapuson sing permanente ang ila pag-upod tungod indi na maantos pa ang pag-upod nila, daku ugaling nga problema ini tungod magasto kaayo kag sa kabudlay sang proseso sang Annulment, paagi sa civil court man ukon sa Church Tribunal.
english: For couples who want to end their marriage permanently because they can no longer bear it, it is a big problem because of the high cost and difficulty of the Annulment process, whether through the civil court or the Church Tribunal.

text: Gani ginhandom sang Kamara (House of Representatives) nga iduso ang Absolute Divorce, nga katulad sa Annulment ma-permanente ang pagbugras sang pag-asawahay apang sa indi magasto kag indi mabudlay kaayo nga proseso, labi na gid para sa mga kubos sa pangabuhi nga mag-asawa.
english: Therefore, the House of Representatives wanted to propose Absolute Divorce, which, like Annulment, would permanently dissolve the marriage but in a less expensive and less difficult process, especially for the poor couples.

text: Sunu sa De Borja Lamorena Duano and Navarro Law Offices (Philippines), Ang gasto sa civil court pwede maglab-ut sa 300 tubtub 600 ka libo ka pesos kon ang manukot amo ang law firm.
english: According to De Borja Lamorena Duano and Navarro Law Offices (Philippines), the cost of civil court can reach 300 to 600 thousand pesos if the collector is the law firm.

text: Sa kaso sang solo practitioner, sa aton nahibal-an sa kaso sang isa ka himata, acceptance fee pa lang P100,000 na.
english: In the case of a solo practitioner, as far as we know in the case of a relative, the acceptance fee is P100,000.

text: Wala kita ugaling ihibalo kon ano ka daku ang gastuhon sa Church Annulment.
english: We do not know, however, how much the Church Annulment will cost.

text: Ang kadugay sang pag-proseso galab-ut naman sa 2-4 ka tuig bag-o mahusgaran ang civil court Annulment, samtang sa  Church Diocesan Tribunal pwede ini magdugay tubtub 10 anyos tungod ga-involve pa ini sang multiple trials.
english: The processing time is 2-4 years before the civil court Annulment is judged, while in the Church Diocesan Tribunal it can take up to 10 years because it involves multiple trials.

text:
***

Problema man ini tungod isa kita ka Demokrasyahon nga pungsod, kon diin ginarespeto gid ang tindug sang mayoriya.
english:
***

This is also a problem because we are a democratic country, where the position of the majority is highly respected.

text: Mga 80 porsyento man sang mga pumuluyo mga katoliko, nga sa pagtudlo sang Simbahan ang sinumpaan sa kasal indi lang sa tunga sang mag-asawa kag sosyedad kundi sa atubangan sang Diyos mismo, nga indi dapat lahog-lahugan lang.
english: About 80 percent of the population is also Catholic, and the Church teaches that the marriage vow is not only between the couple and society but before God himself, which should not be taken lightly.

text: Tungod sini, ang una nga attempt sa pagtulod sang Absolute Divorce Bill ginhimo ini nga may pag-ugyon sa Simbahan.
english: For this reason, the first attempt to push the Absolute Divorce Bill was made with the approval of the Church.

text: Gani ginpasar sang Kamara sadtong 2018 ang HB 6779: “An Act Recognizing the Civil Effects of Church Annulment Decrees”.
english: So the House of Representatives in 2018 passed HB 6779: “An Act Recognizing the Civil Effects of Church Annulment Decrees”.

text: Ugaling gin-reject ini sang Senado tungod labag ini sa Principle of Separation of Church and State nga ginapatuman sang aton Konstitusyon.
english: However, the Senate rejected it because it violated the Principle of Separation of Church and State enforced by our Constitution.

text: Ikaduha na nga attempt ang HB 9349: “The Absolute Divorce bill”, nga ginpasar sang Kamara sadtong Mayo 22, 2024 sa pagpanguna ni Rep.
english: This is the second attempt of HB 9349: “The Absolute Divorce bill”, which was passed by the House on May 22, 2024 under the leadership of Rep.

text: Edcel Lagman sa “claim” nga ang “survey” nila nagasiling nga sobra 50 porsyento sang mga pumuluyo sugot sini.
english: Edcel Lagman on the claim that their survey says that more than 50 percent of the people agree with it.

text: Tungod mapahapos kuno sini ang pagbulagay sang mag-asawa nga wala na paglaum nga magpadayon pa sa pag-upod.
english: Because it will make it easier for couples to separate without any hope of continuing together.

text: Ginapaabot nga maaktuhan ini sang Senado sa Agosto sang sining tuig.
english: The Senate is expected to act on it in August this year.

text: Gapakita ining kuno survey result nga sila mga “practical catholics” nga luyag sang “workable” nga solusyon paagi sa Absolute Divorce, nga mabaton sang ila personal nga konsyensya agud magpabilin gihapon nga katapo sang Simbahan Catolica.
english: This supposed survey result shows that they are “practical catholics” who want a “workable” solution through Absolute Divorce, which is acceptable to their personal conscience in order to remain members of the Catholic Church.

text:
***

Sa idalom sang HB 9349, ang grounds sa Absolute Divorce “include physical violence or grossly abusive conduct directed against the petitioner or a child of the petitioner, drug addiction, habitual alcoholism, or chronic gambling, homosexuality, marital infidelity, and abandonment without justifiable cause for more than one year.”

Halos kapareho ini sa legal basis sang Church annulment ( Annulment, U.S. Conference of Catholic Bishops) sa idalom sang Canon Law, nga nagalista sang grounds for Annulment.
english:
***

Under HB 9349, the grounds in Absolute Divorce “include physical violence or grossly abusive conduct directed against the petitioner or a child of the petitioner, drug addiction, habitual alcoholism, or chronic gambling, homosexuality, marital infidelity, and abandonment for more than one reasonable cause without justifiable use.”

This is almost identical to the legal basis of Church annulment ( Annulment, U.S. Conference of Catholic Bishops) under Canon Law, which lists grounds for Annulment.

text:
Nagalakip ini sang “psychological incapacity, fraud, force or intimidation, insanity, mental illness, lack of consent, a petitioner never intended to be permanently married or faithful, and that substance abuse prevented them from consenting to a lifelong marriage.”

Bahin sa galastuhon sang mga petitioners sa Absolute Divorce, ang Family Court maga-waive sang balayran sa filing fees kag iban nga balayran para sa mga court-assisted petitioners nga tagaan man sing counsejo de oficio.
english:
These include “psychological incapacity, fraud, force or intimidation, insanity, mental illness, lack of consent, a petitioner never intended to be permanently married or faithful, and that substance abuse prevented them from consenting to a lifelong marriage.”

Regarding the expenses of petitioners in Absolute Divorce, the Family Court will waive filing fees and other fees for court-assisted petitioners who will also be given counsejo de oficio.

text: Sa bahin sang Simbahan, sadtong 2014 ginpanugyan ni Pope Francis nga ang Roman Catholic Church Annulment dapat “simpler, faster, and cheaper – (kag) possibly free for catholics seeking to end their marriages”.
english: For the Church, in 2014 Pope Francis suggested that Roman Catholic Church Annulment should be “simpler, faster, and cheaper – (and) possibly free for catholics seeking to end their marriages”.

text: Wala kita ugaling sing ihibalo kon ano ang natabo sa sining panugyan ni Pope Francis.
english: We do not know, however, what happened to this advice of Pope Francis.

text:
***

Personally, upod kita sa Annulment sang kasal nga mapahapos sang civil court kag sang Simbahan, labi na para sa mga kubos nga mag-asawa nga wala na sing paglaum nga mag-upod pa.
english:
***

Personally, we are with the Annulment of marriage that can be facilitated by the civil court and the Church, especially for the poor couples who have no hope of being together again.

text: In fact, kontra kita sa diborsyo tungod sa kabalaka naton sa  mga kabataan.
english: In fact, we are against divorce because of our concern for children.

text: Sunu sa survey sa U.S., ginapahapos sang diborsyo ang pagluib (cheating) sa tunga sang mag-asawa – 40% sang asawa kag 60% sang bana – nga nagatuga sang madamo nga broken homes nga luyag gid naton malikawan paagi sa mabakod nga pag-asawahay./PN
english: According to a survey in the U.S., divorce facilitates cheating between spouses – 40% by the wife and 60% by the husband – which creates many of the broken homes that we would like to avoid through strong marriages./PN

text: Nagtililipon ang grupo sang mga hubog agud i-protesta ang mataas nga presyo sang ilimnon sa Ghana.
english: The group of drunks gathered to protest the high price of liquor in Ghana.

text: Suno sa Ghana Drunkard Association nagpatigayon sila sang hublag sa syudad sang Accra agud hingyuon sa gobyerno nga pamatian ang ila sentimento kag hatagan sang solusyon ang nagataas nga presyo sang mga ilimnon.
english: According to the Ghana Drunkard Association they held a rally in the city of Accra to urge the government to listen to their sentiments and provide a solution to the rising prices of beverages.

text: Suno kay Moses Onyah nga presidente sang grupo, mabatyagan sang minilyon nila nga myembro ang 15 percent nga pagtaas sa presyo sang ilimnon.
english: According to Moses Onyah, president of the group, millions of their members will feel the 15 percent increase in alcohol prices.

text: Naghatag sang tatlo ka semana nga ultimatum ang grupo sa gobyerno nga masolusyunan ang isyu kag nagpanawagan sang bulig sang ila anay Presidente nga si John Dramani Mahama.
english: The group gave a three-week ultimatum to the government to resolve the issue and called for the help of their former President John Dramani Mahama.

text: Apisar makahalam-ot, ang Ghana Drunkards Association (GDA) ang isa sa mga pinakaki­lala nga asosasyon sa Ghana, nga may kapin t 6.6 million members.
english: Although ironic, the Ghana Drunkards Association (GDA) is one of the most well-known associations in Ghana, with over t 6.6 million members.

text: Nagakabalaka ang Defense Secretary sang Pilipinas sa damlag nga military drills sang China sa palibot sang Taiwan, bangud nga mahimo ini makaguba sang kalinong kag stability sang rehiyon, ilabi na sa isla sang Taiwan nga gina-angkon sang Beijing nga iya teritoryo.
english: The Philippine Defense Secretary is concerned about China's upcoming military drills around Taiwan, as they could undermine regional peace and stability, especially on the island of Taiwan, which Beijing claims as its territory.

text: Suno kay Defense Secretary Gilbert Teodoro, ang mga tikang sang China kag sang ila coast guard nagadugang sang tensyon sa mahina nga geopolitical nga sitwasyon.
english: According to Defense Secretary Gilbert Teodoro, the moves by China and its coast guard are increasing tensions in a fragile geopolitical situation.

text: Naglunsar ang China sang mga missiles kag nagdeploy sang madamo nga fighter jets, navy ships, kag coast guard vessels sa palibot sang isla sang Taiwan sa nagliligad nga mga inadlaw antes magtakop ang tuig 2025.
english: China has launched missiles and deployed numerous fighter jets, navy ships, and coast guard vessels around the island of Taiwan in recent days before the end of 2025.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagsugod ang tensyon sang 1949 sang nagtakop ang Chinese Civil War, ang Communist China nagkontrol sang mainland China samtang ang demokratiko nga Taiwan nagpadayon bilang hiwalay nga gobyerno, apang ginapahayag sang Beijing nga ini parte sang ila teritoryo kag nagbanta sang paggamit sang pwersa agud makuha ini.
english: Tensions began in 1949 when the Chinese Civil War ended, Communist China controlled mainland China while democratic Taiwan continued as a separate government, but Beijing claimed it was part of its territory and threatened the use of force to take it.

text: Ginpahayag ni Teodoro nga ang amo nga mga aktibidad may dako nga epekto, indi lamang sa relasyon sang Taiwan kag China kundi pati man sa malapad nga Indo-Pacific nga komunidad, kag nagapahanumdom nga kinahanglan sundon ang international law.
english: Teodoro noted that such activities have a significant impact, not only on Taiwan-China relations but also on the broader Indo-Pacific community, and reminded that international law must be followed.

text: Sa karun, wala pa sang opisyal nga deklarasyon halin sa Beijing nga natapos na ang ila military drills.
english: At present, there is no official declaration from Beijing that its military drills have ended.

text: Nagdangat sa 3.06 milyon US Dollar ang balor sang ube kag mga produkto nga himo sa ube nga na-export halin sa Pilipinas sang 2025, bangud sa mataas nga global demand sa natural nga pagkaon, Asian flavors, kag iban pa nga gamit sa pagkaon.
english: The value of ube and ube-based products exported from the Philippines will reach 3.06 million US Dollars in 2025, due to the high global demand for natural foods, Asian flavors, and other food items.

text: Suno sa Department of Trade and Industry (DTI), nag-umwad ang export sang processed ube pareho sang powder, puree, halaya, kag flavor extracts, kun sa diin nagapanguna ang merkado sang Middle East, Estados Unidos, United Kingdom, kag Italy.
english: According to the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI), exports of processed ube such as powder, puree, halaya, and flavor extracts have grown, with the Middle East, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Italy leading the market.

text: Maobserbaran man ang mataas nga interes sang mga foreign companies sa paggamit sang ube sa ice cream, baked goods, confectionery, specialty beverages, kag mga ready-to-eat desserts.
english: The high interest of foreign companies in using ube in ice cream, baked goods, confectionery, specialty beverages, and ready-to-eat desserts can also be observed.

text: Paathag ni DTI Secretary Cristina Roque nga ginapakita sang pag-export sang ube ang kapasidad sang pungsod nga himuon nga value-added kag competitive ang tradisyonal nga produkto nga agrikultura, kag nagahatag ini sang oportunidad sa mga Filipino exporters kag mangunguma.
english: DTI Secretary Cristina Roque explained that the export of ube shows the country's capacity to make traditional agricultural products value-added and competitive, and it provides opportunities for Filipino exporters and farmers.

text: Ginpabaskog sang DTI ang suporta sa sektor paagi sa pagpaayo sang kalidad, pagpabakod sang supply chains, kag bulig sa marketing agud masiguro ang sustainable nga kompetisyon sa international market.
english: The DTI has stepped up support to the sector through quality improvement, strengthening supply chains, and marketing assistance to ensure sustainable competition in the international market.

english: The 12 Miss Iloilo 2026 candidates visited Bombo Radyo station to share their advocacy.

english: On Saturday, the Filipino-American pair will face third-seeded Chinese pair Yifan Xu and Zhaoxuan Yang.

text: Ginhilway sang Thailand ang 18 ka mga soldado sang Cambodia nga gin-detain halin pa sang bulan sang Hulyo 2025 matapos ang bag-o nga kasugtanan sang ceasefire sang duha ka pungsod.
english: Thailand has released 18 Cambodian soldiers who have been detained since July 2025 after a new ceasefire agreement between the two countries.

text: Natigayon ang pag-turn over sang 18 ka mga soldado kahapon nga adlaw paagi sa isa ka border checkpoint.
english: The turn over of 18 soldiers was achieved yesterday through a border checkpoint.

text: Ginpangunahan sang International Committee of the Red Cross ang pag-release sang mga soldado, nga ginpahayag bilang isa ka importante nga tikang agud mabalik ang kalinong sa tunga sang duha ka pungsod.
english: The International Committee of the Red Cross led the release of the soldiers, which was heralded as an important step to restore peace between the two countries.

text: Suno sa Cambodia, halos lima ka bulan nga gin-detain ang mga soldado, samtang ginpahayag sang Thailand nga gintratar nila ini suno sa international humanitarian law.
english: Cambodia said the soldiers were detained for nearly five months, while Thailand said it treated them in accordance with international humanitarian law.

text: Matandaan nga nagsugod ang mga engkwentro sa tunga sang Thailand kag Cambodia sang nagligad nga bulan kag nagpadayon sang halos 20 ka adlaw, nga nagresulta sa madamo nga napatay kag nag-evacuate nga mga sibilyan.
english: It can be recalled that clashes between Thailand and Cambodia began last month and continued for nearly 20 days, resulting in numerous deaths and evacuation of civilians.

text: Bilang kabahin sang ceasefire, nagsugot ang Thailand nga hilwayon ang mga soldado matapos magpadayon ang kalinong sa sulod sang 72 ka oras, suno sa ila ginakasugtan.
english: As part of the ceasefire, Thailand agreed to release the soldiers after peace continues for 72 hours, according to mutual agreement.

english: Alex Eala and her American partner Iva Jovic defeated 7-time Grand Slam champion Venus Williams and former world no.
