text:
Ginbuylugan sang mga Ilonggo ang ginpatigayon nga Earth Hour kagab-i, Marso 28 nga nag-umpisa halin trenta minutos ang makaliad sa takna nga alas otso sa gab-i tubtob trenta minutos ang makaligad sa takna nga alas nwebe sa gab-i.

Naglab-ot naman sa kapin 700 ka mga indibidwal ang nagbuylog sa ika-apat nga tuig sang “Ligum-Dulom” ukon Earth Hour celebration sa Iloilo Provincial Government bilang kabahin sang kampanya para sa pag-amlig sang kalibutan kag pagkinot sang enerhiya.
english:
Ilonggos participated in the Earth Hour last night, March 28, which started from 30 minutes past 8 pm until 30 minutes past 9 pm.

More than 700 individuals joined the fourth year of the “Ligum-Dulom” or Earth Hour celebration at the Iloilo Provincial Government as part of the campaign to protect the earth and save energy.

text: Nagbuylog man sa Earth hour ang mga commercial establishments sa Distrito sang Mandurriao, Iloilo City, nga nagpakita man sang ila suporta sa nasambit nga inisyatibo.
english: Commercial establishments in Mandurriao District, Iloilo City also joined the Earth hour, showing their support for the initiative.

text: Sa amo nga okasyon, ginpangabay ang publiko nga magpatay sang mga non-essential lights ukon indi man kinahanglanon nga suga sang isa ka oras.
english: On the occasion, the public was asked to turn off non-essential lights for one hour.

text: Ini nga buluhaton ang nagasimbolo sang pag-ugyon sang pumuluyo para sa pagkonserbar sang kuryente.
english: This work symbolizes the consensus of the people for the conservation of electricity.

text: Nahibaluan nga gin-engganyo man ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., ang tanan nga mga Pilipino nga mag-upod sa pag-obserbar sang Earth Hour kahapon nga adlaw.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. also urged all Filipinos to join in the observance of Earth Hour yesterday.

text: Suno sa presidente, tion ato agud binag-binagon sang mga tawo ang ginapangatubang sang kalibutan nga climate change kag iban pa nga environmental issues.
english: The president said it was a time for people to consider the world's climate change and other environmental issues.

text: Lakip man ang paggamit sang insakto sa kuryente kag petroleum products sa tunga sang nagapadayun nga krisis sa Middle East kun sa diin apektado ang Pilipinas.
english: It also includes the proper use of electricity and petroleum products amid the ongoing crisis in the Middle East where the Philippines is affected.

text: Madumduman nga nagdeklarar si President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., sang nagligad nga Marso 24, nga yara na sa idalom sang national energy emergency ang pungsod matapos ang padayun nga pagsaka sang presyo sang mga produktong petrolyo.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. declared on March 24 that the country is under a national energy emergency following the continuous rise in the price of petroleum products.

text: Gintu-ad sang isa ka military medical officer nga kalabanan sa mga katapo sang Philippine Army ang nagasuprer sang hypertension ukon high blood.
english: A military medical officer admitted that most members of the Philippine Army suffer from hypertension or high blood pressure.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Major Angela Mae Mabalot, Medical Officer sang 3rd Infantry Division sang Philippine Army, iya ginpahayag nga ang hypertension ang isa lamang sa mga ‘common’ nga condition nga ginabatyag sang katapo sang Philippine Army.
english: Major Angela Mae Mabalot, Medical Officer of the 3rd Infantry Division of the Philippine Army, said hypertension is one of the common conditions suffered by members of the Philippine Army.

text: Suno kay Mabalot, isa sa factor kon ngaa nagasuprer ang mga suldado sang amo nga sakit bangud man sa nature sang ila trabaho.
english: According to Mabalot, one of the factors why soldiers suffer from the disease is due to the nature of their work.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga kalabanan sa suldado nga operating officers ang nagakaon sang ‘preserved food’ kaangay sang mga can foods nga masami man ginabalon kon sila ang may misyon.
english: He also said that most of the military operating officers eat preserved food such as canned foods that are often packed when they have missions.

text: Limitado man sila sa malimpyo nga tubig-ilimnon kag kon ano lamang ang available, amo lang man na ang ila mainom.
english: They are also limited to clean drinking water and drink only what is available.

text: Rason man nga malapit ang mga suldado nga mag-angkon sang hypertension ukon high blood.
english: It is also a reason why soldiers are close to developing hypertension or high blood pressure.

text: Tatlo ang ginbawian sang kabuhi sa natabo nga massacre sa Brgy.
english: Three people were killed in the massacre in Brgy.

text: Baloc, Sto.
english: Baloc, Sto.

text: Domingo, ­Nueva Ecija sang Sabado.
english: Sunday, Nueva Ecija sang Saturday.

text: Ang mga biktima amo sanday Romulo ­Sangalang, 82, negosyante, kag residente sang Mabalacat, ­Pampanga; Theodore Sangalang, driver, residente sang Guimba, Nueva Ecija;kag kabulig nga si Rose Yuson, residente sang Brgy.
english: The victims were identified as Romulo Sangalang, 82, businessman, and resident of Mabalacat, Pampanga; Theodore Sangalang, driver, resident of Guimba, Nueva Ecija; and assistant Rose Yuson, resident of Brgy.

text: Baloc, Sto.
english: Baloc, Sto.

text: Domingo sa amo nga probinsya.
english: Domingo in the province.

text: Ginpahayag nga ginsulod sang mga armado nga lalaki ang mga biktima sa ila quarters kag ginpangluthang kag ginpangbuno.
english: The armed men reportedly brought the victims into their quarters and shot and stabbed them.

text: Nakit-an ang lawas sang negosyante nga may higot nga alambre sa liog kag tiil; nakagapos naman ang kamot kag may igo sang bala sa ulo ang driver; kag may mga igo man sang bala ang kabulig.
english: The businessman's body was found with a wire around his neck and legs; the driver was handcuffed and shot in the head; and the assistant also had gunshot wounds.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon sang otoridad sa amo nga hitabo.
english: Authorities are still investigating the incident.

text: LAKIP sa mga Outstanding Filipinos sa Literature si Peter Solis Nery.
english: Peter Solis Nery is one of the Outstanding Filipinos in Literature.

text: Bugal ini siya sang Dumangas, Iloilo.
english: He is the pride of Dumangas, Iloilo.

text: Poet, fictionist, author, kag filmmaker.
english: Poet, fictionist, author, and filmmaker.

text: Sa iya pagsulat sa English, Filipino, kag Hiligaynon, nakatapos siya sulat sang at least 35 ka libro kag sang mga screenplay.
english: Writing in English, Filipino, and Hiligaynon, he has written at least 35 books and screenplays.

text: Nagsulat man siya, produce, kag direct sang full-length feature film sa Hiligaynon, ang Gugma sa Panahon sang Bakunawa (Love in the Time of the Bakunawa), nga isa ka finalist sa 1st Sineng Pambansa National Film Competition sang Film Development Council of the Philippines.
english: He also wrote, produced, and directed a full-length feature film in Hiligaynon, Love in the Time of the Bakunawa, which was a finalist in the 1st Sineng Pambansa National Film Competition of the Film Development Council of the Philippines.

text: Ginpadunggan siya sang UP Distinguished Alumnus Award in Championing Hiligaynon Literature and Regional Culture sadtong 2023.
english: He was honored with the UP Distinguished Alumnus Award in Championing Hiligaynon Literature and Regional Culture in 2023.

text: Multi-awarded si Nery sa madamo nga ginpasakupan nga mga prestigious literary contests.
english: Nery is multi-awarded in many prestigious literary contests.

text: Inducted gani siya sa Palanca Awards Hall of fame sadtong 2012.
english: He was even inducted into the Palanca Awards Hall of Fame in 2012.

text: Lakip sa iya mga award-winning short stories amo ang masunod: Lirio (1998); Ang Pangayaw (2000); Ang Kapid (2006); Candido (2007); Donato Bugtot (2011); Si Padre Olan kag ang Dios (2013); kag Ang Milagro sa Ermita (2017).
english: Among his award-winning short stories are the following: Lirio (1998); The Stranger (2000); The Twin (2006); Candido (2007); Donato Bugtot (2011); Father Olan and God (2013); and The Miracle at the Hermitage (2017).

text:
NOTABLE HILIGAYNON WRITERS

* Graciano López Jaena (1856-1896) – journalist, orator, kag rebolusyonaryo halin sa Jaro, Iloilo City.
english:
NOTABLE HILIGAYNON WRITERS

* Graciano López Jaena (1856-1896) – journalist, orator, and revolutionary from Jaro, Iloilo City.

text: Kilala siya sa iya mga sinulatan sa La Solidaridad  kag sang satirical story nga Fray Botod.
english: He is known for his writings in La Solidaridad and the satirical story Fray Botod.

text: Isa siya sang aton national heroes.
english: He is one of our national heroes.

text: * Angel Magahum Sr.
english: * Angel Magahum Sr.

text: (1867–1931) – writer, editor kag composer.
english: (1867–1931) – writer, editor and composer.

text: Nag-compose sang Iloilo ang Banwa Ko.
english: My Town composed Iloilo.

text: Natawo sa Molo, Iloilo City.
english: Born in Molo, Iloilo City.

text: * Valente Cristóbal (1875–1945) – Hiligaynon playwright.
english: * Valente Cristóbal (1875–1945) – Hiligaynon playwright.

text: Natawo sa Polo, Bulacan (karon Valenzuela City), nagpuyo sa Iloilo City..
english: Born in Polo, Bulacan (now Valenzuela City), lives in Iloilo City..

text: * Magdalena Jalandoni (May 27, 1891– Sept.14, 1978) – novelist, playwright, short story writer, sculptor, painter, kag feminist.
english: * Magdalena Jalandoni (May 27, 1891– Sept.14, 1978) – novelist, playwright, short story writer, sculptor, painter, and feminist.

text: Natawo sa Jaro, Iloilo City.
english: Born in Jaro, Iloilo City.

text: Sadtong 1977, nagbaton siya halin sa gobyerno sang prestigious Republic Cultural Heritage Award tungod sang iya literary achievements.
english: In 1977, he received from the government the prestigious Republic Cultural Heritage Award for his literary achievements.

text: * Serapion C. Torre (1892–1942) – Hiligaynon litterateur, poet, novelist, zarzuela writer, kag playwright, kilala bilang  Father of Modern Hiligaynon Literature.
english: * Serapion C. Torre (1892–1942) – Hiligaynon litterateur, poet, novelist, zarzuela writer, and playwright, known as the Father of Modern Hiligaynon Literature.

text: Natawo sa Mandurriao, Iloilo City.
english: Born in Mandurriao, Iloilo City.

text: * Flavio Zaragoza y Cano (1892–1965) – lawyer, journalist, poet, kag poet-translator (from Spanish) nga ginkilala nga “Prince of Poets”.
english: * Flavio Zaragoza y Cano (1892–1965) – lawyer, journalist, poet, and poet-translator (from Spanish) known as the “Prince of Poets”.

text: * Delfin Gumban, natawo sa Pavia, Iloilo.
english: * Delfin Gumban, born in Pavia, Iloilo.

text: Katulad ni Zaragoza nagdaug man bilang “Batharing Mamalybay” sa sunod nga poetry contest nga ginsakdag sang Makinaugalingon Printing Press sa Iloilo sadtong 1926.
english: Like Zaragoza, he also won as “Batharing Mamalybay” in the next poetry contest sponsored by the Makinaugalingon Printing Press in Iloilo in 1926.

text: * Leoncio P. Deriada (1938-2019), natawo sa Barotac Viejo, Iloilo.
english: * Leoncio P. Deriada (1938-2019), born in Barotac Viejo, Iloilo.

text: Multi-awarded fictionist, poet, playwright kag professor emeritus of creative writing and literature sa UP Visayas, nga ginkilala bilang “Father of Contemporary West Visayan Literature”.
english: Multi-awarded fictionist, poet, playwright and professor emeritus of creative writing and literature at UP Visayas, recognized as the “Father of Contemporary West Visayan Literature”.

text: Elevated sa Palanca Hall of fame sadtong 2001.
english: Elevated to the Palanca Hall of fame in 2001.

text: * Quirino (Quin) Baterna (1938-2009), 1993 awardee for Hiligaynon Fiction bilang Pambansang Alagad ni Balagtas sa pagkilala sang UMPIL (Unyon ng mga Manunulat sa Pilipinas).
english: * Quirino (Quin) Baterna (1938-2009), 1993 awardee for Hiligaynon Fiction as the National Servant of Balagtas in recognition of the UMPIL (Unyon ng mga Manunulat sa Pilipinas).

text: Nangin judge sa HiligaynonSection sang 51st Don Palanca Memorial Awards for Literature.
english: He was a judge in the HiligaynonSection of the 51st Don Palanca Memorial Awards for Literature.

text: Nagsulat sang sobra isa ka libo ka mga binalaybay, malip-ut nga mga sugilanon, mga nobela kag mga artikulo sa magasin sang Yuhom kag Hiligaynon.
english: He wrote more than a thousand poems, short stories, novels and articles in Yuhom and Hiligaynon magazines.

text: * Atty. Ramon L. Muzones (1913–1992) – novelist, poet, kag essayist.
english: * Atty. Ramon L. Muzones (1913–1992) – novelist, poet, and essayist.

text: Natawo sa Miag-ao, Iloilo.
english: Born in Miag-ao, Iloilo.

text: Ginkilala (posthumously) bilang National Artist of the Philippines for Literature sadtong 2018.
english: Recognized (posthumously) as National Artist of the Philippines for Literature in 2018.

text: Tagbaton man sang Pambansang Alagad ni Balagtas award sang UMPIL (2014).
english: Also recipient of the National Servant of Balagtas award of UMPIL (2014).

text: Founder (1948) kag First President sang Sumakwelan Iloilo.
english: Founder (1948) and First President of Sumakwelan Iloilo.

text: Nakasulat sang sobra 60 ka matahum nga mga nobela sa Hiligaynon.
english: He has written more than 60 beautiful novels in Hiligaynon.

text: Ang Margosatubig isa sang 1946 novels ni Muzones, nga na-serialize sa Yuhum Magazine nga ginbalhag sang Diolosa Publishing House isa Iloilo City sadtong 1947.
english: Margosatubig is one of Muzones' 1946 novels, serialized in Yuhum Magazine published by Diolosa Publishing House in Iloilo City in 1947.

text: * Nilo P. Pamonag, fictionist kag poet nga nangin Iloilo judge.
english: * Nilo P. Pamonag, fictionist and poet who became an Iloilo judge.

text: UMPIL 2014 awardee bilang Pambansang Alagad ni Balagtas.
english: UMPIL 2014 awardee as National Servant of Balagtas.

text: * Conrado Saquian Norada (born 1921) – fictionist, lawyer, intelligence officer kag gobernador sang probinsya sang Iloilo halin 1969 tubtub 1986.
english: * Conrado Saquian Norada (born 1921) – fictionist, lawyer, intelligence officer and governor of Iloilo province from 1969 to 1986.

text: Co-founder kag editor sang Yuhum magazine.
english: Co-founder and editor of Yuhum magazine.

text: Natawo sa Miag-ao, Iloilo..
english: Born in Miag-ao, Iloilo..

text: Ginpadunggan bilang Pambansang Alagad ni Balagtas (Ilonggo fiction) sang UMPIL.
english: Honored as the National Servant of Balagtas (Ilonggo fiction) by UMPIL.

text:
NATIONAL ARTISTS FOR LITERATURE AND THE ARTS

* Atty. Ramon L. Muzones (1913–1992) – prolific novelist, poet, kag essayist.
english:
NATIONAL ARTISTS FOR LITERATURE AND THE ARTS

* Atty. Ramon L. Muzones (1913–1992) – prolific novelist, poet, and essayist.

text: Natawo sa Miagao, Iloilo.
english: Born in Miagao, Iloilo.

text: Ginkilala  (posthumously) bilang National Artist of the Philippines for Literature sadtong 2018.
english: Recognized  (posthumously) as National Artist of the Philippines for Literature in 2018.

text: * Jovita Flores Fuentes (1895 – 1978), Filipina soprano singer nga tumandok sang Capiz.
english: * Jovita Flores Fuentes (1895 – 1978), Filipina soprano singer native of Capiz.

text: Ginkilala bilang First Filipina nga National Artist for Music sadtong 1976, isa sang pila lang ka Filipina nga ginpadunggan sing international acclaim sa European opera scene.
english: Recognized as the First Filipina National Artist for Music in 1976, she is one of the few Filipinas to be honored with international acclaim on the European opera scene.

text: Segurado kita nga madamo pa sining notable nga mga Ilonggo sa patag sang Letters and Arts nga madiskubrihan naton sa padayon naton nga research.
english: We are sure that there are many more of these notable Ilonggos in the field of Letters and Arts that we will discover in our continued research.

text: Sa kakulangan sang panahon, wala na ugaling naton malab-ut sila sa natalana nga panahon sang aton research.
english: Due to time constraints, however, we were unable to reach them during the scheduled period of our research.

text: Sorry…Pero, kon may kahigayunan nga mahibal-an man ninyo sila, pahibalua lang ninyo ako kay pronto ipaggwa naton diri sa aton kolum./PN
english: Sorry...But, if you have a chance to know them, just let me know because we will soon publish it here in our column./PN

text: Sa Japan, may yara sang isa ka pinasahi nga serbisyo nga ginatawag nga Ikemeso Danshi.
english: In Japan, there is a special service called Ikemeso Danshi.

text: Ini nagatanyag sang emotional comfort paagi sa pag-hire sang gwapo nga lalaki nga mag-upod sa imo sa paglantaw sang masubo nga mga pelikula agud magpahid sang imo luha.
english: It offers emotional comfort by hiring a handsome man to accompany you to watch sad movies to wipe away your tears.

text: Ang Ikemeso Danshi naga-translate sa “handsome weeping boys” kag gindesinyo agud mag- promote sang emotional release ukon “tear therapy,” nga nagabulig sa mga kliyente nga magpautwas sang stress kag mabatyagan nga may nagasuporta sa ila nga tawo kag gwapo pa.
english: Ikemeso Danshi translates to “handsome weeping boys” and is designed to promote emotional release or “tear therapy,” which helps clients release stress and feel supported and handsome.

text: Nagpaguwa sang pahayag si US President Donald Trump nga indi sila sa mag-untat sa pagpang-atake sa Iran tubtub sa masunod nga semana.
english: US President Donald Trump has issued a statement saying they will not stop attacking Iran until next week.

text: Pahayag sini, mas pabaskugon pa sini ang ila pagpamomba.
english: He said it will intensify their bombing.

text: Suno naman kay Pete Hegseth, Secretary of Defense sang US, masobra 15,000 ka target ang halin sa Iran ang gin-atake na sang US kag Israel halin sang pagsugod sang gyera sang Pebrero 28.
english: US Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth said more than 15,000 targets from Iran have been attacked by the US and Israel since the war began on February 28.

text: Suno kay Hegseth, nagnubo na ang kapasidad sang Iran nga magbalos bangod madamo na nga missile, launcher kag drones ang nadula ukon naguba.
english: According to Hegseth, Iran’s capacity to retaliate has diminished because many of its missiles, launchers and drones have been lost or destroyed.

text: Samtang, ang bag-o nga Supreme Leader sang Iran nga si Mojtaba Khamenei napilasan man sa pag-atake kag may posibilidad suno sa Estados Unidos nga naka-angkon sang pilas sa iya nga nawong.
english: Meanwhile, Iran's new Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei was also wounded in the attack and the United States says he may have suffered a facial injury.

text: Matandaan nga nakapaguwa naman sang iya statement si Khamenei nga itimalos sini ang Iran apang wala ini sang audio ukon video nga makakumpirma sang reports kun napilasan gid man siya sa gyera.
english: Khamenei issued a statement saying he would take revenge on Iran but there was no audio or video to confirm reports if he was injured in the war.

text: Ang gyera sa Middle East ang nagbilin man sang problema sa world oil market bangud sang pagsirado sang Iran sa Strait of Hormuz nga isa sa pinaka-importante nga alagyan sang suplay sang krudo nga ginadala sa madamo nga mga pungsod.
english: The war in the Middle East has also left problems in the world oil market due to Iran's closure of the Strait of Hormuz, one of the most important supply routes for crude oil transported to many countries.

text: Kabug-usan nga 480 ka mga Pilipino ang nakatalana nga magapauli sa Pilipinas paagi sa chartered flight halin sa Fujairah, United Arab Emirates pakadto sa Manila subong nga adlaw sang Sabado, Marso 14.
english: A total of 480 Filipinos are scheduled to return to the Philippines via chartered flight from Fujairah, United Arab Emirates to Manila today, Saturday, March 14.

text: Ang nasambit nga flight ginpatigayon sang gobyerno sang Pilipinas sa pagpakig-coordinate kay John Rio, Labor Attaché sang Department of Migrant Workers (DMW), kag kay Ambrosio Brian Enciso, Consul General sang Philippine Consulate General sa Dubai.
english: The flight was conducted by the Philippine government in coordination with John Rio, Labor Attaché of the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW), and Ambrosio Brian Enciso, Consul General of the Philippine Consulate General in Dubai.

text: Sa kabilugan nga numero, 274 ka mga Overseas Filipino Workers (OFWs) kag ang ila nga mga dependent ang ginhanda para sa repatration sang Department of Migrant Workers.
english: A total of 274 Overseas Filipino Workers (OFWs) and their dependents were prepared for repatriation by the Department of Migrant Workers.

text: Samtang, 195 naman ka mga stranded nga mga Pilipino ang ginbuligan sang Philippine Consulate sa UAE.
english: Meanwhile, 195 stranded Filipinos were assisted by the Philippine Consulate in the UAE.

text: Lima ka kaso naman sang repatration ang gina-angutan sang mga indibidwal nga may ara sang medical condition nga nagakinahanglan sang bulig.
english: Five cases of repatriation were linked to individuals with medical conditions that required assistance.

text: Nagabinuligay naman ang mga Filipino organization sa United Arab Emirates sa pagpahibalo kag pagtipon sang mga Pilipino nga nagakinahanglan sang repatriation.
english: Filipino organizations in the United Arab Emirates are working together to inform and mobilize Filipinos in need of repatriation.

text: Personal naman nga nakigkita si DMW Secretary Hans Cacdac sa mga lider sang Filipino community agud mapahayag ang iya pagpasalamat sa ila nga operasyon kag suporta sa pagbulig sa mga naapektuhan nga mga Pilipino.
english: DMW Secretary Hans Cacdac personally met with Filipino community leaders to express his gratitude for their operation and support in helping the affected Filipinos.

text: Ginpasiguro naman sang mga DMW nga padayunon sang gobyerno ang repatration efforts paagi sa commercial ukon chartered flights.
english: The DMWs assured that the government will continue repatriation efforts through commercial or chartered flights.

text: Samtang, padayon naman nga bukas ang Philippine Consulate General sa Dubai kag mga opisina sang DMW sa Dubai kun sa diin may ara man sang mga ini sang hotline nga handa maghatag sang impormasyon kag bulig sa mga Pilipino nga apektado sang krisis sa rehiyon.
english: Meanwhile, the Philippine Consulate General in Dubai and the DMW offices in Dubai remain open where they also have a hotline ready to provide information and assistance to Filipinos affected by the crisis in the region.

text: Nagapanguna sanday Carlos Yulo kag Alex Eala sa mga nominado para sa Athlete of the year 2025 sang Philippine Sportswriters Association (PSA).
english: Carlos Yulo and Alex Eala lead the nominees for Athlete of the year 2025 by the Philippine Sportswriters Association (PSA).

text: Lunsay nakaangkon sang makasaysayan nga record ang duwa kag naghatag sang kadungganan sa Pilipinas sa tagsa ka sports nga ila ginrepresentar.
english: Both have achieved historic records and brought honor to the Philippines in each sport they represented.

text: Liwat nga ginpamatud-an ni Yulo ang iya titulo matapos nga magdaog ini sang gold medal sa vault kag broze sa floor exercise sa 53rd FIG World Championships sa Jakarta.
english: Yulo once again proved her title after she won the gold medal in the vault and broze in the floor exercise at the 53rd FIG World Championships in Jakarta.

text: Samtang, si Alex naman ang labing una nga Filipina nga nakasulod sa Top 50 sang Women’s Tennis Association (WTA) rankings.
english: Meanwhile, Alex is the first Filipina to enter the Top 50 of the Women's Tennis Association (WTA) rankings.

text: Upod man sa mga nomindao sanday Miguel Tabuena, Chezka Centeno kag Kayla Sanchez.
english: Also among the nominees are Miguel Tabuena, Chezka Centeno and Kayla Sanchez.

text: Pagahiwaton ang Philippine Sportswriters Association (PSA) Awards Night sa Pebrero 2.
english: The Philippine Sportswriters Association (PSA) Awards Night will be held on February 2.

text: Nanawagan si Miss Universe 2018 Catriona Gray sa Miss Universe Organization (MUO) na magpatupad ng mas malinaw at transparent na judging process sa mga susunod na pageant, kasunod ng kontrobersiya at alegasyon ng dayaan sa pagkapanalo ni Fatima Bosch ng Mexico ngayong 2025.
english: Miss Universe 2018 Catriona Gray has called on the Miss Universe Organization (MUO) to implement a more transparent judging process in the upcoming pageants, following the controversy and allegations of cheating in the victory of Fatima Bosch of Mexico in 2025.

text: Sa kanyang Instagram Broadcast Channel, sinabi ni Catriona na mahalagang maibalik ng MUO ang tiwala ng mga pageant fans sa pamamagitan ng malinaw na criteria, scoring system, at paggamit ng independent third-party tabulator.
english: On her Instagram Broadcast Channel, Catriona said it is important for MUO to restore the trust of pageant fans through clear criteria, scoring system, and the use of an independent third-party tabulator.

text: Ani Catriona, nakakadismaya ang mga ulat tungkol sa mga nag-resign na judges at umano’y kalituhan sa proseso ng judging system.
english: According to Catriona, reports about resigned judges and alleged confusion in the judging system process are disappointing.

text: Gayunpaman, nalulungkot siya sa online hate na natatanggap ni Bosch at umaasang gagamitin ng bagong Miss Universe ang kanyang titulo para sa positibong adbokasiya.
english: However, she is saddened by the online hate that Bosch is receiving and hopes that the new Miss Universe will use her title for positive advocacy.

text: Pinuri rin niya ang performance nina Ahtisa Manalo ng Pilipinas at Olivia Yacé ng Côte d’Ivoire sa Q&A, na itinuturing niyang pinakamalakas.
english: He also praised the performance of Ahtisa Manalo of the Philippines and Olivia Yacé of Côte d'Ivoire in the Q&A, which he considered the strongest.

text: Ayon kay Catriona, “basic” lamang ang final question at inaasahang handa ang mga kandidata rito.
english: According to Catriona, the final question is “basic” and the candidates are expected to be ready for it.

text: Dagdag pa niya, batay sa kanyang karanasan bilang judge, nagkakaiba-iba ang panlasa ng mga hurado, ngunit nanindigan siya na transparency ang susi para maiwasan ang anumang duda sa resulta ng kompetisyon.
english: He added that based on his experience as a judge, the judges have different tastes, but he insisted that transparency is the key to avoid any doubt in the results of the competition.

text: Ginpasigurado sang Iloilo City District Jail – Male Dormitory nga matatapan ang mga Persons Deprived of Liberty (PDLs) sa ila mga kinahanglanon sa medical kag sa ikaayong-lawas.
english: The Iloilo City District Jail – Male Dormitory has ensured that the Persons Deprived of Liberty (PDLs) will be cared for in their medical and health needs.

text: Sa interview sang Bomb Rayo kay JO2 Krishna Rama Jover, Asst.
english: In an interview with Bomb Rayo, JO2 Krishna Rama Jover, Asst.

text: Chief Health Service Unit of Iloilo City District Jail – Male Dormitory, iya ginpahayag nga ‘in general’ yara sa maayo nga kahimtangan ang ila PDLs subong, ini bangud man sa bulig sang mga opisyal sang BJMP sa higher level.
english: Chief Health Service Unit of Iloilo City District Jail – Male Dormitory, he said that 'in general' their PDLs are in good condition now, this is also due to the help of BJMP officials at higher level.

text: Suno kay Jover, may mga PDLs man sila nga nagamasakit na nga daan sang nagsulod sa presohan kag kalabanan diri amo ang diabetes kag hypertension.
english: According to Jover, they also have PDLs who were already sick when they entered the jail and most of them are diabetes and hypertension.

text: 40 pataas naman ang edad sang PDLs nga masami naga-ekspersyensya sang mga nasambit nga sakit.
english: 40 and above are the age of PDLs who often experience these diseases.

text: Factor naman sa pag-angkon sang sakit amo ang pagbaylo-baylo sang panahon.
english: Another factor in the acquisition of the disease is the change of weather.

text: Sa kabug-usan nga 1,394 ka mga PDLs Iloilo City District Jail, 21 diri ang diabetic, 63 naman ang hypertensive, kag 15 ang asthmatic.
english: Of the 1,394 PDLs in the Iloilo City District Jail, 21 are diabetic, 63 are hypertensive, and 15 are asthmatic.

text: Nagpasalig man ini nga gina-una gid hatagan sang medical attention ang preso nga may malala nga sakit nga nakabase man sa ila sitwasyon.
english: He also assured that prisoners with serious illnesses will be given priority medical attention based on their situation.

text: Ginapaidalom naman sa counseling session ang mga PDLs nga may mental health condition.
english: PDLs with mental health conditions are undergoing counseling sessions.

text: Suno kay JO2 Jose Justo Orbina, Chief nurse sang Iloilo City District Jail – Male Dormitory, paagi sa amo nga tikang, gilayon matumod ang mga PDLs nga nagapangatubang sang mga problema nga mahimo mahulog sa depression.
english: According to JO2 Jose Justo Orbina, chief nurse of Iloilo City District Jail – Male Dormitory, through this move, PDLs who are facing problems that may fall into depression will be immediately identified.

text: Ginpasigurado man sang natungdan nga may psychometrician nga naga-check sa mga PDL nga nagabatyag na sang psychological problems.
english: He also assured that there is a psychometrician who checks the PDLs who are already experiencing psychological problems.

text: MAS MADUMDUMAN naton ang nabasahan sa pahayagan, sa libro, ukon diin man nakasulat sangsa kon sin-o ang tagsulat sini.
english: WE REMEMBER more what we read in a newspaper, a book, or something else than who wrote it.

text: Ina tungod mas interesado kita sa kon ano ang mabulig sining mga sinulatan sa aton kabuhi kag pagpangabuhi sangsa kilalahon ang tagsulat.
english: That's because we're more interested in what these writings can do for our lives and livelihoods than in getting to know the author.

text: Kasubong sang ihibalo kag kinaalam nga importante mahibal-an naton, ang pwede makalingaw sa aton, ukon ang ano pa nga makapukaw sang balatyagon – katulad sang matuod nga pagpakig-abyan, paghigugma, kag bisan pa ang kahaladlukan nga mga istorya kag crime stories kon diin makatuon man kita kon paano makalikaw sa katulad nga kalainan kag kapahamakan.
english: Like knowledge and wisdom that is important for us to know, that can entertain us, or anything else that can arouse feelings – such as true friendship, love, and even horror stories and crime stories where we can also learn how to avoid similar evil and disaster.

text: Kon maupod gid man sa pagdumdum ang tagsulat sa iya sinulatan ina tungod nagaasoy ini sang kabuhi mismo sang tagsulat.
english: If the author is remembered in his writing, it is because it tells the author's own life.

text: Ukon tungod popular gid man siya nga makabulig pa gani hatag interes sa iya sinulatan, katulad sang Noli Me Tangere kag El  Filibusterismo sang aton national hero nga si Dr. Jose P. Rizal, labi na gid kay ginatun-an pa gani ining iya mga libro sa mga eskwelahan.
english: Or because he is so popular that he can even help give interest to his writings, such as Noli Me Tangere and El Filibusterismo of our national hero Dr. Jose P. Rizal, especially since these books are even studied in schools.

text: In other words, balewala sa mga manunulat nga makilala gid sila kay mas importante sa ila nga ang ila sinulatan mabasa, labi na gid kon nagadala ini sing kaayuhan sa sosyedad.
english: In other words, writers don't care about being recognized because it's more important to them that their writing be read, especially if it brings good to society.

text: Tungod ugaling sa pagka-mabungahon sang ila sinulatan sa pagpasanyog sang aton pagka-Filipino, labi na gid ang mas nakaangat sa paghatag sing kaayuhan sa aton sosyedad, obligasyon naton nga indi lang ihatag sa ila ang aton pagpasalamat kundi ang pagpadungog pa sa ila.
english: However, because of the fruitfulness of their writings in promoting our Filipino identity, especially those that have contributed to the benefit of our society, it is our obligation not only to give them our gratitude but also to honor them.

text: Indi lang sang aton gobyerno  kundi sang pribado man nga mga grupo (NGO) agud padayon nila mapasanyog ang ila mabungahon nga ginahimo para sa kaayuhan sang ila kasubong nga Filipino upod sa Hilway kag Diyosnon nga mga kapungsuran.
english: Not only by our government but also by private groups (NGOs) so that they can continue to promote their fruitful work for the benefit of their fellow Filipinos along with the Free and Godly nations.

text: Partikular sa pagpasanyog sang aton mother tongue sa rehiyon  nga Hiligaynon, madamo man gani sa mga Ilonggo ang nakabaton sining pagpasalamat kag pagpadungog.
english: Particularly in promoting our mother tongue in the Hiligaynon region, many Ilonggos have received this thanks and honor.

text: Ining pagkilala sa ila ginahimo sang UMPIL (Unyon ng mga Manunulat sa Pilipinas), Palanca Hall of Fame,  Philippine conferment sang Order of National  Artists (Orden ng Gawad Pambansang Alagad ng Sining) for Arts and Letters.
english: This recognition is done by UMPIL (Unyon ng mga Manunulat sa Pilipinas), Palanca Hall of Fame,  Philippine conferment of the Order of National  Artists (Orden ng Gawad Pambansang Serbi ng Sining) for Arts and Letters.

text: May isa pa ka padungog sa “outstanding Filipinos” nga nahibal-an naton – ang Metro Bank Foundation recognition and award for Outstanding Filipinos.
english: There is another award for “outstanding Filipinos” that we know of – the Metro Bank Foundation recognition and award for Outstanding Filipinos.

text: Sori, pero wala kita ugaling nahibal-an nga manunulat nga nakabaton sang Metro Bank Foundation award tungod sa iya pinasahe kag mabungahon nga mga sinulatan.
english: Sorry, but we don't know of any writer who received the Metro Bank Foundation award for his unique and productive writings.

text: Kon may ara, ang kalantip lang niya seguro sa pagtudlo kag indi ang mapadunggan siya sa pinasahe niya nga mga sinulatan.
english: If anything, it's probably just his teaching skills and not his writings.

text: Ina tungod kay limitado lang ang award sini sa “academe, military and police officers”.
english: Ina tungod kay limitado lang ang award sini sa “academe, military and police officers”.

text: Handa ang gobyerno sang Pilipinas nga dugangan pa ukon pasangkaron pa ang partnership sini sa Japan kun negosyo ang pagahambalan.
english: The Philippine government is ready to increase or expand its partnership with Japan when it comes to business.

text: Ang Japan amo ang ikaduha nga pinakadaku nga trading partner sang Pilipinas.
english: Japan is the Philippines’ second largest trading partner.

text: Naglab-ot sa P1.27 trillion ang balor nga nakuha sa trade sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: Trade value reached P1.27 trillion last year.

text: Ginpakigbahin naman ni Executive Secretary Ralph Recto ang interes para sa dugang nga negosyo kadungan sang 42nd Annual Joint Meeting of the Economic Cooperation Committees of the Philippines and Japan.
english: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto shared the interest for more business during the 42nd Annual Joint Meeting of the Economic Cooperation Committees of the Philippines and Japan.

text: “The Philippines is ready to do more business with Japanese partners,” suno kay Recto.
english: “The Philippines is ready to do more business with Japanese partners,” according to Recto.

text: “You want clear rules.
english: “You want clear rules.

text: You want a coordinated government.
english: You want a coordinated government.

text: And you want decisions made without delay.
english: And you want decisions made without delay.

text: That is exactly what we are working to deliver,” pahayag pa sang former Finance chief.
english: That is exactly what we are working to deliver,” the former Finance chief said.

text: Isa man ang Japan sa nagapanguna nga ginahalinan sang foreign direct investments nga nagapasulod sa Pilipinas sang P42.5 billion sa nauna nga 11 ka bulan sang 2025.
english: Japan is also one of the leading sources of foreign direct investments bringing in P42.5 billion to the Philippines in the first 11 months of 2025.

text: Luyag man sang Palace official nga mas mag-ayo pa ang partnership sang duha ka pungsod sa patag sang turismo ilabi na nga 407,000 Japanese ang nagbisita sa Pilipinas sang una nga 11 ka bulan sang 2025 samtang 825,000 Filipinos naman ang nagbisita sa Japan sa amo nga tion.
english: The Palace official also wants to improve the partnership between the two countries in the field of tourism especially that 407,000 Japanese visited the Philippines in the first 11 months of 2025 while 825,000 Filipinos visited Japan during the same period.

text: Siling nila, ang mga ido gid man ang makabig nga pinaka-loyal nga abyan sang tawo kag ini ang ginpamatud-an sang isa ka estudyante kag sang iya ido didto sa Cagayan.
english: They say that dogs are the most loyal friends of man and this was proved by a student and his dog in Cagayan.

text: Nasaksihan sang mga tawo ini nga makatalandog-balatyagon nga eksena sa Tuguegarao, Cagayan sang isa ka senior high school graduate ang gin-updan sang iya hinuptanan nga ido sa pinakaespesyal nga adlaw sang iya kabuhi.
english: People witnessed this touching scene in Tuguegarao, Cagayan when a senior high school graduate was accompanied by his pet dog on the most special day of his life.

text: Sa baylo nga ginikanan ang mag-upod sa iya sa graduation, ang hinuptanan nga ido nga si Browny ang nangin kaupod ni Jamaica Cabral.
english: Instead of parents accompanying her to graduation, pet dog Browny became Jamaica Cabral’s companion.

text: Ang litrato kag video nila nga magkaupod sa seremonya nag-viral matapos ipost sa social media.
english: A photo and video of them together at the ceremony went viral after being posted on social media.

text: Bisan pa man masubo nga wala sang pamilya nga present, ginpabatyag ni Jamaica nga wala siya nagaisahanon — si Browny ang iya padayon nga kaupod sa kabudlayan kag kalipay.
english: As sad as it was to not have family present, Jamaica made her feel like she wasn’t alone — Browny was her constant companion through thick and thin.

text: Sang ginlawag na si Jamaica sa entablado, nag-behave lang si Browny kag nag-upod pa sa iya, daw kaangay sang isa ka suod nga abyan nga nagapakita sang suporta.
english: Once Jamaica was called on stage, Browny just behaved and even joined her, kind of like a close friend showing support.

text: Gintugutan man sang mga school staff ang presensya ni Browny bangud wala ini nagatuga sang problema kag nagpakita sang husto nga pamatasan.
english: School staff also tolerated Browny’s presence because he was not causing trouble and demonstrated proper behavior.

text: Nagbilib naman ang mga tawo bangud sa espesyal nga pagpalangga sang estudyante kag sang iya ido sa isa kag isa.
english: People were impressed by the special love the student and his dog had for each other.

english: [Content Advisory: The following article discusses rape and sexual violence.
