Preso ang isa ka anay suldado nga nag-AWOL kag amay sini nga madugay na nga may standing warrant of arrest bangud sa kaso sang pagpanghimulos kag pagmolestiya sa menor de edad nga himata sa Quezon City.
english:
Reader discretion is advised.]

A former soldier who went AWOL and his father who has long had a standing warrant of arrest for the case of rape and molestation of a minor relative in Quezon City are in custody.

text: Ang mga arestado amo ang anay suldado nga 34-anyos kag amay nga 64-anyos.
english: Those arrested were a 34-year-old former soldier and a 64-year-old father.

text: Ang ila biktima ang hinablos man lang sang suldado kag nagaedad pa lang sang 10 ka tuig ang bata sang natabo ang pagpangmolestiya sang 2018 tubtob nga nasulit pa gid ini sang pila ka beses tubtob sang 2023.
english: Their victim is the soldier's nephew and the child was only 10 years old when the molestation occurred in 2018 until it was repeated several times until 2023.

text: Natultulan ang mag-amay sa Barangay Santor sa Bongabon, Nueva Ecija.
english: The father and son were located in Barangay Santor in Bongabon, Nueva Ecija.

text: Kaso nga 4 counts sang acts of lasciviousness, 5 counts sang sexual assault ang ginapangatubang sang anay suldado.
english: The former soldier is facing charges of 4 counts of acts of lasciviousness, 5 counts of sexual assault.

text: Qualified rape, 5 counts sang acts of lasciviousness, kag 3 counts sang sexual assault naman ang ginapangatubang sang amay.
english: The father is facing qualified rape, 5 counts of acts of lasciviousness, and 3 counts of sexual assault.

text: Ginatudlo ang indi magnubo sa lima ka mga opisyal sang gobyerno, lakip ang pila ka Cabinet secretaries, nga gina-alegar naulamid sa ginahingadlan nga iregularidad sa 2025 national budget.
english: At least five government officials, including several Cabinet secretaries, are allegedly involved in alleged irregularities in the 2025 national budget.

text: Suno kay Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo “Ping” Lacson, ang alegasyon ginabase sa mga dokumento nga ginatawag nga “Cabral files,” nga ginhalinan sang anay Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Undersecretary Catalina “Cathy” Cabral, nga suno pa kay Lacson ang handa na kun tani magbuyagyag sang impormasyon nahanungod sa anomalya sa flood control projects antes ini napatay.
english: According to Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo “Ping” Lacson, the allegation is based on documents called “Cabral files,” which came from former Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Undersecretary Catalina “Cathy” Cabral, who Lacson said was ready to reveal any information about the flood control project. before it died.

text: Paathag ni Lacson nga ang mga dokumento nagalakip sang mga ngalan sang pila ka Cabinet secretaries nga may allocable kag non-allocable funds sa 2025 budget, lakip ang anay DPWH Secretary Manuel Bonoan, nga gin-alegar nga isa sa may pinakadako nga alokasyon.
english: Lacson explained that the documents include the names of several Cabinet secretaries with allocable and non-allocable funds in the 2025 budget, including former DPWH Secretary Manuel Bonoan, who was allegedly one of the largest allocation holders.

text: Dugang pa, ginpahayag nga ang mga dokumento ginakaangut sa ₱50 bilyon nga unprogrammed funds, nga kabahin sini ginhalinan sang mga flood control projects.
english: Furthermore, it was revealed that the documents were linked to ₱50 billion in unprogrammed funds, part of which came from flood control projects.

text: Kun mapamatud-an ang pagka-authentic sang mga dokumento, mahimo ipatawag ang mga opisyal nga ginahingadlan, sa imbestigasyon sang Senate Blue Ribbon Committee para sa ila padayon nga kawsa nga mapanabat ang tanan nga korap sa gobyerno kag mabalik ang kwarta nga ila ginkawat.
english: If the authenticity of the documents is proven, the named officials can be summoned, to the investigation of the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee for their continued cause to hold all corrupt officials accountable and return the money they stole.

text: Nagapamayagpag sa lokal nga industriya sang kape sa Iloilo ang mga coffee growers sa banwa sang Igbaras.
english: Coffee growers in Igbaras town are taking advantage of the local coffee industry in Iloilo.

text: Ang grupo nga Sitio Buyuan Baras Coffee Growers Association (SBBCGA) sa Brgy.
english: The group Sitio Buyuan Baras Coffee Growers Association (SBBCGA) in Brgy.

text: Tigbanaba, Igbaras, nagatuyo nga indi lang mangin isa ka negosyo sa ila komunidad ang pagpananum sang kape, kundi buhion man ang coffee industry sa probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: Tigbanaba, Igbaras, aims to not only make coffee plantation a business in their community, but also revive the coffee industry in Iloilo province.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ernesto Elgario Emano Jr., Quality Control Manager sang SBBCGA, iya ginpahayag nga apisar madamo sila sang naagyan nga mga pagpanghangkat, padayon gihapon ang mga ini sa ila kawsa, asta nga nangin supplier na ang mga ini sang coffee beans sa nagkalain-lain nga coffee shops sa syudad sang Iloilo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Ernesto Elgario Emano Jr., Quality Control Manager of SBBCGA, said that despite the many challenges they faced, they continued in their cause, until they became suppliers of coffee beans to various coffee shops in Iloilo City.

text: Tuyo man sang grupo nga solusyunan ang problema sang ‘aging farmers’ ukon naga-edad nga mga mangunguma, nga isa sa mga rason sang pagnubo sang produksyon sa nagkalain-lain nga sector sang agrikultura.
english: The group also aims to solve the problem of aging farmers, which is one of the reasons for the decline in production in various agricultural sectors.

text: Nagpanawagan man ang mga ini sa mga pamatan-on sa karun, nga magbalik kag mag-invest sa sektor sang agrikultura, agud mapabakod ang industriya kag masiguro ang padayon nga pag-uswag sang lokal nga agrikultura.
english: They also called on the youth of today, to return and invest in the agricultural sector, in order to strengthen the industry and ensure the continued development of local agriculture.

text: Matandaan man nga sang damlag lang, nagdisisyon ang Department of Agriculture (DA) nga magabukas ang mga ini sang bag-o nga talatapan nga magapokus sa pagpauswag sang industriya sang kape sa Pilipinas nga mangin dako nga bulig sa kaangay nga grupo sang mga mamumugon nga tuyo magpaumwad sang amo nga produkto.
english: It can also be recalled that recently, the Department of Agriculture (DA) decided to open a new office that will focus on the development of the coffee industry in the Philippines which will be a great help to such groups of workers who intend to develop the product.

text: Nagpagwa sang subpoena ang House Committee on Justice sa National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) agud makuha ang mga rekord nga may kahilabtanan sa ginpahayag nga pagpamahog ni Vice President Sara Duterte kay President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., First Lady Liza Araneta-Marcos, kag sa anay Speaker Ferdinand Martin G. Romualdez.
english: The House Committee on Justice has issued a subpoena to the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) to obtain records related to Vice President Sara Duterte's alleged threats against President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., First Lady Liza Araneta-Marcos, and former Speaker Ferdinand Martin G. Romualdez.

text: Ginpangunahan ini ni Justice panel chairman kag Batangas Rep.
english: It was presided over by Justice panel chairman and Batangas Rep.

text: Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” Luistro kasunod sang pormal nga pagsugod sang hearing sa mga impeachment complaints batok kay Duterte.
english: Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” Luistro following the formal start of the hearing on the impeachment complaints against Duterte.

text: Ang tuyo sang amo nga hearing amo ang paghibalo kun may yara sang nagakaigo nga basehan agud pasakaon ang kaso sa Senado para sa trial.Ginplastar ni Luistro ang mosyon sa komite kag gin-aprubahan ini nga wala sang pagpamatok.
english: The purpose of the hearing was to determine if there was a proper basis to refer the case to the Senate for trial. Luistro placed the motion in committee and it was approved without objection.

text: Ginamanduan sang subpoena ang NBI nga ipasa ang mga sertipikado nga kopya sang tanan nga materyales halin sa ila nga imbestigasyon, nga repasuhon sang mga mamalidha bilang kabahin sang pagtipon sang ebidensya.
english: The subpoena orders the NBI to submit certified copies of all materials from its investigation, which will be reviewed by lawmakers as part of the evidence gathering.

text: Nauna na nga gintumod sang komite nga sufficient in form kag substance ang duha ka reklamo nga impeachment batok kay Duterte, kag gintugutan sini nga magpadayon ang hearing bisan panahon yara sa recess ang Kongreso.
english: The committee had earlier determined that the two impeachment complaints against Duterte were sufficient in form and substance, and allowed the hearing to continue even while Congress was in recess.

text: Sa karon, ginatutukan pa lang sang komite kun may ara ini sang probable cause, samtang ang Senado amo ang magaserbi bilang impeachment court kon padayunon ang trial.
english: The committee is currently focusing on whether it has probable cause, while the Senate will serve as the impeachment court if the trial continues.

text: FINALLY, nahibal-an gid man naton kon ano ang husto nga pag-ispeling sang mga tinaga sa Hiligaynon sa idalom sang Rule of Thumb: “Kung ano’ng bigkas, siyang baybay” (Spelled as pronounced).
english: FINALLY, we know what the correct spelling of Hiligaynon words is under the Rule of Thumb: “What’s bigkas, siyang baybay” (Spelled as pronounced).

text: Natigayon naton ini sa bulig sang mga sinulatan sang mga “excellent writers” sa Hiligaynon labi na gid sang mga tumandok sang Iloilo kag Bacolod, sa experto nga pag-edit sang Hiligaynon scholar nga si John Iremil Teodoro,   sa diksyonaryo sang mga tinaga nga kuha sa pagpakigsugilanon sa mga Hiligaynon folks, sa online tutoring,  kag iban pa nga masaligan nga sources.
english: We have achieved this with the help of the writings of excellent writers in Hiligaynon, especially those native to Iloilo and Bacolod, the expert editing of Hiligaynon scholar John Iremil Teodoro, the dictionary of words taken from conversations with Hiligaynon folks, and other reliable online tutorials. sources.

text: In fact, indi lang ang husto nga pag-ispeling sang mga tinaga sa Hiligaynon kundi sa pagmitlang (pronounce), pagbasa (read) kag pagsulat (write) man sini, nga importante  sa gahandom man sa pagsulat sing talunsay sa Hiligaynon sa aton lokal nga mga pahayagan.
english: In fact, not only the correct spelling of words in Hiligaynon but also the pronunciation, reading and writing of them, which is important for those who wish to write fluently in Hiligaynon in our local newspapers.

text: Kag ina tungod man sa handom nga maupdan naton ang aton gobyerno agud mapahapos pa gid ang ihibalo naton sa English, ang lingua franca sa kalibutan, nga kinahanglan sag aton pungsod sa pang-kalibutanon nga relasyon kag mapaugwad man ang aton pangabuhi kon diin man naton makita ini sa iban nga bahin sang kalibutan.
english: And that is also because of the desire to join our government to further facilitate our knowledge of English, the lingua franca in the world, which our country needs in global relations and also to improve our lives wherever we see it in other parts of the world.

text: Tungod man gani sini nga ginbuksan sang aton gobyerno ang pagtudlo sang mga mother tongue sang mga rehiyon, lakip na ang Hiligaynon, sadtong 2012 sa pagsugod pa lang sulod sa eskwelahan sang mga kabataan.
english: It is because of this that our government opened the teaching of the mother tongues of the regions, including Hiligaynon, in 2012 at the very beginning of children's schooling.

text:
***

Tungod sa sining masanyog na nga ihibalo sa Hiligaynon,  nangin mas maathag (precise) man ang aton pagkilala sang mga letra kag mga tinaga nga mahuman naton halin sa nadak-an nga Alpabetong Abakada sang aton mga ginikanan.
english:
***

Because of this advanced knowledge of Hiligaynon, we have become more precise in our recognition of the letters and words that we can form from the enlarged alphabet of our parents.

text: Nadugangan pa ining aton kinaalam sa Hiligaynon dala sang dugang nga walo (8) ka alphabet letters halin sa English kag Spanish sa aton karon Makabagong Alpabetong Pilipino (MAP).
english: This knowledge of Hiligaynon has been enhanced by the addition of eight (8) alphabet letters from English and Spanish in our current Modern Philippine Alphabet (MAP).

text: As a result, however, kinahanglan na naton mag-take exception sa pag-apply sang Rule of Thumb  kon luyag  naton gamiton ang English kag Spanish words sa ila kinaiya nga forma nga indi kinahanglan gamiton ang aton tumandok nga bersyon tungod dala na naton ang ila alphabet letters sa MAP.
english: As a result, however, we have to take exception to the application of the Rule of Thumb if we want to use English and Spanish words in their characteristic form without having to use our native version because we already have their alphabet letters in MAP.

text: Bangod ini sang pagmitlang kag pagsulat sang mga tinaga English kag Spanish nga indi magtugma sa sinang Rule of Thumb tungod man sa paggamit nila, among others, sang “double letters” katulad sang “better” kag “guerra”, kag labi na gid sang presensya sang mga “silent” letters sa mga tinaga.
english: This is due to the pronunciation and writing of English and Spanish words that do not correspond to the Rule of Thumb due to their use, among others, of “double letters” such as “better” and “guerra”, and especially the presence of “silent” letters in words.

text: Ejempo lang ang H sa Spanish nga “always silent” luas lang kon upod sini ang C, katulad sang “hasta” (until) nga ang pagmitlang sini amo lang ang “asta”, kag “mucho” (a lot) nga ang ch may sound katulad sa “cheek”.
english: For example, the H in Spanish is “always silent” unless it is accompanied by a C, such as “hasta” (until) which is pronounced only “asta”, and “mucho” (a lot) which ch has a sound like “cheek”.

text: Silent man ang U kon upod ang Q katulad sang “porque”, ukon sa tunga ini sang G kag E katulad sang “guerra” (war), ukon sa tunga sang tinaga katulad sang “ahora” (now).
english: U is also silent when with Q like “porque”, or between G and E like “guerra” (war), or in the middle of a word like “ahora” (now).

text: Mas daku ugaling ang problema naton sa pagsulat sang English words tungod sa sobra ka damu nga mga silent letters sa pagmitlang pa lang sang mga tinaga.
english: However, we have a bigger problem with writing English words because there are too many silent letters in the pronunciation of words.

text: In fact, halos tanan sini, halin A-Z gid, nga bisan ang mga nagatuon pa lang kag bisan ang native speakers mismo sa English pwede magsala kon paano ang pagmitlang kag pagsulat sang English words.
english: In fact, almost all of them, from A-Z really, that even beginners and even native speakers themselves in English can make mistakes about how English words are pronounced and written.

text: Pinaka-popular gid ang letter E, nga indi mo mabatian sa pagmitlang, por ejempo,  sang “cake” kag “muscle”.
english: The most popular is the letter E, which you don't hear in pronouncing, for example, “cake” and “muscle”.

text:
Subong man ang K sa “knee”; H kon sunod ini sa W katulad sang “what”; L kon sa likod sini ang vowel, katulad sang “would”;

Subong man ang A sa “physically”; B kon sa unahan sang M katulad sang “bomb”; C sa “ascent”;  D sa “badge”;  I sa “business”; N sa “hymn”; P sa “coup”; S sa “Island’; T sa “apostle”;  U sa “guard”; kag W sa “answer”.
english:
Also the K in “knee”; H if it follows a W like “what”; L if followed by a vowel, such as “would”;

Also the A in “physically”; B if in front of M like “bomb”; C in “ascent”;  D in “badge”;  It’s the “business”; I say “hymn”; P the “coup”; S for “Island’;T for “apostle”;  U for “guard”;and W for “answer”.

text: Well, indi gid man ini problema sa mga Filipino nga may mataas nga tinun-an nga hanas sa paghambal kag pagsulat sa English.
english: Well, this is not really a problem for highly educated Filipinos who are proficient in speaking and writing in English.

text: Sa pagsulat sang mga kabataan sa eskwelahan sa English  words, sunu sa isa ka online tutor, pwede matun-an ini sing mahapos paagi, for example, sa “matching” sang mga tinaga sa pictures kag figures kag guided nga pagbasa sang English words sa kinaiya nila nga spelling.
english: In school children's writing in English words, according to an online tutor, it can be learned easily by, for example, matching words with pictures and figures and guided reading of English words in their own spelling.

text: Kon parti sa kon makahambal kita katulad gid sang mga English speaking folks, okey lang sa aton seguro nga mabatian kita sa English sa aton tumandok nga tonog, nga luyag tawgon sang mga pangayaw nga “Filipino English”.
english: As for whether we can speak like English speaking folks, it's okay for us to be heard in English in our native tone, which foreigners like to call “Filipino English”.

text: Kon indi kita magsala, may yara man gani nga “British English” nga liwan gid kaayo sa “American English” nga aton ginagamit diri sa pungsod.
english: If we are not mistaken, there is even a “British English” that is very different from the “American English” that we use here in the country.

text:
***

Mahingapos kita halin diri sa sunod nga edisyon sang aton kolum sa pagkilala kag paghatag dungog sa mas kilala nga mga manunulat naton sa Hiligaynon./PN
english:
***

We will end from here in the next edition of our column to recognize and honor our more famous writers in Hiligaynon./PN

text: Nangin epektibo na ang pagpatuman kahapon nga adlaw, Marso 28, saang ginpapanaug nga Executive Order No.
english: The implementation of Executive Order No.

text: 035, Series of 2026 ni Mayor Raisa Treñas nga nagatukod sang Iloilo City Crisis Management Council.
english: 035, Series of 2026 by Mayor Raisa Treñas establishing the Iloilo City Crisis Management Council.

text: Ini kasunod sang pagdeklara sang state of national energy emergency ni President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr sa pungsod.
english: This follows the declaration of a state of national energy emergency by President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr. in the country.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joy Fantilaga-Gorzal, spokesperson ni Mayor Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga kabahin ini sang pagpanghanda sa epekto sang padayon nga pagsaka sang presyo sang produktong petrolyo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joy Fantilaga-Gorzal, spokesperson of Mayor Treñas, said this is part of the preparation for the impact of the continuous rise in the price of petroleum products.

text: Suno pa kay Gorzal, sa bulig sang nagkalain-lain nga ahensya sang gobyerno ini nga executive order magahatag sang proteksyon sa publiko ilabi na sa mga vulnerable sectors nga labi nga nagakinahanglan sang bulig sa subong nga tion.
english: According to Gorzal, with the help of various government agencies, this executive order will provide protection to the public especially the vulnerable sectors that are in greatest need of assistance at this time.

text: Ginapasangkad man sini ang koordinasyon sa mga pumuluyo agud masiguro ang padayon nga supply sang essential goods pareho sang pagkaon, bulong, kag gatong.
english: It is also expanding coordination with residents to ensure the continued supply of essential goods such as food, medicine, and fuel.

text: Nag-abiso ang Malacañang sa mga Pilipino sa California sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika nga magpabilin nga alerto pananglitan maglunsar sang pag-atake ang Iran sa state bilang pagbalos sa naga-ibwal nga tensyon sa Middle East.
english: Malacañang has warned Filipinos in California in the United States of America to remain alert in case Iran launches an attack on the state in retaliation for escalating tensions in the Middle East.

text: Kasunod ini sang advisory halin sa Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) kag nagpahibalo sa kapulisan sa California nga ginpahayag nga nagtuyo ang Iran nga magpalupad sang mga unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) pakadto sa mga wala ginsapubliko nga target sa amo nga state sang Pebrero.
english: This follows an advisory from the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) and informed police in California that Iran allegedly tried to fly unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to undisclosed targets in the state in February.

text: Nagpaandam man ang FBI nga posible pa gid nga may surprise attack ang Iran sa palaabuton.
english: The FBI also warned that Iran could carry out a surprise attack in the future.

text: Suno naman sa Presidential Communications Office (PCO) sang Malacañang, ang nagapanguna nga prayoridad sang gobyerno amo ang kaluwasan sang mga Pilipino sa iban nga pungsod.
english: According to the Presidential Communications Office (PCO) of Malacañang, the government's top priority is the safety of Filipinos abroad.

text: Pahayag sang opisina, magahimo sang repatriation ukon pagpapauli sa ila sa Pilipinas kun kinahanglanon.
english: The office said it will repatriate them to the Philippines if necessary.

text: Dugang ni Palace Press Officer Atty. Claire Castro, dapat seryosohon ang mga impormasyon nga nagaalin sa mga law enforcement agencies sang United States.
english: Palace Press Officer Atty. Claire Castro, information coming from law enforcement agencies of the United States should be taken seriously.

text: “Kapag may ganiyan na mga impormasyon, kailangan din maghanda ang ating bansa para sa ating mga kababayan,” suno kay Castro.
english: “When there is such information, our country must also prepare for our fellow citizens,” Castro said.

text:
“Hindi po ito maaring ipagsawalang bahala o tulugan.”

Ginabanta nga 1.6-million ka mga Pilipino ang nagapuyo sa California kun sa diin 500,000 ang nagatinir sa Los Angeles samtang 290,000 ang yara sa San Francisco.
english:
"It can't be taken for granted."

An estimated 1.6-million Filipinos live in California, of which 500,000 live in Los Angeles and 290,000 in San Francisco.

text: Una naman nagpahayag si California Gov.
english: Earlier, California Gov.

text: Gavin Newsom nga wala sang imminent threat sa state apisar sang warning halin sa FBI nga maghimo magpalupad ang Iran sang drones sa West Coast bilang kabahin sang ila nga pagtimalos.
english: Gavin Newsom said there is no imminent threat to the state despite a warning from the FBI that Iran will fly drones on the West Coast as part of their retaliation.

text: “We’ve been aware of that information.
english: “We’ve been aware of that information.

text: … It’s all about a posture of preparedness for worst-case scenarios,” pahayag ni Newsom.
english: … It’s all about a posture of preparedness for worst-case scenarios,” Newsom stated.

text: Nagapabilin sa gihapon sa intensive care unit sa Thailand si Miss Jamaica Gabrielle Henry, matapos mahulog halin sa entablado sang Miss Universe 2025 preliminaries sang Nobyembre 19, 2025.
english: Miss Jamaica Gabrielle Henry remains in the intensive care unit in Thailand, after falling from the stage of the Miss Universe 2025 preliminaries on November 19, 2025.

text: Nahulog ini samtang nagarampa sa runway suksok ang orange nga gown kag high heels sa evening gown competition.
english: She fell while walking down the runway wearing an orange gown and high heels in the evening gown competition.

text: Gilayon man ini nga gindala sa ospital, particular na sa ICU para sa nagakaigo nga pagbulong.
english: He was immediately taken to the hospital, particularly the ICU for proper treatment.

text: Suno sa iya utod nga si Dr. Phylicia Henry-Samuels, indi pa sa gihapon maayo ang iya kondisyon.
english: According to his brother, Dr. Phylicia Henry-Samuels, is still in critical condition.

text: Ginmando man sang mga doctor nga magatenir siya sa ICU nga indi magnubo sa pito ka aldaw para sa padayon nga observation.
english: Doctors also ordered him to stay in the ICU for at least seven days for continued observation.

text: Kaupod niya sa Thailand ang iya utod kag iloy nga nagahatag sang suporta.
english: He was in Thailand with his brother and mother who provided support.

text: Nagapanawagan ang Miss Universe Jamaica Organization sang pangamuyo kag pag-intindi para kay Gabrielle.
english: The Miss Universe Jamaica Organization is calling for prayers and understanding for Gabrielle.

text: Madamo sang pageant fans ang nagpabutyag sang suporta kag pagdumdom sa iya sitwasyon nga nagtuga sang tuman nga kakibot sa Miss Universe community.
english: Many pageant fans expressed their support and remembrance for her situation which caused a lot of shock in the Miss Universe community.

text: Mahimo nga magkaangkon ang isa ka indibidwal sang post traumatic disorder bangud sa paggamit sang palupok ilabi na sa pagselebrar sang bag-ong tuig.
english: An individual may develop post traumatic disorder due to the use of fireworks especially during the celebration of the new year.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Rodney Labis, Chief sang Health Service Division sang Iloilo Provincial Health Office, iya ginpahayag nga ang post traumatic disorder isa ka balatian nga madasig nga nagakulbaan kon makabati sang lupok.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Rodney Labis, Chief of the Health Service Division of the Iloilo Provincial Health Office, he said that post traumatic disorder is a disease that quickly panic when you hear gunshots.

text: Suno kay Labis,ang mga naka-eksperysensya naman sang injuries bangud sa palupok, mahimo makaangkon sang bag-o nga psychological effect.
english: According to Labis, those who have experienced injuries due to fireworks, may have a new psychological effect.

text: Indi lamang psychological bangud posible man sa iya physical nga lawas ilabi na kon may nautod ukon napilasan.
english: Not only psychological but also possible in his physical body especially if there is a cut or injury.

text: Ginpahayag man sang natungdan nga mahimo makaangkon sang social anxiety disorder ang nautdan sang parte sang lawas bangud man sa kahadlok sa mangin pana-awan sang iba.
english: He also said that the amputee may develop social anxiety disorder due to fear of what others will see.

text: Nagpanugyan man ang natungdan sa publiko nga kon mahimo, indi na pagtudlo-an ang mga kabataan nga maggamit sang palupok sa kada pagselebrar sang bag-ong tuig agud indi na makaangkon sang mga nasambit nga kahalitan.
english: He also advised the public not to teach children to use fireworks during every New Year's celebration so that they will not suffer these injuries.

text: Indi pagpahanugutan ang mga Russian athletes nga magpartispar sa Milano Cortina Winter Olympics biskan pa nga matabo ang peace deal sa Ukraine.
english: Russian athletes will not be allowed to participate in the Milan Cortina Winter Olympics even if a peace deal is reached in Ukraine.

text: Ini ginkumpirmar sang International Olympic Committee (IOC) President nga si Kirsty Coventry.
english: This was confirmed by International Olympic Committee (IOC) President Kirsty Coventry.

text: Suno kay Conventry nga magapabilin ang desisyon sang International Olympic Committee (OIC) nga pahanugutan nga magapartisipar ang Russian athletes sa hampang sa Pebrero bilang isa ka indibidwal lamang kag indi bilang tagtumalasakop sang Russia.
english: Conventry said the decision of the International Olympic Committee (OIC) to allow Russian athletes to participate in the February Games as individuals and not as Russian participants will remain in place.

text: Gindumilian sang International Olympic Committee (IOC) ang Russia kag Belarus matapos ang pagsalakay sang Russia sa Ukraine sang Pebrero 2022.
english: The International Olympic Committee (IOC) banned Russia and Belarus after Russia’s invasion of Ukraine in February 2022.

text: Dugang pa ni Coventry nga ang pagahiwaton nga Olympics sa madamo nga syudad kaangay sa Italy ang mangin isa ka “the new normality” kag magaserbe nga gabay sang Milano-Cortina Gomes para sa masunod nga Olympics.
english: Coventry added that the upcoming Olympics in many cities such as Italy will be “the new normality” and will serve as a guide for Milano-Cortina Gomes for the next Olympics.

text: Pagahiwaton ang Milano-Cortina Gomes Winter Olympics humalin Pebrero 6 tubtob 22 subong nga tuig.
english: The Milano-Cortina Gomes Winter Olympics will be held from February 6 to 22 this year.

text: Handa na kun tani nga magbuyag-yag sang impormasyon ang anay Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Undersecretary Catalina “Cathy” Cabral nahanungod sa ginahingadlan nga anomalya sa flood control projects antes siya napatay.
english: Former Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Undersecretary Catalina “Cathy” Cabral was ready to reveal information about the so-called anomalies in flood control projects before she died.

text: Suno kay Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo “Ping” Lacson, iya ginpahayag nga nakig-angut sa iya si Cabral kag nagpahayag sang kahandaang nga maghatag sang dokumento may kaangtanan sa Special Allotment Release Orders (SARO) kag ginahingadlan nga ₱50 Billion nga unprogrammed fund insertions sa national budget.
english: Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo “Ping” Lacson said Cabral contacted him and expressed his readiness to provide documents regarding the Special Allotment Release Orders (SARO) and the so-called ₱50 Billion unprogrammed fund insertions in the national budget.

text: Dugang pa sini nga ang ginatawag nga “Cabral files” nagalakip sang mga ngalan sang pila ka Cabinet secretaries nga may allocable kag non-allocable funds sa 2025 budget, upod ang anay DPWH Secretary Manuel Bonoan nga gina-alegar nga isa sa may pinakadako nga alokasyon.
english: He added that the so-called “Cabral files” include the names of several Cabinet secretaries with allocable and non-allocable funds in the 2025 budget, along with former DPWH Secretary Manuel Bonoan who is alleged to be one of the biggest allocation holders.

text: May yara man sang ginapahayag nga pondo nga ginhalinan sang liderato sang Kamara kag pila ka party-list representatives.
english: There are also alleged funds coming from the House leadership and some party-list representatives.

text: Ginpahayag ni Lacson nga ang mga dokumento mahimo pa ma-authenticate sang Department of Budget and Management kag DPWH, kag kun mapamatud-an, mahimo ipatawag ang mga opisyal nga naulamid sa imbestigasyon sang Senate Blue Ribbon Committee.
english: Lacson said the documents can still be authenticated by the Department of Budget and Management and DPWH, and if proven, the officials involved in the investigation can be summoned by the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee.

text: Matandaan man nga si Cabral ang ginapahayag napatay matapos mahulog sa Pil-as sa bahin sang Kennon Road sa Tuba, Benguet sang Disyembre 18.
english: It can also be recalled that Cabral allegedly died after falling into a cliff along Kennon Road in Tuba, Benguet on December 18.

text: Nakaguwa na sa ospital ang two-time heavyweight champion nga si Anthony Joshua duha ka adlaw matapos na-involve ini sa makamamatay nga car accident sa Nigeria.
english: Two-time heavyweight champion Anthony Joshua has been released from the hospital two days after he was involved in a fatal car accident in Nigeria.

text: Suno sa Nigerian officials, padayunon sang British boxing star kag 2012 Olympic gold medalist ang pag-recover sa ila nga balay.
english: According to Nigerian officials, the British boxing star and 2012 Olympic gold medalist will continue to recover at home.

text: Nagpadulong man ang boksidor kag ang iya iloy sa punerarya agud nga magpaalam sa iya duha ka abyan nga napatay sa amo nga aksidente.
english: The boxer and his mother also went to the funeral home to say goodbye to his two friends who died in the accident.

text: Antes ang insidente, nakit-an pa si Joshua kag iya kaupdanan nga nagahampang sang table tennis.
english: Before the incident, Joshua and his companions were seen playing table tennis.

text: Sang nagabyahe na sang Lunes sang kaagahon, nakabunggo ang salakyan nanday Joshua sa truck sa expressway.
english: While traveling on Monday morning, Joshua's vehicle collided with a truck on the expressway.

text: Ulihi siya nga nakahampang sang Disyembre 19 sang ginlutos sini ang YouTuber-turned-boxer nga si Jake Paul sa tune-up.
english: He last played on December 19 when he defeated YouTuber-turned-boxer Jake Paul in a tune-up.

text: Kilala siya nga may 29-4 overall record sa iya nga career kun sa diin 26 ang nadag-an paagi sa knockout.
english: He is known for having a 29-4 overall record in his career with 26 wins by knockout.

text: Iga-deploy ang kapin 350 ka mga uniformed kag non-uniformed personnel para sa security deployment sa ika-48 nga presentasyon sang Pagtaltal sa Balaan Bukid sa Jordan, Guimaras.
english: More than 350 uniformed and non-uniformed personnel will be deployed for security deployment at the 48th presentation of Pagtaltal sa Balaan Bukid in Jordan, Guimaras.

text: Suno kay PLt.
english: According to PLt.

text: Benjie Ganancial, Deputy Chief, Jordan Municipal Police Station, iya ginapahayag nga bangud sang madamo nga nagakadto sa Guimaras agud magsaka sa Balaan Bukid, kinahanglan gid nga mapasiguro ang seguridad sang mga magabisita.
english: Benjie Ganancial, Deputy Chief, Jordan Municipal Police Station, said that due to the large number of visitors to Guimaras to climb Balaan Bukid, it is necessary to ensure the security of the visitors.

text: Magapahamtang man sang mga ambulansya kag fire trucks ang mga otoridad agud magresponde gilayon kun may emerhensya.
english: Authorities will also deploy ambulances and fire trucks to respond immediately in case of emergency.

text: Ginapasiguro man sang mga awtoridad ang mahapos kag organisado nga pagsulod sang mga deboto kag turista sa nasambit nga lugar.
english: The authorities are also ensuring easy and organized entry of devotees and tourists to the said area.

text: MAY 20 ka letra ang sadto Pilipinong Alpabeto, ukon Abakada, nga may 15 ka consonante kag 5 ka bokablo.
english: THE Philippine Alphabet, or Abakada, had 20 letters, with 15 consonants and 5 vowels.

text: Gindugangan, ugaling, ini sang walo (8) ka consonante sa Makabagong Alpabetong Pilipino (MAP) nga ginpatuman sugod sadtong 1987.
english: However, it was supplemented by eight (8) consonants in the Modern Philippine Alphabet (MAP) implemented since 1987.

text: Tungod ginakilala ta man ang Filipino bilang iloy nga lenggwahe, gin-updan naton nga mga Ilonggo ining pagpatuman sang MAP sa aton man nga pagtudlo sa Hiligaynon  tubtub gintugtan na ini sa mga eskwelahan sa Western Visayas sugod sadtong 2012.
english: Because we also recognize Filipino as our mother tongue, we Ilonggos supported the implementation of MAP in our teaching of Hiligaynon until it was allowed in schools in Western Visayas since 2012.

text: Kon ngaa, ina tungod sa pagpati nga mapahapos ang paggamit sang English, samtang gapabilin nga official language ini upod sa aton national language nga Filipino, gamit ang mother tongue sang mga rehiyon.
english: Why, that's because of the belief that it will be easier to use English, while it remains the official language along with our national language Filipino, using the mother tongue of the regions.

text: Nangin madinalag-on naman ini.
english: It was a success.

text: Isa ka experimento ang ginhiwat sadtong 1948 tubtub 1954 agud pamunuan (pioneer) ang paggamit sang Hiligaynon bilang medium of instruction sa Grade 1 kag 2 sa Iloilo.
english: An experiment was conducted from 1948 to 1954 to pioneer the use of Hiligaynon as a medium of instruction in Grades 1 and 2 in Iloilo.

text: Sa ginhiwat nga mga pagtilaw (tests) sa Grade 1 kag 2, nga ginpamunuan ni Aguilar, napamatud-an ang pagpangibabaw sang mga kabataan nga natudluan sang Hiligaynon batok sa mga English-taught lang nga kabataan sa Reading, Math kag Social Studies.
english: In the tests conducted in Grades 1 and 2, led by Aguilar, it was proven that the children who were taught Hiligaynon were superior to the English-taught children in Reading, Math and Social Studies.

text: Gani gintugutan na sang gobyerno ang pagtudlo sang Hiligaynon sa Western Visayas sa primarya (Grade 1-4), lakip na ang Cebuano, Waray, Ilokano kag iban pa, nga galaum pa matudlo ang mga ini tubtub hayskul kag kolehiyo.
english: Therefore, the government has allowed the teaching of Hiligaynon in Western Visayas in primary (Grade 1-4), including Cebuano, Waray, Ilokano and others, with the hope that they will be taught until high school and college.

text: Luas sa daku nga rolyo sang Hiligaynon bilang taytay sa pagpasanyog sang kinaalam sa English, naghatag man ini sing daku nga rason agud dapat ma-preservar ini sing nagakabagay sa kasaysayan sang aton pungsod.
english: Besides the great role of Hiligaynon as a bridge in promoting English knowledge, it also gave a great reason to preserve it in accordance with the history of our country.

text: Manggaran ang Hiligaynon sa matahum nga ubra sa literatura – mga ambahanon (songs), binalaybay (poems), epiko (epic), komposo (original composition of music), kag mga daigon (Christmas songs).
english: Hiligaynon is rich in beautiful literary works – songs, poems, epics, original compositions of music, and Christmas songs.

text:
***

Ang pag-abot ugaling sang pagpatuman sang MAP nagdulot man sing problema.
english:
***

The arrival of the implementation of the MAP, however, also caused problems.

text: Ang 8 ka consonante ginkuha sa Spanish kag English alphabets, nga ang paggamit sini sa pagtuon sang mga kabataan bag-o man gani sa ila mga ginikanan nga ang gindak-an amo ang Abakada, hilaw nga Spanish, kag parrot-like nga pagbasa sang “Pepe and Pilar” sa English sa ila panahon.
english: The 8 consonants are taken from the Spanish and English alphabets, whose use in children’s learning is also new to their parents who grew up with the Abakada, raw Spanish, and parrot-like reading of “Pepe and Pilar” in English in their time.

text: Nonetheless, na-justify ini  sang aton mga otoridad sa lenggwahe.
english: Nonetheless, our language authorities have justified this.

text: Madamo nga mga tinaga ang na-adoptar naton sa Spanish kag English sa mga ngalan sang tawo kag iban pa nga mga tinaga nga imposible na ligwaton ang pagkasulat, labi na gid sa mga opisyal nga dokumento, nga dapat na ma-recognize sa aton lenggwahe (language/dialect).
english: We have adopted many words from Spanish and English in the names of people and other words that are impossible to translate, especially in official documents, which must be recognized in our language/dialect.

text:
***

Sa pag-ulhot sining 8 ka consonante, syempre kinahanglan man ang pagbag-o sang pagtudlo sa mga alfabeto kag mga tinaga.
english:
***

With the emergence of these 8 consonants, there is of course also a need for a change of teaching in alphabets and words.

text: Sa Abakada, mauna ang paghibalo sang kinaiya sang mga alpabeto agud magbalay sang mga tinaga.
english: In the alphabet, the first step is to know the characteristics of the alphabets to form words.

text: Sa MAP kinahanglan mauna anay mahibal-an ang tonog (sound) sang mga 8 ka consonante, mga letter combination kag mga tinaga nga ginaupdan nila agud makabalay sang mga tinaga kag ugaling mabasa sang mga kabataan, katulad sang pagtudlo sa Estados Unidos sang English, nga “sound language” sang mga Amerikano.
english: In MAP, children must first learn the sounds of the 8 consonants, letter combinations and words they accompany in order to form words and then read them, similar to the teaching of English in the United States, the “sound language” of the Americans.

text: Mangin problema gid bala naton ini?
english: Will this really be our problem?

text: Tan-awon ta.
english: Let's see.

text: Ining 8 ka consonante amo ang Cc, Ff, Jj, Ññ, Qq, Vv, Xx, kag Zz.
english: These 8 consonants are Cc, Ff, Jj, Ññ, Qq, Vv, Xx, and Zz.

text:

Carolina (girl’s name, read Karolina), Janice (girl’s name, read Dyanish with silent “e”),  Juan (name, read Huwan), Johnny (name, read Dyani), Alejo (name, read Aleho), Soqueña (family name, read Sokenya), Antique (Philippine province, read Antikey), Rex (name, read Reks) exacto (exact, read egsakto), Luzuriaga (family name, read Lushuriaga), Zarraga (Iloilo town, read Saraga), kag Chavez (name, read Cha-vesh).

Carolina (girl’s name, read Karolina), Janice (girl’s name, read Dyanish with silent “e”),  Juan (name, read Huwan), Johnny (name, read Dyani), Alejo (name, read Aleho), Soqueña (family name, read Sokenya), Antique (Philippine, read Antikey), Rex province, read Antikey read Reks) exacto (exact, read exacto), Luzuriaga (family name, read Lushuriaga), Zarraga (Iloilo town, read Saraga), and Chavez (name, read Cha-vesh).

text: Lakip man diri ang madamo nga Spanish words nga ginagamit sang mga Chavacano sa Zamboanga, mga tinaga nga teknikal kag sa siyensya, kag ang mga foreign words nga mahulam naton kon wala kita anay mabulos sa lokal nga pulong.
english: It also includes many Spanish words used by the Chavacanos in Zamboanga, technical and scientific words, and foreign words that we would borrow if we had not first been exposed to the local language.

english: Is it really a big problem if all we know is the Alphabet when our children are already using MAP in their studies?

english: Well, not really if we follow the teaching of English in the United States using the Code of Sounds under the Alphabetic Principle.

text: In fact, kon nahimo ini sa Estados Unidos nga madinalag-on, ngaa indi diri man sa aton?
english: In fact, if it has been done in the United States successfully, why not here too?

text: Simple man lang seguro kon ipatuman ang “pairing” ukon “matching” sang nasulat nga mga tinaga, nga mamitlang sing husto, sa mga larawan ukon mga figura, katulad sang “balay” nga ipares sa larawan sang balay (house), ukon “zero” nga papilian sa numero 1kag 0, ukon “box” nga ipares sa drowing sang “box”, kag iban pa.
english: It would be simple to implement the “pairing” or “matching” of written words, pronounced correctly, in pictures or figures, such as “balay” to match the picture of a house, or “zero” to choose from the numbers 1 and 0, or “box” to match the drawing of “box”, and so on.

February 1-5.

english: The agency said the price of rice decreased despite the continued increase in the price of rice.

text: Indi lahog- lahog ang nadangtan sang isa ka babaye sa United States matapos mag-angkon sang malala nga impeksiyon sa sinus nga nagsugod bangud sa utot sang iya nga nobyo.
english: A woman in the United States has suffered a serious sinus infection that started with her boyfriend's urine.

text: Suno kay Christine Connell, nag-umpisa ang iya masakita sang 2016.
english: According to Christine Connell, her illness began in 2016.

text: Sa iya pagsaysay, nagahigda siya sa kama sang hinali lang nag-utot ang iya nobyo direkta sa iya nawong.
english: In her account, she was lying in bed when her boyfriend suddenly farted directly in her face.

text: Sa una, nagkadlaw lang sila sa natabo apang makaligad ang pila ka adlaw, nakabatyag si Christine sang barado nga ilong, sakit sang ulo, sip-on kag hilanat.
english: At first, they just laughed about it but after a few days, Christine developed a blocked nose, headache, cold and fever.

text: Naglala ang sintomas kag naglawig sang tinuig tubtob napilitan siya nga magpalantaw sa mga doktor.
english: The symptoms worsened and lasted for years until she was forced to see doctors.

text: Nadiskubrehan nga may Escherichia coli o E. coli bacteria sa iya nga sinus.
english: He was found to have Escherichia coli or E. coli bacteria in his sinus.

text: Ang E. coli masami nga makit-an sa tinai kag indi sa ilong.
english: E. coli is usually found in the gut and not the nose.

text: Suno sa mga eksperto, posible nagsulod ang bacteria sa lawas ni Christine bangud maluya ang iya nga immune system.
english: According to experts, the bacteria may have entered Christine's body because of her weak immune system.

text: Pila ka ka mga bulong ang iya gintilawan apang nagabalik-balik ang impeksiyon.
english: She tried several medications but the infection kept coming back.

text: Bangud sini, ginkonsiderar sang doktor nga operahan ini kag kakason ang infected nga tissue sa iya nga ilong.
english: Because of this, the doctor considered surgery to remove the infected tissue from his nose.

text: Pahanumdom niya nga indi pagpabay-an ang mga sintomas kag samtang temprano pa, ipalantaw na ini sa doctor agud indi na maglala pa.
english: He reminded the public not to ignore the symptoms and while it is still early, to see a doctor so that it does not get worse.

text: Panugyan man sini sa tanan nga kun mahimo, likawan nga ototan ang sin-o man nga tawo bangud basi matabo man ini sa ila.

text: Nanindugan ang bag-o nga Supreme Leader sang Iran nga si Ayatollah Mojtaba ​Khamenei nga magapabilin nga sirado ang Strait of Hormuz.
english: Iran's new Supreme Leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei has insisted that the Strait of Hormuz remain closed.

text: Pahayag sini, gamiton nila ang amo nga strait bilang paagi agud nga ma-pressure ang ila kasumpong.
english: He said they will use the strait as a way to put pressure on their opponent.

text: Kabahin ini sang iya labing-una nga mensahe halin sang nag-ibwal ang gyera sa Middle East.
english: It was part of his first message since the war in the Middle East broke out.

text: Wala sang audio ukon video si Mojtaba, apang ginbasa sang state TV broadcaster ang iya public remarks.

text: Ginsupak ni Khamenei ang mandu ni US President Donald Trump kag panawagan sang iban nga global leaders nga dapat nga buksan na ang amo nga alagyan sang langis.
english: Khamenei defied US President Donald Trump's order and calls from other global leaders to open the oil pipeline.

text: Ginakabig ang Strait of Hormuz nga isa sa pinaka-importante nga shipping chokepoints sa bilog nga kalibutan nga amo ang nagaangot sa Persian Gulf sa madamo nga kapungsuran.
english: The Strait of Hormuz is considered one of the most important shipping chokepoints in the world that connects the Persian Gulf to many countries.

text: Antes ang gyera, ginabanta nga 20% sang global production sang langis ang nagalabay sa sini nga waterway.
english: Before the war, an estimated 20% of global oil production passed through this waterway.

text: Mahapos para sa Iran ang magsirado sini nga alagyan bangud sila ang nagakontrol sa northern side sang amo nga passageway.
english: It is easy for Iran to close this passage because they control the northern side of that passageway.

text: Nagpaandam man si Khamenei sa iya statement nga dapat siraduhan na ang tanan nga U.S. military bases sa rehiyon bangud bombahan ini sang Tehran.
english: Khamenei also warned in his statement that all U.S. military bases in the region should be closed because Tehran will bomb them.

text: “Studies have been conducted on opening other fronts in which the enemy has little experience and will be extremely vulnerable in them, and their activation will be carried out if the war situation continues and based on the observance of interests,” pahayag pa sini.
english: “Studies have been conducted on opening other fronts in which the enemy has little experience and will be extremely vulnerable in them, and their activation will be carried out if the war situation continues and based on the observance of interests,” it said.

text: Suno sa otoridad, may nabaton sila nga report nga nagpanginmatay si Ronquillo.
english: According to the authorities, they received a report that Ronquillo committed suicide.

text: Gindala pa ini sa ospital kag gin-revive apang ginbawian gid sang kabuhi.
english: He was rushed to the hospital and revived but died on the spot.

text: Matandaan nga sang nagligad nga adlaw, gindala man ni Ronquillo ang iya ex-girlfriend nga si Lima sa ospital apang gindeklarar man nga dead on arrival.
english: Last day, Ronquillo also took his ex-girlfriend Lima to the hospital but was declared dead on arrival.

text: Suno sa kapulisan, sa inisyal nga report, cardiorespiratory distress ang ginkamatay ni Lima apang may alegasyon nga nagaangot kay Ronquillo sa amo nga insidente.
english: According to police, in the initial report, Lima died of cardiorespiratory distress but there are allegations linking Ronquillo to the incident.

text: Base anay sa testimoniya sang ex-boyfriend, ginpulihan pa siya sang mga abyan sang late actress rason kun ngaa may mga kinarusan sa iya nawong.
english: According to the testimony of the ex-boyfriend, the late actress's friends replaced her, causing bruises on her face.

text: Natalana pa nga ipagwa ang autopsy result para sa bangkay sang ex-girlfriend agud matumod kun may foul play.
english: The autopsy result for the body of the ex-girlfriend is scheduled to be released to determine if there is any foul play.

text: (If you or someone you know is struggling with thoughts of self-harm, help is available.
english: (If you or someone you know is struggling with thoughts of self-harm, help is available.

text: Contact the National Center for Mental Health Crisis Hotline at +63 917 899 8727 and 7989 8727.)
english: Contact the National Center for Mental Health Crisis Hotline at +63 917 899 8727 and 7989 8727.)

text: Nagahingyo naman ang Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) sang koordinasyon halin sa publiko ilabi na sa mga barangay officials sa nagkalain-lain nga distrito sang syudad sa pagkampanya batuk sa iligal nga droga.
english: The Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) is seeking coordination from the public especially the barangay officials in the various districts of the city in the campaign against illegal drugs.

text: Suno kay PMaj.
english: According to PMaj.

text: Shella Mae Sangrines, spokesperson sang Iloilo City Police Office, iya ginpahayag nga wala nagakulang ang mga kapulisan sa pagmonitor sa mga persona nga naga-engage sa iligal drugs kag pagpangdakop sa mga suspek.
english: Shella Mae Sangrines, spokesperson of the Iloilo City Police Office, said the police are not lacking in monitoring persons engaged in illegal drugs and arresting suspects.

text: Apang, ginpahayag man niya nga dako nga bulig sa mga otoridad kun may yara sang koordinasyon ang mga residente kag barangay officials sa mga kapulisan.
english: However, he also said that it is a big help to the authorities if there is coordination between the residents and barangay officials with the police.

text: Ini bangud nga sila ang mas nakabalo sang sitwasyon sa ila tagsa ka barangay kag nakakilala sa mga indibidwal nga nagapuyo diri.
english: This is because they are more aware of the situation in their respective barangays and know the individuals who live there.

text: Pahayag pa sini nga kalabanan sa mga drug subject ang nagasaylo-saylo sang ila lugar agud nga indi madali madakpan sang mga kapulisan.
english: He said most of the drug subjects move from place to place so that they are not easily caught by the police.

text: Words by: Bombo Krylle Melliza
english: Words by: Bombo Krylle Melliza

text: Tuyo nga masabat sang Iloilo Provincial Government ang nagapadayon nga kakulangan sang classroom sa probinsya, paagi sa pagtun-over sang P125.320 Million nga pondo para sa programa kag proyekto nga iga-implementar sa bug-os nga Iloilo.
english: The Iloilo Provincial Government aims to address the ongoing shortage of classrooms in the province, by allocating P125.320 Million funds for programs and projects to be implemented throughout Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo, ginpahayag ni Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr.

text: nga base sa ila assessment, yara sa 1,665 ka classrooms ang kulang sa bug-os nga probinsya.Sa sini nga record, may yara sang 460 ka classrooms ang ginakabig nga prayoridad kag amo ang una nga pagatutukan sang provincial government.
english: that based on their assessment, there are 1,665 classrooms missing in the entire province. Of this record, there are 460 classrooms that are considered priority and will be the first focus of the provincial government.

text: Suno pa sa gobernador, ginpatigayon na ang maid-id nga pag-assess agud mahibaluan kun diin nga mga eskwelahan ang may pinaka daku nga kinahanglanon kag amo ini ang pagatagaan sang nasambit nga classrooms.
english: The governor said a thorough assessment has been conducted to determine which schools have the greatest need and will be provided with the classrooms.

text: Ang nasambit nga pondo ang naghalin sa Special Education Fund (SEF) nga tinutuyo gid nga makahatag sang solusyon sa problema sa kakulangan sang classroom kag mapauswag ang kahimtangan sang edukasyon sa probinsya.
english: The fund comes from the Special Education Fund (SEF) which aims to provide a solution to the problem of classroom shortage and improve the education system in the province.

text: Dugang pa ni Defensor, ang pagpatindog sang mga classrooms ang iga-implementar sa hugot nga koordinasyon sa Department of Education (DepEd).
english: Defensor added that the construction of classrooms will be implemented in close coordination with the Department of Education (DepEd).

text: Sa karon nga termino kag sa palaabuton pa, nagpasalig ang gobernador nga tinguhaan sang probinsya nga makabaton sang P500 Million nga budget para sa classroom construction, agud nga masiguro nga ang tanan nga bulutuhan sa Iloilo ang may nagakaigo kag husto nga mga hulot para sa pagtuon sang mga kabataan.
english: In the current term and in the future, the governor assured that the province will strive to receive a P500 million budget for classroom construction, to ensure that all schools in Iloilo have adequate and proper rooms for the learning of children.

text: SA PADAYON ko nga pagpasanyog sang ihibalo sa “correct Hiligaynon writing”, nag-abot gid man ang panahon nga nakasiling ako nga 75% nga pasado na ako kag wala na sing pangduha-duha sa akon ikasarang sa pagsulat kag pag-edit sa Hiligaynon.
english: IN my continuous development of knowledge of “correct Hiligaynon writing”, the time came when I could say that I was 75% passed and had no doubt about my ability to write and edit in Hiligaynon.

text: Sa mga bag-o nga manunulat sa Hiligaynon luyag ko, sa UNA, ipanugyan ini: “Kon tumod n’yo ang Ilonggo nga katilingban, gamiton n’yo sing lubos ining Filipino language variant (dialect) nga Hiligaynon, luas lang kon kinahanglanon gid ang paggamit sang mga “exception” halin sa pangayaw nga mga termino (terms).
english: To the new writers in Hiligaynon, I would like to suggest this: “If you are referring to the Ilonggo society, make full use of this Filipino language variant (dialect) of Hiligaynon, unless it is absolutely necessary to use exceptions from foreign terms.

text: IKA-DUHA, luyag ta man makabulig “reconcile” sang “differences”, paagi sa aton pagsulat, sa nagakalain-lain nga Ilonggo “areas” sa hambal (spoken words) kag pagsulat (writing) santu na sa “standardized” nga paggamit sang “correct Hiligaynon writing” sandig sa mga pagsulundan nga nahisugtan na sang aton mga otoridad sa lenggwahe (language/dialect).
english: SECOND, we also want to help reconcile differences, through our writing, in the various Ilonggo areas of spoken words and writing based on the standardized use of correct Hiligaynon writing based on the rules agreed upon by our language/dialect authorities.

text: Kag ina bisan pa may kaugalingon nga hambal ang kada isa sa aton para sa at least duha ka lenggwahe – ang pang-rehiyon nga diyalekto nga Hiligaynon kag ang ginagamit gihapon sang iban nga mas “localized” nga lenggwahe, katulad sang Kinaray-a sa Antique kag Akeanon sa Aklan, lakip na ang gindak-an naton nga Spanish kag ang English nga ginagamit pa gani sa mga eskwelahan.
english: And that's despite the fact that each of us has our own language for at least two languages ​​– the regional dialect of Hiligaynon and the more localized languages ​​still used by others, such as Kinaray-a in Antique and Akeanon in Aklan, including the Spanish we grew up with and even the English used in schools.

text: Indi katingalahan ang padayon naton nga paggamit sang Spanish kag English.
english: No wonder we continue to use Spanish and English.

text: Sa idalom kita sadto sa gahum sang Espanya sa sulod sang mga 300 ka tuig, kag mga 50 anyos sa idalom sang Estados Unidos.
english: We were then under Spanish power for about 300 years, and about 50 years under the United States.

text: May naamot man gani ang Chinese diri, labi na gid sa mga niluto nga pagkaon (batchoy, siopao, siomai).
english: The Chinese have even contributed here, especially in the cooked foods (batchoy, siopao, siomai).

text: Pati na seguro ang Niponggo sang sa idalom kita sing mga tatlo ka tuig sa mga Hapon.
english: Even Niponggo when we were under the Japanese for about three years.

text: Sa nasiling na naton, ang Hiligaynon ginatudlo na sa mga kabataan sugod pa sadtong 2012 sa mga lugar kon diin madamo nga mga Ilonggo ang nagapuyo, katulad sang Western Visayas.
english: As we have already mentioned, Hiligaynon has been taught to children since 2012 in areas where many Ilonggos live, such as Western Visayas.

text: Upod man diri sa sina nga hingyu ang mga diyalekto sang 10 pa ka dalagku nga mga rehiyon, lakip na gani ang pila ka “minor dialects” katulad sang Kinaray-a sa Antique kag Akeanon sa Aklan.
english: The request also includes the dialects of 10 other major regions, including some minor dialects such as Kinaray-a in Antique and Akeanon in Aklan.

text: Ang pagtudlo sa “correct Hiligaynon” sa hambal kag pagsulat  mahimo man ini sa mga “language seminar” kag mga “scholarship” sa bag-o nga mga manunulat kag sa mga nagapasanyog man sa pag-edit.
english: Teaching correct Hiligaynon in speech and writing can also be done through language seminars and scholarships for new writers and those who promote editing.

text: Sa akon bahin, tungod sa kakulang sang panahon, nagmatumato na gid lang ako sa pagtuon paagi sa “online tutoring”.
english: For my part, due to lack of time, I have been able to learn through online tutoring.

text: Subong man sa natun-an ko halin sa pagbasa sang “Balangaw sa Tingadlaw”, nga isa ka koleksyon sang mga malip-ut nga mga sugilanon ni Quin Baterna sa pag-edit sang premyado nga manunulat sa Hiligaynon nga si John Iremil Teodoro.
english: Also from what I learned from reading “Rainbow in Winter”, a collection of short stories by Quin Baterna edited by award-winning Hiligaynon writer John Iremil Teodoro.

text: Pati na, syempre, ang nahimo ko nga “research” sa iban pa nga “sources”.
english: Including, of course, the research I have done on other sources.

text: Kasubong ining akon pagtuon sa Hiligaynon sa Alternative Learning System (ALS), nga isa ka “shortcut” nga pagtuon baylo sa “formal learning” nga ginatugot naman sang aton Department of Education, nga sa akon pagpati natigayon ko pasaron sa grado nga 70-75%.
english: Like this study of Hiligaynon in the Alternative Learning System (ALS), which is a “shortcut” study instead of “formal learning” allowed by our Department of Education, which I believe I managed to pass with a grade of 70-75%.

text: IKATLO, nga mabuligan pa naton ang pagpasanyog sang Hiligaynon paagi sa “Rule of Thumb” sa pagsulat sandig sa “correct pronunciation” sang mga letra sang alfabeto kag mga tinaga (words).
english: THIRD, that we can help promote Hiligaynon through the “Rule of Thumb” in writing based on the “correct pronunciation” of the letters of the alphabet and words.

text:
Kung hambalon pa sa Filipino, “Kung ano’ng bigkas, siyang baybay.”

May kaugalingon nga tonog (sound/phoneme) kag pagmitlang (pronounce) ang mga bokablo (vowels) – a, e, i,o, u – kag mga consonante (consonants) nga ginaupdan naton sa Makabagong Alpabetong Pilipino.
english:
As the saying goes in Filipino, “What’s pronounced, he’s baybay.”

The vowels – a, e, i,o, u – and consonants that we include in the Modern Filipino Alphabet have their own sound/phoneme and pronunciation.

text: Ginpatuman ining MAP sadtong 1987 sa panahon ni anay Presidente Cory Aquino.
english: This MAP was implemented in 1987 during the tenure of former President Cory Aquino.

text: May lima (5) ini ka bokablo kag 23 ka mga consonante (consonants).
english: It has five (5) words and 23 consonants.

text: Walo (8) sa sining mga consonante mga bag-o nga letra, nga gindugang  sa sadto 20 ka letra sang Pilipino Abakada.
english: Eight (8) of these consonants are new letters, added to the previous 20 letters of the Philippine Alphabet.

text: Ining 8 ka letra amo ang Cc, Ff, Jj, Ññ, Qq, Vv, Xx, kag Zz nga halin sa “foreign alphabets” – Latin (sa forma sang pagsulat), kag ang Spanish kag English nga ang pagmitlang kag pagsulat sini nagapabilin sang ila impluwensya sa pagbalay sang aton lenggwahe nasyonal sadtong 1937 samtang ginasapupo gihapon ang aton mga diyalekto.
english: These 8 letters are Cc, Ff, Jj, Ññ, Qq, Vv, Xx, and Zz from the “foreign alphabets” – Latin (in written form), and Spanish and English whose pronunciation and writing retain their influence in shaping our national language in 1937 while we were still dialects.

text: Ang mga bokablo sa Hiligaynon may kinaiya (distinct) nga pagmitlang ang kada isa “similar” sa Spanish nga mapaathag man sa English – a (ah, as in father), e (eh, as in pet), i (ee, as in see), o (oh, as in boat), kag u (oo, as in boot).
english: The words in Hiligaynon have a distinct pronunciation, each “similar” to Spanish and can also be explained in English – a (ah, as in father), e (eh, as in pet), i (ee, as in see), o (oh, as in boat), and u (oo, as in boot).

text: Sa kaso ugaling sang a, may duha ini ka pagmitlang depende sa paggamit (allophone), katulad sang baga (burning ember) kag baga (lung), nga agud ma-“stress” pwede sulatan sang “acute accent” (mahumok nga pagmitlang) sa ibabaw sang nauna, kag sing “grave accent” (matig-a nga pagmitlang) sa ibabaw sang naulihi.
english: In the case of a, however, there are two allophones, such as burning ember and lung, which can be stressed with an acute accent over the former, and a grave accent over the latter.

text: Ang paggamit sang duha ka “accent” makita sa French word déjà vu, nga gin-“describe” ni  Saint Augustine nga isa ka “false memory”./PN
english: The use of both “accents” is found in the French word déjà vu, which Saint Augustine “described” as a “false memory”./PN

text: Ginhimo ni New York Yankees shortstop kag half filipino nga si Anthony Volpe nga mangin makahulugan ang iya pagbisita sa Pilipinas paagi sa paghiwat sang libre nga baseball camp para sa mga kabataan nga pinoy.
english: New York Yankees shortstop and half filipino Anthony Volpe made his visit to the Philippines meaningful by holding a free baseball camp for Filipino children.

text: Naglab-ot sa 200 ka mga kabataan ang nakabenepisyo sa camp nga ginhiwat sa isa ka Stadium sa Taguig.
english: About 200 children benefited from the camp held at a stadium in Taguig.

text: Naghatag sang mga laygay kag eksperyensya parte sa baseball si Volpe amo man ang mga personal sini nga ginpang-agyan sa nasambit nga sport.
english: Volpe gave advice and experiences about baseball as well as his personal experiences in the sport.

text: Nagpasalamat man siya sa iya mga pamilya diri sa Pilipinas nga nagbulig sa pagpatuman sang programa.
english: He also thanked his families here in the Philippines who helped implement the program.

text: Magapabilin si Volpe sa Pilipinas tubtob Enero 7 antes magbalik sa Estados Unidos agud magpreparar para sa maabot nga Major League Baseball season sa Marso 2026.
english: Volpe will remain in the Philippines until January 7 before returning to the United States to prepare for the upcoming Major League Baseball season in March 2026.

text: Naglapaw sa P1-trillion ang assets sang Social Security System (SSS) sang 2025.
english: The assets of the Social Security System (SSS) will exceed P1-trillion by 2025.

text: Ang SSS amo ang pension fund para sa mga empleyado sa pribado nga sector.
english: SSS is the pension fund for private sector employees.

text: Suno sa Department of Finance (DOF), nakalab-ot ang total assets sang SSS sa P1.26 trillion nga mas mataas sang 22.1% halin sa P1.03 trillion sang 2024.
english: According to the Department of Finance (DOF), the total assets of the SSS reached P1.26 trillion, up 22.1% from P1.03 trillion in 2024.

text: Suno kay Finance Secretary kag Social Security Commission (SSC) chairman Frederick Go, ang SSS reserve nagsobra sa P1 trillion sa labing-una nga tion nga isa ka pamatuod sang financial strength, overall security kag sustainability.
english: According to Finance Secretary and Social Security Commission (SSC) chairman Frederick Go, the SSS reserve exceeded P1 trillion for the first time which is a proof of financial strength, overall security and sustainability.

text: Ini nga performance suno sa ahensya isa ka maathag nga mensahe sa SSS members nga sigurado ang ila nga pension kag sustained ang mga benepisyo.
english: This performance, according to the agency, is a clear message to SSS members that their pension is secure and benefits are sustained.

text: “This record performance and over P1 trillion reserve fund level send a clear message to SSS members: your pensions are secure; your benefits sustained,” suno sa Finance official.
english: “This record performance and over P1 trillion reserve fund level sends a clear message to SSS members: your pensions are secure; your benefits sustained,” the Finance official said.

text: “Surpassing the P1 trillion mark in our reserve fund is a historic milestone and a strong affirmation of our duty to every Filipino worker and pensioner who relies on SSS,” dugang sini.
english: “Surpassing the P1 trillion mark in our reserve fund is a historic milestone and a strong affirmation of our duty to every Filipino worker and pensioner who relies on SSS,” it added.

text: Sang nagligad nga tuig, gin-implementar sang SSS ang una nga hugnat sang tuigan nga saka sa pension.
english: Last year, the SSS implemented the first round of annual pension increases.

text: Nag-grant ang SSS sang tuigan nga saka nga 10% sa retirement kag disability pensions, kag 5% sa survivor pensions halin sa 2025 tubtub sa 2027.
english: The SSS has granted an annual increase of 10% in retirement and disability pensions, and 5% in survivor pensions from 2025 to 2027.

text: “Guided by President Marcos Jr.’s directive to enhance benefits and strengthen governance, we are building a social security system that is financially resilient and more responsive to the needs of every Filipino,” dugang ni Go.#
english: “Guided by President Marcos Jr.’s directive to enhance benefits and strengthen governance, we are building a social security system that is financially resilient and more responsive to the needs of every Filipino,” Go.# added.

text: Nagsaka sa 188 ang kaso sang firecracker-related injuries nga nabalhag sang Department of Health (DOH).
english: The number of firecracker-related injuries recorded by the Department of Health (DOH) has risen to 188.

text: Suno kay Department of Health spokesperson Assistant Secretary Albert Domingo, ang kaso subong nga tuig ang mas mataas kon ikumpara sa 124 cases nga na-report sa kapareho nga period sang 2023.
english: According to Department of Health spokesperson Assistant Secretary Albert Domingo, the case this year is higher compared to the 124 cases reported in the same period in 2023.

text: As of 6 o’clock this morning, Disyembre 31, na-monitor sang ahensya ang 188 cases of fireworks-related injuries.
english: As of 6 o’clock this morning, December 31, the agency has monitored 188 cases of fireworks-related injuries.

text: Ini ang mas mataas sang 52% kon ipaangid sang 2023.
english: This is up 52% ​​compared to 2023.

text: Suno kay Domingo, kalabanan sa kabugh-usan sang kaso ang bangud sa boga—an improvised cannon nga himo sa PVC pipes kag ginagamitan sang denatured alcohol—ginasunda ini sang five star, kag piccolo.
english: According to Domingo, most of the total cases were due to boga—an improvised cannon made of PVC pipes and used with denatured alcohol—followed by five star, and piccolo.

text: Lakip naman ang eye injury, burnt skin ukon severed body parts ang masami nga complaints sang firecracker victims nga na-record sang DOH.
english: Eye injury, burnt skin or severed body parts are the most common complaints of firecracker victims recorded by the DOH.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga ang mga biktima ang halos naga-edad lima tubtob 19-anyos, kon sa diin ang na-report ang naghalin sa Metro Manila, Central Luzon, Western Visayas, Ilocos Region, kag Central Visayas.
english: He said the victims were mostly aged five to 19 years old, with those reported from Metro Manila, Central Luzon, Western Visayas, Ilocos Region, and Central Visayas.

text: Ginalauman sang DOH nga magasaka pa ang numero sang firecracker-related injuries sa tion mismo sang pagsug-alaw sang New Year.
english: The DOH expects the number of firecracker-related injuries to rise during the New Year.

text: Sang nagligad tuig, yara sa 140 ka kaso ang na-report sa tion lang sang midnight celebration.
english: Last year, 140 cases were reported during the midnight celebration alone.

text: Agud respondehan ang influx sang emergency patients sa tion sang New Year celebration, ginpasalig ni Domingo nga ang DOH hospitals kag regional offices ang yara sa Code White Alert tubtob Enero 6.
english: To respond to the influx of emergency patients during the New Year celebration, Domingo assured that DOH hospitals and regional offices are on Code White Alert until January 6.

text: Dismayado ang mga otoridad sang Iloilo City Police Station (ICPS) 2 sa mga barangay officials, amo man sa mga pumuluyo sang San Isidro, La Paz, Iloilo City matapos nga wala ang mga ini naga-coordinate sa estado sang iligal nga droga sa ila nga barangay.
english: The authorities of Iloilo City Police Station (ICPS) 2 are disappointed with the barangay officials, as well as the residents of San Isidro, La Paz, Iloilo City after they do not coordinate the state of illegal drugs in their barangay.

text: Suno kay PCapt.
english: According to PCapt.

text: Gimel Acuesta, hepe sang Iloilo City Police Station (ICPS) 2, wala sang may naga-report sa ila sa sitwasyon sang illegal drugs sa nasambit nga barangay.
english: Gimel Acuesta, chief of Iloilo City Police Station (ICPS) 2, said no one is reporting to them on the situation of illegal drugs in the said barangay.

text: Pahayag niya kun wala nakasa ang mga nagkalain-lain nga drug buybust operation sa barangay kun sa diin sunod-sunod man nga nadakpan ang mga drug subject, wala nahibaluan nga alarming na ang iligal nga droga sa nasambit nga barangay.
english: He said if the various drug buybust operations in the barangay had not been successful where drug subjects were arrested one after another, it would not have been known that illegal drugs in the said barangay are alarming.

text: Dugang pa ni PCapt.
english: PCapt.

text: Acuesta, personal man niya ginasekyar kag gina-monitor ang San Isidro La paz agud nga matul-id ang iban pa nga naga-engage sa illegal drugs kag malikawan ang paglapta sini.
english: Acuesta, he also personally checks and monitors San Isidro La Paz in order to correct others who are engaged in illegal drugs and prevent the spread of it.

text: ANG Standard Hiligaynon may tradisyonal kag masangkad nga bokabularyo (vocabulary), samtang ang Urban Hiligaynon may mas simplified ukon moderno nga bokabularyo.
english: Standard Hiligaynon has a traditional and extensive vocabulary, while Urban Hiligaynon has a more simplified or modern vocabulary.

text: Mabatian diri, por ejemplo, sa Standard Hiligaynon ang tradisyonal nga tinaga nga “dayan” (to wander) nga ang synonym sini nga “lagaw” ang preferred nga gamit sang mga kabataan sa Metro Iloilo.
english: Here, for example, in Standard Hiligaynon, you can hear the traditional word “dayan” (to wander) whose synonym “lagaw” is the preferred use of children in Metro Iloilo.

text: In fact, basi wala pa gani sila kahibalo sining tinaga nga “dayan”.
english: In fact, they may not even know this word “dayan”.

text: Mabatian man sa Metro Iloilo ang simplified kag moderno nga panghambal kag ang corrupted nga bersyon sang foreign words kag expressions sa Hiligaynon.
english: Simplified and modern speech and corrupted versions of foreign words and expressions in Hiligaynon can also be heard in Metro Iloilo.

text: Katulad sang mga expression nga “Kaon ‘ta” sa lugar sang “Makaon kita”; “Musta ka?” (Kamusta ka?); “Hi” (Hello); Kuha mo?” (Do you understand?);  “syudad” (siyudad);  “sugal” (jugar sa Spanish); “bilding” (building sa English) kag iban pa.
english: For example, the expressions “Let's eat” instead of “Let's eat”; “How are you?” (Hi there?); “Hi” (Hello); Get it?” (Do you understand?);  “city” (city);  “gambling” (jugar in Spanish); “building” and so on.

text: Yara man gani ang Bacolodnon Hiligaynon sa Metro Bacolod, Negrense Hiligaynon sa probinsya sang Negros Occidental nga ma-dividir sa tatlo ka sub-variants: Northern, Central kag Southern Negrense Hiligaynon.
english: There is also Bacolodnon Hiligaynon in Metro Bacolod, Negrense Hiligaynon in the province of Negros Occidental which can be divided into three sub-variants: Northern, Central and Southern Negrense Hiligaynon.

text: May Guimaras Hiligaynon kag Mindanao Hiligaynon man.
english: There are also Guimaras Hiligaynon and Mindanao Hiligaynon.

text: Ang Mindanao Hiligaynon may lakot nga Cebuano kag iban pa nga panghambal tungod sa influx sang mga pangayaw halin sa Cebu, Bohol, Siquijor kag iban pa nga Cebuano-speaking nga mga pumuluyo sa Soccsksargen (South Cotabato, Cotabato, Sultan Kudarat, Sarangani, kag General Santos).
english: Mindanao Hiligaynon is mixed with Cebuano and other dialects due to the influx of foreigners from Cebu, Bohol, Siquijor and other Cebuano-speaking peoples in Soccsksargen (South Cotabato, Cotabato, Sultan Kudarat, Sarangani, and General Santos).

text: In fact, undoubtedly sa bisan diin nga lugar, madamo na nga mga tinaga kag expressions nga indi na familiar ang mga ulihing tubo.
english: In fact, undoubtedly in any place, there are many words and expressions that are no longer familiar to the younger generation.

text: Mabasol ini siguro sa kapaslawan sang transgenerational transmission kon diin wala nangin madinalag-on ang mga katigulangan sa pag-transmit sini sa mga ulihing  tubo.
english: This is probably due to the failure of transgenerational transmission where the ancestors were not successful in transmitting it to the younger generation.

text: Nagakatabo ini bangod sa kakulang sang constant conversation sa ila tungod laban sang ila panahon ginagamit na sa gwa upod sa mga kaklase kag kasugilanon sa palibot sa hilway nga sitwasyon nga indi kinahanglan ang  pressure sang sinang-una nga nabal-an sang ila katigulangan.
english: This is due to the lack of constant conversation with them because most of their time is spent outside with classmates and talking around in a free situation that does not require the pressure of what their ancestors knew.

text: Dugang pa dira ang huyog sang mga kabataan nga mag-imbento sang mga terminology nga comfortable sila, nga nagalubong pa gid sa limot sang madamo nga dinumaan nga mga tinaga kag expressions.
english: In addition, children tend to invent terminology that they are comfortable with, further burying into oblivion many outdated words and expressions.

text: May problema man kita kon bala ano ang himuon sa mga pangayaw nga lenggwahe – foreign words (mainly English kag Spanish) – kon bala okey lang ang paggamit sa ila orihinal nga ispeling ukon sa corrupted nga Hiniligaynon nga ispeling, katulad sang “pasyar” (pasear sa Spanish),  “iskul” (school sa English), ukon ang ngalan nga  “Antique” gihapon nga indi maislan sa tumandok nga pagtawag nga “Iraya” ukon ano pa.
english: We also have a problem with foreign languages – foreign words (mainly English and Spanish) – whether it is okay to use them in their original spelling or in the corrupted Hiniligaynon spelling, such as “pasyar” (pasear in Spanish), “iskul” (school in English), or the name “Antique” “Iraya” or something.

text: May tion nga tatlo ang aton official language – Filipino, English kag Spanish.
english: There was a time when we had three official languages ​​– Filipino, English and Spanish.

text: Nangin duha na lang ini sang ma-abolish ang Spanish bilang official  language sadtong 1987.
english: It was reduced to two when Spanish was abolished as an official language in 1987.

text: Naabtan ko pa ang pagtuon sa Spanish.
english: I even caught up on learning Spanish.

text: Nangin subject ko sa hayskul ang Basic Spanish Grammar sadto.
english: I took Basic Spanish Grammar as a subject in high school.

text: Unfortunately, wala gid ako nag-alam sing husto diri kay indi gid madula-dula sa isip ko ang pagpamintas sang Spanish government sa Filipinas, labi na gid sa pagpatay nila kay Dr. Jose Rizal nga aton national hero.
english: Unfortunately, I didn't study properly here because I will never forget the Spanish government's atrocities in the Philippines, especially the killing of Dr. Jose Rizal our national hero.

text: Pero, no problem ako sa English kay “Best in English” pa gani ako sadto.
english: But, I had no problem with English because I was even “Best in English” back then.

text: I wonder though kon paano nag-bilib ang mga manunudlo ko ngaa kampyon ako sa English.
english: I wonder though how my teachers were impressed why I was a champion in English.

text:
Daw indi man…
