Tungod sining indi paghilituhog (variation) sa paggamit sang language dialect nga Hiligaynon kinahanglan gid seguro nga ma-reconcile ang ila differences kag ma-standardize ang paggamit sang Hiligaynon agud ma-minimize ang pagsalingasag sa pagsinugilanon kag sang mabasahan sa pahayagan.
english:
It doesn't seem like...

***

Because of this variation in the use of the Hiligaynon dialect, it is necessary to reconcile their differences and standardize the use of Hiligaynon in order to minimize confusion in conversation and what is read in the newspaper.

text: Indi lang agud ma-reconcile ang tonog (sound) kag ispeling (spelling) sini sa mga buluthuan sang mga kabataan, kundi agud ma-regulate man ang hilway nga huyog sang mga manunulat, labi na gid ang mga multi-lingual nga pwede maggamit sang Hiligaynon, Kinaray-a, Akeanon, English man ukon Spanish.
english: Not only to reconcile the sound and spelling of it in children's schools, but also to regulate the free will of writers, especially multi-lingual ones who can use Hiligaynon, Kinaray-a, Akeanon, English or Spanish.

text: In other words, kon ang tumod mo ang bumalasa sa Hiligaynon, puro na gid lang ang language dialect nga Hiligaynon ang gamiton mo sa pagsulat, luas lang kon kinahanglan sa kasulhayan sang panghangop sang bumalasa kag nimo man sang foreign words, lakip na ang halin sa Tagalog kag iban nga mga language dialects nga familiar man kita.
english: In other words, if you mean the reader in Hiligaynon, you should use only the Hiligaynon dialect in writing, unless it is necessary for the comfort of the reader's understanding and you also use foreign words, including those from Tagalog and other language dialects that we are familiar with.

text: Ginatagaan ta gid sing importansya ini sa aton research kag mga pangutana sa mga kilala nga mga manunulat nga katapo sang Sumakwelan Iloilo Inc.
english: We give importance to this in our research and questions to well-known writers who are members of Sumakwelan Iloilo Inc.

text: kon diin nagsulod kita sang nangin editor na ako sa Hiligaynon nga pahayagan.
english: where we entered when I became editor of the Hiligaynon newspaper.

text: Ang Sumakwelan gintukod ni Atty. Ramon Muzones sadtong 1948 upod sa iban pa nga kilala nga manunulat katulad sang multi-lingual nga si Santiago Alv.
english: Sumakwelan was founded by Atty. Ramon Muzones in 1948 along with other well-known writers such as multi-lingual Santiago Alv.

text: Mulato.
english: Mulatto.

text: Gani, UNA gid seguro sa mga pagsulundan sa pag-edit naton sa Hiligaynon ang ini: Kon tumod mo ang Hiligaynon nga Katilingban, gamiton mo sing lubos ang Hiligaynon, luas sa kinahanglanon nga mga exception.
english: Therefore, the FIRST of the rules for editing in Hiligaynon is this: If you refer to the Hiligaynon Society, you will use Hiligaynon fully, except for the necessary exceptions.

english: (Attached)/PN

text: Wala na ginasapak ni Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas ang posible nga pamulitika sa naglupok nga isyu sa Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situation (AICS).
english: Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas is no longer paying attention to possible politics in the issue of Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situation (AICS).

text: Ini matapos nga nalakip ang duha ka mga empleyado sang Iloilo City Hall sa 14 ka mga indibidwal, 12 diri ang mga barangay officials, sa ginpasakaan sang kaso sang Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) sa Office of the Ombudsman matapos ginaalegar nga nagpangbuhin sang AICS sang mga pumuluyo.
english: This comes after two Iloilo City Hall employees were among 14 individuals, 12 of them barangay officials, filed a case by the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) with the Office of the Ombudsman after allegedly reducing the AICS of residents.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo sa alkalde, iya ginpahayag nga kun sapakon niya ini, madula siya sa iya nga goal bilang pinuno sang syudad.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, the mayor said that if he ignores this, he will lose his goal as the head of the city.

text: Suno sa iya, ginatugyan na lang niya sa City Legal Office ang paghatag atensyon sa amo nga isyu.
english: He said he is leaving it to the City Legal Office to address the issue.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang mga involved nga city hall employees amo sanday Joebert Lim kag si Johnny Paul Dizon nga naga-duty sa Atipan Center .
english: It was learned that the involved city hall employees are Joebert Lim and Johnny Paul Dizon who are on duty at the Atipan Center.

text: Suno man sa alkalde nga iya pa nga ginahibalo ukon ginareview ang status sang mga Job Order angot sa duha ka empleyado sang city hall.
english: The mayor said he is still reviewing the status of the Job Orders regarding the two city hall employees.

text: Nag-agaw sang atensyon sang mga pilgrims sa katapusan nga adlaw sang National Youth Day (NYD) Cáceres 2025 sa Naga City, Camarines Sur matapos nga nagtuhaw ang panganod nga ang hurma ang kaangay sang imahe ni Birhen Maria.
english: The attention of pilgrims on the last day of the National Youth Day (NYD) Cáceres 2025 in Naga City, Camarines Sur was caught after a cloud appeared in the shape of the image of the Virgin Mary.

text: Natabuan gid nga may ginapatigayon nga closing mass kag programa sa lugar.
english: Coincidentally, there was a closing mass and program being held in the area.

text: Nagtuhaw ini sa ibabaw sa Basilica Minore of Peñafrancia.
english: It rose above in the Basilica Minore of Peñafrancia.

text: Tuman naman nga ginkalipay sang mga pilgrims ang ila nakita nga patimaan, suno sa ila, nga ginaubayan sila sang kalangitan sa ila nga kahiwatan.
english: The pilgrims were very happy to see the sign, according to them, that the sky is with them in their activity.

text: Nakigkita ang mga Hollywood stars nga sanday Oscar-winners Cate Blanchett kag Spike Lee kay Pope Leo XIV sa Vatican City.
english: Hollywood stars Oscar-winners Cate Blanchett and Spike Lee met with Pope Leo XIV in Vatican City.

text: Ginpahaya sang Santo Papa nga ang sinehan isa ka “workshop of hope” samtang naga-kabalaka naman ini sa naganubo nga tumlan-aw sa sinehan.
english: The Pope described the cinema as a “workshop of hope” while expressing concern over the declining cinema audience.

text: Nakigkita man sa Santo Papa sanday Monica Bellucci sang Mary Magdalene sang “The Passion of the Christ kag si Adam Scott sang Parks and Recreation kag Severance amo man si Sergio Castellitto sang Conclave.
english: Also meeting with the Pope were Monica Bellucci of Mary Magdalene of “The Passion of the Christ and Adam Scott of Parks and Recreation and Severance as well as Sergio Castellitto of the Conclave.

text: Suno kay Pope Leo, ang sinehan nagahatag sang paglaum kag lugar sa mga tawo agud ila pa gid makilala ang ila kaugalingon.
english: According to Pope Leo, cinema gives people hope and a place to know themselves better.

text: Ginpakigbahin man sang Santo Papa ang iya mga paborito nga pelikula kaangay sang It’s a Wonderful Life (1946), The Sound of Music (1965), Ordinary People (1980), kag Life is Beautiful (1997).
english: The Pope also shared his favorite films such as It's a Wonderful Life (1946), The Sound of Music (1965), Ordinary People (1980), and Life is Beautiful (1997).

text: Ginahikayat man sini ang mga institusyon nga indi magsuko sa ila ginabuhat, kundi magbinuligay sa paghatag sang importansya sa sosyal kag kultural nga misyon sang kaangay nga buluhaton.
english: It also encourages institutions not to give up on what they are doing, but to work together to emphasize the social and cultural mission of such work.

text: Natughong na sang 157 ka mga tricycle driver gikan sa nagkalain-lain nga toda sa distrito sang La Paz ang ila nga P500 fuel subsidy subong nga adlaw, Marso 28.
english: 157 tricycle drivers from various todas in La Paz district have already received their P500 fuel subsidy today, March 28.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jomarie Bendaval, isa ka tricycle driver nga may ruta nga Javellana-San Pedro-Ledesco Village, iya ginpahayag nga daku ang bulig sang P500 nga fuel subsidy bangud nga makalibre ini sila sang gatong sa pila ka adlaw nga byahe.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jomarie Bendaval, a tricycle driver on the Javellana-San Pedro-Ledesco Village route, said the P500 fuel subsidy is a big help because it will save them fuel for several days of travel.

text: Suno kay Bendaval, nagalab-ot pa sa isa ka semana sang una ang P500 pesos nga gatong apang subong asta na lang ini sa tatlo ka adlaw.
english: According to Bendaval, the P500 pesos fuel used to last for a week but now it lasts for three days.

text: Pahayag niya, agud nga mas makatipid sila sa gatong wala na sila nagalibot kag nagapila na lang sa ila toda kun sa diin maximun lang sa lima ka pasahero ang ila pwede mapasakay sa isa ka byahe.
english: He said that in order to save money on fuel, they no longer go around and queue at their toda where they can only accommodate a maximum of five passengers on a trip.

text: Apang, ginpahayag pa niya nga indi sa gihapon husto ang ila kita bangud nga halos tanan sini nagakadto na lang subong sa ila pagpagatong.
english: However, he said that their income is still not enough because almost all of it is now going to their fuel.

text: Dugang pa ni Bendaval, naga-umpisa siya byahe alas-syete sa aga tubtob alas-onse sa gab-i para madugangan ang iya kita bangud nga tama na gid ka pigado ka kabuhi subong ilabi na nga halos tanan nga balaklon nagataas ang presyo.
english: Bendaval added that he starts traveling from 7:00 am to 11:00 pm to increase his income because life is very poor now especially that almost all commodities are increasing in price.

text: Reported by: Bombo Krylle Crislyn Melliza
english: Reported by: Bombo Krylle Crislyn Melliza

text: Nangin “blessing in disguise” ang pagka-late sang isa ka estudyante kun ngaa nakaluwas ini sa posible nga kamatayon sang nagtibusok ang eroplano nga iya kuntani sakyan halin sa India.
english: A student's lateness was a blessing in disguise that saved him from possible death when his plane from India crashed.

text: Istorya ini ni Bhoomi Chauhan, 28-anyos nga business administration student sa Bristol, England nga nagbakasyon sa western India para sa holiday.
english: This is the story of Bhoomi Chauhan, a 28-year-old business administration student in Bristol, England who went on holiday to western India.

text: Suno kay Chauhan, naatrasar siya sa pagkadto sa airport bangud naipit siya sa traffic.
english: Chauhan said he was delayed in reaching the airport because he was stuck in traffic.

text: Nag-abot siya sa paluparan sa Ahmedabad dies minutos matapos nga nag-umpisa ang boarding process.
english: He arrived at the Ahmedabad airport ten minutes after the boarding process began.

text: Wala na siya ginpasugtan sang staff nga makakadto sa seat 36G sa Boeing 787 bisan pa nga naka-check-in siya online.
english: The staff refused to allow him access to seat 36G on the Boeing 787 even though he had checked in online.

text: Pila ka ginutlo lang ang nagligad matapos ang take-off, nagtibusok na ang eroplano kag masobra sa 260 ang napatay.
english: Moments after take-off, the plane crashed, killing more than 260 people.

text: “We got very angry with our driver and left the airport in frustration,” panugiron sini.
english: “We got very angry with our driver and left the airport in frustration,” he said.

text:
“I was very disappointed.”

“We left the airport and stood at a place to drink tea and after a while, before leaving… we were talking to the travel agent about how to get a refund for the ticket….
english:
“I was very disappointed.”

“We left the airport and stood at a place to drink tea and after a while, before leaving… we were talking to the travel agent about how to get a refund for the ticket….

text:
There, I got a call that the plane had gone down.”

Para kay Chauhan, milagro ini nga hitabo.
english:
There, I got a call that the plane had gone down.”

For Chauhan, this event was a miracle.

text: “I requested airline staff to allow me inside as I am only 10 minutes [late].
english: “I requested airline staff to allow me inside as I am only 10 minutes [late].

text: I told them that I am the last passenger and so please allow me to board the plane, but they did not allow me,” pagpakigbahin pa sini sang iya nga istorya.
english: I told them that I am the last passenger and so please allow me to board the plane, but they did not allow me,” he shared his story.

text: Ini kag ang isa ka lone survivor nga British national nga si Vishwashkumar Ramesh amo ang pila sa “miracle stories” sa sini nga plane crash.
english: This and a lone survivor British national Vishwashkumar Ramesh are among the “miracle stories” in this plane crash.

text: Base sa airline company, sakay man sa eroplano kag napatay sa amo nga trahedya ang British, Indian, Portuguese kag Canadian nationals.
english: According to the airline company, British, Indian, Portuguese and Canadian nationals were also on board the plane and died in the tragedy.

text: Nagapadayon pa ang imbestigasyon sang Indian authorities kun ngaa natabo ang pag-crash.#
english: Indian authorities are still investigating the cause of the crash.

text: Ginransak ang isa ka jewelry shop kag Money Changer sa sulod sang isa ka mall sa Pavia, Iloilo kaina sang aga.
english: A jewelry shop and money changer were robbed inside a mall in Pavia, Iloilo this morning.

text: Suno kay Police Colonel Bayani Razalan Director sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO), temporaryo nga ginpauntat sang management ang pagpasulod sang mga shoppers sa mall agud mapadasig ang imbestigasyon sang kapulisan.
english: According to Police Colonel Bayani Razalan, Director of the Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO), the management temporarily suspended the entry of shoppers into the mall to expedite the police investigation.

text: Ginpahayag ni Pcol.
english: Pcol said.

text: Razalan nga tatlo ang ginalantaw suspek sa nasambit nga pagpangransak kag ginapatihan miyembro sang ginatawag nga “termite gang.”Suno sa imbestigasyon, posible nga nag-agi ang mga suspek sa tiles ukon salog sang isa ka massage center.
english: Razalan said the three are believed to be suspects in the robbery and are believed to be members of the so-called “termite gang.” According to the investigation, the suspects may have passed through the tiles or floor of a massage center.

text: Una nga ginsulod ang jewelry shop nga nakuhaan sang madamo nga mga alahas, sunod naman nga ginkawatan ang isa ka money changer nga ginabanta nagabalor sang kapin P500,000 nga kwarta ang nataban.Padayon sa karon ang imbestigasyon sang kapulisan paagi sa pag-review sa mga CCTV sa lugar, agud matumod ang mgaindibidwal sa likod sang nasambit nga pagpangawat.
english: First, the jewelry shop was robbed of a large amount of jewelry, followed by the robbery of a money changer estimated to be worth more than P500,000. Police are conducting an investigation by reviewing CCTV cameras in the area, to identify the individuals behind the robbery.

text: Samtang, sa separado nga interview sang Bombo Radyo, ginpahayag ni Francis George Gorriceta, Executive Assistant to the Mayor sang Pavia, nga ginapanag-iyahan sang pamilya Gorriceta ang jewelry shop nga ginransak.Suno kay Gorriceta, posible nga natabo ang krimen kahapon sang gab-i kag nagpalagyo ang mga suspek kaagahon na sang aga.
english: Meanwhile, in a separate interview with Bombo Radyo, Francis George Gorriceta, Executive Assistant to the Mayor of Pavia, said the jewelry shop was owned by the Gorriceta family.

text: Dugang pa sini, nagakoordinar na sila sa kapulisan agud madakpan ang mga responsable sa pagpangawat nga ginatawag “termite gang.”
english: He added that they are coordinating with the police to arrest those responsible for the theft called “termite gang.”

text: Wala nadala pauli ni Alex Eala ang kadalag-an sa MGM Macau Tennis Masters matapos mapierde ini sa iya kasumpong nga si Mirra Andreeva sa score nga 6–4, 6–2.
english: Alex Eala failed to take home the victory at the MGM Macau Tennis Masters after losing to her opponent Mirra Andreeva 6–4, 6–2.

text: Hugot ang natabo nga hapang sang duwa ka mga atleta kun sa diin sa una nga set naka-abanse si Eala, apang madali naman nga nakabawi si Andreeva ilabi na sa exhibition match.
english: The two athletes had a tight match where Eala took the lead in the first set, but Andreeva quickly recovered especially in the exhibition match.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang sabado, napierde man sanday Eala kag Jerry Shang sa mixed doubles event matapos sila ginpierde sa magkapares nga sanday Yibing Wu kag Alejandro Davidovich Fokina.
english: On Saturday, Eala and Jerry Shang also lost in the mixed doubles event after they were defeated by the pair of Yibing Wu and Alejandro Davidovich Fokina.

text: Ginalauman nga magabalik si Eala sa Enero sa Australian Open.
english: Eala is expected to return in January at the Australian Open.

text: NANABAD naman ang aton abyan nga si Pedro.
english: OUR friend Peter is in trouble.

text: Nahibal-an mo bala… “Indi pa!” tugda ko nga palahog.
english: Did you know… “Not yet!” I suggested threateningly.

text: Wala  ka lang seguro kahibalo nga ginabasa ko ang imo kolum sa kada gwa sini.
english: You probably don't know that I read your column every time it comes out.

text: Nanotaran ko, ugaling, nga galain-lain ang  ang pagkasulat mo sang pila ka tinaga.
english: I noticed, however, that you spelled some words differently.

text: Kon kis-a “madamo”, kon kis-a “madamu”; kon kis-a “matahom”, kon kis-a “matahum”…Ano gid bala ang husto?
english: Sometimes “a lot”, sometimes “many”; sometimes “beautiful”, sometimes “beautiful”…What is really right?

text: Amo bala…Salamat kay ginasundan mo gali ang akon kolum, na-apreciar ini, kag seguro may natun-an ka man dira sa pila ka mga nasulat ko.
english: So...Thank you for following my column, appreciating it, and maybe you learned something from some of what I wrote.

text: Sori, kon kis-a indi ko man lubos matagaan panadlong (edit) ang ginasulat ko… Kon kis-a indi ko gid man matuod makita ang husto nga ispeling (spelling) sang tanan bisan sa pila ka liwat-liwat nga pagpanadlong ko.
english: Sorry, sometimes I can't quite edit what I write... Sometimes I can't really find the correct spelling of everything even in a few repeated corrections.

text: Kon kis-a malipat man ako kag lain ang maisip ko nga ispeling sa akon ginasulat.
english: Sometimes I forget and think of a different spelling of what I'm writing.

text: Ina tungod kay galain-lain man ang pagmitlang (pronounce) sa “spoken Hiligaynon” base sa tonog (sound) – mahumok ukon matig-a – nga masunod man sa pag-ispeling kon isulat sa Hiligaynon.
english: That's because the pronunciation of "spoken Hiligaynon" is different based on the sound - soft or hard - that follows the spelling when written in Hiligaynon.

text: Tungod man ina seguro kay ang diyalekto, katulad sang Hiligaynon, kasubong man sang aton lenggwahe nga Filipino, nahaloan na sang mga lenggwahe sang mga nag-tener diri nga mga pangayaw, labi na gid ang Spanish, English, kag Chinese.
english: That's probably because the dialect, like Hiligaynon, like our Filipino language, has been mixed with the languages ​​of the foreigners who stayed here, especially Spanish, English, and Chinese.

text: Nagpa-uso gani ini sang Taglish (halo sang Spanish, English kag Chinese).
english: It even popularized Taglish (a mix of Spanish, English and Chinese).

text: Indi lang sa pagpahayag, sa hambal kag sinulatan, sang kadam-an kundi lakip man gani sang kilala nga mga manunulat naton sa pungsod sa ila pagsulat sa Filipino kag sa nagakalain-lain nga diyalekto, lakip na ang Hiligaynon.
english: Not only in the expression, in speech and writing, of the masses but also of our well-known writers in the country in their writing in Filipino and in various dialects, including Hiligaynon.

text: By the way, lain ang tinaga nga Hiligaynon sa Ilonggo.
english: By the way, the word Hiligaynon is different from Ilonggo.

text: Ang Hiligaynon amo ang diyalekto sang mga pumuluyo samtang ang Ilonggo nagatumod sa mga pumuluyo sang Iloilo, Negros Occidental kag Capiz, lakip na ang mga nangayaw sa pagpuyo sa iban nga bahin sang Filipinas kag sa luas sang pungsod nga nagagamit sang nadak-an nga Hiligaynon.
english: Hiligaynon is the dialect of the people while Ilonggo refers to the people of Iloilo, Negros Occidental and Capiz, including those who have migrated to live in other parts of the Philippines and abroad who speak Hiligaynon.

text: Kon kis-a, ugaling, ginagamit naton ang diyalekto nga Hiligaynon interchangeably sa Ilonggo sa pagtumod sa panghambal sang mga pumuluyo sa kabug-usan sang Western Visayas tungod ensyano man ang halos tanan sa Hiligaynon bisan pa ang iban sa ila may kaugalingon nga panghambal.
english: Sometimes, however, we use the Hiligaynon dialect interchangeably with Ilonggo to refer to the speech of the people of Western Visayas as a whole because almost everyone speaks Hiligaynon even though some of them have their own language.

text: Ang Western Visayas nagasakop sang Iloilo, Capiz, kag Negros Occcidental lakip na ang Antique kag Aklan sa isla sang Panay  kag ang isla sang Guimaras.
english: Western Visayas includes Iloilo, Capiz, and Negros Occidental as well as Antique and Aklan on the island of Panay and the island of Guimaras.

text: Ang naandan nga panghambal sang taga-Antique, kon tawgon, Kinaray-a; samtang Akeanon naman ang iya sang Aklan.
english: The common language of the people of Antique, if called, Kinaray-a; while Aklan's is Akeanon.

text:
Sa Guimaras, isa sang lima ka banwa sini, ang Nueva Valencia,  naga-kinaray-a.

***

Unfortunately, indi ako nangin estudyante sang “formal education” sa Hiligaynon.
english:
In Guimaras, one of its five towns, Nueva Valencia, is Kinaray-a.

***

Unfortunately, I did not become a student of formal education in Hiligaynon.

text: Sa amon panahon, English kag Filipino lang ang amon ginatun-an hambalon kag sulaton sa eskwelahan, kag diutay nga Spanish sa hayskul.
english: In our time, we only learned to speak and write English and Filipino in school, and a little Spanish in high school.

text: Nagasalig lang ako sa akon paggamit sang “spoken Hiligaynon” upod sa kadam-an sa palibut ko sa paghambal samtang nagatuon kon paano sa pagsulat sini paagi sa nagalain-lain nga istilo kag pag-ispeling sang mga manunulat sa Hiligaynon kag Yuhom magazine.
english: I only rely on my use of “spoken Hiligaynon” with the crowd around me to speak while learning how to write it through the different styles and spellings of writers in Hiligaynon and Yuhom magazine.

text: Nanotaran ko ugaling sang ulihi nga indi man magsinantu sa “written Hiligaynon” ang sinulatan sang mga manunulat bisan sa ila tagsa sinulatan, katulad sang kon paano ang mag-ispeling sang mga tinaga sa Hiligaynon sandig sa pagpanugyan sang mga Hiligaynon scholars kag “production editors” nga nagatipon sang ila sinulatan para mas ma-apreciar ang presentasyon sini sa publiko kag para mabuligan edukar ang “reading public” para sa “educated” nga paggamit sang Hiligaynon.
english: I later noticed, however, that the writers' writings do not match the “written Hiligaynon” even in their own writings, such as how to spell words in Hiligaynon based on the advice of Hiligaynon scholars and production editors who collect their writings for publication and presentation. help educate the reading public for the educated use of Hiligaynon.

text: Especially tungod indi man magkapareho, sa siling ta na, ang “spoken” kag “written” Hiligaynon.
english: Especially since “spoken” and “written” Hiligaynon are not the same.

text: By the way, daw nadula lang ining duha ka magasin sang ulihi, tungod seguro kay nagkulang sang readership agud indi na mapasige, although ginabuhi gihapon ang paggamit sang Hiligaynon bisan paano sa mga balita kag kolum sa pila ka pahayagan katulad sang Panay News kag iban pa nga pahayagan lokal.
english: By the way, these two magazines seem to have disappeared later, probably because there was a lack of readership so that they could not be continued, although the use of Hiligaynon is still revived in news and columns in some newspapers such as Panay News and other local newspapers.

text:
***

Daw aksidente man lang nga nangin-editor ako sa isa ka pahayagan nga Hiligaynon.
english:
***

It was an accident that I became an editor of a Hiligaynon newspaper.

text: Tungod sa engganyo sang mas daku nga kita napasugot ako sang amigo ko nga publisher nga mag-editor sa iya mga pahayagan tungod sa paghalin sang nauna sa akon nga editor.
english: With the lure of a higher income, a friend of mine, a publisher, agreed to become an editor for his newspapers due to the departure of my predecessor.

text: Ang iya mga pahayagan nagalakip sang isa ka English daily newspaper, isa ka weekly magazine sa English, kag ang isa ka tri-weekly sa Hiligaynon.
english: His newspapers include an English daily newspaper, a weekly magazine in English, and a tri-weekly in Hiligaynon.

text: One-man army ang gwa ko, apang wala ako nagreklamo kay mas mataas ang iya ginasuweldo sa akon ikumparar sa ginhalinan ko nga pamantalaan.
english: I was a one-man army, but I didn't complain because he paid me more than the newspaper I came from.

text: Of course, ang problema ko amo kon paano ako magsulat kag mag-edit sa “educated Hiligaynon” bangod “street Hiligaynon” lang ang akon naandan.
english: Of course, my problem is how to write and edit in “educated Hiligaynon” because I am only used to “street Hiligaynon”.

text: Nangisug lang ako sa pagbaton mangin editor sang Hiligaynon tri-weekly sang maisip ko nga ang mga bumalasa laban sini indi man mga lantip sa Hiligaynon.
english: I only dared to accept the editorship of the Hiligaynon tri-weekly when I thought that most of the readers were not fluent in Hiligaynon.

text: Basi ang mga manunudlo man lang kag mga estudyante nga naga-“major subject” sa Filipino language upod ang local dialect.
english: Maybe the teachers and students who are majoring in Filipino language with the local dialect.

text: (May kasugpon)/PN
english: (Attached)/PN

text: Nagdangat sa 3.52 billion US Dollar ang ginapadala nga kwarta sang mga Overseas Filipino Workers (OFW) sang Disyembre 2025, nga nagpa-umwad sa kabug-usan nga remittances sa bilog nga tuig nga 35.63 billion US Dollar nga pinakamataas sa kasaysayan, suno sa Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP).
english: The remittances of Overseas Filipino Workers (OFWs) will reach 3.52 billion US dollars in December 2025, bringing the total remittances for the whole year to 35.63 billion US dollars, the highest in history, according to the Central Bank of the Philippines (BSP).

text: Mas mataas ini sang 3.3% kumpara sa 34.49 billion US Dollar sang 2024.
english: This is 3.3% higher compared to 34.49 billion US Dollar in 2024.

text: Ang remittances sang 2025 nagrepresentar sang 7.3% sang GDP kag 6.4% sang gross national income sang pungsod.
english: Remittances in 2025 represented 7.3% of GDP and 6.4% of the country’s gross national income.

text: Ang Estados Unidos ang nagapanguna nga pinagmumulan sang remittances, sinundan sang Singapore kag Saudi Arabia.
english: The United States is the leading source of remittances, followed by Singapore and Saudi Arabia.

text: Para sa mga land-based OFW, 41% ang share sang Estados Unidos, samtang sa sea-based naman, 32.2%.
english: For land-based OFWs, the United States accounted for 41%, while for sea-based, it was 32.2%.

text: Kaupod sa personal remittances, nga nagalakip sang kwarta kag goods ang nag-record sang 3.89 billion US Dollar sa Disyembre kag 39.62 billion US Dollar sa bilog nga tuig, mas mataas sang 3.3% kumparar sa 2024.
english: Together with personal remittances, which includes money and goods recorded 3.89 billion US Dollar in December and 39.62 billion US Dollar for the whole year, up 3.3% compared to 2024.

text: Ginwasak sang US military ang naval ships sang Iran dala ang 16 nga minelayers ukon barko nga gina-gamit sa pag-mina malapit sa Strait of Hormuz, isa sa pinaka-importante nga alagyan kun sa diin ginabyahe ang one-fifth nga krudo sa bilog nga kalibutan.
english: The US military destroyed Iranian naval ships along with 16 minelayers or ships used for mining near the Strait of Hormuz, one of the most important routes through which one-fifth of the world's crude oil travels.

text: Ang nasambit nga strike parte sang military action sang pungsod kun sa diin nagpaandam si US Secretary Pete Hegseth sang tuman nga pagpang-atake.
english: The strike is part of the country's military action where US Secretary Pete Hegseth warned of severe attacks.

text: Base sa report, nagapati ang US intelligence assets nga nagahanda ang Iran para sa posible nga pagpadala sang naval mines sa Strait of Hormuz.
english: According to the report, US intelligence assets believe that Iran is preparing for the possible shipment of naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz.

text: Ginkumpirma naman ni US President Donald Trump nga nakit-an na sang mga ini nga naguba ang pila ka mga numero sang inactive mine laying boats kag mga barko.
english: US President Donald Trump confirmed that they have already found a number of inactive mine laying boats and ships damaged.

text: Samtang, gin-akusaran naman sang Iran Ambassador to the United Nations ang Amerika kag Israel nga tuyo ang pagtarget sa mga sibilyan kun sa diin nagpatay masobra 1,300 ka mga tawo sa ila ginpataigayon nga airstrike halin sang nag-umpisa ang gyera sang Pebrero 28.
english: Meanwhile, the Iranian Ambassador to the United Nations accused the United States and Israel of deliberately targeting civilians, killing more than 1,300 people in airstrikes since the war began on February 28.

text: Padayon pa subong ang imbestigasyon sang otoridad sa kamatayon sang Vivamax ­artist nga si Gina Lima.
english: Authorities are still investigating the death of Vivamax artist Gina Lima.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon, antes ang insidente, nagbisita sa iya condominium sa Quezon City ang iya ex- boyfriend nga si Ivan Cezar Ronquillo, 24.
english: According to the investigation, before the incident, her ex-boyfriend Ivan Cezar Ronquillo, 24, visited her condominium in Quezon City.

text: Pagkasunod nga aga, nakit-an na lang ni Ronquillo si Lima nga wala na nagaginhawa.
english: The next morning, Ronquillo found Lima not breathing.

text: Gindala sang anay nobyo si Lima sa ospital apang gindeklarar ini nga dead-on- arrival.
english: Lima's ex-boyfriend rushed her to the hospital but she was declared dead on arrival.

text: Kasunod sang insidente, madamo naman ang nagpahayag sang ila pagduda kay Ronquillo nga amo ang ginatudlo nga nagkastigo kay Lima nga amo ang gintunaan sang kamatayon sini.
english: Following the incident, many expressed their suspicion of Ronquillo who allegedly beat Lima to death.

text: Suno sa post sang mga abyan sang biktima, masami sadto makitaan sang lagob sa lawas ang biktima kag ang ginatudlo nga may kahimuan amo si Ronquillo.
english: According to the post of the victim's friends, the victim was often seen with bruises on his body and the suspect was Ronquillo.

text: Patay ang 2 ka indibidwal samtang pilason naman ang 8 matapos ang pagpangluthang nga natabo sa Brown University sa Providence, Rhode Island, sa Estados Unidos samtang nagapadayon ang final exams sang mga estudyante.
english: Two people were killed and eight others injured in a shooting at Brown University in Providence, Rhode Island, in the United States while students were taking their final exams.

text: Suno sa mga awtoridad, ang suspek ang isa ka lalaki nga nakit-an nga nagasuksok sang itom nga panapton sang natabo ang nasambit nga krimen.
english: According to authorities, the suspect is a man who was seen wearing black clothing at the time of the crime.

text: Nagpagua naman ang unibersidad sang shelter-in-place alert kag nagakoordinar sa mga kapulisan kag mga medical team samtang nagahatag sang suporta sa mga estudyante, empleyado, kag pamilya nga apektado sang insidente.
english: The university has issued a shelter-in-place alert and is coordinating with police and medical teams while providing support to students, employees, and families affected by the incident.

text: Sa karun, nagapadayon ang pag-imbestiga amo man ang pagpangita sa suspek nga nakapalagyo.
english: The investigation is ongoing as well as the search for the suspect who escaped.

text: Nagapahanumdom man ang mga lokal nga opisyales sa publiko nga magpabilin nga mabinantayon sa ila tagsa ka palibot.
english: Local officials are also reminding the public to remain aware of their surroundings.

text: Napaslawan nga makuha sang Tennis star nga si Alex Eala kag duo sini nga si Jerry Shang ang ila mixed doubles sa MGM Macau Tennis Masters event.
english: Tennis star Alex Eala and his duo Jerry Shang failed to win their mixed doubles at the MGM Macau Tennis Masters event.

text: Ini matapos sila malutos sila sang ila kasumpong nga sanday Alejandro Davidovich Fokina sang Spain kag Yibing Wu sang China sa score nga 7–5, 7–6 sa tiebreak.
english: They were defeated by Alejandro Davidovich Fokina of Spain and Yibing Wu of China 7–5, 7–6 in a tiebreak.

text: Si Fokina amo man ang nagdaog kay Shang sa men’s singles sa score nga 7–6, 7–5.
english: Fokina also defeated Shang in the men’s singles by a score of 7–6, 7–5.

text: May yara naman sang kahigayunan si Eala nga magpasundayag sa women’s singles kontra kay Mira Andreeva sa subong nga adlaw.
english: Eala will have the opportunity to perform in the women's singles against Mira Andreeva today.

text: Apisar nga MGM Macau Tennis Masters isa ka exhibition tournament kag indi kabahin sang Women’s Tennis Association (WTA) calendar, nagahatag naman ini sang importante nga eksperyensya para sa mga atleta.
english: Although the MGM Macau Tennis Masters is an exhibition tournament and not part of the Women’s Tennis Association (WTA) calendar, it does provide an important experience for the athletes.

text: Magahatag sang cash relief assistance para sa mga transport groups ang Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) Region 6 kun sa diin paga-unahun nga hatagan ang mga qualified tricycle drivers sa Western Visayas.
english: The Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) Region 6 will provide cash relief assistance to transport groups with priority given to qualified tricycle drivers in Western Visayas.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Therese Fely Legaste, Regional Information Officer, DSWD Field Office VI, iya ginpahayag nga P5,000 ang pagabatunon sang mga ini nga subsidiya halin sa gobyerno.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Therese Fely Legaste, Regional Information Officer, DSWD Field Office VI, said they will receive P5,000 subsidy from the government.

text: Suno kay Legaste, padayun pa ang koordinasyon sang ila ahensya sa local government units sang mga highly urbanized cities, component cities kag mga munisipalidad nahanungod sa igahatag nga assistance.
english: Legaste said their agency is still coordinating with local government units of highly urbanized cities, component cities and municipalities regarding the assistance to be provided.

text: Ginpakigbahin man niya nga patigayunon ang distribution sang cash assistance sa Abril 8, ukon sa pagtakop sang semana santa.
english: He also shared that the distribution of cash assistance will be held on April 8, or at the end of Holy Week.

text: Dugang pa ni Legaste, kinahanglan nga magpakig-angot anay sang mga tricycle drivers sa ila tagsa ka TODA kag Local Government Units agud mangin isa sa mga benepisyaryo.
english: Legaste added that tricycle drivers should first contact their respective TODAs and Local Government Units to become one of the beneficiaries.

text: Kumpirmado nga pangunahan ni Iñigo Pascual ang cast sang Philippine adaptation sang kilala nga medical drama nga “The Good Doctor,” nga ginatalana mag-premiere sa masunod nga tuig.
english: Iñigo Pascual is confirmed to lead the cast of the Philippine adaptation of the acclaimed medical drama “The Good Doctor,” set to premiere next year.

text: Ang serye base sa 2013 nga South Korean K-drama nga may pareho man nga tig-ulo.
english: The series is based on the 2013 South Korean K-drama of the same title.

text: Pagabidahan ni Iñigo ang karakter ni Dong, ang ginatawag nga “The Good Doctor,” nga nagapakita sang pinasahi nga abilidad, instincts, kag matuod-tuod nga kaluoy sa iya mga pasyente.
english: Iñigo will play Dong’s character, the so-called “The Good Doctor,” who displays exceptional skills, instincts, and genuine compassion for his patients.

text: Maupod sang actor ang aktres nga si Gabby Padilla, nga isa man sa mangin importante nga parte sang serye.
english: The actor will be joined by actress Gabby Padilla, who will also be an integral part of the series.

text: Sa subong, wala pa gibuyagyag ang dugang nga detalye angot sa kabug-usan nga storyline kag iban pa nga mga karakter nga mangin kabahin sang drama.
english: As of now, no further details have been revealed about the overall storyline and other characters that will be part of the drama.

text: Nadiskubrehan man nga ang “The Good Doctor” gin-adopt na sang nagkalain-lain nga pungsod, lakip na ang Estados Unidos, Turkey, Japan, kag Hong Kong, antes ini masulod sa Philippine television.
english: It was also discovered that “The Good Doctor” had already been adopted by various countries, including the United States, Turkey, Japan, and Hong Kong, before it entered Philippine television.

text: Nagaguwa sa reports nga nagpangtanum na ang Iran sang bomba sa Strait of Hormuz — ang alagyan sang daku nga suplay sang langis nga kinahanglan sang madamo nga mga pungsod.
english: Reports indicate that Iran has already planted a bomb in the Strait of Hormuz — the channel for a large supply of oil that many countries need.

text: Sandig sa impormasyon nga nakalab-ot naman kay United States President Donald Trump, indi pa malapad ang area kun sa diin ginpangbutang ang mga bomba.
english: According to information received by US President Donald Trump, the area where the bombs were placed is not yet wide.

text: “The mining is not extensive yet, with a few dozen having been laid in recent days, the sources said.
english: “The mining is not extensive yet, with a few dozen having been laid in recent days, the sources said.

text: But Iran still retains upward of 80% to 90% of its small boats and mine layers, one of the sources said, so its forces could feasibly lay hundreds of mines in the waterway,” sandig sa reports sang CNN.
english: But Iran still retains upward of 80% to 90% of its small boats and mine layers, one of the sources said, so its forces could feasibly lay hundreds of mines in the waterway,” according to CNN reports.

text: Nahibaluan nga may kapasidad ang Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) sang Iran nga mag-deploy sang “gauntlet” sang dispersed mine-laying craft, explosive-laden boats, kag shore-based missile batteries.
english: It is known that Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) has the capacity to deploy a “gauntlet” of dispersed mine-laying craft, explosive-laden boats, and shore-based missile batteries.

text: Ang IRGC amo subong ang nagakontrol sang Strait of Hormuz.
english: The IRGC now controls the Strait of Hormuz.

text: Gilayon naman nga gin-address ni Trump ang isyu paagi sa iya post sa Truth Social.
english: Trump immediately addressed the issue with a post on Truth Social.

text: Nagpaandam ini nga dapat kakason na sang Tehran ang ginpangbutang sini nga bomba, bangud kun indi, maagyan nila ang military consequences nga wala pa nila na-eksperyensyahan.
english: He warned that Tehran must remove the bomb it planted, otherwise they will suffer military consequences that they have never experienced.

text: “If for any reason mines were placed, and they are not removed forthwith, the Military consequences to Iran will be at a level never seen before,” kabahin sang post sang US president.
english: “If for any reason mines were placed, and they are not removed forthwith, the Military consequences to Iran will be at a level never seen before,” part of the US president’s post.

text:
Apang dugang niya, kun kuhaon sang Iran kun ano ang ila ginbutang, “it will be a giant step in the right direction.”

Kasunod sang amo nga post ni Trump, nag-post man si US Secretary of War Pete Hegseth sa X nga sunod sa direksyon sang presidente, gina-eliminate na sang US Central Command ang “inactive mine-laying vessels in the Strait of Hormuz—wiping them out with ruthless precision.
english:
But he added that if Iran takes what they have put in place, “it will be a giant step in the right direction.”

Following Trump's post, US Secretary of War Pete Hegseth also posted on X that following the president's direction, US Central Command is eliminating “inactive mine-laying vessels in the Strait of Hormuz—wiping them out with ruthless precision.

text:
We will not allow terrorists to hold the Strait of Hormuz hostage.”

Sunod naman nga nagkumpirma ang US Central Command nga ginpangguba nila ang pila ka Iranian naval ships — lakip na ang 16 minelayers — malapit sa Strait of Hormuz.
english:
We will not allow terrorists to hold the Strait of Hormuz hostage.”

The US Central Command subsequently confirmed that it had destroyed several Iranian naval ships — including 16 minelayers — near the Strait of Hormuz.

text: Ginakabig ang Strait of Hormuz nga isa sa most critical maritime chokepoints sa kalibutan kun sa diin 20–25% sang global oil consumption kag 20% sang liquefied natural gas (LNG) ang nagalabay kada adlaw.
english: The Strait of Hormuz is considered one of the most critical maritime chokepoints in the world where 20–25% of global oil consumption and 20% of liquefied natural gas (LNG) pass daily.

text: Nahamtang ini nga 33km-wide waterway sa tunga sang Iran kag Oman, kag amo ang primary exit para sa Gulf producers kaangay sang Saudi Arabia, Iraq, kag Qatar.
english: This 33km-wide waterway is located between Iran and Oman, and is the primary exit for Gulf producers like Saudi Arabia, Iraq, and Qatar.

text: GINA-selebrar sang Kristiyanong katilingban ang Semana Santa (Holy Week) sa semana nga ini.
english: THE Christian community is celebrating Holy Week this week.

text: Mayor ginapamalandongan naton diri ang Good Friday (Marso 29) kon san-o nag-antos kag napatay sa krus si Kristo kag ang Iya pagka-banhaw sa adlaw nga Sabado (Marso 30).
english: Mayor, we are reflecting here on Good Friday (March 29) when Christ suffered and died on the cross and His resurrection on Saturday (March 30).

text: Samtang, luyag ta anay tagaan kasanagan diri kon paano malikawan ang  mga nagapa-diyos-diyos kag mga mensahero kuno sang Diyos nga madamo na ang nangin biktima sang ila paniplang tubtub sa sining ulihi lang.
english: Meanwhile, we would like to shed light on how to avoid the idolaters and supposed messengers of God who have become victims of their deception until recently.

text: Gintudluan kita ni Santo Tomas kon paano makilala ining peke nga mga personalidad agud indi kita nila matontohan kag maupod pa sa kalaglagan sang ila kalag.
english: St. Thomas taught us how to recognize these false personalities so that they will not deceive us and lead us to the destruction of their souls.

text: Paano?
english: How?

text: Una, indi basta magpati lang sa ginasugid sang bisan ang nagapanumpa gid sa kuno kamatuoran sang iya ginasugid, ukon gapakita sang indi kinaandan nga kinaadman.
english: First, do not simply believe what is said even by someone who swears to the truth of what he says, or who shows unusual wisdom.

text: Ika-duha, hatagi gihapon ini sing pagpangduha-duha kay may tawo gid man nga manloloko kag may kasubong nga kinaadman nga indi kinahanglan may pagka-Diyos siya.
english: Second, still give it a doubt because there are people who are deceitful and have such knowledge that they do not have to have God.

text: Kag ika-tatlo, tukibon kon ano gid ang pagkatawo sini sandig sa pagtudlo, buhat, kag pagkatawo kag pagka-Diyos ni Kristo.
english: And third, discover what it really is based on the teachings, works, and person and divinity of Christ.

text: “Indi ako magpati sa pagka-banhaw ni Kristo kon indi ko  mahikap ang pilas sang lansang sa Iya mga palad,” siling ni Santo Tomas sang sugiran sang mga kaupod niya parti sini.
english: “I would not believe in the resurrection of Christ unless I could touch the nail wounds in His hands,” said St. Thomas when his companions told him about it.

text: Nakumbinsir lang ini sang magpakita liwat si Kristo sa Iya mga disipulo nga upod na si Santo Tomas.
english: This was only confirmed when Christ appeared again to His disciples with St. Thomas.

text: Samtang ang iban nga disipulo nagpati, paagi sa “proof by contradiction”, sa sugid ni Santa Magdalena nga kilala sa iya katampad kag sang duha ka testigo nga nakasugata kay Kristo sa dalanon.
english: While the other disciples believed, by “proof by contradiction”, the story of St. Magdalene who was known for her companionship and the two witnesses who met Christ on the road.

text: Nagpahayag sila nga matuod gid ang ila ginasugid nga indi  manegar sang ila konsyensya agud mapatihan “by faith”, nga ginkilala naman ni Kristo.
english: They declared that what they were telling was true and that their conscience would not deny it in order to believe “by faith”, which Christ recognized.

text: Gamit man ang “proof of contradiction”, simple man ang paglubag sang paniplang sang mga peke nga ini  paagi sa pagpamatuod sang pagka-taliwas nila sa pagkatawo kag pagka-Diyosnon ni Kristo.
english: Using the proof of contradiction, it is simple to break the scheme of these fakes by proving their difference from the humanity and divinity of Christ.

text: Gintindugan ni Kristo ang iya Diyosnon nga otoridad, apang nagpaidalom Siya sa kasuguan kag pamatbat sang tawo.
english: Christ established His Divine authority, but He submitted to human law and interpretation.

text: Indi pareho sang peke nga ginapahog ang husgado nga naga-akusa sa iya sang silot sa Impyerno.
english: It’s not like fake threatening the court accusing him of punishment in Hell.

text: Wala si Kristo kinahanglan sang manggad sang kalibutan kundi ang kapatawaran kag kaluwasan lang sang kalag sang katauhan.
english: Christ did not need the riches of the world but only the forgiveness and salvation of the souls of mankind.

text: Nangabuhi  Siya sa duta upod sa mga kubos.
english: He lived on earth with the poor.

text: Indi pareho sang peke nga ang handom lang magamit ang mga sumulunod sa iya pagtipon sang kalibutanon nga manggad.
english: Unlike the fake whose only desire is to use followers in his accumulation of worldly wealth.

text: Si Kristo nagpaseguro sang matabo  (prophesy) sa Iya pag-antos kag kamatayon nga natuman.
english: Christ made sure that what would happen (prophecy) in His suffering and death was fulfilled.

text: Indi pareho sa peke nga ginapakot-pakot lang gali ang mga hitabo.
english: It's not like a fake where events are just made up.

text: Sa bulig sining aton pagpaathag, kabay pa nga makilala na naton tanan ining peke nga mga ini.
english: With the help of this explanation, hopefully we can all recognize these fakes.

text:
***

Ang Pag-asa nagpahibalo sang pagsugod sang tag-init (summer or dry season) sadtong Marso 22, 2024, sa pagtapos gid sang northeast moonson (Amihan), nga magapadayon pa tubtub sa Abril kag Mayo.
english:
***

Pag-asa announced the start of the summer or dry season on March 22, 2024, at the end of the northeast moonson, which will continue until April and May.

text: Sa aton diri sa Panay kag Guimaras, ma-experyensyahan naton ang amat-amat na nga pagkanay sang huyop sang Amihan nga magadulot sing kagin-ut sa palibut bag-o magbulos ang Habagat (southwest moonson) malapit na sa Hunyo.
english: Here in Panay and Guimaras, we will experience the gradual weakening of the Northwest wind that will cause drought in the environment before the southwest moonson takes over near June.

text: Gina-predict man, ugaling,  sang Pag-asa ang padayon nga pagpainit sang El Niño, nga makapa-delay sang tag-ulan (rainy season) sa Hunyo kon san-o magasugod na ang La Niña padulong sa Hulyo kag Agosto.
english: However, Pag-asa also predicts the continued warming of El Niño, which will delay the rainy season in June when La Niña will begin into July and August.

text: Ang El Niño kag La Niña kabahin sang El Niño-Southern Oscillation (ENSO).
english: El Niño and La Niña are part of the El Niño-Southern Oscillation (ENSO).

text: Isa ini ka recurring climate pattern, ukon pagbalik-balik sang temperatura sa surface waters sang kalalawran (ocean) sa central kag eastern tropical Pacific Ocean, nga gasakop sang Filipinas, nga may mabaskug man nga epekto sa panahon sa iban pa nga bahin sang kalibutan.
english: It is a recurring climate pattern, or recurrence of temperature in the surface waters of the ocean in the central and eastern tropical Pacific Ocean, which includes the Philippines, which also has a strong impact on weather in other parts of the world.

text: Sa pag-abot sang 3 tubtub 7 ka tuig ang surface waters sa tropical Pacific Ocean nagainit ukon galamig sing dugang nga 1-3 degrees Celsius (1o-3o C)  ikumparar sa normal nga temperatura.
english: Over the next 3 to 7 years the surface waters of the tropical Pacific Ocean warm or cool an additional 1-3 degrees Celsius (1o-3o C) compared to normal temperatures.

text: Sa nahibal-an na, ang ENSO nagatuga sang madamo nga ma-kalamidad nga hitabo, katulad sang mas mabaskug nga bagyo, tagtuyot (drought), heat stress, wild forest fire, kag pagbaha.
english: As is well known, ENSO causes many disaster events, such as stronger typhoons, droughts, heat stress, wild forest fires, and floods.

text: Nagadulot man ini sang madamo nga pamalatian sa katauhan, katulad sang drought-related health kag nutritional problems kag mga balatian nga dala sang bad rainy weather.
english: It also causes many human diseases, such as drought-related health and nutritional problems and diseases caused by bad rainy weather.

text: Naga-apekto man ini sa ikaayo sang palibut (environment) sa kadutaan, kahanginan kag kalalawran.
english: It also affects the health of the environment on land, air and sea.

text:
***

Sa El Niño ang ocean surface naga-init sa above-average nga kainiton, katulad sang pagsaka na sang ma-experyensyahan sang tawo nga kainit (heat index) sa 40o C sa pila ka lugar sa Filipinas.
english:
***

During El Niño, the ocean surface warms to above-average temperatures, with the human heat index rising to 40º C in some parts of the Philippines.

text: Ang La Niña naman nagadala sang below-average nga kalamig sang surface temperature sang kalalawran, nga nagadulot sing indi kinaandan nga lamig sa palibut.
english: La Niña, on the other hand, brings below-average cool ocean surface temperatures, causing unusually cold environments.

text: On the other hand, ang ENSO-Neutral nagadala sang temperatura nga malapit sa average, nga kon kis-a makasiling ka nga ang nagakatabo daw El Niño ukon La Niña.
english: On the other hand, ENSO-Neutral brings temperatures so close to average, that sometimes you can say that what’s happening looks like El Niño or La Niña.

text: Ukon combined effects ini sining duha ka extreme cases.
english: Or it's combined effects of these two extreme cases.

text: Gin-predict sang Pag-asa ang ENSO-Neutral nga matabo sa Abril tubtub Mayo kag Hunyo ./PN
english: Pag-asa predicts ENSO-Neutral to occur in April to May and June.

text: Gindeklarar ni President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. declared

text: ang state of national energy emergency sa Pilipinas apisar sang una nga panindugan sang Malacañang nga wala pa sang oil crisis diri sa pungsod.
english: the state of national energy emergency in the Philippines despite Malacañang's initial position that there is no oil crisis in the country.

text: Natabo man ang pagpirma sang presidente sa executive order samtang ginalantaw nga magatimbuok sa P130 ang presyo sang diesel kada litro subong nga semana, samtang magalapaw naman sa P100 kada litro ang presyo sang gasolina.
english: The president's signing of the executive order also comes as the price of diesel is expected to rise to P130 per liter this week, while the price of gasoline is expected to exceed P100 per litre.

text: Ginpagwa kagab-i, Marso 24, ang Executive Order 110 kun sa diin ginmandu man ni Marcos ang pag-adoptar sang whole-of-government approach.
english: Executive Order 110 was issued last night, March 24, in which Marcos also ordered the adoption of a whole-of-government approach.

text: Ini agud nga mapahagan-hagan ang palas-anon sang apektado nga mga sector sa idalom sang Unified Package for Livelihoods, Industry, Food and Transport ukon UPLIFT.
english: This is to ease the burden of the affected sectors under the Unified Package for Livelihoods, Industry, Food and Transport or UPLIFT.

text: Ini ang una nga tion nga gingamit sang presidente ang amo nga awtoridad agud nga maka-responde sa oil supply disruptions.
english: This is the first time the president has used such authority to respond to oil supply disruptions.

text: Nakabutang ini sa Republic Act 7638 nga amo man ang nagahatag sang awtoridad sa President nga mag-deklarar sang critically low ener­gy supply kag magpatuman sang energy allocation.
english: This is enshrined in Republic Act 7638 which also authorizes the President to declare critically low energy supply and implement energy allocation.

text: Sa executive order ni Marcos, ginsiling sini nga ang gyera sang Estados Unidos kag Israel sa Iran nga nagtulod sa pagsirado sa Strait of Hormuz amo ang nag-trigger sang wala kasiguraduhan nga sitwasyon sa kalibutan.
english: In his executive order, Marcos said the US-Israel war with Iran that led to the closure of the Strait of Hormuz triggered the uncertain situation in the world.

text: Lakip sa apektado amo ang global energy markets kag may yara man sang malala nga disruption sa supply chains, may pagsaka man sa international oil prices, gani nga may nadala man nga threat ukon pamahog sa energy security sang pungsod.
english: Among the affected are the global energy markets and there is also a serious disruption in supply chains, there is also a rise in international oil prices, thus bringing a threat to the country's energy security.

text: Ginpahayag ni Marcos nga bangud net importer sang langis ang Pilipinas, mahuyang gid ini sa disruptions sa global oil production pati na sa transporasyon sang sini nga produkto.
english: Marcos said that as a net importer of oil, the Philippines is very vulnerable to disruptions in global oil production as well as in the transportation of this product.

text: Si Marcos ang magapanguna bilang chairperson sang UPLIFT kag updan siya sang tiglikom sang Department sang energy, transportation, social welfare, agriculture, finance, kag budget and economy, planning and development.
english: Marcos will lead as chairperson of UPLIFT and will be accompanied by the secretaries of the Departments of energy, transportation, social welfare, agriculture, finance, and budget and economy, planning and development.

text: Lakip sa himuon sang UPLIFT amo ang pag-monitor kag pagsiguro nga may yara sang tayuyon kag talunsay nga hulag, suplay, distribusyon, kag availability sang gatong, pagkaon, bulong, produktong pang-agrikultura, kag iban pa nga nagapanguna nga kinahanglanon.
english: UPLIFT will monitor and ensure the consistent and smooth movement, supply, distribution, and availability of fuel, food, medicines, agricultural products, and other basic necessities.

text: Ini man ang magapasiguro nga may yara sang tayuyon nga operasyon sa public transportation, public services, public utilities, healthcare facilities, kag iban pa nga critical establishments and infrastructure.
english: It will also ensure the smooth operation of public transportation, public services, public utilities, healthcare facilities, and other critical establishments and infrastructure.

text: Antes sini, nauna na nga nag-angkon sang kritisismo ang pahayag sang Palasyo nga wala man sang oil crisis sa Pilipinas, kundi “disruption” sa fuel prices.
english: Earlier, the Palace's statement that there is no oil crisis in the Philippines, but a disruption in fuel prices, has been criticized.

text: “Ang sinasabi po natin na wala pa po, hindi dinideklara dahil may sapat na supply pa sa ngayon.
english: “What we say is not yet, is not declared because there is still enough supply.

text: Ang nagkakaroon lang ng isyu ay ang sa presyo,” paathag ni Communications Undersecretary Claire Castro matapos ginpakamalaot ang iya nauna nga statement nga wala sang krisis.
english: The only issue is the price,” explained Communications Undersecretary Claire Castro after condemning her earlier statement that there was no crisis.

text: “Wala pa po tayong tawagin na oil crisis sa bansa.
english: “We have not yet called it an oil crisis in the country.

text: Sa ngayon hindi pa natin masabi dahil pinagsusumikapan ng gobyerno na walang patid ang supply sa atin,” dugang sini.#
english: At the moment we cannot say because the government is trying to ensure that there is no end to our supply,” he added.

text: Isa ka grupo sang mga squatter sa banwa sang San Miguel de Pedroso, Burgos Province sa Spain ang sentro sang atensyon matapos sila nagpatakod sang alarm system agud bantayan ang isa ka balay nga ila nga illegal nga gin-okupa.
english: A group of squatters in the town of San Miguel de Pedroso, Burgos Province in Spain is the center of attention after they installed an alarm system to guard a house they illegally occupied.

text: Suno sa mga residente sang lugar, ang balay ang madugay na nga wala ginaistaran sang tag-iya sang halos duha ka dekada.
english: According to local residents, the house has been unoccupied by its owner for almost two decades.

text: Gani ginhingalitan ini sang mga squatters.
english: So the squatters took advantage of it.

text:
Apang sa baylo nga sekretuhon, ginhaboy nila ang tanan nga daan nga gamit sa bintana, nagdala sang ila nga kagamitan kag nagpatakod pa sang alarm system — kumpleto sa paandam nga “NO ENTRY.”

Gintuyo pa sang mga ini nga magparehistro sa lokal nga otoridad agud himuon nga legal ang ila nga pagtinir sa lugar apang wala ginpasugtan.
english:
But instead of keeping it a secret, they threw all the old stuff out the window, brought their equipment and even installed an alarm system — complete with the warning “NO ENTRY.”

They tried to register with the local authorities to legalize their stay in the area but were not allowed.

text: Magluwas sa balay, gin-angkon man sang mga squatter ang tupad nga bakante nga lote kag ginhimo nga kurungan sang ila nga mga ido.
english: Besides the house, the squatters also claimed the adjacent vacant lot and turned it into a kennel for their dogs.

text: Tatlo ka reklamo na ang ginpasaka sang orihinal nga tag-iya apang wala pa sang tikang ang otoridad.
english: The original owner has filed three complaints but the authorities have not taken any action.

text: Nakatalana na nga iga-lift ang tatlo ka bulan nga fishing ban sa bilog nga Visayan Sea, suno sa Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR).
english: The three-month fishing ban in the entire Visayan Sea is scheduled to be lifted, according to the Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR).

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay BFAR Regional Director Remia Appari, iya ginpahayag nga subong nga adlaw sang Domingo, Pebrero 15, 2026 ang ulihi nga adlaw sang nasambit nga tatlo ka bulan nga closed fishing season sa Visayan Sea, nga nag-umpisa sang Nobyembre 15, 2025.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, BFAR Regional Director Remia Appari said that today, Sunday, February 15, 2026, is the last day of the three-month closed fishing season in the Visayan Sea, which began on November 15, 2025.

text: Pagkatapos sang amo nga close fishing season, sarang na nga makapangisda ang mga manugpangisda sa bilog nga rehiyon.
english: After the close fishing season, fishermen throughout the region will be able to fish.

text: Nahibaluan nga tinutuyo sang nasambit nga fishing ban nga mahatagan sang tion ang mga isda sa kadagatan nga makapadamo agud mas mag-umwad ang produksyon sang isda sa rehiyon kag suportahan ang food security.
english: It is known that the purpose of the said fishing ban is to give time to the fish in the sea to reproduce in order to further develop fish production in the region and support food security.

text: Hugot man nga nagpahanumdom si Director Appari sa mga local nga manugpangisda nga likawan gid ang illegal fishing agud indi makahalit sa kadagatan.
english: Director Appari also strongly reminded local fishermen to avoid illegal fishing so as not to damage the sea.

text: Patigayunon subong nga adlaw, Marso 25, ang una nga hearing sang Kamara kaangot sa impeachment complaints nga ginpasaka batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: The first hearing of the impeachment complaints filed against Vice President Sara Duterte will be held today, March 25.

text: Apang base sa kampo sang bise-presidente, indi ini magtambong sa amo nga hearing.
english: But based on the vice-president's camp, he will not attend the hearing.

text: Ginkumpirma ini ni Atty. Michael Poa, legal counsel ni Duterte.
english: This was confirmed by Atty. Michael Poa, Duterte’s legal counsel.

text: Matandaan nga nakit-an sang House Committee on Justice nga sufficient in form, substance, and grounds ang mga reklamo sa vice president.
english: The House Committee on Justice found the complaints against the vice president sufficient in form, substance, and grounds.

text: Una na nga nagpaandam si Batangas Rep.
english: Earlier, Batangas Rep.

text: Gerville Luistro, chairperson sang House committee on justice, nga kun indi magkadto si Duterte, mawad-an ini sang tyansa nga makumbinse ang mga kongresista nga wala sang probable cause ang mga impeachment complaints batok sa iya.
english: Gerville Luistro, chairperson of the House committee on justice, said that if Duterte does not go, he will lose the chance to convince congressmen that there is no probable cause for the impeachment complaints against him.

text: Suno kay Luistro, kun indi magtambong si Duterte, magapabilin nga “unchallenged” ukon indi masabat ang mga alegasyon batok sa iya, gani nga magaboto na lang ang mga committee members pabor sa pahayag nga may yara sang probable cause.
english: According to Luistro, if Duterte does not attend, the allegations against him will remain “unchallenged”, so the committee members will vote in favor of the statement that there is probable cause.

text: Ginlaragway sang committee chair ini nga stage nga pareho sa preliminary investigation phase sa isa ka criminal complaint.
english: The committee chair described this stage as similar to the preliminary investigation phase in a criminal complaint.

text: Hatagan ang complainants kag ang defense sang tyansa nga magpresentar sang ila tagsa ka documentary evidence kag mga testigo.
english: The complainants and the defense will be given the opportunity to present their respective documentary evidence and witnesses.

text: Iresolba anay sang House justice panel ang mga mosyon nga nagatuyo nga i-subpoena ukon i-compel ang pag-abot sang mga testigo kag production sang documents nga ginakonsiderar nga material evidence sa complaints.
english: The House justice panel will first resolve motions seeking to subpoena or compel the appearance of witnesses and production of documents considered material evidence in the complaints.

text: Magluwas sa hearing subong nga adlaw, may naka-schedule man sa Abril 14, 22, kag 29.
english: In addition to today's hearing, there are also scheduled for April 14, 22, and 29.

text: SINING ulihi lang nga tinuig nangin matonog ang mga isyu batok sa mga naga-claim nga propeta sila sang Diyos.
english: IN RECENT years, the issues against those who claim to be God's prophets have become louder.

text: Gali kay peke!
english: It's fake!

text: Sang magbistuhanay na, ginagamit lang gali ni pastor ang amot kag donasyon para sa kuno ibulig sa mga nalisdan agud mapatambok lang ang iya bulsa kag agud maka-asta nga diktador sa iya inosente nga mga sumulunod.
english: When they got acquainted, the pastor was using the donations to help the poor in order to fatten his pockets and to act like a dictator to his innocent followers.

text: Katulad man bala sa mga “corrupt” nga mga politiko nga ang handom manggad kag poder lang.
english: Is it like the “corrupt” politicians who only want wealth and power?

text: Sunu sa Bibliya, ang mga propeta may mga “divine communication” sa Diyos kag kilala sa ila Diyosnon nga panimuot kag pamatasan.
english: According to the Bible, prophets had “divine communications” with God and were known for their divine attitude and behavior.

text: May espesyal man ini sila nga ihibalo sa mga nagliligad kag bisan sa palaabuton (prophecy).
english: They also have special knowledge of the past and even the future (prophecy).

text: On the other hand, ang mga peke nga mga propeta naga-“preach” man sang maayong balita angot sa moral kag ispiritwal nga kabuhi sang tawo kag, sa publiko, nagapakita nga daw mga “harmless” nga mga karnero, gali kay Yawan-on sing pamatasan.
english: On the other hand, false prophets also “preach” the good news about the moral and spiritual life of man and, in public, appear like “harmless” sheep, actually to the Devil.

text: Ginapatalang sini ang daw na-hypnotize nga mga sumulunod agud sunud-sunuran sa iya malain nga mga hingyu kag buhat.
english: It misleads seemingly hypnotized followers into following its evil demands and actions.

text: Gina-tiplang sini ang mga kabataan agud mahimuslan, ginapahog sing silot nga Impyerno ang mga sumulunod para mapasobahar sing lubos ang mga sumulunod sa iya luyag.
english: It tricks children into taking advantage of it, threatens followers with the punishment of Hell to make followers completely submit to its will.

text: Todo madumot man ini supak sa ginatudlo ni Kristo, ng iya kuno ginayauban.
english: It is also completely against the teachings of Christ, which he supposedly preached.

text: Mastermind man ini sang mga hilimuon kriminal katulad sang ginahimo sang mga sindikato.
english: It is also a mastermind of criminal activities such as those carried out by syndicates.

text: Kag palagpat lang gali ang iya propesiya (prophecy).
english: And his prophecy was just a joke.

text: Indi kasubong sang mga matuod nga mga propeta sa Bibliya nga mapamatud-an nila ang ila ginasugid nga mga hitabo sa nagliligad kag bisan sa palaabuton, katulad nanday Daniel, Ezekiel, kag Jeremiah sa Bibliya.
english: Unlike the true prophets of the Bible, they can prove what they tell about events in the past and even in the future, such as Daniel, Ezekiel, and Jeremiah in the Bible.

text: Natandaan ta pa ang peke nga propeta nga, samtang yara sa Mount of Sinai si Moses, ginpatalang ang mga Israelita agud magsimba sa Bulawan nga Tinday (Golden Calf).
english: We remember the false prophet who, while Moses was on Mount Sinai, led the Israelites to worship the Golden Calf.

text: May nagpapati man sa iya sumulunod nga katapusan na sang kalibutan kag gin-upod sa pagpakamatay ini sila tanan agud malikawan ang kuno wala  tupong nga kapahamakan, nga wala man natabo.
english: Some also convinced his followers that the end of the world was coming and led them all to commit suicide to avoid a supposedly unprecedented disaster, which did not happen.

text: May yara man nga gintalana ang kamatayon sang iya kaaway sa pila ka  bulan, apang nagligad lang ang tinuig wala man sing natabo sa iya kaaway.
english: There was also the death of his enemy was scheduled for a few months, but a year passed and nothing happened to his enemy.

text: Tungod sini, si Hesukristo nagpaandam gid sadtong panahon pa Niya batok sa sining mga peke nga mga propeta.
english: Because of this, Jesus Christ warned against these false prophets in His day.

text:
Siling Niya: “Amlig kamo sa ila (‘false prophets’) kay samtang gapakita sila katulad sang mabuot (harmless) nga karnero (sheep) sa ila hulam nga panapot,  sa matuod gali mga mabangis ini sila nga mga lobo (wolves) nga magahatag sa inyo sang kapahamakan.”

***

Dapat tapos na ang “Era of Conquest” – ang magpalawak sang gahum paagi sa pagpangagaw sang teritoryo sang iban, ukon sa pag-angkon sang pila ka lugar nga gindaug sa gyera, ukon sa ano pa nga taliwas nga hingyu nga nasakop ining dugang nga mga teritoryo.
english:
He said: “Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.”

***

The “Era of Conquest” must be over – to expand power by seizing the territory of others, or by acquiring some area conquered in war, or by any other contrary claim that conquered these additional territories.

text: Patapos naman ang “Colonialism” agud kilalahon ang self-determination sang mga pumuluyo sa ila ginakilala kag naandan nga teritoryo kag puluy-an.
english: End “Colonialism” to recognize the self-determination of the people in their recognized and habitual territory and home.

text: Ginakilala naman ang “equality of rights” sang mga pungsod kag pagpatuman lang, tubtub mahimo, sang “…peaceful means with the principles of Justice and International Law…” (UN Charter, Chapter 1, Article 1).
english: It recognizes the “equality of rights” of nations and the implementation, as far as possible, of “…peaceful means with the principles of Justice and International Law…” (UN Charter, Chapter 1, Article 1).

text: Unfortunately, wala ini ginasapak sang China.
english: Unfortunately, China ignores this.

text: Padayon nga gina-insistir sini ang iya “illegal” nga “historical claims”sa South China Sea, nga natigayon sa panahon pa sang Era of Conquest, kag sang pagduso sang iya Revisionist Policy sa karon.
english: It continues to insist on its “illegal” “historical claims” to the South China Sea, which were acquired during the Era of Conquest, and the pursuit of its Revisionist Policy today.

text: Ano ayhan ang mahimo sining magagmay nga mga pungsod agud mapunggan ang kabuangan sang China?
english: What could these small countries do to stop China’s madness?

text: Tungod obligado ang Filipinas kag ang iya kasilingan sa Southeast Asia nga may claim man sa SCS sa panugyan sang UN for “peaceful settlement of disputes, ginpakamaayo nila nga hingyuon ang China sa pagsulod sa isa ka “Code of Conduct”.
english: Since the Philippines and its Southeast Asian neighbors who also have claims to the SCS are obliged to the UN's recommendation for peaceful settlement of disputes, they have decided to ask China to enter into a Code of Conduct.

text: Apang kansar lang, kay gapadungol lang ini kay ang iya “illegal” gid nga luyag ang masunod.
english: But it's just cancer, because it's just stupid because it's “illegal” to want the next one.

text: So, ano na lang ang mahimo sining mga magagmay nga mga pungsod?
english: So, what can these small countries do?

text: Kinahanglan na gid man seguro nga matapatan (challenge) na ang China sa iya mismo ginahimo nga “illegal” sa Exclusive Econmic Zone naton sa West Philippine Sea.
english: China needs to be challenged for its illegal activities in our Exclusive Economic Zone in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Kon gatukod ang China sang artificial island, pasanyugon ta man ang mga isla nga sakop naton dira sa EEZ.
english: If China is building an artificial island, let's also develop the islands that belong to us in the EEZ.

text: Kon ga-develop ini sang infra sa potential oil ang gas fields, makig-sosyo kita sa mas makasarang naton nga mga kaalyado agud i-deveop man ini., etcetera… Pareklamuha lang da ang China!
english: If it is developing infrastructure in potential oil and gas fields, let's partner with our more capable allies to develop it., etcetera... Just complain about China!

text: Tutal wala man kita dapat hadlukan.
english: After all, we have nothing to fear.

text: Kaupod na naton ang sentimiento  kag  pasalig sang pagbulig sang US, sa diin may Mutual Defense Pact kita, kag sang iban nga kaalyado katulad sang UK, France, Germany, Canada, Australia, lakip na ang India, Japan kag Vietnam.
english: We have with us the sentiment and commitment of the US, where we have a Mutual Defense Pact, and other allies such as the UK, France, Germany, Canada, Australia, including India, Japan and Vietnam.

text: Indi bala?
english: Isn't it?

text: Laban!/PN
english: Against!/PN

text: Ibinunyag ng aktres na si AJ Raval na mayroon na siyang limang anak, kung saan tatlo sa mga ito ay anak nila ng aktor na si Aljur Abrenica.
english: Actress AJ Raval revealed that she has five children, three of whom are the children of actor Aljur Abrenica.

text: Kinumpirma ito ni AJ sa isang panayam kay Boy Abunda, kung saan sinabi niyang gusto na niyang sabihin ang totoo sa publiko upang tuluyan nang matapos ang mga haka-haka at upang magkaroon ng kalayaan ang kanyang mga anak.
english: AJ confirmed this in an interview with Boy Abunda, where he said he wants to tell the truth to the public so that the rumors will end and his children will have freedom.

text: Ibinahagi rin ni AJ ang mga pangalan ng kanyang mga anak na sina Ariana, Aaron, Aikina, Aljur Junior, at Abraham.
english: AJ also shared the names of his children Ariana, Aaron, Aikina, Aljur Junior, and Abraham.

text: Matatandaan na noong Setyembre, ibinunyag ng ama ni AJ na si Jeric Raval na may anak ang kanyang anak na babae kay Aljur Abrenica, na lalong nagpasiklab ng mga usapin tungkol sa relasyon ng dalawa.
english: It can be recalled that in September, AJ's father, Jeric Raval, revealed that his daughter had a child with Aljur Abrenica, which further fueled rumors about the relationship between the two.

text: Gina-preparar sang France kag sang mga kaalyado sini nga pungsod ang “defensive” mission agud nga mabuksan liwat ang Strait of Hormuz kag ma-updan ang mga barko nga magalabay.
english: France and its allies are preparing a “defensive” mission to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and escort ships passing through.

text: Gin-anunsyo ini ni French President President Emmanuel Macron sa Cyprus kasunod sang pag-intercept sang missiles sang Iran sa Türkiye, Qatar kag sa United Arab Emirates.
english: This was announced by French President President Emmanuel Macron in Cyprus following the interception of Iranian missiles in Türkiye, Qatar and the United Arab Emirates.

text: Kasunod man ini sang pagtimbuok sang presyo sang langis sa masobra $US150 kada barrel.
english: This also follows the rise in oil prices to more than $US150 per barrel.

text: Suno kay Macron, ang ila escort mission nga gina-preparar ang paga-updan sang European kag non-European countries.
english: According to Macron, their escort mission being prepared will be joined by European and non-European countries.

text: Tuyo sini suno sa iya nga makahatag sang suporta ukon proteksyon sa mga barko kag tankers samtang amat-amat nga ginabuksan ang Strait of Hormuz.
english: He said the aim is to provide support or protection to ships and tankers while the Strait of Hormuz is gradually being opened.

text: Nagpahayag man si Macron nga masobra 12 ka naval assets ang ila ipadala sa Mediterranean, Red Sea kag sa Strait of Hormuz lakip ang ila nga aircraft carrier strike group bilang kabahin sang defensive support sa ila mga kaalyado nga nabutang sa alang-alang bangud sa gyera.
english: Macron also said they will send more than 12 naval assets to the Mediterranean, Red Sea and the Strait of Hormuz including their aircraft carrier strike group as part of defensive support to their allies threatened by the war.

text: Lakip sa ila ipadala amo ang walo ka warships, duha ka helicopter carriers kag ang nuclear-powered aircraft carrier nga Charles de Gaulle nga may 20 Rafale fighter jets agud nga makabulig sa seguridad.
english: Among the deployments are eight warships, two helicopter carriers and the nuclear-powered aircraft carrier Charles de Gaulle with 20 Rafale fighter jets to assist in security.

text: Ginakabig ang Strait of Hormuz nga isa sa most critical maritime chokepoints sa kalibutan kun sa diin 20–25% sang global oil consumption kag 20% sang liquefied natural gas (LNG) ang nagalabay diri kada adlaw.
english: The Strait of Hormuz is considered one of the most critical maritime chokepoints in the world where 20–25% of global oil consumption and 20% of liquefied natural gas (LNG) pass through it every day.

text: Nahamtang ini nga 33km-wide waterway sa tunga sang Iran kag Oman, kag amo ang primary exit para sa Gulf producers kaangay sang Saudi Arabia, Iraq, kag Qatar.
english: This 33km-wide waterway is located between Iran and Oman, and is the primary exit for Gulf producers like Saudi Arabia, Iraq, and Qatar.

text: Wala sang plano ang Liga ng mga Barangay sa siudad sang Iloilo nga magbulig sa mga involved nga indibidwal sa pag-abusar sang cash assistance nga para kuntani sa mga naapektuhan sang bagyo.
english: The League of Barangays in Iloilo City has no plans to assist individuals involved in the abuse of cash assistance that was supposed to be for those affected by the typhoon.

text: Ginpahayag ini ni Councilor Irene Ong, presidente sang Liga ng mga Barangay sa siudad, matapos ginpasaka sang Department of Social Welfare and Development ang kaso-administratibo sa barangay officials nga involved sa AICS scandal.
english: This was stated by Councilor Irene Ong, president of the League of Barangays in the city, after the Department of Social Welfare and Development filed an administrative case against barangay officials involved in the AICS scandal.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Councilor Ong, iya ginpahayag nga hugot ang iya desisyon nga bisan sa idalom sini ang mga opisyales sang barangay nga involved sa kaso, indi siya magbulig sa mga opisyal bangud sala gid ang mga gin-ubra sang mga opisyales.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Councilor Ong said he is firm in his decision that even under the barangay officials involved in the case, he will not help the officials because the officials did wrong.

text: Dugang man niya, wala siya sang ideya sa mga ginpang-ubra sang mga nasambit nga mga opisyales.
english: He added that he had no idea what the officials were doing.

text: Madumduman nga base sa fact-finding and investigation team sang DSWD nga ginapangunahan ni Assistant Secretary Paul Ledesma nga ginpatigayon sang Nobyembre 24, indi matapos ang tuig kag makilal-an ang mga involved nga mga opisyales.
english: It can be recalled that based on the fact-finding and investigation team of the DSWD led by Assistant Secretary Paul Ledesma conducted on November 24, the involved officials will not be identified until the end of the year.

text: Gilayon naman nagguwa ang inisyal nga lista sang ila pangalan kasunod sang pag-file sang kaso.
english: The initial list of their names was immediately released following the filing of the case.

text: Isa ka pinasahi nga trend ang nagakatabo subong sa China kun sa diin ang pamatan-on nga wala sang trabaho mismo ang nagabayad sa mga peke nga kumpanya agud magpakuno-kuno nga may trabaho sila — bisan wala sila sang ginakita diri.
