english: A unique trend is happening now in China where unemployed young people themselves pay fake companies to pretend they have a job — even if they don't earn anything here.

text: Sa bayad nga 30 tubtob 50 yuan kada adlaw (katumbas ng ₱250–₱400 ukon $4–$7), ginatugutan sang mga ginatawag nga “pretend-to-work companies” ang sin-o man nga makaeksperyensiya sang working environment.
english: For a fee of 30 to 50 yuan per day (equivalent to ₱250–₱400 or $4–$7), so-called “pretend-to-work companies” allow anyone to experience the working environment.

text: Kalakip diri ang opisina, desk, libre nga Wi-Fi, kag pantry.
english: This includes an office, desk, free Wi-Fi, and a pantry.

text:
Para nga daw mas matuod ang ila pagpakuno-kuno, pwede sila magbayad sang dugang para sa mga peke nga ulubrahon, peke nga boss, kag magpakuno-kuno nga may kaaway sila nga kaangay man nila nga mga “empleyado.”

Sang Marso, narekord ang youth unemployment rate sa 16.5% para sa mga edad 16 tubtob 24 (wala nalakip ang mga estudyante), kag 7.2% para sa mga edad 25 tubtob 29.
english:
To make their pretense seem more authentic, they can pay extra for fake jobs, fake bosses, and pretend they have enemies who are just like them “employees.”

In March, the youth unemployment rate was recorded at 16.5% for those aged 16 to 24 (excluding students), and 7.2% for those aged 25 to 29.

text: Sa padayon nga pagtaas sang numero sang mga wala sang trabaho, nangin popular ang ini nga “work simulation” bilang alternatibo nga kalingawan.
english: With the unemployment rate continuing to rise, this “work simulation” has become popular as an alternative form of entertainment.

text: Apisar pinasahi, ginasalamin sini ang kultura sa trabaho sa China kun sa diin ang mismo nga balatyagon nga Masako ang indibidwal ang tuman ka importante — bisan peke.
english: Although unique, it mirrors the work culture in China where the very feeling that the individual is Busy is very important — even if it is fake.

text: Nakalikum ang Western Visayas sang halos 110,993 metric tons nga produkto halin sa pagpangisda sa ika-apat nga kwarter sang 2025, mas mataas sang 41.5% ukon 32,561 tonelada kumparar sa pareho nga panahon sang 2024, suno sa datos sang Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) Regional Office VI.
english: Western Visayas harvested nearly 110,993 metric tons of fisheries products in the fourth quarter of 2025, up 41.5% or 32,561 tons compared to the same period in 2024, according to data from the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) Regional Office.

text: Pinangunahan sang aquaculture ang nasambit nga pagtaas, nga nagdangat sa 61.8% kag nagrepresentar sang 81.6% sang kabug-usan nga produksiyon, kun sa diin pinangunahan sang Capiz ang aquaculture growth nga may 81.6% nga share.
english: Aquaculture led the increase, reaching 61.8% and representing 81.6% of total production, with Capiz leading aquaculture growth with an 81.6% share.

text: Nagtaas naman ang municipal fisheries sang 17.4% sa Antique, Aklan, Iloilo, kag Guimaras, samtang nagnubo sang 34.1% ang inland nga bahin sang municipal fisheries.
english: Municipal fisheries increased by 17.4% in Antique, Aklan, Iloilo, and Guimaras, while the inland portion of municipal fisheries decreased by 34.1%.

text: Sa kabug-usan, nagdangat sa PHP 13.07 billion ang fisheries production, mas mataas sang 86.2% kumpara sa pareho nga kwarter sang 2024.
english: Overall, fisheries production reached PHP 13.07 billion, up 86.2% compared to the same quarter of 2024.

text: Ini nga datos nagapakita man nga nagtaas ang municipal fisheries production, samtang nagnubo ang commercial fisheries production.
english: This data also shows that municipal fisheries production has increased, while commercial fisheries production has decreased.

text: Arestado ang duha ka kabataan sang isa ka drug personality sa ginpatigayon nga buybust operation sang Iloilo City Drug Enforcement Unit (CDEU) sa Zone 1, Brgy.
english: Two children of a drug personality were arrested in a buybust operation conducted by the Iloilo City Drug Enforcement Unit (CDEU) in Zone 1, Brgy.

text: Bakhaw, Mandurriao, Iloilo City, kahapon nga adlaw, Pebrero 26.
english: Bakhaw, Mandurriao, Iloilo City, yesterday, February 26.

text: Ang main subject amo si alyas ‘AJ’, 20-anyos, kag isa ka contruction worker kaupod ang iya magulang nga si alyas “Batwan”, 21-anyos kag isaka Passenger Assistant Officer (PAO).
english: The main subject is alias ‘AJ’, 20-years-old, and a construction worker with his brother alias “Batwan”, 21-years-old and a Passenger Assistant Officer (PAO).

text: Nakuha sa mga ini ang 14 ka sachet sang iligal nga druga ng ginabulubanta masobra 280 grams kag may standard drug price nga P1,904,000.
english: Recovered from them were 14 sachets of illegal drugs weighing more than 280 grams with a standard drug price of P1,904,000.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Roque Gimeno III, officer in charge sang Iloilo City Drug Enforcement Unit, iya ginpahayag nga nadakpan sang nagligad lang nga tuig ang amay sang duha sa kapareho man nga kaso kag nagapabilin nga preso sa Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP) sa Nanga, Pototan.
english: Police Captain Roque Gimeno III, officer in charge of the Iloilo City Drug Enforcement Unit, said the father of the two was arrested last year in the same case and remains detained at the Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP) in Nanga, Pototan.

text: Sa subong, yara na sa kustodiya sang ICPS 10 ang mga nadakpan nga mga indibidwal kag posible magapangatubang sang kaso nga pagpalapas sa Republic Act 9165 ukon Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.
english: The arrested individuals are now in the custody of ICPS 10 and may face charges of violating Republic Act 9165 or the Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.

text: SA NAHIBAL-AN na sang aton mga pumuluyo, padayon gihapon nga wala sing kasolbaran ang conflicto sa tunga sang Filipinas kag sang China sa West Philippine Sea (WPS).
english: As our people already know, the conflict between the Philippines and China in the West Philippine Sea (WPS) remains unresolved.

text: Daw nagalala pa gani sa padayon nga pang-bully sang China.
english: It seems to be getting worse with China's continued bullying.

text: Angot ini sa kaso nga ginpasaka sang Filipinas sa China sadtong 2012, kag gindaug sadtong 2016, batok sa papwersa nga pagsakop sang Scarborough Shoal sang armado nga hangaway sang China.
english: This is in connection with the case filed by the Philippines against China in 2012, and won in 2016, against the forcible occupation of Scarborough Shoal by the Chinese armed forces.

text: Sakop ining shoal sang aton Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ), nga 200-nautical mile ang kalayo halin sa aton baybayon.
english: This shoal is part of our Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ), which is 200-nautical miles from our coast.

text: Gin-award ini sa aton sang UN Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) upod sa sobra 90 pa ka mga pungsod nga may kasubong man kalapad nga award halin sa ila baybayon.
english: It was awarded to us by the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) along with more than 90 other countries that have a similarly extensive award from their coasts.

text: Unfortunately, wala sing police power ang ICA agud mapatuman ang ruling sini, nga gin-take advantage sang “Mighty” China para sa iya “revisionist policy” agud mapalawak ang iya interes sa South China Sea (SCS) paagi sa pagpalapad sang iya mapa nga wala naman sing kapat-uran halin pa sadto.
english: Unfortunately, the ICA does not have the police power to enforce its ruling, which “Mighty” China has taken advantage of for its “revisionist policy” to expand its interests in the South China Sea (SCS) by expanding its map that has been uncertain ever since.

text: Sa matuod, nagalain-lain ang kalapad sang mapa sang China depende kon ano nga dinastiya, emperador ukon diktador ang yara sa gahum.
english: In fact, the width of the map of China varies depending on which dynasty, emperor or dictator is in power.

text: Sang nagligad lang nga tuig gani ang 9-dash line nga gina-claim nga maritime territory sa SCS, nangin 10-dash line na.
english: Just last year even the 9-dash line claimed as maritime territory in the SCS, has become a 10-dash line.

text: Maathag nga panglupig lang ining ginahimo sang China agud maduso ang iya “revisionist policy” sa pagpasanyog sang iya ideyolohiya, ma-kontrol ang trade route sa SCS, kag ma-solo ang maritime resources labi na gid ang rich fishing ground dira kag ang makuha dira nga rich fuel oil resources sa idalom sang kalalawran.
english: Clearly, this is only oppression by China to push its “revisionist policy” to promote its ideology, control the trade route in the SCS, and monopolize the maritime resources especially the rich fishing ground there and the rich fuel oil resources under the sea.

text: Pensar niya seguro nga daw subay lang nga matiris sang iya tudlo ang Filipinas.
english: He must have thought that the Philippines was just a fingertip.

text: Nevah!
english: Nevah!

text: In fact, bisan ang elepante pwede padalaganon sa kahadlok sang subay, labi na gid kon kaalyado sini ang mas masakit mangagat nga mga guyom.
english: In fact, even an elephant can be driven away by the fear of an ant, especially if it is allied with more painful fangs.

text: In other words, pwede siya malutos sang bisan daw subay ka gamay lang nga pungsod.
english: In other words, he can be defeated by even a small country.

text: Sa madamo nga paagi.
english: In many ways.

text: Sa psychological kag socio-economic warfare, por ejemplo.
english: In psychological and socio-economic warfare, for example.

text: Kag sa pag-atubang na sa China, bilang last resort, sang coalition of forces sang mga pungsod nga kaalyado sang Filipinas.
english: And to face China, as the last resort, of the coalition of forces of the countries allied to the Philippines.

text: Nga tani indi na kinahanglan matabo pa kon kalinong gid man ang tuyu sang China!
english: That shouldn't have happened if China's goal was peace!

text: Pero daw gamo gid ang luyag sini!
english: But it seems to want chaos!

text:
***

Sa nasiling ta na sa ibabaw, may at least duha ka kahalimbawa ang pagpakigbatok sang 11 ka legation (gamay nga embassy) sa panahon sang 1899 Boxers’ Rebellion sa China sa aton karon conflicto sa China sa WPS.
english:
***

As we have already said above, there are at least two examples of the struggle of 11 legations (small embassies) during the 1899 Boxers' Rebellion in China in our current conflict with China in the WPS.

text: Una, legal ang pagluntad sa China sining 11 ka legation kag, tungod sini, may kinamatarong ini sila nga pahalinon lang sang China sa ma-diplomasya kag matarong nga paagi.
english: First, the existence in China of these 11 legations is legal and, therefore, they have the right to be expelled by China in a diplomatic and fair manner.

text: Indi kay sa paagi sang pamahog kag pagpamatay sang mga dumuluong.
english: Not by threatening and killing foreigners.

text: Sa kaso sang Filipinas, ini pa gani ang may legal sovereignty rights dira sa WPS sa idalom sang otoridad sang UNCLOS kag ICA, nga dapat tani respetohon sang China bilang katapo man sang UNCLOS.
english: In the case of the Philippines, it even has legal sovereignty rights in the WPS under the authority of UNCLOS and ICA, which China should respect as a member of UNCLOS.

text: Ikaduha, may kinamatarong ang 11 ka legation sa self-defense, labi na gid sang ginpatigayon na sang mga Boxers ang armado nga pag-atake sa international compound kon diin nagapangapin ining nauna.
english: Second, the 11 legations have the right to self-defense, especially since the Boxers have already carried out an armed attack on the international compound where the former is defending.

text: Kasubong man nga pwede naton mapangapinan ang aton interes sa WPS batok sa pang-bully sang China sa paggamit sini sang water cannons kag pang-harass sa aton mga mangingisda kag sang nagadala sang ayuda sa outposts sang Filipinas sa WPS.
english: Likewise, we can defend our interests in the WPS against China's bullying in its use of water cannons and harassment of our fishermen and those who bring aid to Philippine outposts in the WPS.

text: Although sa subong, mga paglikaw lang anay ang ginahimo sang aton gobyerno.
english: Although for now, our government is only taking precautions.

text: Indi magsiling, ugaling, ang China nga indi pang-gyera ang ila ginahimo.
english: China will not say, however, that what they are doing is not warlike.

text: Para sa aton, “act of war” atong mahaliton nga pamomba sang tubig sa mission ships sang Filipinas, labi na gid kay sa isa ka misyon para sa Sierra Madre, nga na-verify sang mga balita, sakay didto ang AFP Chief of Staff.
english: For us, the harmful water bombing of Philippine mission ships is an act of war, especially since in a mission for the Sierra Madre, which was verified by the news, the AFP Chief of Staff was on board.

text: Sa idalom sang Mutual Defense Pact upod sa US, ang “act of war” sa Filipinas matabo kon may “armed attack” batok diri, nga pwede na hangpon sing amo sina ang mahaliton nga pamomba sang tubig sang Chinese coastguard sa mga barko sang Filipinas, labi na gid kay may presensya dira sang soldado nga may mataas sing ranggo.
english: Under the Mutual Defense Pact with the US, an act of war in the Philippines will occur if there is an armed attack against it, which can be understood as the destructive water bombing of Philippine ships by the Chinese coastguard, especially since there is a presence of high-ranking soldiers.

text: Tungod sini, at least may dapat himuon kita nga defensive move sunu sa degree of offense nga nahimo sang China.
english: Because of this, at least we should make a defensive move according to the degree of offense that China has committed.

text: Nga tani indi maglab-ut pareho sa natabo sa 1899 Boxers Rebellion kon diin may inaway gid nga natabo.
english: Hopefully it will not reach the same level as the 1899 Boxers Rebellion where there was a real war.

text: Indi naton luyag matabo ini.
english: We don’t want this to happen.

text: Tani bukas man ang China sa ano man nga kasugtanan, katulad sang Code of Conduct, nga indi kinahanglan mahulog sa gyera!
english: I wish China was open to any agreement, such as the Code of Conduct, that does not have to fall into war!

text: Kag tani mag-upod sa negosasyon ang US tungod co-party ini sa MDP.
english: And hopefully the US will join the negotiations because it is a co-party with the MDP.

text: (Wala na sing kasugpon)/PN
english: (No longer attached)/PN

text: Gin-ugyunan sang presidente sang Association of Barangay Captains (ABC) sa Lapuz, Iloilo City ang ginapanindugan sang Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) nga indi makaalarma ang sitwasyon sang iligal nga droga diri sa syudad.
english: The president of the Association of Barangay Captains (ABC) in Lapuz, Iloilo City agreed with the insistence of the Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) that the illegal drug situation in the city is not alarming.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Punong Barangay Arnel Asturias nga amo ang nagpatawag sang meeting agud istoryahan ang amo nga isyu, iya ginpahayag nga suportado sang data ang statement ni Police Lieutenant Colonel Lorenez Losaria sang nag-atubang ini sa ila.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Punong Barangay Arnel Asturias, who called the meeting to discuss the issue, said the data supports the statement of Police Lieutenant Colonel Lorenez Losaria when he faced them.

text: Si Losaria amo ang representative nga nagtambong sa meeting, tal-os kay ICPO officer-in-charge Police Colonel Wilbert Parilla.
english: Losaria was the representative who attended the meeting, replacing ICPO officer-in-charge Police Colonel Wilbert Parilla.

text: Sa pagsinapol, tatlo ka bagay ang ginplastar sini nga mahimo gamiton nga rason suno sa iya nga masiling nga alarming na ang droga.
english: During the meeting, he put forward three things that could be used as a reason to say that drugs are alarming.

text: Una, dapat nga kinilo-kilo na sang droga ang makumpiskar; ikaduha, kun may mga opisyales ukon dalagku nga personalidad nga involved sa illegal drugs; kag ikatatlo, kun may mga opisyal nga nadakpan mismo sa operasyon.
english: First, kilos of drugs should have been confiscated; second, if there are officials or big personalities involved in illegal drugs; and third, if there are officers arrested in the operation itself.

text: Pahayag sini, tag-gamay lang ang na-recover sa Iloilo City kag magamay lang nga users indi pareho sa iban nga lugar kun sa diin may mga barangay officials pa nga involved.
english: He said only a few were recovered in Iloilo City and only a few users unlike in other places where there are barangay officials involved.

text: Suno naman kay Asturias, sandig sa ginhambal ni Losaria, kun lantawon sang naglinigad nga mga tinuig, may yara pa gani sang mga dalagku nga mga personalidad nga nagakontrol sa Iloilo pag-abot sa iligal nga droga.
english: According to Asturias, based on what Losaria said, if you look at the past years, there are even big personalities who control Iloilo when it comes to illegal drugs.

text: Pahayag pa sang punong barangay, nagsiling ang ICPO nga wala na sang ma-identify sa Iloilo subong nga amo ang nagakontrol sa diin man nga areas kun droga ang hambalan.
english: According to the barangay captain, the ICPO said that there is no one in Iloilo who can be identified as the one who controls any areas when it comes to drugs.

text: “Kun tan-awon naton, napanas ni sang tyempo ni [former President] Digong Duterte.
english: “If we look at it, it was erased during the time of [former President] Digong Duterte.

text: Nagpalagyo gani ang iban kay nahadlok, kay pila ka drug personalities sa aton ang napatay.
english: Some even ran away because they were afraid, because some of our drug personalities were killed.

text: Ang iban nagpalagyo.
english: Others fled.

text: That’s why ang iya explanation, indi alarming ang iligal nga droga,” suno kay Asturias.
english: That’s why his explanation, illegal drugs are not alarming,” Asturias said.

text: Sang ginpamangkot ini kun may kilala siya nga nagpalagyo, sabat ni Asturias: “Indi ta nalang na paghambal, kay bisan sin-o daw nakabalo man.
english: When asked if he knew anyone who had escaped, Asturias replied: “Let's not talk about it, because everyone seems to know.

text: May ara man ta gani kilala nga sang una nagpalagyo man pero sang nagligad nag-spokesman spokesman man sa babaw nga nakibot man kita.”#
english: We even know someone who used to run away but later became a spokesman spokesman above that surprised us.”#

text: Ipinahayag ng aktor na si Anjo Yllana ang kanyang pagkadismaya sa umano’y mga “magnanakaw” sa gobyerno, na isa sa mga dahilan kung bakit niya nais subukan ang kanyang kapalaran sa Senado.
english: Actor Anjo Yllana expressed his disappointment with the alleged “thieves” in the government, which is one of the reasons why he wants to try his luck in the Senate.

text: Sa isang livestream sa TikTok noong Oktubre 27, sinabi ni Yllana na gusto nitong tanggapin ang challenge na tumakbo sa Senado dahil aniya naiinis na siya sa mga nakaupo sa Kongreso.
english: In a livestream on TikTok on October 27, Yllana said she wants to accept the challenge to run for the Senate because she is annoyed with those sitting in Congress.

text: Hinimok niya rin ang publiko na huwag nang iboto ang mga magnanakaw na politiko.
english: He also urged the public not to vote for corrupt politicians.

text: Sa bago nitong post, idineklara ni Yllana ang kanyang suporta sa DDS (die-hard Duterte supporter) at ipinahayag ang suporta kay Vice President Sara Duterte, pati na rin sa panawagan na ilagay si dating Pangulong Rodrigo Duterte sa house arrest sa Davao.
english: In this new post, Yllana declared her support for DDS (die-hard Duterte supporter) and expressed her support for Vice President Sara Duterte, as well as the call to put former President Rodrigo Duterte under house arrest in Davao.

text: Sinabi niya na sana umano ay tanggapin siya ng Duterte party.
english: He said he hopes the Duterte party will accept him.

text: Muli pang inihayag ng dating artista at politiko na tumakbo man siya o hindi ay kaniya paring susuportahan ang team Duterte sa 2028.
english: The former actor and politician reiterated that whether he runs or not, he will still support team Duterte in 2028.

text: Magugunitang si Anjo ay may karanasan sa politika bilang dating konsehal at bise-alkalde ng Parañaque City.
english: Anjo has political experience as a former councilor and vice-mayor of Parañaque City.

text: Noong 2024, tumakbo rin siya bilang bise-alkalde sa Calamba City ngunit ito’y natalo.
english: In 2024, he also ran for vice-mayor in Calamba City but lost.

text: Gintawag nga unbecoming kag unparliamentary ni Councilor Rex Marcus Sarabia ang remarks ni Vice Mayor Love Baronda kay Councilor Sheen Marie Mabilog sa ginpatigayon nga regular session subong nga adlaw, Disyembre 10, 2025.
english: Councilor Rex Marcus Sarabia called the remarks of Vice Mayor Love Baronda to Councilor Sheen Marie Mabilog unbecoming and unparliamentary.

text: Ini matapos nag-relinquish bilang presiding officer si Mabilog sang ginboto ini sang konseho kag kun sa diin man ginhambal sa mikropono ni Vice Mayor Baronda nga kinahanglan ni Councilor Mabilog nga mangin “Bigger person”.
english: This is after Mabilog relinquished as presiding officer when the council voted for him and where Vice Mayor Baronda said in the microphone that Councilor Mabilog needs to be a “Bigger person”.

text: Ini man nga tinaga ang wala nagustuhan ni Councilor Sarabia kag gintawag ini nga daw ginahikayan sang bise alkalde ang konsehal.
english: Councilor Sarabia also did not like the word and called it as if the vice mayor is arranging for the councilor.

text: Dayun man nga ginklaro ni VM Baronda ang iya nga statement nga wala ini sang iban nga kahulugan kag nagatuyo lang sini nga hambalon kay Councilor Mabilog nga kinahanglan sini nga mag-concede sa rule of majority.
english: VM Baronda immediately clarified that his statement has no other meaning and only intends to tell Councilor Mabilog that he needs to concede to the rule of majority.

text: Makabaton sang pinakadako nga incentives halin sa Philippine Sports Commission (PSC) ang Filipino swimmer nga si Kayla Sanchez.
english: Filipino swimmer Kayla Sanchez will receive the biggest incentives from the Philippine Sports Commission (PSC).

text: Ini matapos ang iya madinalag-on nga pagtiglawas para sa Pilipinas sa 2025 Southeast Asian Games nga ginhiwat sa Thailand.
english: This is after he successfully represented the Philippines in the 2025 Southeast Asian Games held in Thailand.

text: Si Sanchez ang nakahakot sang kabug-osan nga tatlo ka gold kag lima ka silver medals.
english: Sanchez won a total of three gold and five silver medals.

text:
(SEA GAMES)

Sandig sa Republic Act 10699, ang kada Filipino athlete nga makakuha sang gold medal sa SEA Games ang may batunon nga P300,000, P150,000 naman para sa silver medal, kag P60,000 para sa bronze medal.
english:
(SEA GAMES)

According to Republic Act 10699, each Filipino athlete who wins a gold medal at the SEA Games will receive P300,000, P150,000 for the silver medal, and P60,000 for the bronze medal.

text: Bangud sini, yara sa masobra P1.2 million ang ihatag sang PSC kay Sanchez.
english: As a result, the PSC will give more than P1.2 million to Sanchez.

text: Samtang, ginpahayag sang komisyon nga naglab-ot sa P35,190,000 ang kabug-osan nga kantidad sang incentives nga ipanagtag sa 277 ka mga atleta nga nakakuha sang medalya para sa Pilipinas sa amo nga kompetisyon.
english: Meanwhile, the commission said the total amount of incentives to be distributed to 277 athletes who won medals for the Philippines in the competition reached P35,190,000.

text: Ginpatpat sang pila ka mga doctor ang mahimo padulongan ukon maabtan sang isa ka tawo nga naga-engage sa illegal drugs.
english: Some doctors have explained where a person who engages in illegal drugs can go.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Maria Lourdes Hembra, Chief of Hospital sang Department of Health – Treatment and Rehabilitation Center Pototan, iya ginpahayag nga ang ‘drug addiction’ ang isa ka chronic brain disease, kon sa diin, ang tawo nga nagagamit ang masami nga nagapangita sang iligal nga druga.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Maria Lourdes Hembra, Chief of Hospital of the Department of Health – Treatment and Rehabilitation Center Pototan, said that drug addiction is a chronic brain disease, where the user is often looking for illegal drugs.

text: Suno kay Dr. Hembra, ang tawo nga adik sa druga ang indi maka-function sang maayo kon wala naga-hithit sang druga.
english: According to Dr. Hembra, a person who is addicted to drugs cannot function well without hithitting drugs.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga masami man nga mindset sang mga illegal drug users amo ang makabulig ang paggamit sini sa ila trabaho ukon ginaubra, apang ang kamatuoran amo ang makatuga lamang sang pagkaguba sang utok.
english: He also explained that often the mindset of illegal drug users is that using drugs will help them in their job or work, but the truth is that it can only cause brain damage.

text: Mahimo man nga magresulta sa mental health disorder ang tuman nga paggamit sang druga ilabi na kon indi gilayon nga matatapan.
english: Excessive drug use can also lead to mental health disorders especially if not treated immediately.

text: Ginklaro man ni Dr. Mariano Hembra, isa ka adult and addiction psychiatrist, nga ang paggamit sang iligal nga druga indi makabig nga tumalagsahon lang bangud nangin parte na ini sang pang-adlaw-adlaw nga tanan sang mga na-adik sa druga.
english: He also clarified that Dr. Mariano Hembra, an adult and addiction psychiatrist, said that the use of illegal drugs is not unusual because it has become part of the daily life of all drug addicts.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga indi lamang ang paggamit sang illegal drugs ang makaapekto sa pang-adlaw-adlaw nga routine sang isa ka tawo, bangud ang gulpiyada nga pag-untat gamit ang makaapekto man sa daily routine sang isa ka drug addict.
english: He also said that not only the use of illegal drugs can affect a person's daily routine, because the sudden withdrawal of drugs can also affect the daily routine of a drug addict.

text: Nagapanguna sa ranggo sang Miss Universe 2025 hot pics ang kilala nga beauty pageant observer nga Missosology ang Filipino beauty queen nga si Ma.
english: Filipino beauty queen Ma.

text: Athisa Manalo nga ginakabig “leading the pack” sa ila pinakabag-o nga listahan nga ginpagguwa kahapon nga adlaw, Nobyembre 7.
english: Athisa Manalo who is considered “leading the pack” in their latest list released yesterday, November 7.

text: Suno sa Missosology, nagapanginbabaw si Manalo indi lamang sa iya poise kag kumpyansa, kundi pati man sa iya estorya.
english: According to Missosology, Manalo dominates not only with her poise and confidence, but also with her story.

text: Gitmitlang man sang pageant platform nga ang iya kadalag-an ang makaangkon sang “symbolic weight” sa kultura sang pageant sa Pilipinas.
english: The pageant platform also said that her victory will have “symbolic weight” in the pageant culture in the Philippines.

text: Lakip pa sa mga listahan sang frontrunners ang Colombia, Croatia, Puerto Rico, Thailand nga isa man sa paborito bilang crown contender.
english: Colombia, Croatia, Puerto Rico, Thailand are also among the favorites as crown contenders.

text: Sa kabug-usan, 122 ka mga kandidata ang magpaindis-indis sa titulo nga Miss Universe 2025 nga pagahiwaton sa Thailand sa Nobyembre 21.
english: In total, 122 contestants will compete for the Miss Universe 2025 title to be held in Thailand on November 21.

text: Ginhingadlan si Mojtaba Khamenei bilang bag-o nga Supreme Leader sang Iran.
english: Mojtaba Khamenei has been named as the new Supreme Leader of Iran.

text: Anak siya ni Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, ang anay Supreme Leader sang Islamic Republic nga napatay sang gin-atake sang Israel kag Estados Unidos sang Amerika ang iya compound sa Tehran sang nagligad nga semana.
english: He is the son of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, the former Supreme Leader of the Islamic Republic who was killed when Israel and the United States of America attacked his compound in Tehran last week.

text: Suno sa Assembly of Experts ukon ang panel sang Shia clerics nga amo ang responsable sa idalom sang Iranian law sa pagpili sang top leader, ginpili si Mojtaba Khamenei bilang ikatatlo nga leader sang ila nga republika.
english: According to the Assembly of Experts or the panel of Shia clerics responsible under Iranian law for selecting the top leader, Mojtaba Khamenei was elected as the third leader of their republic.

text: Gin-report na ini sang IRIB state TV kag Fars, Tasnim kag ISNA news agencies.
english: This has already been reported by IRIB state TV and Fars, Tasnim and ISNA news agencies.

text: Isa ka politician kag cleric si Mojtaba Khamenei kag may daku nga impluwensya sa administrators kag sa Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, apang indi siya tuman ka bantog sa Iran.
english: Mojtaba Khamenei is a politician and cleric and has considerable influence over administrators and the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, but he is not very prominent in Iran.

text: Madamo man ang nagamuno nga kulang ini sa religious credentials nga ginakaptan sang iya amay nga amo anay ang nagpamuno sa clerical regime — nga amo ang naga-claim nga naga-represent sang “pagbuot sang Diyos” sa kalibutan.
english: Many also say it lacks the religious credentials held by his father, who once headed the clerical regime — which claims to represent “God’s will” in the world.

text: Ang Supreme Leader amo ang “Supreme Leadership Authority”, ang de jure head sang state, kag ang pinakamataas nga political kag religious authority sang Iran nga mas mataas pa sa presidente.
english: The Supreme Leader is the “Supreme Leadership Authority”, the de jure head of state, and Iran’s highest political and religious authority above the president.

text: Napaidalom sa iya ang armed forces, judiciary, state radio and television, kag iban pa nga government organizations kaangay sang Guardian Council and Expediency Discernment Council.
english: It includes the armed forces, judiciary, state radio and television, and other government organizations such as the Guardian Council and Expediency Discernment Council.

text: Sandig sa constitution, ang supreme leader amo ang naga-deliher sang general policies sang Islamic Republic, naga-supervise sa legislature, judiciary, kag sa executive branches.
english: According to the constitution, the supreme leader delivers the general policies of the Islamic Republic, supervises the legislature, judiciary, and the executive branches.

text: Sa bahin sang Israel Defense Forces, nagpaandam ini nga puntariyahon nila kun sin-o man ang magabulos sa pwesto bilang Supreme Leader.
english: On the part of the Israel Defense Forces, he warned that they will target whoever succeeds him as Supreme Leader.

text: Una naman nagbuya sang kaugalingon nga paandam si US President Donald Trump nga indi magdugay ang bag-o nga lider sang Iran kun indi pagkuhaon ang iya nga approval.
english: Earlier, US President Donald Trump issued his own warning that Iran's new leader would not last long if his approval was not withdrawn.

text: “They are wasting their time.
english: “They are wasting their time.

text: Khamenei’s son is a lightweight.
english: Khamenei’s son is a lightweight.

text: I have to be involved in the appointment,” pahayag sini.
english: I have to be involved in the appointment,” he said.

text:
“Khamenei’s son is unacceptable to me.”

Una naman nagsabat ang Iran nga indi sila magpasugot nga magpasilabot si Trump ukon ang bisan sin-o nga pungsod sa pagpili sang ila bag-o nga Supreme Leader.#
english:
“Khamenei’s son is unacceptable to me.”

Earlier, Iran said it would not allow Trump or any other country to interfere in the election of its new Supreme Leader.

text: Ano ayhan ang masarangan mo nga himuon para lang sapakon ikaw sang imo nga crush?
english: What can you do to get your crush to ignore you?

text: May yara sang babayi nga naga-edad sang 33-anyos kag residente sang Pinhalzinho, Brazil ang nag-viral matapos gin-ako nga permi siya gakadto sa mga patay sa ila komunidad sa sulod sang duha ka tuig agud lang masapak sang iya crush nga isa ka undertaker.
english: A 33-year-old woman from Pinhalzinho, Brazil has gone viral after she admitted that she has been visiting the dead in her community for two years just to be kicked by her crush who is an undertaker.

text: Ang babayi ang ginkilala kay Daniela Signor, kag ang iya crush amo si Apollo Scariot, 31-anyos.
english: Ang babayi ang ginkilala kay Daniela Signor, kag ang iya crush amo si Apollo Scariot, 31-anyos.

text: Suno kay Daniela, nakita niya si Apollo sang ini siya ang nagtambong sa lubong sang isa niya ka paryente sang tuig 2023.
english: According to Daniela, she saw Apollo when she attended the funeral of a relative in 2023.

text: Halin sadto, abaw, gulpyada lang nga nagka-crush ini kay Apollo kag gusto niya ini nga makuha ang atensyon sang lalaki.
english: Since then, she suddenly had a crush on Apollo and wanted to get his attention.

text: Basi galibog ang ulo niyo kun ano ang buot silingon sang undertaker?
english: You might be confused about what undertaker means?

text: Amo ina sila ang mga tawo nga nagaasikaso sang mga patay, halin sa pag-embalsamar tubtob sa preparasyon sang haya kag lubong.
english: These are the people who take care of the dead, from embalming to funeral preparation and burial.

text: Ang ginahimo ni Daniela, nagakadto ini siya sa mga haya sa ila lugar.
english: What Daniela does is she goes to the beehives in their area.

text: Apang, wala sa gihapon nasapak ukon natalupangdan ni Apollo si Daniela bangud nga naka-focus ini sa iya nga trabaho.
english: However, Apollo still did not notice or notice Daniela because he was focused on his work.

text: Matapos ang masobra duha ka tuig nga pag-admire kag pag-antos ni Daniela, sa wakas, nasapakan gidman siya ni Apollo kag didto na nag-umpisa ang ila pag-estoryahanay.
english: After more than two years of Daniela's admiration and suffering, Apollo finally noticed her and that's when their conversation began.

text: Nag-abot gidman ang tion nga nangin magkarelasyon sila kag nagtapos sa kasal sang nagligad lang nga bulan.
english: They finally got into a relationship and ended up getting married just last month.

text: Ang makahalam-ot lang kay sa adlaw mismo sang ila kasal, ginkakibot sang ila mga bisita sang nag-abot sila sa wedding venue nga sakay sa karo sang patay.
english: The funny thing is that on their wedding day itself, they surprised their guests when they arrived at the wedding venue in a hearse.

text: Bangud sang madamo nakibot, gin-explain sang couple sa likod sang ila pagpili sang karo sang patay bilang ila sakayan sa ila nga kasal.
english: To the surprise of many, the couple explained behind their choice of a hearse as their wedding boat.

text: Suno kanday Daniela kag Apollo, ini ang isa ka pamatuod nga ang matuod-tuod nga paghigugma handa maghulat, magsakripisyo, kag magpaubos bisan sa tunga sang mga tumalagsahon nga sitwasyon.
english: According to Daniela and Apollo, this is proof that true love is willing to wait, sacrifice, and humble even in the midst of unusual situations.

text: Nakit-an ang isa ka lapsag nga nasulod sa isa ka labador sa kilid sang sapa sa Ramon, Isabela.
english: A baby was found trapped in a sink by a river in Ramon, Isabela.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon, nabatian sang mga residente nga may lapsag nga nagahibi sa sapa kag sang ila ginpalapitan, isa ka lapsag ang ila nakit-an.
english: According to the investigation, residents heard a baby crying in the river and when they approached, they found a baby.

text: Nakaputos ini sa punda sang ulunan kag yara pa ang pusod sini.
english: It was wrapped in a pillowcase and still had its belly button in it.

text: Madasig naman nga gindala sa health center ang lapsag agud mahatagan sang atensyon-medikal.
english: The baby was rushed to the health center for medical attention.

text: Ginahibalo pa kun sin-o ang ginikanan sang lapsag.
english: The identity of the baby's parents is still unknown.

text: Opisyal na nga natapos ang ika-33 nga Southeast Asian Games nga ginpatigayon sa Thailand.
english: The 33rd Southeast Asian Games held in Thailand has officially come to an end.

text: Sa amo nga kompetisyon, nakahakot ang Pilipinas sang kabug-osan nga 277 ka medalya nga nagbutang sa pungsod sa ika-6 nga pwesto sa overall medal tally.
english: In the competition, the Philippines won a total of 277 medals, placing the country in 6th place in the overall medal tally.

text: Sa sini nga numero, 50 ang gold, 73 ang silver, kag 154 ang bronze medals.
english: Of this number, 50 were gold, 73 were silver, and 154 were bronze medals.

text: Nalakip sa mga Filipino athletes nga naghatag kadungganan sa pungsod amo sanday EJ Obiena sa pole vault, Alex Eala sa tennis, kag Eumir Marcial sa boxing.
english: Among the Filipino athletes who brought honor to the country were EJ Obiena in the pole vault, Alex Eala in tennis, and Eumir Marcial in boxing.

text: Nakabaton man sang bulawan nga medalya ang Gilas Pilipinas Men and Women sa basketball, lakip na ang Filipinas sa women’s football.
english: Gilas Pilipinas Men and Women also won gold medals in basketball, including the Philippines in women's football.

text: Ginhingadlan naman nga overall champion ang host country nga Thailand matapos ini makaangkon sang 233 gold, 154 silver, kag 112 bronze medals, ukon kabug-osan nga 449 ka medalya.
english: Host Thailand was named the overall champion after winning 233 gold, 154 silver, and 112 bronze medals, or a total of 449 medals.

text:
Yari ang final medal tally sa 33rd Southeast Asian Games:

1.Thailand- 233-154-112=4992.Indonesia-91-111-131=3333.Vietnam-87-81-110=2784.Malaysia-57-57-117=2315.Singapore-52-61-89=2026.Philippines-50-73-154=2777.Myanmar-3-21-49=738.Lao People’s Democratic Republic-2-9-28=399.Brunei darussalam-1-3-5=910.Timor Leste-0-1-7=8

Sa liwat wala na nadala ang Cambodia sa medal tally bangud nagwithdraw na ini sa tournament bangud sa tension sa border sini sa Thailand.
english:
Here is the final medal tally at the 33rd Southeast Asian Games:

1.Thailand- 233-154-112=4992.Indonesia-91-111-131=3333.Vietnam-87-81-110=2784.Malaysia-57-57-1 17=2315.Singapore-52-61-89=2026.Philippines-50-73-154=2777.Myanmar-3-21-49=738.Lao People’s Democratic Republic-2-9-28=399.Brunei darussalam-1-3-5=910.Timor Leste-0-1-7=8

Once again, Cambodia was not included in the medal tally as it withdrew from the tournament due to tensions on its border with Thailand.

text: Nagpasalig ang mga importer sang bugas nga buhinan ang pag-import sa bulan sang Marso kag Abril agud mabuligan ang mga lokal nga mangunguma.
english: Rice importers have pledged to reduce imports in March and April to help local farmers.

text: Suno kay Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr., ang pag-import sang bugas naglab-ot sa average nga indi magkulang sa 400,000 metric tons sa kada bulan.
english: According to Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr., rice imports have averaged at least 400,000 metric tons per month.

text: Nagpabutyag naman suno sa iya ang mga importer nga ila pagalimitahan ini sang 150,000 metric tons lamang para sa tyempo sang harvest.
english: He said importers have expressed that they will limit it to 150,000 metric tons for the harvest season.

text: Ang pagdumili sang pag-import sang bugas ang ginkakas na sang Enero kag suno pa sa tiglikom nga dapat mangin normal na ang sitwasyon sa tunga-tunga sang bulan sang Marso.
english: The ban on rice imports was lifted in January and the secretary said the situation should return to normal by mid-March.

text: Suno pa sa iya nga maganubo ang presyo sang bugas sa tyempo sang harvest.
english: He said the price of rice will decrease during the harvest season.

text: Kasunod sang pagpa-uswag sang P20/kilo nga bugas nga programa sang gobyerno sa mga Local Government Units sa Manila, ginpahayag ni Tiu Laurel nga ila ginalauman ang nagakaigo nga suplay sang bugas agud masustentuhan ang implementasyon sini.
english: Following the promotion of the government's P20/kilo rice program to Local Government Units in Manila, Tiu Laurel said they expect adequate supply of rice to sustain its implementation.

text: Ang pagbaligya sang subsidized nga bugas ang ginalimitahan lamang sang 10ka kilo sa kada pamilya sa kada bulan kag 30kg naman sa kadala bulan para sa PWDs, senior citizens, kag mga single parent.
english: The sale of subsidized rice is limited to 10 kilos per family per month and 30 kg per month for PWDs, senior citizens, and single parents.

text: UNDERSTANDABLE ang lihok sang Senado sa pag-amendar sang ginapatihan nila nga istrikto nga “economic provisions” sang 1987 Constitution agud maka-akomodar sang dugang nga direkta nga  pamuhunan halin sa luas (Foreign Direct Investment – FDI) nga makabulig sa pagpasanyog sang aton kabuhian (ekonomiya).
english: UNDERSTANDABLE is the Senate's move to amend what they believe are the strict “economic provisions” of the 1987 Constitution to accommodate more foreign direct investment (FDI) that will help improve our economy.

text: Gin-updan man ini sang Kamara (House of Representatives) sa Resolution of Both Houses (RBH) No.
english: This was also accompanied by the House of Representatives in Resolution of Both Houses (RBH) No.

text: 6, pagkatapos nga ginsikway nila ang ma-anomaliya nga People’s Initiative nga ginpangunahan sang pila ka kongresista sadtong Enero 2024.
english: 6, after they rejected the anomalous People’s Initiative led by some congressmen in January 2024.

text: Ginatudlo nila ang 1987 Constitution nga naga-limite sang pagsulod sang foreign investment nga indi maglapaw sa 40%, samtang dapat 60% gid ang iya sang Filipino investors.
english: They point to the 1987 Constitution that limits the entry of foreign investment to no more than 40%, while 60% should belong to Filipino investors.

text: Daku gid man ini nga rason agud mag-atras ang pila ka FDI investors.
english: This is a big reason for some FDI investors to withdraw.

text: Natural lang sa investors, labi na gid kon daku gid ang ila investment, ang luyag mag-angkon sang “controlling position” sa kompaniya.
english: It is natural for investors, especially if they have a large investment, to want to have a “controlling position” in the company.

text: Indi nila mahimo ini kon minority investors lang sila kag gaduha-duha sang ikasarang sang Filipino investors kag workforce sa pagpalakat sang negosyo.
english: They cannot do this if they are only minority investors and doubt the ability of Filipino investors and workforce to run the business.

text: Nonetheless, sa pila ka mga FDI investors nga may minority investments (40% and below), okey lang ina kon makita nila nga may ikasarang gid man ang mga Filipino sa pagpalakat sang negosyo kag tungod man sa nagaluntad nga “good investment climate” sa aspeto sang peace and order, proteksyon sang ila minority investments, kag iban pa nga mainakupon nga pagsulundan sa pungsod.
english: Nonetheless, for some FDI investors with minority investments (40% and below), it is okay if they see that Filipinos are capable of running businesses and also because of the existing “good investment climate” in terms of peace and order, protection of their minority investments, and other inclusive policies in the country.

text: Amo gani nga may pila man ka FDI investors diri sa pungsod!
english: That's why there are some FDI investors here in the country!

text:
***

Sa pagpati sang Kongreso, ang pagpaluag sang pagsulod sang FDI sa Filipinas makahatag gid ini sang dugang nga kaayuhan sa pungsod.
english:
***

Congress believes that expanding the flow of FDI into the Philippines will bring additional benefits to the country.

text: Katulad sang dugang nga palamugnan (employment), mga critical infrastructure nga makapahulag sing maayo sang lakat sang negosyo kag public services (for public leisure and convenience) nga makapasanyog sang kita sang pungsod sa kabilugan (Gross Domestic Product), kag pagsangkad sang edukasyon, scientific kag technological knowhow, samtang nagaamlig man sang aton securidad kag national interests sa kabug-usan.
english: Such as increased employment, critical infrastructure that will stimulate business and public services (for public leisure and convenience) that will boost the country's gross domestic product, and expansion of education, scientific and technological knowhow, while protecting our security and overall national interests.

text: In fact, sunu sa nakita nila, mas madasig gali ang pagsanyog sang ekonomiya sang mga pungsod diri mismo sa aton rehiyon sa Southeast Asia tungod sa madasig nga pagsulod sang FDI sa ila.
english: In fact, according to their findings, the economies of countries in our Southeast Asian region are growing faster due to the rapid inflow of FDI into them.

text: Nanotaran nila ang madasig nga pag-asenso, por ejemplo, sang Singapore kag Vietnam tungod sa pagtaas sang pagsulod sang FDI sa ila mga pungsod, samtang nagakawigit na kita sa ila tungod wigit man kita sa pagsulod sang mga FDI sa aton pungsod.
english: They noted the rapid development, for example, of Singapore and Vietnam due to the increase in FDI inflows into their countries, while we are already catching up with them because we are also catching up with the entry of FDI into our country.

text: Ikumparar lang sa Vietnam, sunu mismo kay Senate President Zubiri, daku gid ang pag-asenso sini tungod sa pagsulod sang madamo kag dalagku nga FDI.
english: Compared to Vietnam, according to Senate President Zubiri, it has made great progress due to the influx of large FDI.

text: Sadtong 2022 ang nakasulod sa aton pungsod nga FDI mga $6B lang samtang $36B gid sa Vietnam nga karon larawan sang daku nga pag-asenso ang ila ekonomiya.
english: In 2022, our country's FDI was only about $6B while it was $36B in Vietnam whose economy is now a picture of great progress.

text:
***

Apang kinahanglan gid bala naton nga ma-amendar ang economic provisions sang 1987 Constitution agud mapaluag-luag ang pagsulod sang foreign business sa pungsod, partikular ang FDI diri agud mapasanyog man ang aton ekonomiya?
english:
***

But do we really need to amend the economic provisions of the 1987 Constitution to expand the entry of foreign business into the country, particularly FDI here to boost our economy?

text: “Indi!” sunu kay retired Supreme Court Justice Antonio Carpio.
english: "No!" according to retired Supreme Court Justice Antonio Carpio.

text: Sunu sa kay Carpio, mismo sa hearing sang Senate Committee on Constitutional Amendments and Revision of Codes, kulang lang sing ihibalo kag paghangop ang aton mga lideres nasyonal sa kasangkad na sang foreign ownership sa negosyo (business) sang pungsod sa idalom sang aton mga kasuguan.
english: According to Carpio, during the hearing of the Senate Committee on Constitutional Amendments and Revision of Codes, our national leaders lack knowledge and understanding of the extent of foreign ownership in the country's business under our laws.

text: By the way, indi ayhan nagapaabo-abo lang ining mga lead petitioners sa House of Reps.
english: By the way, maybe these lead petitioners in the House of Reps are just messing around.

text: nga ang matuod nga plano sa People’s Initiative amo ang ligwaton gid ang organisasyon sang gobyerno agud mapabaskug kag mapabilin ang ila gahum sa gobyerno?
english: that the real plan of the People's Initiative is to strengthen the organization of government in order to strengthen and maintain their power in government?

text: In fact, sa idalom na sang aton kasuguan ang 100% ownership sang madamo nga foreign business sadto pa, siling ni Carpio – ang power generation sa coal, oil kag gas plants; ang pila ka industrial undertakings nga na-define kag na-reclassify na halin sa “public utility” (kinahanglanon gid sang mga pumuluyo), nga wala ma-define sa 1987 Constitution sa idalom sang Section 11, Article XII, apang na-define na sa idalom sang RA 11569 kag na-reclassify bilang “public services” (for public convenience, in general) agud matugutan sang 100% foreign ownership sa telecommunications, air, sea, and land transportation except public utility vehicles and airports; local banks (RA 106421); legal trade (RA 8762) katulad sang retail trade,  although subject sa minimum capital requirements; kag generation of renewable energy – solar and wind – sa idalom sang Dept.
english: In fact, 100% ownership of many foreign businesses is already under our law, Carpio said – power generation in coal, oil and gas plants; certain industrial undertakings that have been defined and reclassified from “public utility” (essential needs of the people), which were not defined in the 1987 Constitution under Section 11, Article XII, but have been defined under RA 11569 and have been reclassified as “public service” (for public convenience, in general) in order to allow 100% foreign ownership in telecommunications, air, sea, and land transportation except public utility vehicles and airports; local banks (RA 106421); legal trade (RA 8762) similar to retail trade,  although subject to minimum capital requirements; and generation of renewable energy – solar and wind – under the Dept.

text: of Energy circular.
english: of Energy circular.

text: Kon manubo ang FDI sang Filipinas, paathag ni  Carpio, indi, therefore, mabasol ini sa 1987 Constitution, kundi  sa iban nga rason, katulad sang “high cost of power, bureaucratic regulation, kag inadequate infrastructure”.
english: If the Philippines' FDI is low, Carpio explained, it is not, therefore, to be blamed on the 1987 Constitution, but on other reasons, such as “high cost of power, bureaucratic regulation, and inadequate infrastructure”.

text: Madugang man naton diri  ang “corruption” sa gobyerno nga mataas kaayo ang grado sa international transparency survey./PN
english: We can also add to this the “corruption” in the government that scores very high in the international transparency survey./PN

text: Ginbasura sang konseho sa first reading ang ordinansa nga luyag tani nga i-duso ni Vice Mayor Love Baronda kadungan sang 23rd Regular Session sang Sangguniang Panlungsod subong nga adlaw.
english: The council rejected in first reading the ordinance that Vice Mayor Love Baronda wanted to propose during the 23rd Regular Session of the Sangguniang Panlungsod today.

text:
Ang ordinansa may titulo nga “Proposed ordinance establishing the official logo, office address and communication channels and correspondence protocol of the Sangguniang Panlungsod (SP) of Iloilo City, providing for their management and use thereof.”

Suno kay Baronda, katuyuan kuntani sang ordinansa nga may yara sang opisyal nga logo ang konseho, opisyal nga address, kag communication kag protocols bangud isa ini ka requirements sang Department of th Interior and Local Government (DILG).
english:
The ordinance is titled “Proposed ordinance establishing the official logo, office address and communication channels and correspondence protocol of the Sangguniang Panlungsod (SP) of Iloilo City, providing for their management and use thereof.”

According to Baronda, the purpose of the ordinance was for the council to have an official logo, official address, and communication and protocols as this is a requirement of the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG).

text: Matapos wala ini ginsuportahan sang mayorya, nag-apelar si Baronda nga i-reconsider sang mga kaupod nga opisyal gani nga ginhatagan ini sang kahigayunan nga ipresentar liwat sa masunod nga session sa konseho.
english: After it was not supported by the majority, Baronda appealed for reconsideration by his fellow officials so he was given the opportunity to present it again in the next session of the council.

text: Ginsiling naman ni Majority Floor Leader Councilor Rex Marcus Sarabia, wala sang official logo sa ginduso nga ordinansa sang bise-alcalde rason nga wala nila ini ginsuportahan.
english: Majority Floor Leader Councilor Rex Marcus Sarabia said there is no official logo in the vice-mayor's proposed ordinance which is why they did not support it.

text: Ginpakamaayo man sang konseho nga ipasar liwat ini sang bise alcalde kun may picture na sang official logo sa iya ordinansa.
english: The council also approved that the vice mayor will pass it again if there is a picture of the official logo in his ordinance.

text: Nagserbe man nga presiding officer si Councilor Sheen Marie Mabilog sa reading sang ordinansa.
english: Councilor Sheen Marie Mabilog also served as presiding officer at the reading of the ordinance.

text: Mahimo nga mahulog sa otitis media ukon middle ear infection ang common cold nga mabatyagan sang mga kabataan subong nga holiday season nga malamig ang panahon.
english: Otitis media or middle ear infection can be a common cold that children feel this holiday season when the weather is cold.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Philip Ian Padilla, Assistant to the Director sang Philippine Genome Center, iya ginpahayag nga ang otitis media ukon ang middle ear infection ang prone sa mga bata, ilabi na ang naga-edad sang anom ka bulan tubtob isa ka tuig kag duha ka tuig.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Philip Ian Padilla, Assistant to the Director of the Philippine Genome Center, said otitis media or middle ear infection is prone to children, especially those aged six months to one year and two years.

text: Suno kay Padilla, ang mga bata ang naga-bottle feeding ang prone man sa amo nga balatian bangud sa mas mahina pa ang ila nga system nga pakigbato-an ang nasambit nga sakit.
english: According to Padilla, children who are bottle fed are also prone to the disease because their system is weaker to fight the disease.

text: Ginakabig man sini nga mas madasig mag-angkon sang otitis media ang mga bata nga wala naka-breast feed.
english: It also believes that children who are not breastfed are more likely to develop otitis media.

text: Kon masarangan, kinahanglan nga i-breast feed ang mga bata agud nga mas mapabaskog ang ila immune system.
english: If possible, children should be breast fed to boost their immune system.

text: Nagaumpisa naman ang sakit paagi sa mga symptom nga sip-on kon sa diin, posible ini makalaton sa kapareho man nga bata paagi sa mucous nga nagaguwa halin sa bata nga may middle ear infection.
english: The disease begins with cough symptoms where it can be transmitted to the same child through mucous that comes out of the child with middle ear infection.

text: Nagpanugyan man ang natungdan sa mga ginikanan nga gilayon hatagan sang antibiotics ang bata nga makitaan sang sintomas agud nga malikawan nga maglapta kag makalaton.
english: He also advised parents to immediately give antibiotics to children who show symptoms to prevent spread and infection.

text: Nadugangan liwat sang bulawan nga medalya sang Pilipinas sa nagapadayon nga 2025 Southeast Asian Games sa Thailand.
english: The Philippines won another gold medal at the ongoing 2025 Southeast Asian Games in Thailand.

text: Ini matapos nga naghimo sang maragtas ang Filipina tennis star nga si Alex Eala.
english: This is after Filipina tennis star Alex Eala made history.

text: Nakuha ni Eala ang iya pinakauna nga SEA Games gold medal sa women’s singles tennis event matapos niya ginlutos ang tiglawas sang host country nga si Mananchaya Sawangkaew, 6-1, 6-2.
english: Eala won her first SEA Games gold medal in the women’s singles tennis event after defeating host country representative Mananchaya Sawangkaew, 6-1, 6-2.

text: Ini ang nagmarka sang iya labing una nga bulawan nga medalya sa SEA Games matapos nga nakakuha lamang siya sang tatlo ka bronze medals sa iya debut sang 2022 SEA Games sa Vietnam.
english: This marked her first-ever SEA Games gold medal after she only managed three bronze medals in her 2022 SEA Games debut in Vietnam.

text: Ini man ang ikatatlo nga gold medal sang Pilipinas sa women’s tennis sa SEA Games, kasunod nanday Pia Tamayo (1982) kag Maricris Fernandez (1999).
english: It is also the Philippines' third gold medal in women's tennis at the SEA Games, following Pia Tamayo (1982) and Maricris Fernandez (1999).

text: Samtang, nagkampyon man ang Philippines Men’s Softball Team matapos nila ginlutos ang Singapore, 3-0.
english: Meanwhile, the Philippines Men’s Softball Team also won the title after defeating Singapore, 3-0.

text: Nag-abanse man sa men’s basketball finals ang Gilas Pilipinas matapos ginlutos sang national team ang Indonesia, 71-68.
english: Gilas Pilipinas also advanced to the men's basketball finals after the national team defeated Indonesia, 71-68.

text: Sulod man sa finals sang women’s basketball tournament ang Gilas Pilipinas matapos nila ginlutos ang defending champion nga Indonesia, 66-55.
english: Gilas Pilipinas also entered the finals of the women's basketball tournament after defeating defending champion Indonesia, 66-55.

text: Ini na ang ikaapat nga sunod-sunod nga finals appearance sang Gilas Women sa biennial games.
english: This is the fourth consecutive finals appearance of the Gilas Women in the biennial games.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, napaslawan ang Philippine Men’s National Football Team nga makabulsa sang medalya matapos ginlutos sang Malaysia, 2-1, sa bronze medal match sang 33rd SEA Games.
english: Meanwhile, the Philippine Men’s National Football Team failed to bag a medal after being defeated by Malaysia, 2-1, in the bronze medal match of the 33rd SEA Games.

text: Apisar sini, ginakabig gihapon nga maragtason ang kampanya sang koponan, bangud sila ang nagdala sang men’s football team sang Pilipinas sa semifinals sang SEA Games sa labing una nga tion sa sulod sang masobra tatlo ka dekada.
english: Despite this, the team’s campaign is still considered historic, as they took the men’s football team of the Philippines to the semifinals of the SEA Games for the first time in more than three decades.
