text: Ginapreparar na ang datos kag rekisitos agud nga maka-request ang Iloilo Provincial Government sa Sangguniang Panlalawigan nga magdeklarar sang state of calamity sa probinsya sang Iloilo bangud sa nagapadayon nga krisis sa produktong-petrolyo.
english: The data and requirements are being prepared so that the Iloilo Provincial Government can request the Sangguniang Panlalawigan to declare a state of calamity in the province of Iloilo due to the ongoing crisis in petroleum products.

text: Suno kay Governor Arthur Defensor, Jr., nagsapol na siya sa mga alkalde agud nga pangayuon ang ila nga bulig nga matipon ang data santo sa guidelines sang National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (NDRRMC).
english: According to Governor Arthur Defensor, Jr., he has already met with the mayors to ask for their help to collect the data according to the guidelines of the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (NDRRMC).

text: Sa amo nga guidelines, mahimo madeklarar ang state of calamity kun 15% sang populasyon ang apektado ukon 30% sang economic sector ukon palangabuhian ang apektado.
english: According to the guidelines, a state of calamity can be declared if 15% of the population is affected or 30% of the economic sector or livelihood is affected.

text: Suno pa sa gobernador, kun may duha ukon masobra pa nga mga banwa nga magdeklarar sang state of calamity, mahimo man ini nga mangin basehan.
english: The governor said that if there are two or more towns that declare a state of calamity, this can also be the basis.

text: Kun ma-secure na ini, diri na kag i-convene ang Provincial DRRMC antes nga mag-request sang deklarasyon halin sa provincial board.
english: Once secured, the Provincial DRRMC will be convened before requesting a declaration from the provincial board.

text: Sa subong suno sa governor, may yara sang P82-million nga Quick Response Fund (QRF) ang probinsya apang indi ini bastante para nga ma-cover ang nagakinahanglan sang bulig.
english: Currently, the governor said, the province has a P82-million Quick Response Fund (QRF) but it is not enough to cover those in need.

text: “We discussed this with our municipalities, we need to have a declaration of a state of calamity for the province.
english: “We discussed this with our municipalities, we need to have a declaration of a state of calamity for the province.

text: Dira kita nagapabulig sa aton nga mga munisipyo,” suno kay Defensor.
english: That's where we ask our municipalities to help,” Defensor said.

text: Magluwas sa pagsapol sa mga alkalde kaina, gin-istoryahan man ang fuel supply situation sa Western Visayas kaupod ang Department of Energy-Visayas Field Office.
english: Besides meeting with the mayors yesterday, the fuel supply situation in Western Visayas was also discussed with the Department of Energy-Visayas Field Office.

text: Ginplastar ang data sa report sang DOE nga as of March 20, 2026, makaigu pa ang gasolina sa 53 ka adlaw; makaigu ang diesel sa 45 ka adlaw; kag makaigu ang fuel oil sa 61 ka adlaw.
english: The data is laid out in the DOE report that as of March 20, 2026, there will be enough gasoline for 53 days; diesel can last 45 days; and enough fuel oil for 61 days.

text: Gintumod naman ang nagapanguna nga mga pagpanghangkat kaangay sang pagpabaskog pa sang energy conservation and efficiency measures; pagpasiguro sang paghatag-prayoridad sa importante nga mga sektor; kag pag-address sa economic impact sang pagtimbuok sang presyo sang gatong.
english: The main challenges such as strengthening energy conservation and efficiency measures were identified; ensuring prioritization of critical sectors; and addressing the economic impact of rising fuel prices.

text: Kon ikaw ang ginagutom, sa diin ka gid bala masami nga nagapadulong?
english: When you are hungry, where do you usually go?

text: Isa ka gutom nga elepante ang halin sa kakahoyan ang nagtuga sang kakugmat sa isa ka grocery store sa Thailand matapos ini naglakat halin sa malapit nga national park kag nangawat sang pagkaon gikan sa mga food shelves.
english: A hungry elephant from the jungle has caused panic at a grocery store in Thailand after it walked in from a nearby national park and stole food from food shelves.

text: Makit-ang nga ang lalaki nga elepante nga kilala sa ngalan nga Plai Biang Lek, ang nagtindog anay sa guwa sang tindahan nga nahamtang sa kilid sang dalan malapit sa Khao Yai National Park sa northeastern Thailand, antes niya ginduso ang iya bug-os nga lawas agud makasulod sa tindahan.
english: It can be seen that the male elephant, known as Plai Biang Lek, used to stand outside the shop located on the side of the road near Khao Yai National Park in northeastern Thailand, before he pushed his whole body to enter the shop.

text: Nag-untat ang elepante sa atubang sang counter, kalma lang nga nagkuha kag nagkaon sang mga snacks, kag wala gid sang nagpakita sang kahadlok bisan ginapanikasog sang mga trabahador sang national park nga paguwaon ini.
english: The elephant stopped in front of the counter, calmly took and ate the snacks, and showed no fear despite the efforts of the national park workers to release it.

text: Pagkatapos, nag-atras siya pa-gwa halin sa tindahan samtang nagadala sang isa ka bag sang snacks gamit ang iya ilong.
english: Afterwards, he backed out of the store while carrying a bag of snacks with his nose.

text: Wala naman ini nagbilin sang dako nga kahalitan, apang lutak nga tinapak sa salog kag marka sa kisame lang.
english: It did not leave much damage, but only cracks on the floor and marks on the ceiling.

text: Suno sa tag-iya sang tindahan, nakakaon ang elepante sang siyam (9) ka bags sang sweet rice crackers, isa ka sandwich, kag pila ka dried bananas.
english: According to the shop owner, the elephant ate nine (9) bags of sweet rice crackers, a sandwich, and some dried bananas.

text: Wala naman ini ginkadismaya sang tag-iya, kon sa diin, nagkadlaw pa matapos ang hitabo.
english: The owner was not disappointed, however, and laughed after the incident.

text: Gindalahig na sang Israel kag Estados Unidos sang Amerika ang mga oil facilities sa Iran sa ika-siyam nga adlaw sang gyera sa Middle East.
english: Israel and the United States of America have involved oil facilities in Iran on the ninth day of the war in the Middle East.

text: Ini ang una nga tion nga gin-atake nila ang oil infrastructure sa Iran halin sang nag-ibwal ang tensyon sa rehiyon sang Pebrero 28, 2026.
english: This is the first time they have attacked oil infrastructure in Iran since tensions flared in the region on February 28, 2026.

text: Nasaksihan ang pagdaba-daba sang apat ka oil storage facilities kag isa ka oil production transfer center sa Tehran kag sa probinsya sang Alborz.
english: Four oil storage facilities and an oil production transfer center were witnessed on fire in Tehran and Alborz province.

text: Ang ginpuntariya nga mga pasilidad amo ang Aghdasieh oil warehouse sa northeast Tehran, ang Tehran refinery sa south, ang Shahran oil depot sa nakatundan sang Tehran, kag ang oil depot sa Karaj city.
english: The targeted facilities were the Aghdasieh oil warehouse in northeast Tehran, the Tehran refinery in the south, the Shahran oil depot in western Tehran, and the oil depot in Karaj city.

text: Sa inisyal nga reports, nag-leak na sa mga dalanon ang langis bangud sa strike sa Shahran depot.
english: According to initial reports, oil has already leaked onto the roads due to the strike at the Shahran depot.

text: Bangud sa amo nga atake, apat ka tanker drivers ang napatay sa Tehran kag Alborz.
english: As a result of the attack, four tanker drivers were killed in Tehran and Alborz.

text: Nagrason ang Israel nga gin-atake nila ang fuel storage facilities sa Tehran bangud ginagamit ini agud mag-operate sang military infrastructure.
english: Israel argued that it attacked fuel storage facilities in Tehran because they were used to operate military infrastructure.

text: Natapos ang kampanya sang pambato sang pungsod sa Miss Earth 2025 nga si Joy Barcoma.
english: The country's Miss Earth 2025 contestant Joy Barcoma's campaign has come to an end.

text: Ini matapos nga wala nakasulod sa Top 4 Finalist sang pageant.
english: This after not making it to the Top 4 Finalist of the pageant.

text: Una nga nakasulod sa Top 8 sang kompetisyon si Barcoma kun sa diin ang Too ang mga pambato sang Vietnam, Thailand, Czech Republic at Iceland.
english: Barcoma was the first to enter the Top 8 of the competition where the Too were players from Vietnam, Thailand, Czech Republic and Iceland.

text: Antes ang Question and Answer portion, nag-halad anay ini sang prayer sa mga naapektuhan sang bagyo Tino sa pageant nga ginhiwat sa Paranaque.
english: Before the Question and Answer portion, he offered a prayer to those affected by Typhoon Tino in the pageant held in Paranaque.

text: Ang Cavite native nga beauty queen nag nag-pauli sang medalya sa Best in Terno for Asia and Oceana sang Miss Earth 2025.
english: The Cavite native beauty queen took home a medal in the Best in Terno for Asia and Oceana of Miss Earth 2025.

text: Matandaan nga sang Agusto, ginkoronahan bilang Miss Philippines Earth si Barcoma.
english: In August, Barcoma was crowned Miss Philippines Earth.

text: Ginkansela na ang pasaporte ni Anay Ako-Bicol Partylist Representative.
english: Former Ako-Bicol Partylist Representative's passport has been cancelled.

text: Zaldy Co.
english: Zaldy Co.

text: Ini ang pahayag ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: This is the statement of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: sa isa ka uploaded video sa iya nga facebook page.
english: in an uploaded video on his facebook page.

text: Kaangot ini sa pagpakatig-a gihapon ni Co nga magsungka bangud sa iya kahilabtanan sa maanomaliya nga flood control projects sa pungsod.
english: This is in connection with Co's insistence on surrendering due to his involvement in anomalous flood control projects in the country.

text: Suno man kay Marcos, ginmanduan na niya ang Philippine National Police kag Department of Foreign Affairs kag nakig-angot naman ini sa mga embahada sa iban nga pungsod agud nga masiguro nga indi na makapanago ang anay kongresista.
english: Marcos said he has already ordered the Philippine National Police and Department of Foreign Affairs and has contacted embassies in other countries to ensure that the former congressman can no longer hide.

text: SUNU sa aton abyan nga si Pedro madamo nga trabaho  sa gobyerno ang mahinay nga matapos tungod sa dugay-dugay nga pagbalikid sa orasan sang mga empleyado nga daw may appointment nga indi nila dapat malipatan.
english: ACCORDING to our friend Pedro, many government jobs are slow to complete because of the constant looking back at the clock by employees who seem to have an appointment that they should not forget.

text: Kon madasig gid man ang pagtrabaho, indi naman maayo ang pagtapos sini kay ang orasan ang ginahimo nga talaksan bisan wala man ini ginasakuan.
english: If the work is done very quickly, it is not good to finish it because the clock is used as a standard even if it is not busy.

text: In other words, sunu kay Pedro, mas mabungahon seguro sa pagtrabaho ang mga empleyado kon durop lang sa pag-ubra nga wala gina-orasan ang ila trabaho tubtub magtonog ang dismissal bell.
english: In other words, according to Pedro, employees are more productive if they are busy working without clocking their work until the dismissal bell rings.

text: Kon wala gid man sing ulubrahon, pwede man mag-unyat-unyat kuno sang kalawasan, magtulutindug kag mag-in-place exercise sa pulungkuan nga indi maka-iskandalo sa iban agud mapabilin ang kapagsik sang mga empleyado sa trabaho.
english: If there is nothing to do, you can also stretch your body, stand up and do in-place exercises in a chair that will not scandalize others in order to maintain the enthusiasm of employees at work.

text: Syempre luyag man sina ni bossing nga mapabilin ang kapagsik sang iya empleyado, indi bala?
english: Of course, the boss wants to keep his employee motivated, right?

text:
***

Gin-treat ako kag si asawahon sang akon duha ka hija sa isa ka panyaga sadtong Domingo.
english:
***

My two daughters treated my wife and I to a lunch that Sunday.

text: Indi ini sila nga duha pirme namon kaupod sa balay.
english: These two were not always with us at home.

text: Ang kinagot lang, nga public school teacher, samtang ang magulang naga-board sa gwa agud mapalapit sa iya gina-ubrahan bilang CPA sa Commission on Audit sa Western Visayas  office.
english: The youngest, a public school teacher, while the elder brother was boarding outside to get closer to his job as a CPA in the Commission on Audit in the Western Visayas office.

text: Tungod gani sini, kon san-o lang namon maupod ang magulang.
english: Because of this, we could only spend time with the older brother.

text: Kag kon mag-upod kami nga apat sa gwa kon may okasyon lang nga importante sa amon nga mag-pamilya.
english: And when the four of us go out together only when there is an occasion that is important to us as a family.

text: Liwat kami nag-upod nga apat para sa panyaga sinang Domingo.
english: The four of us met again for lunch that Sunday.

text: Importante yadto nga okasyon para sa amon nga mag-asawa.
english: It was an important occasion for my wife and me.

text: Indi ko lang isugid ugaling  kon ano nga okasyon.
english: I won't tell you what occasion though.

text: Basi ma-kuryente kami, he-he-he!
english: We might get electrocuted, he-he-he!

text: Sa pagsampot pa lang sa pwertahan sang restoran makahatag na ini dayon sing interes.
english: As soon as you arrive at the door of the restaurant, it immediately attracts interest.

text: Sa ngalan pa lang.
english: In name only.

text: Wala pa ako makasulod sa kasubong nga restoran.
english: I have never been to such a restaurant.

text: Nowhere in the Philippines, hambalon pa, nga may kasubong sina nga lugar nga nasudlan ko sa akon pag-attend bilang student leader sa mga conference kag tuigan nga pagtililipon sang mga organisasyon nasyonal nga katapo ako.
english: Nowhere in the Philippines, in other words, is there such a place that I have entered in my attendance as a student leader in the conferences and annual meetings of the national organizations of which I am a member.

text: Indi lang sa Manila kundi tubtub sa pila pa ka lugar sa Luzon, luas sa pila ka lugar diri mismo sa Western Visayas.
english: Not only in Manila but also in some other places in Luzon, except for some places right here in Western Visayas.

text: Kag indi lang tungod sining mga okasyon kundi langkoy na ang paglagaw-lagaw sa free time.
english: And not only because of these occasions but it's time to go out in your free time.

text: Lakip na dira sang ma-qualify ako sa isa ka one-month student leadership institute sa Cebu.
english: Including when I qualified for a one-month student leadership institute in Cebu.

text: Subong man samtang editor each time sa tatlo ka local daily para sa pagpasanyog pa sang akon ihibalo sa ina nga trabaho.
english: Also while editor each time in three local dailies to further enhance my knowledge in that job.

text:
***

Sa ngalan pa lang sang restoran unique na ini nga makatawag igtalupangod sang huyog sang tag-iya sa pagsagud sang kuring.
english:
***

The name of the restaurant is unique enough to draw attention to the owner's penchant for keeping cats.

text: In fact, madamo dira ang makita nga naka-display sa sulod mismo sang palibut sang restoran.
english: In fact, many of them can be found on display inside the restaurant itself.

text: Nagalain-lain nga kuring nga pwede hikapon, apang indi makungkong, libre sa isa ka aircon nga kwarto kon diin sa pagsulod required ka mag-uba sang sapatos kag mag-face mask.
english: Different cats that can be touched, but not hugged, free in an air-conditioned room where you are required to take off your shoes and wear a face mask.

text: May bulbulon kag indi, may tambukon, may niwangon, may sobra ka daku nga  pensar mo isa ka idu.
english: There are hairy and not, there are fat, there are thin, there are too big think you are a bear.

text: May mga kuring man nga wala gid sing bulbol!
english: There are also cats that have no hair at all!

text: Mga lima ang nakita ko sa ila cage.
english: I saw about five in their cage.

text: Daw dressed chicken nga ready litsunon.
english: It's like dressed chicken ready to roast.

text: Ang isa nga may daku mata daw alien creature gani sa pelikula.
english: The one with the big eye even looks like an alien creature in the movie.

text: May waiter man dira nga daw genius.
english: There's a waiter there who looks like a genius.

text: Man, siya pa lang, sa tanan nga waiter nga naka-serve sa akon, ang wala nagalista sang order sang kustomer.
english: Man, he is the only one, of all the waiters who have served me, who does not list the customer's order.

text: Lima kami, upod ang nobyo sang magulang, kag malapit sa walo ang order.
english: There were five of us, including the eldest’s boyfriend, and the order was close to eight.

text: Nangutana gid ako sa iya kon kaya niya madumduman ang tanan namon nga order.
english: I actually asked him if he could remember all our orders.

text: “Huo,” siling niya nga daw nagapahambog pa.
english: “Yes,” he said, still sounding boastful.

text: Sa pensar ko lang, andaman mo lang karon kon may isa ka order ang indi mo ma-serve ukon sala sa gin-order namon.
english: I just think, just prepare now if there is one order that you can't serve or wrong with what we ordered.

text: Aba, ang tanan namon nga order na-serve niya personal kag sa paglihog sa kaupod nga mga waiter!
english: Why, he served all our orders personally and at the request of his fellow waiters!

text:
***

Indeed, where in the Philippnes may kasubong nga attraction – madamo nga mga kuring nga may nagakalain-lain nga rasa.
english:
***

Indeed, where in the Philippnes there is a similar attraction – many cats of different breeds.

text: Kag mahagop pa bisan sa indi nila kilala!
english: And even tolerate strangers!

text: Indi kasubong sang amon mga kuring – mukhang hybrid ang duha kag ang isa bulbulan nga Persian nga may kasubong sila dira sa restoran – nga nagapinalumba palagyo sa indi nila kilala.
english: Unlike our cats – two look like hybrids and one a hairy Persian that they have like in the restaurant – running away from strangers.

text: Kag where in the Philippines nga may waiter nga may kasubong nga abilidad sa pag-memorize sang order sa iya, samtang ang iban makita ko nagalista gid sang gina-order sa ila.
english: And where in the Philippines is there a waiter who has such an ability to memorize the order to him, while others I see actually list what is ordered to them.

text: Basi interesado kamo mahibal-an kon diin ang restoran nga ini?
english: You might be interested to know where this restaurant is?

text: Bisan pang-curiosity lang nga matigayon mo sa pag-order sang snack kay, sunu sa standard sang akon bulsa, medyo mahal ang pagkaon diri.
english: Even just for curiosity you get to order a snack because, according to the standard of my pocket, the food here is quite expensive.

text: Diri lang ini sa Mandurriao, siyudad sang Iloilo./PN
english: It's only here in Mandurriao, Iloilo City./PN

text: Bukas ang Estados Unidos sang Amerika nga diskusyunan ang free trade agreement (FTA) kaupod sa Pilipinas.
english: The United States of America is open to discuss a free trade agreement (FTA) with the Philippines.

text: Suno kay Philippine Ambassador to the United States Jose Manuel Romualdez, nagpabutyag ang Trump administration sang interes para sa amo nga kasugtanan.
english: Philippine Ambassador to the United States Jose Manuel Romualdez said the Trump administration has expressed interest in the agreement.

text: Una nga nabuksan ang istorya sa potensyal nga FTA sa duha ka pungsod sang ginadiskusyunan ang taripa sa pagpanguna anay ni Special Assistant to the President for Investment and Economic Affairs Frederick Go.
english: The talks on a potential FTA between the two countries were first opened during the tariff discussion led by Special Assistant to the President for Investment and Economic Affairs Frederick Go.

text: Sa subong, nagapatuman ang US sang 19% nga taripa sa mga gina-export sang Pilipinas lakip na sa pila ka agricultural goods kag semiconductors.
english: Currently, the US is imposing a 19% tariff on Philippine exports including some agricultural goods and semiconductors.

text: Sang nagligad nga semana, nagpirma ang US sang memorandum of understanding (MOU) kaupod sa iban nga mga pungsod lakip na ang Pilipinas.
english: Last week, the US signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with other countries including the Philippines.

text: Ini nagatuyo nga mapalain-lain ang global critical mineral supply chains kag ma-promote ang investments sa sector.
english: It aims to diversify global critical mineral supply chains and promote investments in the sector.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginabanta 70% sang Philippine trade ang gina-conduct nga may FTA partners.
english: It is known that approximately 70% of Philippine trade is conducted with FTA partners.

text: Ang nabilin nga 30% naga-involve sang non-FTA countries kun sa diin 10% ang United States kag 8-10% naman ang sa European Union.#
english: The remaining 30% involve non-FTA countries with 10% in the United States and 8-10% in the European Union.

text: Patay ang 50 ka mga indibidwal lakip ang 33 ka mga kabataan matapos ang drone strikes sa isa ka kindergarten kag ospital sa Sudan.
english: Fifty individuals including 33 children were killed after drone strikes on a kindergarten and hospital in Sudan.

text: Suno sa lokal nga opisyal sa banwa sang Kalogi sa South Kordofan, tatlo ka beses ginpalupok ang drone: una sa kindergarten, ikaduha sa ospital, kag ikatlo samtang gina-rescue mga kabataan.
english: According to the local official in the town of Kalogi in South Kordofan, the drone was shot down three times: first at a kindergarten, second at a hospital, and third while rescuing children.

text: Dugang pa, sang gin-target ang mga paramedics kag mga sibilyan nga nagbulig sa mga pilason, nagdugang ang kadamuon sang biktima kag nagdako ang halit sa pasilidad sang mga hospitals.
english: In addition, when paramedics and civilians who helped the injured were targeted, the number of victims increased and the damage to hospital facilities increased.

text: Sa karun, ginpahayag sang mga humanitarian groups kag sang UNICEF nga ini nga atake isa ka “paglapas sa kinamatarong sang mga kabataan” kag nagpanawagan sa tanan nga partido nga untaton ang pag-atake.
english: Meanwhile, humanitarian groups and UNICEF said the attack was a “violation of children’s rights” and called on all parties to stop the attack.

text: Ginduso ni Senate Deputy Majority Leader JV Ejercito ang Anti-Online Hate and Harassment Bill ukon kilala man nga Emman Atienza Bill.
english: Senate Deputy Majority Leader JV Ejercito proposed the Anti-Online Hate and Harassment Bill or also known as the Emman Atienza Bill.

text: Sandig sa press release sang Senate of the Philippines nga nakabalhag sa official website sang upper chamber, tuyo sang hagna nga ma-address ang nagadamo nga kaso sang cyberbullying, fake news, kag online defamation diri sa Pilipinas.
english: According to a press release from the Senate of the Philippines published on the official website of the upper chamber, the bill aims to address the increasing number of cases of cyberbullying, fake news, and online defamation here in the Philippines.

text: Ginbasehan sang senador ang kaso ni Emman, anak sang TV presenter nga si Kuya Kim Atienza, nga nabiktima man sang online hate.
english: The senator cited the case of Emman, son of TV presenter Kuya Kim Atienza, who was also a victim of online hate.

text: “While social media serves as a platform to advocate for truth, it has also given room for ruining reputations, spreading fake news, rumors, false accusations, and violence.
english: “While social media serves as a platform to advocate for truth, it has also given room for ruining reputations, spreading fake news, rumors, false accusations, and violence.

text: In reality, there are no delete or edit buttons for the ones we have hurt,” suno sa senador.
english: In reality, there are no delete or edit buttons for the ones we have hurt,” according to the senator.

text: Tuyo sini nga maprotektahan ang mga indibidwal sa online harassment kag mapabaskog pa ang implementasyon sang mga layi agud nga malikawan ang cyberbullying and online hate.
english: It aims to protect individuals from online harassment and strengthen the implementation of laws to prevent cyberbullying and online hate.

text: Ang ginatumod sini nga mga layi amo ang Cybercrime Prevention Act kag ang Anti-Bullying Act.
english: These laws refer to the Cybercrime Prevention Act and the Anti-Bullying Act.

text: “And as Emman used to always say, to promote ‘a little kindness,’” pahayag pa sang senador sa iya ginduso nga hagna.
english: “And as Emman used to always say, to promote ‘a little kindness,’” the senator said in his proposed bill.

text: Sa sini nga hagna, ginaduso ang silot para sa mga akto kaangay sang cyberlibel, online hate speech, kag harassment.
english: In this bill, punishment is proposed for acts like cyberlibel, online hate speech, and harassment.

text: Magabaton naman ang mga biktima sang psychosocial support kag counselling paagi sa Victim Support and Protection Program.
english: Victims will receive psychosocial support and counseling through the Victim Support and Protection Program.

text: Ang tanan nga gasto sa sini nga mga serbisyo ang pagasukton halin sa perpetrators.
english: All costs of these services will be charged from the perpetrators.

text: Ini nga perpetrators ang mangatubang naman sang multa nga halin sa P50,000 tubtub sa P200,000 kag pagkapreso kun mapamatud-an nga guilty.
english: The perpetrators will face fines ranging from P50,000 to P200,000 and imprisonment if found guilty.

text: Kun mga menor de edad naman ang involved, may patigayunon nga counseling kag pagpasangkad sang edukasyon agud nga matapna ang negatibo nga pamatasan.
english: If minors are involved, counseling and education will be conducted to prevent negative behavior.

text: “We hope Emman’s passing will not be in vain as we push for the immediate passage of this measure.
english: “We hope Emman’s passing will not be in vain as we push for the immediate passage of this measure.

text: We need to bring back kindness online, where people pause and think before they post.
english: We need to bring back kindness online, where people pause and think before they post.

text: We must prevent another tragedy where our fellowmen, especially the youth, are pushed to the breaking point by the vitriol of online hate,” suno pa kay Ejercito.
english: We must prevent another tragedy where our fellowmen, especially the youth, are pushed to the breaking point by the vitriol of online hate,” Ejercito said.

text: Sang nagligad nga Oktubre sang gin-anunsyo sang pamilya Atienza ang kamatayon sang 19-anyos nga si Emman nga isa man ka mental health advocate.
english: It was last October when the Atienza family announced the death of 19-year-old Emman, who was also a mental health advocate.

text: Ginpresentar naman sa mag-asawa nga Kim kag Felicia ang kopya sang bill kadungan sang haya ni Emman.
english: Kim and Felicia were presented with a copy of the bill along with Emman's funeral.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa Kamara, may yara man sang counterpart measure nga gin-file si Negros Occidental 3rd District Rep.
english: It is known that in the House of Representatives, there is also a counterpart measure filed by Negros Occidental 3rd District Rep.

english: Albee Benitez.#

text: Literal nga nag-backfire sa suspek ang ginhimo sini nga pagsunog sa isa ka restaurant sa Melbourne, Australia.
english: The suspect literally backfired when he set fire to a restaurant in Melbourne, Australia.

text: Samtang ginahimo sang lalaki ang pagsunog, pati siya, nasunog man.
english: While the man was doing the burning, he, too, was burned.

text: Base sa video sang pulis nga gin-post sa social media, nagsulod ang lalaki sa restaurant nga may dala nga fuel container.
english: According to police video posted on social media, the man entered the restaurant with a fuel container.

text: Ginbubo niya ang unod sini sa may bar area.
english: He poured its contents into the bar area.

text: Pagkadugay-dugay, nag-ibwal na ang kalayo, apang nadala pati ang iya nga bayo gani nga nagligid-ligid siya sa salog.
english: Eventually, the fire broke out, but his clothes were also taken away and he rolled on the floor.

text: Nagdali-dali ini guwa kag nagsakay sa kotse nga nagakalayo pa ang bayo, apang sang ulihi nanaog naman ini kag nagligid para mapatay ang kalayo.
english: He rushed out and got into the car with his clothes still on fire, but later got out and rolled over to put out the fire.

text: Nakapalagyo gid ini sang ulihi gamit ang kotse nga nagahulat sa guwa sang restaurant.
english: He later escaped in a car waiting outside the restaurant.

text: Suno sa pulis, may minor damages sa restaurant kag padayon nila nga ginapangita ang suspek.
english: Police said there were minor damages to the restaurant and they are still looking for the suspect.

text: Sigurado man ang awtoridad nga bisan nakapalagyo ang lalaki, nagapaidalom ini subong sa treatment bangud sa mga paso sa iya lawas bangud sa literal nga pag-“backfire” sang iya ginhimo.
english: Authorities are also sure that although the man escaped, he is now undergoing treatment for burns on his body due to the literal backfire of his actions.

text: Nagapanguna ang Iloilo sa may pinakamataas nga kaso sang HIV (human immunodeficiency virus) sa Western Visayas.
english: Iloilo has the highest number of HIV (human immunodeficiency virus) cases in Western Visayas.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Rodney Labis, Chief, Health Service Delivert Division sang Iloilo Provincial Health Office, iya ginpahayag nga halin 1986 tubtob Septyembre 2024, ang Iloilo ang may na-record nga 1,990 nga kaso sang HIV, kon sa diin, 249 ang nabalhag nga napatay.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Rodney Labis, Chief, Health Service Delivered Division of the Iloilo Provincial Health Office, said that from 1986 to September 2024, Iloilo has recorded 1,990 cases of HIV, of which 249 have died.

text: Suno kay Labis, kon ikumpara naman ang mga kaso subong nga tuig 2024, mas mataas ini sang nagligad nga 2023.
english: Labis said the number of cases in 2024 is higher than in 2023.

text: Ginakabig man sang natungdan nga mas maayo nga indikasyon ang pagsaka sang numero sang amo nga balatian bangud amat-amat na nga na-detect sang ila talatapan kag gilayon nga mabulong.
english: He also considered the increase in the number of cases as a better indication because their office has gradually detected and immediately treated.

text: Nagapati man ang natungdan nga importante nga matumod ang mga indibidwal agud nga indi na mahulog pa sa Acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS) ang amo nga balatian.
english: He also believes that it is important to identify individuals so that the disease does not fall into the acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS).

text: Nahibaluan nga sa 43 ka mga local government units (LGU) sa probinsya, sugod Enero tubtob Setyembre 2024, ang mga banwa nga may mataas nga kaso sang HIV amo ang: Pavia, Sta.
english: Of the 43 local government units (LGUs) in the province, from January to September 2024, the towns with high HIV cases are: Pavia, Sta.

english: Barbara, Barotac Nuevo, Calinog, Oton, and Pototan.

english: THE politician is practical.

english: In fact, it has no permanent loyalty even to its party and the principles it stands for.

text: May kaugalingon ini nga panan-aw nga dulot sang iya “free will” nga ginhatag sa tawo sang Diyos, nga bisan si Adan kag si Eba may kaisug sa pagsupak sa sugo sang Diyos nga ginkabangdan ugaling sang pagpalayas sa ila sang Diyos.
english: It has its own vision given by its “free will” given to man by God, that even Adam and Eve had the courage to disobey God's command which caused them to be expelled by God.

english: Sometimes, it is true, a politician's views do not match the position and even the sworn principles of his party.

english: In fact, we can't say he's a liar.

text:

Sadto, panindugan ini Duterte ang magpaayon-ayon lang sa China sa aton problema sa 200-Nautical mile Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) sa West Philippine Sea tungod, kon indi gid man kahadlok sa China, mas gustuhin gid man niya ang pagpakig-abyan sa China sangsa U.S. sa iya mismo ginapakita nga pagpakalain sa naulihi.
english:

In the past, Duterte insisted that China should agree to our problem in the 200-Nautical mile Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) in the West Philippine Sea because, if not afraid of China, he would prefer friendship with China than the U.S. in his own criticism of the latter.

english: "Why?" Pedro suggested that PBBM agree with Duterte's position, “Didn't the United States save their families from disaster?

text: Nakita man ni PBBM ang kaayuhan sang pagpabaskug sang pagpakig-abyan sa U.S. – ang kinahanglan nga pagpabakod sang aton Mutual Defense Pact sa U.S. batok sa pang-“bully” sang China; ang pagpabakod sang relasyon sang Filipinas sa mga pungsod nga luyag pabakuron ang human rights sa Filipinas bilang katapo sang UN Human Rights Council, nga nangin kwestyonable tungod sa Duterte Drug War nga linibu nga “suspects” ang napatay; kag ang ma-imbestigaran gid ang Drug War ni Duterte sa reklamo nga wala sing “due process” ining mga pagpamatay.

text: Ginaduso subong sang pila ka mga mamalidha nga buhinan ang value-added tax (VAT) nga ginadugang sa mga kompanya sang enerhiya agud mapanubo ang bili sang kuryente.
english: Some lawmakers are now proposing to reduce the value-added tax (VAT) added to energy companies to lower the cost of electricity.

text: Suno kay Senator Sherwin Gatchalian,  anay nagapamuno sang Energy, Ways and Means Committees sa Senado, dako ang mangin epekto sini sa kita sang gobyerno kun kuhaon ang VAT sa power generation kag distribution.
english: According to Senator Sherwin Gatchalian, former chairman of the Energy, Ways and Means Committees in the Senate, the removal of VAT on power generation and distribution will have a huge impact on government revenue.

text: Apang suno sa Senador, ginatun-an pa sini ang posibilidad nga buhinan ang VAT nga ginapasa sa mga consumer.
english: However, the Senator said he is still studying the possibility of reducing the VAT passed on to consumers.

text: Nag-ugyon naman si Energy Regulatory Commission (ERC) Chairman Nino Juan sa pagkuha sang VAT sa kuryente, nga suno pa sa iya magaresulta sa mas manubo nga sukot para sa mga ordinaryo nga consumer kag negosyante.
english: Energy Regulatory Commission (ERC) Chairman Nino Juan agreed to the removal of VAT on electricity, which he said will result in lower rates for ordinary consumers and businesses.

text: Ginbulsa sang Pinay tennis star nga si Alex Eala ang gold medal sa women’s singles sa 33rd Southeast Asian Games matapos ginlutos ang tiglawas sang Thailand nga si Mananchaya Sawangkaew sa final match subong nga adlaw.
english: Pinay tennis star Alex Eala bagged the gold medal in the women’s singles at the 33rd Southeast Asian Games after defeating Thailand’s representative Mananchaya Sawangkaew in the final match today.

text:
Ginpierde ni Eala ang home bet sa straight-sets, 6-1, 6-2, sa National Tennis Development Center sa Nonthaburi, Thailand pasado 12:00 subong nga udto (Philippine time.)

Maragtason ini nga kadalag-an para sa Pilipinas matapos ulihi nga nadag-an ang bulawan nga medalya sa women’s singles sa biennial meet paagi kay Maricris Fernandez-Gentz sang 1999.
english:
Eala lost the home bet in straight-sets, 6-1, 6-2, at the National Tennis Development Center in Nonthaburi, Thailand past 12:00 this afternoon (Philippine time.)

This is a historic victory for the Philippines after Maricris Fernandez-Gentz last won the women's singles gold medal at the biennial meet in 1999.

text: Sang amo nga tuig, wala pa nabun-ag ang subong world no.

english: This is Eala's first gold medal at the SEA Games and her third medal this edition after also winning bronze in the women's team event and mixed doubles.

text: Sang 2021 nga edisyon sang tournament, bronze medalist si Eala sa women’s singles event.
english: In the 2021 edition of the tournament, Eala was a bronze medalist in the women’s singles event.

text: Siya kag ang volleyball player nga si Bryan Bagunas ang flagbearers sang Pilipinas sa Bangkok subong nga 2025.
english: He and volleyball player Bryan Bagunas are the flagbearers of the Philippines in Bangkok this 2025.

text: Natigayun nga nakapauli ang 80 ka mga Pilipino nga turista nga na-stranded sa Jordan bangud sa US-Israeli airstrikes sa Iran, suno sa Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA).
english: Eighty Filipino tourists stranded in Jordan due to US-Israeli airstrikes in Iran have returned home, according to the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA).

text:
Base sa record sang DFA, 82 sa 113 ka mga indibidwal nga stranded ang hilway nga nakabyahe halin Queen Alia International Airport padulong sa mga transit hubs sa Cairo, Dubai, Mumbai, kag Riyadh, kun sa diin sila ang magasakay sa ila tagsa ka mga connecting flights pabalik sa Manila.”

81 naman ka mga Overseas Filipino Workers (OFWs) nga naapektuhan ang ila mga biyahe bangud sa mainit nga tension sa middle East, ang nakapauli na sa pungsod kahapon nga adlaw.
english:
Based on DFA records, 82 of the 113 stranded individuals were able to travel safely from Queen Alia International Airport to transit hubs in Cairo, Dubai, Mumbai, and Riyadh, where they will board their respective connecting flights back to Manila.”

81 Overseas Filipino Workers (OFWs) whose flights were affected by the heated tensions in the Middle East, returned to the country yesterday.

english: The agency is currently trying to repatriate all Filipinos stranded in several Middle Eastern countries due to the still-hot tensions between the United States and Iran.

english: The New Orleans Pelicans defeated the Chicago Bulls 114-104.

english: Pelicans forward Trey Murphy III led his team to pocket its fifth win this season in 27 games.

english: Murphy produced 20 points and 10 rebounds, aided by eight field goals made in 34 minutes.

text: Nagtaas ang domestic liquidity, ukon ang kantidad sang kwarta nga nagasirkular sa ekonomiya sa Pilipinas, sang 7% year-on-year sang Disyembre 2025, base sa inisyal nga datos sang Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP).
english: Domestic liquidity, or the amount of money circulating in the Philippine economy, increased by 7% year-on-year in December 2025, based on initial data from the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP).

text: Matapos nga i-adjust ang seasonal fluctuations, nagapadayon nga mapag-un ang M3 halin sang Nobyembre.

text: Ginahimo man nila ini para sa taga-Negros sa ila man mga negosyo nga pwede madala sa Iloilo.
english: They are also doing this for the people of Negros in their businesses that can be brought to Iloilo.

text: Syempre mahimo man ini sang DA kag DTI kon gustuhon agud makabulig sa mga mangunguma naton sang ila produkto sa uma, indi bala?
english: Of course the DA and DTI can do this if they want to help our farmers with their farm products, right?

text:
***

In fact, kon mahibal-an na sang gobyerno ang mga presyo sa mga merkado, mahimuan na nila ini sang medyos agud mapatuman ang pagpa-istable sang presyo (stable pricing) sining mga produkto.
english:
***

In fact, once the government knows the prices in the markets, they can take steps to implement stable pricing of these products.

text: Kon matigayon ini, syempre daku ini nga bulig sa mga negosyante.
english: If this is achieved, of course it will be a great help to the entrepreneurs.

text: Makapahapos ini sang ila pag-estimate sang ila gastos kag kita nga wala sing daku nga risgo sa ila negosyo.
english: This can make it easier for them to estimate their cost and revenue without taking a huge risk to their business.

text: Makabulig man ini sa mga manugbakal kay ang “stable pricing” makapahapos man sa ila pag-budget sang ila galastuhon sa panimalay, indi bala?/PN
english: This will also help consumers because stable pricing will make it easier for them to budget their household expenses, right?/PN

text: Ginsapubliko ni Sam Milby nga na-diagnose siya nga may latent autoimmune diabetes in adults (LADA) ukon Type 1.5 diabetes.
english: Sam Milby has announced that he has been diagnosed with latent autoimmune diabetes in adults (LADA) or Type 1.5 diabetes.

text: Suno kay Sam, nahibaluan niya ang iya kondisyon kasunod sang general check-up sa Singapore.
english: Sam said he learned of his condition following a general check-up in Singapore.

text: Base sa Mayo Clinic, ang LADA amo ang sahi sang diabetes nga naga-umpisa sa adulthood kag nagalala samtang nagadugay.
english: Based on the Mayo Clinic, LADA is the type of diabetes that starts in adulthood and worsens over time.

text: Kaangay sa type 1 diabetes, nagakatabo ang LADA kun mag-untat na ang pancreas sa paghimo sang insulin bangud sang autoimmune process nga naga-damage sang cells sa pancreas.
english: As with type 1 diabetes, LADA occurs when the pancreas stops producing insulin due to an autoimmune process that damages cells in the pancreas.

text: Apang indi kaangay sa type 1 diabetes, sa LADA, mahinay lamang ini rason nga indi kinahanglan nga mag-insulin gid gilayon ang pasyente.
english: But unlike type 1 diabetes, in LADA, it is mild so the patient does not need to take insulin immediately.

text: “It’s bad.
english: “It’s bad.

text: Type 1 is the worst.
english: Type 1 is the worst.

text: Tito Gary [Valenciano] has Type 1.
english: Tito Gary [Valenciano] has Type 1.

text: It means that your pancreas does not produce insulin at all.
english: It means that your pancreas does not produce insulin at all.

text: So I may have to start insulin shots eventually.
english: So I may have to start insulin shots eventually.

text: Ganun talaga,” suno sa aktor.
english: It really is,” according to the actor.

text: Pahayag pa sang aktor, pareho nga may diabetes ang iya iloy kag amay.
english: The actor said that both his mother and father have diabetes.

text: Ginsiling sini nga ginatinguhaan niya nga mangin mas aktibo ilabi na sa pag-exercise.
english: He said he is trying to be more active especially in exercising.

text: “I am trying to be more physically active.
english: “I am trying to be more physically active.

text: During the pandemic, hindi masyado, e. I would do some push-ups and sit-ups pero cardio kulang.
english: During the pandemic, not so much, e. I would do some push-ups and sit-ups but cardio is lacking.

text: Hindi ako mahilig sa treadmill, e,” pahayag pa sini.
english: I don't like treadmills,” he said.

text: “Well, I do pickleball now.
english: “Well, I do pickleball now.

text: I’ve been playing pickleball on and off for two years.
english: I’ve been playing pickleball on and off for two years.

text: That’s my cardio.
english: That’s my cardio.

text: Sometimes I run,” dugang niya.
english: Sometimes I run,” he added.

text: “Also, eating habits—I’m pretty strict on my diet.
english: “Also, eating habits—I’m pretty strict on my diet.

text: The one thing that helps also is shiratake rice and shiratake pasta, okay siya, masarap siya.
english: The one thing that helps also is shiratake rice and shiratake pasta, it's okay, it's delicious.

text:
That’s a big help.”

Parte subong si Sam sang upcoming Prime Video series nga ‘The Alibi’ kaupod si Kim Chiu kag Paulo Avelino.
english:
That’s a big help.”

Sam is currently part of the upcoming Prime Video series ‘The Alibi’ alongside Kim Chiu and Paulo Avelino.

text: Ginrekomendar ni Senator Bam Aquino ang pagdeklarar sang state of national emergency bangud sa epekto sang pagsaka sang produktong petrolyo sa pungsod.
english: Senator Bam Aquino recommended the declaration of a state of national emergency due to the impact of the rise in petroleum products in the country.

text: Suno sa senador, madamo na nga pamilya nga Pilipino ang naga-eksperyensya sang mabug-at nga epekto sang pagsaka sang presyo sang gasolina kag diesel, gani kinahanglan na nga padalion sang gobyerno ang mga tikang nga gina-implementar sini.
english: The senator said many Filipino families are already experiencing the heavy impact of the rise in gasoline and diesel prices, so the government needs to accelerate the measures it is implementing.

text: Lakip sa iya suhestyon ang pagpatuman sang price ceiling sa mga nagapanguna nga balaklon, madali nga pagpanagtag sang bulig nga ginpa-in sa 2026 budget para sa mga transport worker.
english: His suggestions include the implementation of a price ceiling on basic commodities, easy distribution of assistance allocated in the 2026 budget for transport workers.

text: Dugang pa sang Senador nga kinahanglan man sang bulig kag suporta sang mga micro, small and medium enterprises sa sini nga tinion agud malikawan ang pagsara sang mga negosyo nga ila ginakuhaan sang matag-adlaw nga kinahanglon gani nga kinahanglan nga buligan ang mga ini.
english: The Senator added that the help and support of micro, small and medium enterprises is also needed at this time to avoid the closure of businesses from which they get their daily necessities so they need to be helped.

text: Suportado sang isa ka travel industry group ang pagrepaso sang Kamara sa pagsulundan sa pagpanukot sang travel tax.
english: A travel industry group supports the House's review of the travel tax collection rules.

text: Suno sa Global Tourism Business Association (GTBA), importante ang pag-review bangud makabulig ini nga masiguro nga makabenepisyo gid ang sektor sang turismo kag ang lokal nga komunidad sa travel tax.
english: According to the Global Tourism Business Association (GTBA), the review is important because it will help ensure that the tourism sector and the local community truly benefit from the travel tax.

text: Subong, nagalab-ot na ang suktanay sa P2,700 sa first-class passengers kag P1,620 sa economy travelers.
english: Now, the fare is P2,700 for first-class passengers and P1,620 for economy travelers.

text: Sang Sabado, matandaan nga nagpanawagan si House tourism committee vice chairman kag Palawan Representative Gil Acosta sang pagpatigayon sang congressional review sa utilization sang travel taxes nga ginasukot sa mga Pinoy nga nagabyahe sa luwas sang pungsod.
english: On Saturday, House tourism committee vice chairman and Palawan Representative Gil Acosta called for a congressional review on the utilization of travel taxes charged to Filipinos traveling abroad.

text: Suno sa mamalidha, ini nga travel tax collections ang may average nga P4 billion tubtub sa P5 billion kada tuig.
english: According to the lawmaker, these travel tax collections average P4 billion to P5 billion per year.

text: Nagakadto ini sa Tourism Infrastructure and Enterprise Zone Authority (TIEZA), Commission on Higher Education (CHED), kag sa cultural sector.
english: This goes to the Tourism Infrastructure and Enterprise Zone Authority (TIEZA), Commission on Higher Education (CHED), and the cultural sector.

text: Kahapon, Pebrero 10, gin-anunsyo naman sang Malacañang nga lakip sa 21 ka priority legislative measures nga aprubado ni President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.
english: Yesterday, February 10, Malacañang announced that among the 21 priority legislative measures approved by President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.

text: ang hagna nga maga-abolish sa travel tax.
english: the bill that would abolish the travel tax.

text: Suno kay Palace Press Officer Claire Castro, luyag sang presidente nga mapahagan-hagan ang palas-anon nga pinansyal sang mga byahero, ilabi na nga indi tanan naga-byahe agud maglagaw lamang kundi agud magtrabaho kag bangud may kadtuan nga emerhensya.
english: According to Palace Press Officer Claire Castro, the president wants to ease the financial burden of travelers, especially since not everyone travels just to sightsee but to work and because there is an emergency.

text: May yara sang mga kahangawa nga mabuhinan ang pondo sa edukasyon kag sa promosyon sang turismo kun i-abolish ang travel tax, apang suno kay Castro, iga-cover sang gobyerno ang mangin kakulangan sa pondo paagi sa national budget.#
english: There are concerns that funding for education and tourism promotion will be reduced if the travel tax is abolished, but Castro said the government will cover the shortfall through the national budget.

text: DAW indi magpati ang abyan naton nga si Pedro sa nakita kag nabalitaan niya sa TV parti sa pag-upod sa procession (traslacion)  sang sobra 30,000 ka mga deboto sang Itom nga Nazareno (Black Nazarene) sadtong Enero 9, kon san-o ginaselebrar ang pyesta sini kada tuig.
english: OUR friend Pedro could not believe what he saw and heard on TV about the procession (traslacion) of more than 30,000 devotees of the Black Nazarene on January 9, when its feast is celebrated every year.

text: Indi kasubong ini kadamo, sunu sa iya, ang nagdugok sa sining traslacion sang pagpadungog sa Black Nazarene sa nagliligad nga mga tinuig.
english: Not as many, he said, have attended this traslacion of honoring the Black Nazarene in recent years.

text: Seguro kay mga tatlo gid man ka tuig nga wala ini mahiwat tungod sang Covid-19 pandemic sugod sadtong Pebrero 2020 sa pungsod, pagkatapos una nag-igu ini sa China sadtong Nobyembre 2019 kag amat-amat lang nagtahaw sadtong 2022.
english: Maybe because it was not held for about three years due to the Covid-19 pandemic since February 2020 in the country, after it first hit China in November 2019 and gradually disappeared in 2022.

text: Nahalawhaw man si Pedro sa ginpakita nga paghangad sang mga deboto nga nagadinagoso sa pagdugok kag pagsunod sa karosa sang imahen (istatwa) sini sa ginhiwat nga procession nga naglab-ut sa sobra 15 ka oras halin sa kaagahon tubtub sa pagbalik sini sa Quiapo Church sa Manila sang gab-i na.
english: Pedro was also impressed by the admiration shown by the devotees who flocked to follow the chariot of his image (statue) in the procession that lasted more than 15 hours from morning until its return to the Quiapo Church in Manila late at night.

text: May nagapilit gid gani sa pagkabit sa kilid sang karosa bisan ginadilian ini agud mahaplos bisan na lang ang salamin kon diin nasulod ini, samtang ang iban nga nagadinasok gid sa palibut gahaboy sang mga tuwalya sa mga nagabantay agud ihaplos ini sa salamin ugaling ihaboy balik ini sa ila.
english: Some even insist on hanging on the side of the carriage even though it is forbidden to touch even the glass where it is inside, while others who are crowded around throw towels at the guards to touch the glass but throw it back to them.

text: Bag-o sini may “pahalik” naman sa Black Nazarene ang ginhiwat sa simbahan para sa publiko.
english: Earlier, a “kiss” to the Black Nazarene was held at the church for the public.

text:
***

Ginasiling nga milagroso ang ining imahen sang Black Nazarene gani indi katingalahan nga madamo ini sang mga deboto nga luyag gid makapalapit, makahikap kag maghalok diri.
english:
***

This image of the Black Nazarene is said to be miraculous so it is not surprising that it has many devotees who are eager to approach, touch and kiss it.

text: Kon paano nasapwan sang mga tumuluo ining Black Nazarene nga imahen ni Hesukristo, nga indi naman itom sing pamanit sunu sa Bibliya, kag ginpadunggan wala ugaling kita kahibalo.
english: How the believers found this Black Nazarene image of Jesus Christ, who was not black according to the Bible, and honored it, however, we do not know.

text: Ang nabalitaan nga pag-ayo sang mga naga-balatian sa paghikap lang sini nagdugang pa gani sa paghangad sini tubtub nangin kapistahan na ang pagpadungog sini paagi sa traslacion, nga nagapadumdum sang pagsaylo sini halin sa isa ka simbahan sa Luneta (Bagumbayan) pakadto sa Quiapo Church.
english: The reported healing of the sick by touching it even increased its admiration until it became a feast to honor it with a traslacion, which commemorates its move from a church in Luneta (Bagumbayan) to Quiapo Church.

text:
***

Medyo gareklamo ugaling si Pedro sa klase sang ginapakita nga paghangad sang mga tawo sa ining imahen ni Hesukristo.
english:
***

Peter, however, was a little complaining about the kind of admiration people showed for this image of Jesus Christ.

text: Nanotaran niya kuno nga daw gatutok na gid lang ang ila pagsimba sa imahen nga ini ni Hesukristo.
english: He said he noticed that their worship seemed to be focused on this image of Jesus Christ.

text: Kag indi na sa personal nga kamatuoran ni Hesukristo sa Iya pagkatao pisikal   sa nahibal-an nila sa Bibliya kag ispirituhanon nga kamatuoran  bilang Anak sang Diyos nga ginbun-ag ni Maria paagi sa Ispiritu Santo.
english: And no longer in the personal truth of Jesus Christ in His physical being in what they knew from the Bible and spiritual truth as the Son of God born of Mary through the Holy Spirit.

text: “Daku ini nga kasal-an nga ‘idolatry’, nga ginasikway sang Bibliya,” paathag ni Pedro.
english: “This is a serious sin called ‘idolatry’, which the Bible condemns,” Peter explains.

text: Indi bala katoliko ka man, siling ko,  kag kahiwatan na sang Simbahan Catolica ang paghatag sing importansya sa mga imahen ni Hesukristo kag sang mga baganihan sang Simbahan nga kon tawgon mga santos?
english: Are you not a Catholic, I said, and it is the custom of the Catholic Church to give importance to the images of Jesus Christ and the heroes of the Church who are called saints?

text:
“Ti, ngaa ano gid ang reklamo mo dira?”

Siling niya: “Indi bala ang Bibliya nagasiling nga kilalahon lang naton ang matuod nga Diyos kag wala na sing iban kag kon sin-o lang nga diyos-diyos ukon bisan pa gani sang ila mga imahen?”

“Indi husto inang imo interpretasyon sa panugyan sang Bibliya.
english:
“Well, why are you complaining about that?”

He said: “Doesn't the Bible say that we should know only the true God and no one else and anyone else or even their images?”

“Your interpretation of the Bible's counsel is wrong.

text: Indi bala normal lang sa aton nga mga tao ang maghupot kag magpakabit sang mga retrato sa dingding sang aton mga ginikanan, iban nga myembro sang pamilya, kag kon sin-o pa nga luyag naton dumdumon sa adlaw-adlaw para indi kita malipat sa ila?
english: Isn't it normal for us humans to keep and hang pictures on the walls of our parents, other family members, and anyone else we want to remember every day so we don't forget them?

text: Ginaamligan man naton ining ila mga retrato sa pagpakita naton sang respeto sa ila, buhi man ukon nagtaliwan na,” siling ko.
english: We also protect these photographs of them as we show respect to them, whether alive or deceased,” I said.

text: ”Ti, ano ang malain kon ginadumdum ta man si Hesukristo, nga Anak sang Diyos paagi kay Maria, paagi sa iya imahen sing may kasubong nga respeto kag  pagdumdum?
english: "Well, what's wrong if we also remember Jesus Christ, the Son of God through Mary, through his image with the same respect and remembrance?

text: Malain lang ina kon pang-insulto na sa Diyos kag mga santos ang aton paggamit sa sining ila mga imahen,” dugang ko gani.
english: It's bad if we use these images to insult God and the saints,” I added.

text:
“In fact,” siling ko pa, “Ang mga pari nga katoliko nagakilala man sining kasal-anan nga ‘idolatry’ kon ang ginasimba mo ang  imahen lang nila kag indi ang matuod nga kamatuoran sang Diyos kag mga santos?”

Ginaako ini nga kamatuoran sang Simbahan Cartolica mismo.
english:
“In fact,” I said, “Do Catholic priests also recognize this sin of idolatry if you worship only their image and not the true truth of God and the saints?”

This fact is recognized by the Catholic Church itself.

text: Sa interbyu gani sa isa ka pari sa tion sang Traslacion sadtong Enero 9, ginsiling niya nga mayoron ta ang pagpangamuyo kon diin ginalab-ut gid sa aton kaisipan kag balatyagon si Hesukristo kag indi lang sa iya imahen sa Black Nazarene kundi sa Iya gid.
english: In an interview with a priest during the Traslacion on January 9, he said that we should pray where Jesus Christ is reached in our minds and feelings and not only in his image in the Black Nazarene but in Himself.

text: In fact, kon nagapangamuyo kita sa Diyos, indi bala ginapiyong ta ang aton mga mata agud matumod Siya sa iya ispirituhanon nga kamatuoran kag indi kay sa iya imahen lang?/PN
english: In fact, when we pray to God, do we not close our eyes to see Him in His spiritual truth and not just in His image?/PN

text: Nagpaandam ang fishers’ group nga Pambansang Lakas ng Kilusang Mamamalakaya ng Pilipinas (Pamalakaya) batok sa padayon nga importasyon sang isda.
english: The fishermen's group Pambansang Lakas ng Kilusang Mamamalakaya ng Pilipinas (Pamalakaya) has warned against the continued importation of fish.

text: Suno sa grupo, may nagguwa nga report sa pagsarurot sang produksyon sang isda, apang indi ini dapat paghimuon nga rason sang Department of Agriculture (DA) agud nga mag-import na naman sang tonelada nga suplay bangud maapektuhan sini ang local nga mga manugpangisda.
english: According to the group, there has been a report on the decline in fish production, but this should not be used as a reason for the Department of Agriculture (DA) to import tons of supply again because it will affect local fishermen.

text: Ang ginatumod nga report sang grupo amo ang ginbalhag sang international conservation organization nga Oceana nga naganubo sang 45,000 metric tons ang mahulik nga mga isda sa Pilipinas sa kada tuig.
english: The group is referring to a report published by the international conservation organization Oceana that the number of wild fish in the Philippines is decreasing by 45,000 metric tons every year.

text: Ang ginplastar nga mga rason amo ang overfishing, illegal fishing, kag ang maluya nga pagpatuman sang fisheries law.
english: The reasons put forward were overfishing, illegal fishing, and the weak enforcement of the fisheries law.

text: Suno naman sa Pamalakaya, ginapabay-an sang gobyerno ang ikaayo sang sektor sang mga manugpangisda ilabi na ang municipal fisheries subsector.
english: According to Pamalakaya, the government is neglecting the welfare of the fishing sector especially the municipal fisheries subsector.

text: Halin sang 2018 suno sa grupo, masobra sa 200,000 metric tons sang isda lakip na ang tamudyos ang gina-import halin sa China, Taiwan, kag Vietnam.
english: Since 2018, the group said, more than 200,000 metric tons of fish including shellfish have been imported from China, Taiwan, and Vietnam.

text: Bilang resulta, nagnubo man ang farmgate prices ukon ang presyo sang hulik sang local fisherfolk.
english: As a result, the farmgate prices of the local fisherfolk also decreased.

text: “Ito ang dapat na mapagpasya at konkretong inaaksyunan ng pamahalaan, imbes na mag-angkat ng tone-toneladang isda na higit na pumipinsala sa lokal na produksyon,” kabahin sang statement sang grupo.
english: “This is what the government should take decisive and concrete action, instead of importing tons of fish that are more damaging to local production,” the group said in a statement.

text: Una naman sila nagpaandam nga mas magaluya ang municipal fisheries production kasunod sang ruling sang korte nga nagatugot sa commercial fishing vessels nga mag-operate sa sulod sang 15-kilometer municipal waters.
english: Earlier, they warned that municipal fisheries production would be further weakened following the court ruling allowing commercial fishing vessels to operate within 15-kilometer municipal waters.

text: Ginpabaskog sang International Criminal Court Appeals Chamber ang nauna nga desisyon sang Pre-Trial Chamber 1 nga ipabilin sa prisuhan si former President Rodrigo Duterte kaangot sa kaso nga ginapangatubang sini nga crimes against humanity.
english: The International Criminal Court Appeals Chamber has upheld the earlier decision of Pre-Trial Chamber 1 to keep former President Rodrigo Duterte in jail in connection with the case he is facing for crimes against humanity.

text: Buot silingon sini, dalayon na nga ginbasura sang Appeals Chambers ang tanan nga argumento kag ang ground of appeals nga ginpasa sang mga abogado ni Duterte.
english: This means that the Appeals Chambers have immediately rejected all arguments and grounds of appeals filed by Duterte's lawyers.

text: Unanimous ang boto sang lima ka mga miyembro sang Appeals Chamber agud nga dalayon nga ibasura ang pangabay sang depensa batok sa desisyon sang Pre-Trial Chamber.
english: The five members of the Appeals Chamber voted unanimously to immediately dismiss the defense's request against the Pre-Trial Chamber's decision.

text: Sa ginpagwa nga pahayag, napaslawan ang depensa nga mapakita ukon matul-id kun may sala ang Pre-Trial Chamber sa pag-base sa Panel of Experts nga naghatag sang pinakabag-o nga update nahanungod sa kahimtangan sang ikaayong lawas ni Duterte.
english: In a statement, the defense failed to show or correct whether the Pre-Trial Chamber was wrong based on the Panel of Experts that provided the latest update on Duterte's health condition.

text: Ginkonsiderar man sang panel of experts ang duha ka report nahanungod sa kondisyon sang ikaayong lawas sang anay presidente nga gin-preparar sang mga medical practitioner nga ginpili sang defense team.
english: The panel of experts also considered two reports on the former president’s health condition prepared by medical practitioners selected by the defense team.

text: Nahibaluan nga humalin sang Marso 12, 2025, yara na sa detention facility sang ICC sa The Hague ang anay president.
english: It is known that as of March 12, 2025, the former president will be in the detention facility of the ICC in The Hague.

text: Sang Pebrero, ginpatigayon ang confirmation of charges hearing agud matumod kun ipasaka bala sang judges ang kaso sa para sa trial.
english: In February, a confirmation of charges hearing was held to determine whether the judges would file the case for trial.

text: Nagpalab-ot ang pagpakig-unong ang Original Pilipino Music (OPM) community kasunod sang kamatayon sang isa sa lead vocalists sang banda nga Jeremiah.
english: The Original Pilipino Music (OPM) community has extended its condolences following the death of one of the band's lead vocalists, Jeremiah.

text: Suno sa banda, nagtaliwan si Piwee Polintan kasunod sang stroke nga gin-suprer sini sang Oktubre 23.
english: According to the band, Piwee Polintan passed away following a stroke he suffered on October 23.

text:
Naghatag man sang tribute ang grupo paagi sa Facebook post nga nagalaragway kay Piwee bilang “exceptional artist whose voice and passion touched the hearts of many.”

“It is with profound sadness that we announce the passing of Mr. Piwee Polintan, beloved vocalist of the band Jeremiah,” pahayag pa sang OPM band.
english:
The group also paid tribute with a Facebook post describing Piwee as an “exceptional artist whose voice and passion touched the hearts of many.”

“It is with profound sadness that we announce the passing of Mr. Piwee Polintan, beloved vocalist of the band Jeremiah,” the OPM band said in a statement.

text: “Beyond his music, he was a cherished friend, a loving soul, and a brother to us all.
english: “Beyond his music, he was a cherished friend, a loving soul, and a brother to us all.

text: His legacy will live on through the songs and memories he shared with the world,” kabahin pa sang post sang grupo.
english: His legacy will live on through the songs and memories he shared with the world,” the group said in a post.

text: Ila man ginpasalamatan ang tanan nga nagpangamuyo, nagsuporta, kag nagpalangga kay Piwee ilabi na sang tion nga ginbudlayan ini sa iya nga kondisyon.
english: They also thanked everyone who prayed, supported, and loved Piwee especially during the difficult times with his condition.

text: “Please continue to keep his family and loved ones in your thoughts and prayers.
english: “Please continue to keep his family and loved ones in your thoughts and prayers.

text:
May his soul rest in eternal peace.”

Matandaan nga nagsuprer man anay si Piwee sang Stage 4 cancer sa tonsil sang 2007, apang nag-ayo ini paagi sa operasyon kag chemotherapy.
english:
May his soul rest in eternal peace.”

Piwee also suffered from Stage 4 tonsil cancer in 2007, but recovered from surgery and chemotherapy.

text: Sang 2011, gindeklarar siya nga cancer-free kag nagbalik ini sa pagkanta.
english: In 2011, she was declared cancer-free and returned to singing.

text: Una nga nabatian ang Jeremiah sang 1998 kag kilala sa mga kanta nga “Bakit Ka Iiyak?” “Nanghihinayang,” “Kahit Anong Mangyari,” “Basta’t Ikaw,” kag madamo nga iban pa.
english: Jeremiah was first heard in 1998 and is known for the songs “Why Are You Crying?” “Regretting,” “Whatever Happens,” “Just Be You,” and many others.

text: Ginkilala ang banda bilang winner sang Best Performance by a New Group sa 12th Awit Awards.
english: The band was recognized as the winner of Best Performance by a New Group at the 12th Awit Awards.

text: Nanindugan ang Malacañang nga wala pa nagapangatubang sang oil crisis ang Pilipinas.
english: Malacañang insists that the Philippines is not yet facing an oil crisis.

text: Ini sa tunga sang nagapadayon nga kinagamo sa Middle East nga nagresulta sa pagtaas sang presyo sang produktong petroylo.
english: This is amid the ongoing unrest in the Middle East that has resulted in a rise in the price of petroleum products.

text: Suno kay Palace Press Officer kag PCO Undersecretary Atty. Claire Castro, padayon ang paghulag sang gobyerno agud masiguro nga bastante ang suplay sang produktong petrolyo sa pungsod.
english: According to Palace Press Officer and PCO Undersecretary Atty. Claire Castro, the government continues to act to ensure sufficient supply of petroleum products in the country.

text: Pahayag ni Castro nga base sa pahayag ni DOE Secretary Sharon Garin, may yara sang negosasyon tuhoy sa 440,000 barrels sang fuel.
english: Castro said that based on the statement of DOE Secretary Sharon Garin, there are negotiations regarding 440,000 barrels of fuel.

text: Dugang niya, may yara man sang 600,000 barrels nga mahimo pa nga ma-import sa masunod.
english: He added that there are also 600,000 barrels that can be imported in the future.

text: Gin-athag man ni Castro nga ang pahayag ni Presidente Marcos tuhoy sa oil crisis ang nagapatuhoy sa Middle East.
english: Castro also clarified that President Marcos' statement on the oil crisis refers to the Middle East.

text: Ginainsister man sang Palace Press Office nga indi man mapaktan kun san-o makonsiderar nga may krisis gid man sa langis bangud padayon ang pagtinguha sang gobyerno agud masiguro ang bastante nga suplay.
english: The Palace Press Office also insists that it is impossible to predict when the oil crisis will be considered as the government is continuing its efforts to ensure sufficient supply.

text: Ini nga pahayag ni Castro ang sa tunga sang padayon nga pagtimbuok sang preso sang gatong sa Pilipinas.
english: Castro's statement comes amid the continuous increase in fuel prices in the Philippines.

text: Iga-deploy ang mga pulis sa mga pilgrimage sites sa probinsya sang Iloilo kun sa diin linibo ka mga tumuluo ang ginaantisipar nga magakadto kadungan sang Semana Santa.
english: Police will be deployed at pilgrimage sites in Iloilo province where thousands of believers are expected to attend during Easter.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lt.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Police Lt.

text: Colonel Rolando Araño, spokesperson sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO), iya ginpahayag nga magluwas sa mga personnel halin sa municipal police stations, may yara man sang iga-augment nga dugang nga pwersa halin sa mobile force companies.
english: Colonel Rolando Araño, spokesperson of the Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO), said that besides the personnel from the municipal police stations, there will also be additional forces from mobile force companies.

text: Lakip sa ginadugukan sa Holy Week kada tuig sa Iloilo amo ang Taltal sa Barotac Viejo kag ang Agony Hill sa Alimodian nga ginakadtuan naman para sa Stations of the Cross.
english: Among the places visited during Holy Week every year in Iloilo are Taltal in Barotac Viejo and Agony Hill in Alimodian which is also visited for the Stations of the Cross.

text: Suno pa kay Araño, may ipalapta man nga mga pulis sa mga lugar kun sa diin nagatingob ang madamo nga mga tawo kaangay sang mga pantalan, terminal, simbahan, kag iban pa.
english: According to Araño, police will also be deployed in places where many people gather such as ports, terminals, churches, and others.

text: May yara man sang ipadala nga mga covert kag police assistance desk personnel.
english: Coverts and police assistance desk personnel will also be sent.

text: Sa masunod nga inadlaw suno sa IPPO, natalana na nga ipadalom sa heightened alert status ang talatapan.
english: The next day, according to the IPPO, the office is scheduled to be placed under heightened alert status.

text: Ginpahanumdom man sa mga pumuluyo, ilabi na sa mga may plano nga magbiya anay sa ila nga mga balay, nga mag-doble halong gid ilabi na nga ginakuha sang mga kriminal ini nga oportunidad agud nga makapang-hingalit kag makapangawat.#
english: Residents, especially those who plan to leave their homes, are also reminded to be doubly vigilant especially as criminals take this opportunity to rob and steal.

text: Isa ka police academy sa Japan ang nagatudlo sa ila nga mga lalaki nga kadete nga mag-makeup.
english: A police academy in Japan is teaching their male cadets to wear makeup.

text: Kalakip na ang makeup training sa academy.
english: Including makeup training at the academy.

text: Ini amo ang Fukushimaken Keisatsugakko Police Academy sa Fukushima Prefecture nga nagapatuman sang pinasahi nga klase, kun sa diin ginatudluan ang 60 kadete kun paano maghimos sang kaugalingon gamit ang makeup kag husto nga­ grooming.
english: This is the Fukushimaken Keisatsugakko Police Academy in Fukushima Prefecture which implements a special class, where 60 cadets are taught how to groom themselves using makeup and proper grooming.

text: Suno sa akademya, kabahin ini sang pagtudlo sang importansya sang katinlo kag pagpabilin sang propesyonal nga imahe sa publiko.
english: According to the academy, this is part of teaching the importance of cleanliness and maintaining a professional image to the public.

text: Nakigbuylog ang akademya sa kilala nga Japanese­ cosmetics brand nga Shiseido, nga nagpadala sang ila nga mga beauty consultant para magtudlo sang insakto nga pag-moisturize sang panit, pagkay-o sang kilay kag buhok kag iban pa.
english: The academy partnered with well-known Japanese cosmetics brand Shiseido, which sent their beauty consultants to teach proper skin moisturizing, eyebrow and hair repair and more.

text: Magluwas sa Fukushima, ang Yamaguchi Police Academy ang nagahimo man sang amo nga programa kun sa diin ginatudluan ang mga pulis kun paano tinluan ang nawong.
english: Besides Fukushima, the Yamaguchi Police Academy is also conducting a similar program where police officers are taught how to clean their faces.

text: Nadala-pauli sang Philippine Team ang silver medal sa sporting clay team event, isa ka pioneering sport sa Southeast Asian Games 2025 sa Thailand.
english: The Philippine Team brought home the silver medal in the sporting clay team event, a pioneering sport at the Southeast Asian Games 2025 in Thailand.

text: Myembro sang team sanday Leyte 4th District Rep.
english: Team members are Leyte 4th District Rep.

text: Richard Gomez, Carlo Baltonado, kag Jed Rivilla.
english: Richard Gomez, Carlo Baltonado, and Jed Rivilla.

text: Nag-upod man sa Thailand si Ormoc City Mayor Lucy Torres-Gomez agud suportahan ang iya bana kag pareho nga mga Ormocanon.
english: Ormoc City Mayor Lucy Torres-Gomez also went to Thailand to support her husband and fellow Ormocanons.

text: Suno kay Gomez, ini nga sport ang rason kun ngaa nagbalik siya sa SEA Games masobra duha ka dekada matapos ang iya katapusan nga pag-compete.
english: According to Gomez, this sport is why she returned to the SEA Games more than two decades after she last competed.

text: Sang 1995, gintiglawas sini ang Pilipinas sa fencing sa SEA Games sa Chiang Mai.
english: In 1995, she represented the Philippines in fencing at the SEA Games in Chiang Mai.

text: Nagdaog siya sang silver medal sa 1997 edition sa Jakarta kag isa pa ka medalya sang 2001 edition sa Kuala Lumpur.
english: He won a silver medal in the 1997 edition in Jakarta and another medal in the 2001 edition in Kuala Lumpur.

text:
Sa sini nga biennial meet sa Thailand, nagapasakop man ang anak sang celebrity couple nga si Juliana nga kabahin sang fencing team.#

Photo: John Kevin Pilapil
english:
The celebrity couple's daughter Juliana, who is part of the fencing team, is also participating in the biennial meet in Thailand.

Photo: John Kevin Pilapil

text: Nagapati ang Association of Taxi Operators of Panay nga wala halos sang dako nga mabulig ang pagsuspende sang excise tax sa nagapadayun nga pagtaas sang presyo sang gatong.
english: The Association of Taxi Operators of Panay believes that the suspension of the excise tax will not do much to help the ongoing increase in fuel prices.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Perfecto Yap, Presidente sang nasambit nga asosasyon, iya ginpahayag nga makabulig man ang nasambit nga lihok sang gobyerno sa transport sectors, apang P6 lang ang mabuhin sa presyo sang gatong nga magapabilin sa gihapon sa mga produktong petrolyo sa balor nga masobra P100.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Perfecto Yap, president of the association, said the government's move will also help the transport sectors, but only P6 will be reduced in the price of fuel which will remain in petroleum products worth more than P1

text: Suno pa sa iya, wala gid nagasanto ang tikang nga ini agud nga mahagan-hagan ang krisis sa Pilipinas.
english: He said this move is not in line with the crisis in the Philippines.

text: Madumduman nga ginpirmahan na ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., ang layi nga nagapahanugot sa iya nga suspendihon ukon buhinan ang excise tax sa produktong petrolyo nga mangin epektibo matapos ang 15 ka adlaw matapos niya ini napirmahan.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has already signed a law allowing him to suspend or reduce the excise tax on petroleum products to be effective 15 days after he signed it.

text: Nagalaum sa gihapon ang mga church leaders sa Iloilo, nga masulit pa ang mga hublag-kontra korapsyon sa pungsod.
english: Church leaders in Iloilo still hope that the anti-corruption movements will be repeated in the country.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Rdayo kay Jaro Archdiocesan Social Action Center director nga si Msgr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Rdayo, Jaro Archdiocesan Social Action Center director Msgr.

text: Meliton Oso, iya ginpahayag nga magapadayon ang ila kawsa nga mapanabat ang mga politiko sa likod sang mga kurapsyon.
english: Meliton Oso, he said they will continue their cause to hold the politicians behind corruption accountable.

text: Ginalantaw man sini nga rason kun ngaa nagbuhin ang nagbuylog sa gintalikdan nga Trillion Peso March Rally kahapon nga adlaw, bangud sa mga importante man nga hilikuton sang pila ka mga organisasyon.
english: He also believes that the reason why the number of participants in the Trillion Peso March Rally yesterday decreased was due to the important activities of some organizations.

text: Dugang pa sini nga bangud sa ginhiwat nga Trillion Peso March Rally 2.0, mas nagdamo pa ang kawsa nga ginapakigbato sang tagsa ka hubon sa sosyudad kag indi lamang ang mga maanomalya nga mga flood control projects.
english: He added that due to the Trillion Peso March Rally 2.0, there are more causes that each group in society is fighting for and not just the anomalous flood control projects.

text: Ginapakigbato man sa karun sang nagkalain-lain nga hubon ang kawsa sang mga manugbaligya, mamumugon, hubon sang mga manugbulong, kawsa sa agrikultura kag kinamatarong sang mga pamatan-on.
english: Various groups are also fighting for the cause of traders, workers, doctors' groups, agricultural causes and youth rights.

text: Nagtaliwan na ang 80’s matinee idol nga si Patrick Dela Rosa.
english: 80’s matinee idol Patrick Dela Rosa has passed away.

text: Ginkumpirma ini sang iya pamilya kag sang Provincial Information Office sang Oriental Mindoro kun sa diin nagserbe siya anay bilang board member.
english: This was confirmed by his family and the Provincial Information Office of Oriental Mindoro where he previously served as a board member.

text: As of press time, wala pa ginsapubliko sang pamilya ang rason kag iban nga detalye sa kamatayon sang 64-anyos nga former actor.
english: As of press time, the family has not yet released the cause and other details of the death of the 64-year-old former actor.

text: Base sa post sang misis sini nga si Arnie Bella dela Rosa, napatay si Patrick sang Domingo sang hapon sa ospital sa California, USA.
english: According to the post of his wife, Arnie Bella dela Rosa, Patrick died on Sunday afternoon at a hospital in California, USA.

text: “It is with profound sadness that I announce the passing of my beloved husband, Patrick Dela Rosa, 64 years old, yesterday, October 26, 2025, at 5:25 PM at Adventist Hospital in Bakersfield, California.
english: “It is with profound sadness that I announce the passing of my beloved husband, Patrick Dela Rosa, 64 years old, yesterday, October 26, 2025, at 5:25 PM at Adventist Hospital in Bakersfield, California.

text: He will be remembered for his unwavering love, strength, and compassion.
english: He will be remembered for his unwavering love, strength, and compassion.

text: His memory will forever remain in our hearts,” pahayag sini.
english: His memory will forever remain in our hearts,” it said.

text:
“We ask for your prayers and understanding as our family grieves this great loss.”

Nagpaalam man kay Patrick ang iya utod nga si Dr. Marlon Gilbert Dela Rosa: “Rest in peace Patrick, no more pain ‘tol.
english:
“We ask for your prayers and understanding as our family grieves this great loss.”

Patrick was also bid farewell by his brother, Dr. Marlon Gilbert Dela Rosa: “Rest in peace Patrick, no more pain ‘tol.

text: You are not just a brother to me but also my bestfriend.
english: You are not just a brother to me but also my bestfriend.

text: Thank you for all the memories that we share together.
english: Thank you for all the memories that we share together.

text: You are always there during my ups and down.
english: You are always there during my ups and down.

text:
I LOVE U brother.”

Sa probinsya naman sang Oriental Mindoro, gindumdom si Patrick bilang isa ka maayo nga public servant.
english:
I LOVE U brother.”

In the province of Oriental Mindoro, Patrick was remembered as a good public servant.
