text: Kabahin sang ila Facebook post: “Taos-pusong nakikidalamhati ang Pamahalaang Panlalawigan sa pamilya ng namayapang si Former Board Member Patrick Dela Rosa.
english: Part of their Facebook post: “The Provincial Government extends its heartfelt condolences to the family of the late Former Board Member Patrick Dela Rosa.

text:
Maraming salamat sa iyong mga iniwang ala-ala hindi lamang sa industriya ng pag-aartista, kundi maging sa pagbibigay-serbisyo para sa mga Mindoreño.”

Sang Abril, nakasugid pa si Patrick nga nasadyahan gid ini sa iya simple nga pagpangabuhi bilang negosyante sa California matapos sini ginbayaan ang showbiz kag pulitika sa Pilipinas.
english:
Thank you very much for your legacy not only in the acting industry, but also in providing services to the Mindoreños.”

In April, Patrick said he was very happy with his simple life as a businessman in California after he left showbiz and politics in the Philippines.

text: Bantog si Patrick sang 1980s kag 1990s sa pagdala sang villain roles sa nagkalain-lain nga action movies.
english: Patrick was famous in the 1980s and 1990s for carrying villain roles in various action movies.

text: Lakip sa mga nagtatak nga papel sini amo ang sa mga pelikula nga Kristo, Suspek, Ping Lacson: Super Cop, Sisingilin ko ng Dugo, kag Ex-Con.#
english: Among his landmark roles are in the films Kristo, Suspek, Ping Lacson: Super Cop, Sisingilin ko ng Dugo, and Ex-Con.

text: Isa ka iloy ang hinali lang ng nagsininggitan sa ila puluy-an sang natukiban nga ang ginhampangan sang iya kabataan amo ang abo sang ila lolo.
english: A mother suddenly screamed in her home when she discovered that her children were playing with their grandfather's ashes.

text:
Didto ini natabo sa Colorado, U.S.A.

Gindumdom sang mga bata nga yab-ok lang ang unod sang suludlan sang abo sang ila lolo.
english:
It happened in Colorado, U.S.A.

The children remembered that their grandfather's ashes contained only dust.

text: Suno kay Monica Long, isa ka single mom sa tatlo ka mga anak nga lalaki, ginbayaan niya ang mga anak nga naga-edad 2 kag 3 sa banyo samtang naga­handa siya para sa kaadlawan sang iya agot nga bata.
english: Monica Long, a single mom to three boys, said she left the children, ages 2 and 3, in the bathroom while she prepared for her youngest son’s birthday.

text: Sa sulod sang apat ka minuto, nahimo sang duha nga maglapta sang kaangay sang “pu­ti nga yab-ok” sa ila nga lawas kag salog kag possible nga nakaon pa nila ini.
english: Within four minutes, the two managed to spread a “white dust” on their bodies and floor and possibly ate it.

text: Bangud masako sa pagpanglimpyo, gintinluan niya ini gamit ang vacuum.
english: Being busy cleaning, she cleaned it with a vacuum.

text: Pila ka adlaw pa ang nagligad sang natukiban niya nga wala na sang unod ang suludlan sang abo sang iya napatay nga amay.
english: It was a few days later when he discovered that his deceased father's ashes were empty.

text: Sa pihak sang natabo, wala man nangakig ang iloy kag naham-ot pa gani ini sa iya kabataan kag nagapati siya nga bisan ang iya amay ang naham-ot man sa ginhimo sang mga apo.
english: Despite what happened, the mother was not angry and was even angry with her children and she believes that even her father was angry with what the grandchildren did.

text: INDI tanan sa Kongreso kumpome sa pagpasar sang kasuguan para gamiton ang manggad sang pungsod (sovereign wealth) bilang state-owned investment, nga ginhingadlan sang Marcos Administration nga Maharlika Investment Fund (MIF).
english: NOT everyone in Congress is in favor of passing a law to use the country's sovereign wealth as a state-owned investment, which the Marcos Administration named the Maharlika Investment Fund (MIF).

text: Ginproponer ini sadtong Nobyembre 2022 ni Presidente Marcos Jr.
english: It was proposed in November 2022 by President Marcos Jr.

text: kag sang pitu (7) ka katapo sang House of Representatives nga nagalakip sang anak niya nga si Sandro Marcos kag sang iya pakaisa nga si Speaker Martin Romualdez.
english: and seven (7) members of the House of Representatives including his son Sandro Marcos and his cousin Speaker Martin Romualdez.

text: Gin-aprubahan ini sang daku nga mayoriya sa House of Rrepresentatives  kag sang Senado sa pagpanguna sang mga kaalyado sang Presidente bisan pa sa matigda nga pag-oponer sang political opposition, lakip sang pila ka kaalyado sang Presidente nga wala basta nagpadala sa grupo “without thinking” bilang COO (Civilian Opod Opod ) lang.
english: It was approved by a large majority in the House of Representatives and the Senate under the leadership of the President's allies despite strong opposition from the political opposition, including some of the President's allies who did not simply send the group “without thinking” as COO (Civilian Opod Opod).

text: Gintudlo sang mga naga-oponer ang daku nga posibilidad sang corruption sa paggamit sining MIF.
english: Opponents pointed to the high potential for corruption in the use of this MIF.

text: Gintudlo man nila ang peligro sa ekonomiya sa kabug-usan sang indi paggamit sang “surplus public  earnings” lang; kag paggamit, instead, sang mga kinitaan kag pondo sang gobyerno nga nagabutang sa risgo sang pila ka reserved funds agud indi magulpihan sa pag-us-us ang aton ekonomiya kon “worse comes to worst” sa paggamit sang MIF.
english: They also pointed to the risk to the economy as a whole of not using “surplus public  earnings” alone; and using, instead, government revenues and funds that put some reserved funds at risk so that our economy does not suddenly collapse when “worse comes to worst” with the use of the MIF.

text: Labi na gid tungod sang padayon karon nga mga kinagamo sa kalibutan nga nagabutang sa alang-alang sang ano man nga hulag pangnegosyo.
english: Especially because of the ongoing world unrest that puts any business movement at risk.

text: Sa matuod, wala gid man kita”surplus earnings” kundi “deficit spending” kag padayon nga pagpangutang.
english: In fact, we don't have surplus earnings but deficit spending and continuous borrowing.

text: Kag kon may masaligan kita nga mabawian, ang nagalumapaw gid lang nga pasalig sang mga “economic manipulators” ni PBBM sa milagro sang MIF.
english: And if there is anything we can rely on, it is the overwhelming assurance of the economic manipulators of PBBM in the miracle of the MIF.

text: Maayo pa gani seguro nga pasanyugon na gid lang naton ang pagsulod sang foreign investments nga makapatukod sang mga industriya kag negosyo nga makahatag trabaho sa aton mga pumuluyo kag makapasulod sang dolyar para sa aton currency reserves.
english: It would be better if we encouraged the inflow of foreign investments that can build industries and businesses that can provide jobs for our people and bring in dollars for our currency reserves.

text:
***

In fact, ang initial seed money naton nga P125 Billion sa MIF halin lang sa Philippine national government, Land Bank of the Philippines, kag sa Development Bank of the Philippines upod pa ang Central Bank.
english:
***

In fact, our initial seed money of P125 Billion in the MIF came only from the Philippine national government, Land Bank of the Philippines, and the Development Bank of the Philippines as well as the Central Bank.

text: Kag, kon pwede naton mapatihan, basi magamit man dira pati na ang “savings” sang GSIS, SSS kag PhilHealth.
english: And, if we can believe it, maybe the savings of GSIS, SSS and PhilHealth will also be used there.

text: Sunu ina kay Senador Bato sa iya pagpati nga pwede nila mahimo ini paggi sa mga “third parties”.
english: Senator Bato said he believes they can do this through third parties.

text: Huwag naman!
english: Don't!

text: Kaluluoy man ang mga pensioners sang GSIS kag SSS kag health benefiaries sang PhilHealth kon matabo nga madala pa sila sa disgrasya sang MIF.
english: Pity the pensioners of GSIS and SSS and health beneficiaries of PhilHealth if they happen to be involved in the accident of MIF.

text: Indi katulad ini sa kaso sang Norway sa Uropa nga naggamit sang ila “sovereign wealth” halin sa ila “export earnings surplus” sa ila madinalag-on nga offshore oil fields, kag sa Singapore tungod sang ila “growing foreign reserves”.
english: This is unlike the case of Norway in Europe which used its sovereign wealth from its export earnings surplus in its successful offshore oil fields, and Singapore because of its growing foreign reserves.

text:
***

Isa sang nagapamatok gid sa ining MIF amo ang utod mismo kag kaalyado ni Presidente nga si Senator Imee tungod daku ini nga tentasyon para sa korapsyon.
english:
***

One of the strongest opponents of this MIF is the President's own sister and ally Senator Imee because it is a great temptation for corruption.

text: Nga daan nagapabilin gihapon ang wala pagtahaw nga korapsyon sa aton gobyerno.
english: That there is still rampant corruption in our government.

text: In fact, sunu sa Transparency International (Ti) sa “scoring” sini sang level of corruption sang mga 180 ka pungsod sa kalibutan, dala kita sa mga pinaka-corrupt nga mga pungsod.
english: In fact, according to Transparency International (Ti) in its scoring of the level of corruption of about 180 countries in the world, we are among the most corrupt countries.

text: Sa paggamit sang scoring sang TI, ang score sang “highly corrupt” amo ang zero (O) samtang 100 kon “very clean”.
english: Using the scoring of TI, the score of “highly corrupt” is zero (O) while 100 if “very clean”.

text: Sadtong  2022 gintagaan sang TI ang Filipinas sang score nga 34 nga naglakip sini sa ika-116 nga ranggo halin sa ibabaw upod sa Algeria, Angola, El Salvador, Mongolia, Ukraine kag Zambia, nga nagapakita nga significante ang corruption sa sining mga pungsod.
english: In 2022, TI gave the Philippines a score of 34 which ranked it 116th from above along with Algeria, Angola, El Salvador, Mongolia, Ukraine and Zambia, indicating that corruption is significant in these countries.

text: Sa pagka-matuod, may mga kasuguan man kita nga nagapataw sing mabug-at nga penalidad batok sa corruption pero nada kay wala naman ini sing ngipon sa kamot sang aton mga tagpatuman.
english: In fact, we have laws that impose heavy penalties against corruption but no, it has no teeth in the hands of our enforcers.

text: Kon si Pedro pa gani ang pahambalon, paano abe sila manglagas sing tuod-tuod sa mga corrupt kay numero man sa pagka-corrupt ang madamo sa ila.
english: If Peter is asked to speak, how can they really pursue the corrupt because many of them are corrupt.

text:
Ang ila gani kuno hurubaton amo ang: “What are we in power for?”

***

Well, yara na ina nga kasuguan kag igapatuman na gid lang sang kon sin-o gintugyanan ni Presidente Marcos.
english:
Their saying is: “What are we in power for?”

***

Well, that law already exists and will be enforced by whoever President Marcos has entrusted.

text: Tani indi sila pareho sa Davao Group ni Duterte nga pati bakuna sa Covid-19 kag face mask himuan pa nila sang pangkurakot, samtang ang mga akusasyon batok sa ila daw wala lang sing mapadulungan kag daw madula na gid lang.
english: I hope they are not like Duterte's Davao Group who even use Covid-19 vaccines and face masks for corruption, while the accusations against them seem to have nowhere to go and seem to disappear.

text: Ang masiling ta lang sa subong seguro amo nga tani wala nagsala si PBBM sa iya gintugyanan sa paggamit sining MIF agud i-invest sing madinalag-on sa kon diin man nga mga  proyekto nga makitaan naton bisan sa interest lang.
english: All we can say for now is that PBBM should not have made a mistake in using this MIF to invest successfully in any projects that we see even on interest.

text: Kag indi lang agud makaganar sing dugang nga kita kundi agud indi man kita mangin kasosyo pa sa mga proyekto nga nagaguba sang environment sang aton kalibutan kag nagapasanyog pa sang Climate Change!/PN
english: And not only to earn more income but also so that we do not become partners in projects that destroy the environment of our world and promote Climate Change!/PN

text: Magapasilabot si United States President Donald Trump sa pagpili sang masunod nga lider sang Iran.
english: United States President Donald Trump will intervene in the selection of Iran's next leader.

text: Ini matapos nga napatay ang Supreme leader sang Iran nga si Ayatollah Ali Khamenei sa tunga sang pagpang-atake sang US kag Israel sa nasambit nga pungsod.
english: This comes after Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei was killed amid US and Israeli attacks on the country.

text: Ginpahayag pa sang Presidente nga maga-angkon ini sang dako nga impluwensya sa bag-o nga magapamuno sa Iran.
english: The President also said that he will have a great influence on the new leader of Iran.

text: Ginpaangid man sini ang natabo sa Venezuela matapos nga gindakop sang US ang Presidente sini nga si Nicolas Maduro kag gindala sa New York kag nangin dako man ang impluwensiya sang Estados Unidos sa pagpili sang bag-o nga lider.
english: He also compared what happened in Venezuela after the US arrested its President Nicolas Maduro and brought him to New York and the influence of the United States in choosing a new leader.

text: Wala naman ginabaton ni Trump ang posibilidad nga magabulos bilang Supreme Leader ang anak ni Khamenei nga si Mojtaba Khamenei.
english: Trump does not accept the possibility of Khamenei's son Mojtaba Khamenei succeeding him as Supreme Leader.

text: Suno pa kay Trump nga naga-uyang lang sa tyempo ang mga naga-atipan sa bata ni Khamenei.
english: Trump said those who take care of Khamenei's son are wasting their time.

text: Dugang pa sini nga wala sini ginakonsidera ang administrasyon ni Reza Pahlavi, anay anak sang Shah sang Iran nga suno pa sa iya mas maayo nga naghalin sa sulod sang Iran ang masunod nga magapamuno sa nasambit nga pungsod.
english: He added that he does not consider the administration of Reza Pahlavi, former son of the Shah of Iran, whom he said would preferably come from within Iran, to be the next leader of the country.

text: Arestado ang 194 ka mga indibidwal sa Qatar, matapos nga nagpalapta ang mga ini sang video clips kag sala nga mga impormasyon nahanungod sa sitwasyon kag nagakalatabo sa sulod sang nasambit nga pungsod bangud man sa nagapadayun nga gyera sa Middle East.
english: A total of 194 individuals were arrested in Qatar after they spread video clips and false information about the situation and what is happening inside the country due to the ongoing war in the Middle East.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Bombo Joseph Rivera, international correspondent sa Qatar, iya ginpahayag nga wala pa sang kumpirmasyon kun may ara sang mga Pilipino sa nasambit nga mga naaresto.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Bombo Joseph Rivera, international correspondent in Qatar, said there is no confirmation if there are any Filipinos among the arrested.

text: Ang pag-aresto amo ang ginpatigayon sang Economic and Cyber Crimes Combating Department sa idalom sang General Directorate of Criminal Investigation.
english: The arrest was conducted by the Economic and Cyber ​​Crimes Combating Department under the General Directorate of Criminal Investigation.

text: Suno kay Rivera, liwat-liwat nga nagapahanumdom ang Qatari Authorities nga likawan gid ang paglapta sang mga indi pa kumpirmado nga detalye sa tunga sang tension.
english: Rivera said the Qatari authorities have repeatedly reminded the public to avoid spreading unconfirmed details amid tensions.

text: Dugang pa niya bilang isa ka lider sang Filipino community sa Qatar, nagpahanumdom ini sa mga Pinoy ilabi na sa mga content creators nga likawan ang pagpost sang mga sensitibo nga mga video.
english: He added that as a leader of the Filipino community in Qatar, he reminded Filipinos especially content creators to avoid posting sensitive videos.

text: Isa ka indi ordinaryo nga medical case ang nagkibot sa mga doktor sa Western France matapos mag-angkon sang lain nga accent ang isa ka babaye nga residente sa lugar bisan pa nga indi man ini makahibalo maghambal sa Ingles!
english: An unusual medical case has shocked doctors in Western France after a female resident of the area acquired a different accent despite not being able to speak English either!

text: Ini amo si Laetitia, 47, cashier sa Montval-sur-Loir.
english: This is Laetitia, 47, cashier in Montval-sur-Loir.

text: Siya ang gulpi lang nakahambal nga kaangay sang isa ka Briton humalin sang gin-operahan ini sang 2010 agud kakson ang iya nga tonsils.
english: He has suddenly spoken like a Briton since he underwent surgery in 2010 to remove his tonsils.

text: Apisar wala man siya sang madalom nga ihibalo sa lenggwahe nga Ingles, kaangay nga natural sa iya nga dila ang British accent kag siya mismo ang nakibot.
english: Although he did not have a deep knowledge of the English language, the British accent seemed natural on his tongue and he was surprised.

text: Matapos ang serye sang pag-check sa iya, na-diagnose si Laetitia nga may Foreign Accent Syndrome, isa ka rare condition nga mahimo nga idulot sang aksidente, stroke, ukon operasyon.
english: After a series of tests, Laetitia was diagnosed with Foreign Accent Syndrome, a rare condition that can be caused by an accident, stroke, or surgery.

text: Sa pihak sang panibag-o nga estilo sang iya paghambal, natun-an na ni Laetitia nga batunon ini.
english: Despite her new style of speech, Laetitia has learned to accept it.

text: Ginpunto sang hubon sang manugbulong sa ginpatigayun nga Trillion Peso March Rally subong nga adlaw sa bahin sang Iloilo Capitol ground ang mga korapsyon nga nagakatabo sa nagkalain-lain nga distrito sang Iloilo.
english: The group of doctors at the Trillion Peso March Rally held today at the Iloilo Capitol ground pointed out the corruption that is happening in various districts of Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Cynthia Cabangal-Ng, Former Hospital Management Head sang Iloilo, iya ginplastar ang pila ka mga proyekto sang Department of Public Works and Highways sa Iloilo City, amo man sa probinsya sang Iloilo nga ginpangbuhinan ang pondo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Cynthia Cabangal-Ng, Former Hospital Management Head of Iloilo, she laid out some of the projects of the Department of Public Works and Highways in Iloilo City, as well as in the province of Iloilo that the funds have been reduced.

text: Ginpakigbahin man sini ang pila ka mga data sang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) ilabi na sa first district sang Iloilo nga may pinakadako nga ghost projects.
english: He also shared some data of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) especially in the first district of Iloilo which has the largest ghost projects.

text: Luyag karun sang grupo nga mapanabat ang tanan nga naulamid sa korapsyon sa pungsod.
english: The group now wants to hold accountable all those involved in corruption in the country.

text: SOMETIMES kinahanglan mo man awayon ang kaaway paagi sa iya mismo armas agud lutoson ini.
english: SOMETIMES you also have to fight the enemy with its very weapon to defeat it.

text: In  other words, kon indi mo na siya madaug kag malutos ka pa gani gamit ang tinapay, justified na nga balion mo na ang iya sungay paagi sa iya mismo hanganiban agud magdaug sa away sang Good versus Evil, indi bala?
english: In other words, if you can't beat him and even defeat him with bread, it's justified to break his horn with his own weapon to win the battle of Good versus Evil, right?

text:
***

Sa subong nga edisyon sang aton kolum, ginapaabot naton sa sining bag-o nga tuig 2024 ang mga hitabo nga posible matabo.
english:
***

In the current edition of our column, we look forward in this new year 2024 to the events that are likely to take place.

text: Una gid dira amo ang kon ano ang matabo sa aton padayon nga conflicto  sa China sa isyu sang aton sovereignty sa 200-nautical mile nga Exclusive Economic Zone sa West Philippine Sea (South China Sea sa pagkilala sang China).
english: First of all, what will happen to our ongoing conflict with China on the issue of our sovereignty over the 200-nautical mile Exclusive Economic Zone in the West Philippine Sea (South China Sea in China's recognition).

text: Gintalana ining EEZ sa aton sang UN Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) kag gindaug pa gid sa International Tribune sadtong 2016.
english: This EEZ is designated to us by the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) and was further won in the International Tribune in 2016.

text: Ugaling kay gina-claim gihapon sang China nga lakip pa ini sa ila teritoryo, nothwithstanding nga gin-deklarar na nga illegal sang International Tribune ining claim sini sa pagpanag-iya sa sining bahin sang South China Sea.
english: However, since China still claims that it is still part of its territory, nothwithstanding that the International Tribune has declared its claim to ownership of this part of the South China Sea illegal.

text: Gani ginapaabot naton sa sini nga tuig nga indi gid kita pagtantanan gihapon sang China sa iya kabuangan kag pagka-malugoson.
english: So we expect this year that China will never again threaten us with its stupidity and aggression.

text: Kag, tungod sini, mangin mas tensyonado pa ang sitwasyon sa sining conflicto naton sa China sa aton EEZ.
english: And, because of this, the situation in this conflict with China in our EEZ will become even more tense.

text: Apang kay ang tanan nga kinamatarong parti sa ining conflicto batok sa China sa subong sobra-sobra pa gani nga pabor gid sa aton – sa desisyon sang International Tribune kag ang madugay na nga pagpuyo sang mga Filipino sa mga isla mismo sa aton EEZ, katulad sang Pag-asa Island nga madugay na nga kabahin sang probinsya sang Palawan –  ginapaabot man naton ang indi malingkang nga panindugan sang Filipinas nga depensahan ining kinamatarong naton sa EEZ sang bisan aton kabuhi pa kon kinahanglan.
english: But since all the rights regarding this conflict against China are now overwhelmingly in our favor – with the decision of the International Tribune and the long-standing residence of Filipinos on the islands themselves in our EEZ, such as Pag-asa Island which has long been part of the province of Palawan – we also expect the Philippines to defend this right. in the EEZ of even our lives if necessary.

text:
***

Kon isipon gid, nagsawsaw lang ang China dira sa West Philippine Sea kon diin nagaluntad ining EEZ naton kag ginpwersa lang sini ang pag-okupar sang pila ka isla dira, kon diin ang pila ka kabatuhan ginpatindugan pa sini sang mga artificial islands.
english:
***

In fact, China has just dipped into the West Philippine Sea where our EEZ exists and has forcibly occupied some of the islands there, where some of the rocks have been built by artificial islands.

text: Malugos kag indi dapat respetohon ang China tungod sini kag dapat gid naton upangan sing tuod-tuod ang ining pang-bully sang China.
english: China is violent and disrespectful because of this and we must really stop this Chinese bullying.

text: Lakip na sang iban nga myembro sang Southeast Asian Treaty Organization (SEATO), labi na gid ang mga may claim man sa South China Sea nga naisgan lang i-bully sang China.
english: Including other members of the Southeast Asian Treaty Organization (SEATO), especially those with claims to the South China Sea that China has dared to bully.

text: Pero, indi man seguro pang-girit-girit para sa gyera kon himuon ta man ang ginahimo sang China sa pag-bully sa aton paagi sa ginahimo na sini batok sa aton kay indi man kuno “act of war” ang ila ginahimo nga indi kinahanglan sabton man sang “act of war” naton kag sang United States kon diin kita may Mutual Defense Treaty.
english: However, it's probably not a stir for war if we do what China is doing to bully us by what it's doing against us because it's not an act of war that doesn't have to be answered by an act of war between us and the United States where we have a Mutual Defense Treaty.

text: Katulad abe sang perwisyo nga ginahimo sa aton mga mangingisda dira sa aton EEZ gamit ang ila madamo nga militia nga kuno nagapangisda man, paggamit sang ila coastguard kay indi ini kuno gamit pang-gyera, ang pagbomba sang tubig sa naga-misyon naton nga mga salakyan nga nagadala sang ayuda kon diin kinahanglan ang ayuda, kag ang pagtukod sang artificial islands mismo sa aton EEZ.
english: Such as the damage done to our fishermen in our EEZ using their many militias who are supposedly fishing, using their coastguard because it is not used for war, pumping water into our mission vehicles that bring aid where aid is needed, and building artificial islands in our EEZ.

text: In other words, kon ini tanan nga ginahimo sang China indi man gali “act of war”, pwede ta man gali mahimo ini nga indi kita maakusaran nila nga nagapatigayon sang “act of war”.
english: In other words, if all this that China is doing is not an act of war, we can do it without being accused of committing an act of war.

text: So, ga-expect kita nga pwede himuon man ini sang Filipinas sa tuig 2024 agud ipakilala sa China nga aton ang EEZ kag indi sang China sa ano man nga rason legal kag moral.
english: So, we expect that the Philippines can do the same in 2024 to introduce to China that the EEZ is ours and not China's for whatever legal and moral reasons.

text: Katulad sang pagpatrolya na sang aton coastguard sa aton EEZ nga makabalos man bomba sang tubig sa mga salakyan sang China kon bombahan man kita sang tubig.
english: Like our coastguard patrolling our EEZ that can retaliate with water pumps on Chinese vehicles if we are pumped with water.

text: Tutal indi man gali “act of war” ini.
english: After all, this is not an act of war.

text: Meantime, padayon lang ang aton hilikuton agud makapangingibabaw sa China nga indi kinahanglan ang “act of war” kay basi magapadulong pa ini sa nuclear war sa pag-entra na sang US tungod sang aton MDT.
english: Meantime, we will continue our work to dominate China without the need for an act of war because it might lead to nuclear war with the US's involvement because of our MDT.

text: Sige lang gihapon ang aton hilikuton diplomasya, ang indi na pagsalig sa China sang pila naton nga kinahanglanon kag didto na sa aton mga kaalyado kuhaon ini, kag pagsaylo sang aton investment opportunities didto man sa aton mga kaayado./PN
english: We are still working on diplomacy, not relying on China for some of our needs and getting them from our allies, and transferring our investment opportunities to our friends./PN

text: Ginakabig sang pila ka mga public health expert nga isa ka tumalagson nga balatian ang Maple syrup urine disease (MSUD).
english: Some public health experts consider Maple syrup urine disease (MSUD) to be a rare disease.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Uzanne Marie Carmona-Barrera, Head sang Newborn Screening Long Term Continuity Clinic sang West Visayas State University – Medical Center, iya ginpahayag nga ang MSUD isa ka talagsahon apang seryoso nga metabolicc nga balatian nga mahimo makatalagam sa kabuhi kon indi ini maatipan sang temprano.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Uzanne Marie Carmona-Barrera, Head of the Newborn Screening Long Term Continuity Clinic of West Visayas State University – Medical Center, she disclosed that MSUD is a rare but serious metabolicc disease that can be life-threatening if not treated early.

text: Suno kay Carmona-Barrera ang confirmatory testing pagkatapos sang positibo nga resulta sang newborn screening ang importante agud matumod kon ang isa ka lapsag ang may yara sang Maple syrup urine disease.
english: Carmona-Barrera said confirmatory testing after a positive newborn screening result is important to determine if a baby has maple syrup urine disease.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga ang long-term management sang MSUD nagalakip sang estrikto nga pagkontrol sa pagkaon, regular monitoring, kag paghanda para sa mga metabolic crises.
english: She also explained that long-term management of MSUD involves strict dietary control, regular monitoring, and preparation for metabolic crises.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang temprano nga detection paagi sa newborn screening ang magahatag sang immediate intervention, nga nagapauswag sang prognosis para sa mga apektado nga kabataan.
english: It is known that early detection through newborn screening will provide immediate intervention, improving the prognosis for affected children.

text: Iga-patuman sa subong nga semana ang panibag-o nga oil price hike sa presyo sang produktong petrolyo.
english: The new oil price hike will be implemented this week.

text: Yari ang panibag-o nga price adjustment nga epektibo bwas nga adlaw sang Martes, Pebrero 10.
english: Here is the new price adjustment effective tomorrow Tuesday, February 10.

text:
Gasoline- magasaka sang P0.60 per literDiesel- magasaka sang P1.00 per literKerosene- magasaka sang P0.60 per liter

Suno sa Department of Energy-Oil Industry Management Bureau (DOE-OIMB) ini nga mixed fuel price movements ang apektado bangud sa de-escalation signals sa tunga sang United States kag Iran.
english:
Gasoline- to rise by P0.60 per literDiesel- to rise by P1.00 per literKerosene- to rise by P0.60 per liter

According to the Department of Energy-Oil Industry Management Bureau (DOE-OIMB) these mixed fuel price movements are affected due to de-escalation signals between the United States and Iran.

text: UNAHON ta anay ang aton panamyaw nga: A HAPPY AND BLESSED NEW YEAR TO ONE AND ALL!
english: Let's start with our greeting: A HAPPY AND BLESSED NEW YEAR TO ONE AND ALL!

text:
***

Tarso gid ining abyan naton nga si Pedro.
english:
***

This friend of ours Peter is a Tarsus.

text: Gapamangkot siya kon ano gid ang pinaka-seksi nga parti sang babaye.
english: He asks what the sexiest part of a woman is.

text: Katigulang na sini ni Pedro pero kon ano pa ang iya ginapang-usyosohan.
english: Pedro was old but what else was he curious about.

text:
“Ti, ngaa amo gid ina ang imo gina-intresan?” pamangkot naton, “Daw indi ka naman pwede kay pareho na kamo nga laos ni Misis?”

“Basta lang,” pilit niya nga sabat nga ang rason indi naton matungkad.
english:
“Well, why are you so interested in that?” we ask, “You can't because you're both old with your wife?”

“It's just that,” he replied forcefully, for reasons beyond our comprehension.

text: Okey, kundi pasugtan.
english: Okay, could agree.

text: Siling ko sa iya nga indi kinahanglan nga ang babaye medyo maniwang kag nagahabyog ang balikawang, ukon tambok nga nami pisil-pisilon ang maunod nga pisngi, ukon naka-bikini kon diin madamo dira sa beach nga ginabandera pa nila ang malaw-ay nila nga forma.
english: I told him that a woman doesn't have to be a little thin and with a waist, or fat enough to squeeze her fleshy cheeks, or wearing a bikini where there are many on the beach who still flag their ugly shape.

text: Kon parti naman sa hublas nga lawas sang babaye, indi man ina makahatag malisya sa nars kag doctor kag sa mga painting artists kag enthusiasts nga luyag lang mag-admirar sang matahum nga lawas sang babaye nga indi kinahanglan malisyahan.
english: As for the naked body of a woman, it does not give malice to nurses and doctors and painting artists and enthusiasts who just want to admire the beautiful body of a woman without being malicious.

text: Ga-click na sa akon ang gapangagda nga bibig (katulad sang iya ni former French actress kag animal rights activist Brigitte Bardot) kag gayuhom nga mga mata sang leading lady sa Jack & Jill sitcom sa TV 5.
english: The inviting lips (similar to those of former French actress and animal rights activist Brigitte Bardot) and smiling eyes of the leading lady in the Jack & Jill sitcom on TV 5 are already clicking to me.

text: In fact, aware sini ang mga babaye kon ngaa kon ano na lang ang ginahimo nila sa ila mga mata, labi na gid ang pagpabayod sang ila mga amimilok agud ma-attract ka sa ila mga mata.
english: In fact, women are aware of this why they do whatever they do with their eyes, especially the widening of their eyebrows to attract you to their eyes.

text: Of course, para sa akon, mas importante gid nga mapalanggaon siya nga ang bisan gamay lang nga pagpakita sang pag-angga gapukaw na sang imo balatyagon, labi na gid sa inyo paghanda sa pagtulog, he-he-he!
english: Of course, for me, it's more important to love him that even the slightest show of affection can awaken your feelings, especially when you're getting ready to go to bed, he-he-he!

text: Hinali lang nagsaligbat si Pedro.
english: Peter suddenly interrupted.

text: “Kumporme ako sa imo nga ang pinaka-seksi nga parti sang babaye amo gid ang mata,” siling niya.
english: “I agree with you that the sexiest part of a woman is definitely the eyes,” he said.

text: Nadumduman ko dayon si Frat Sis Sanchez nga converted Muslim, nga ang  kadalagahan sa pila ka pungsod Muslim may tabon ang nawong nga mata lang ang nagagwa sa publiko tubtub indi pa makapamana.
english: I immediately remembered Frat Sis Sanchez who was a converted Muslim, that girls in some Muslim countries wear face coverings and only their eyes go out in public until they get married.

text:
***

Kabahin na naton ang traditional jeepney sa madugay na nga panahon, kag daku ang naamot sini sa aton kasaysayan.
english:
***

The traditional jeepney has been a part of us for a long time, and it has contributed a lot to our history.

text: Na-remodel ini halin sa army vehicles nga ginbilin sang US forces pagkatapos sang WW2 sadtong 1945.
english: It was remodeled from army vehicles left behind by US forces after WW2 in 1945.

text: Showcase ini sang Filipino ingenuity kag resourcefulness, nga gina-patronize sang low- to middle-income nga mga pasahero, nga tungod sini dapat ipabugal naton.
english: It is a showcase of Filipino ingenuity and resourcefulness, patronized by low- to middle-income passengers, for which we should be proud.

text: Kag i-preserve katulad sang mga heritage home sang mga manggaran nga nagapakita sang arckitektura sang nagliligad, nga ginapilit naton i-reenforce agud mapabilin sa panghuna-huna sang mga ulhing tubo.
english: And preserve like the heritage homes of the rich that show the architecture of the past, which we insist on reinforcing to remain in the minds of the next generation.

text: Indi kay basta i-phaseout na lang ining salakyan sa pag-abot sang Disyembre 31, 2023!
english: Not that this car will simply be phased out by December 31, 2023!

text: Madugay nga mapuslanon ini sa mga kubos sa bentaha sini.
english: It will long be useful to the less fortunate in its advantage.

text: Gamay ini ikumparar sa mga mini-bus nga amat-amat nagadalagan na sa madamo nga dalanon diri sa pungsod.
english: This is small compared to the mini-buses that are slowly running on many roads in the country.

text: Tungod gamay ini madale mapuno kag mas madale maghalin agud dalhon ang mga pasahero sa mas madasig man nga pag-abot sa ila kaladtuan.
english: Because it is small, it can easily fill up and leave more quickly to take passengers to their destination faster.

text: Ikumparar ini sa gina-proponer nga modernized nga jeepney nga ang hitsura daw sa traditional jeepney, ugaling kay mas daku ini.
english: Compare this to the proposed modernized jeepney which looks like a traditional jeepney, but is larger.

text: kag may dugang nga upgraded features katulad sang mas mataas nga atop agud maka-akomodar sang dugang nga pasahero nga pwede makatindug sa tunga.
english: and has additional upgraded features such as a higher roof to accommodate more passengers who can stand in the middle.

text: May environment-friendly man nga Euro-5 engine.
english: There is also an environment-friendly Euro-5 engine.

text: Ang iban pwede ma-convert sa e-jeepney nga ginapadalagan sang kuryente kag wala nagabuga sang makahililo nga greenhouse gas (GHG) nga nagatuga sang Global Warming nga nagadala sang mas mabaskug nga mga bagyo kag kainiton nga sobra sa indi kinaandan.
english: Some can be converted into e-jeepneys that are powered by electricity and do not emit toxic greenhouse gases (GHG) that cause Global Warming that brings stronger storms and heat that is more than normal.

text: Ang reklamo – labi na gid sang myembro sang PISTON kag MANIBELA nga nag-tigil pasada gid – amo ang sobra ka mahal sang pagpatukod sini nga nagadangat sa  P1.5M tubtub P2M, samtang pwede naman baklon ukon utangon ang bagay nga makina nga Euro 4 nga sadto gina-rekomendar sang LTFRB sa mga traditonal jeepney nga okey pa man ang kaha (body).
english: The complaint – especially from the members of PISTON and MANIBELA who stopped to pass – is the excessive cost of construction, which amounts to P1.5M to P2M, while the Euro 4 engine that the LTFRB used to recommend for traditional jeepneys can be bought or borrowed.

text: Ang ginabulig nga subsidy sang gobyerno sa modernized jeepney amo lang ang P160,000 nga kulang kaayo kay sobra sa mga PhP1M pa ang balayran sang mga jeepney owners nga madamo dira mga kubos.
english: The government's subsidy for modernized jeepneys is only P160,000 which is too little because the jeepney owners, many of whom are poor, pay more than PhP1M.

text: Ano abe kon ihatag man ining subsidy sa mga tag-iya sang traditional jeepney nga maayo pa naman ang kaha kag makina lang dapat islan?
english: What if this subsidy is also given to the owners of traditional jeepneys that are still in good condition and only need to be replaced with engines?

text: Seguro naton nga kaya nila bayaran ini sing utay-utay sa husto nga kalawigon nga ila masarangan.
english: We're sure they can pay it off in installments for as long as they can afford it.

text: Kon mapasugtan ini, matagaan naton ang kadam-an nga pasahero sing mas manubo nga pamasahe kag mas madasig nga byahe sa ining traditional jeepney, nga dapat ta man dumdumon katulad sang mga heritage home sang mga manggaran./PN
english: If this is approved, we will be able to provide the majority of passengers with lower fares and faster trips on this traditional jeepney, which we should also remember as the heritage homes of the rich./PN

text: Wala gihapon sang medalya ang Team Philippines sa patag sang weightlifting sa 33rd Southeast Asian (SEA) Games sa Thailand.
english: Team Philippines is still without a medal in weightlifting at the 33rd Southeast Asian (SEA) Games in Thailand.

text: Ini matapos nagpang-apat ang labing-una nga Olympic gold medalist sang pungsod nga si Hidilyn Diaz sa iya nga division nga women’s 58kg weightlifting event.
english: This comes after the country's first Olympic gold medalist Hidilyn Diaz finished fourth in her division's women's 58kg weightlifting event.

text: Nag-rehistro ang Tokyo Olympic champion sang 90kg lift sa snatch apang sa clean and jerk, na-clear sini ang 110kg antes napaslawan nga mahakwat ang 115kg kag 116kg.
english: The Tokyo Olympic champion registered a 90kg lift in the snatch but in the clean and jerk, she cleared 110kg before failing to lift 115kg and 116kg.

text: Nanguna si Natasha Beteyob sang Indonesia (98kg snatch), kag ginsundan nanday Yodsarn Suratwadee sang Thailand (96kg), kag Thi Tam Quang sang Vietnam (96kg) sa clean and jerk.
english: Indonesia’s Natasha Beteyob (98kg snatch) led the way, followed by Thailand’s Yodsarn Suratwadee (96kg), and Vietnam’s Thi Tam Quang (96kg) in the clean and jerk.

text: Nagtapos si Diaz nga 4th overall nga may total nga 200kg.
english: Diaz finished 4th overall with a total of 200kg.

text: Una na nga nagpahayag ang Olympian nga mabudlayan siya nga makuha ang gold medal bangud indi na pareho sang una ang iya preparasyon bilang atleta subong.
english: Earlier, the Olympian said that it will be difficult for him to win the gold medal because he is not as prepared as an athlete now.

text: Magluwas sa iya sport, masako man ang 34-anyos nga weightlifter sa iban nga mga aktibidad kaangay ang fundamental culinary course.
english: Aside from his sport, the 34-year-old weightlifter is also busy with other activities such as the fundamental culinary course.

text: Sang 2023 SEA Games sa Cambodia, wala naka-compete si Diaz bangud mas ginpili sini ang Asian Championships.#
english: At the 2023 SEA Games in Cambodia, Diaz was unable to compete as she preferred the Asian Championships.#

text: Ginsapubliko na sang singer nga si Katy Perry kag anay Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau ang ila relasyon.
english: Singer Katy Perry and former Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau have made their relationship public.

text: Ini matapos nga makita ang duha nga naga-holding hands sang sila ang naga-date sa Paris, France sa pagselebrar sang 41 ka kaadlawan sang singer.
english: This comes after the two were spotted holding hands when they were on a date in Paris, France to celebrate the singer's 41st birthday.

text: Sang nagligad nga bulan, madamo ang nagguwa nga mga huring-huring tuhoy sa ila relasyon matapos nga madamo na ka beses sila nakita nga magkaupod.
english: Last month, many rumors surfaced about their relationship after they were spotted together many times.

text: Nakita man sila nga nagakup-anay samtang yara sa isa ka yate sa baybayon sang California.
english: They were also spotted cuddling while on a yacht off the coast of California.

text: Makapila man ka beses Nakita ang anay Prime Minister nga nagatambong sa concert sang singer.
english: The former Prime Minister was also seen attending the singer's concert several times.

text: Nakibot ang masobra sa 25,000 residente sang banwa sang Lice sa Diyarbakir pro­vince sa Turkey matapos ginsunog sang mga otoridad ang masobra sa 20 ka tonelada nga nakum­piskar nga marijuana.
english: More than 25,000 residents of the town of Lice in Turkey's Diyarbakir province were shocked after authorities burned more than 20 tons of confiscated marijuana.

text: Bangud sa madamol nga aso, wala nakabukas sang bintana ang mga tawo kag wala man nakagwa sa sulod sang lima ka adlaw.
english: Because of the thick smoke, people could not open their windows or go outside for five days.

text: Madamo ang nakaeksperyensiya sang paglingin sang ulo, pagsuka, hallucination kag iban pa nga mga sintomas bangud sa nahaklo nga aso.
english: Many have experienced dizziness, vomiting, hallucinations and other symptoms due to the inhaled smoke.

text: Suno sa isa ka grupo, apisar madinalag-on ang kampanya batok sa droga, sala ang nangin pamaagi sang pagsunog.
english: According to one group, despite the success of the anti-drug campaign, the burning method was wrong.

text: Ginsuhestyon sang grupo nga sa mas safe nga lugar kag may yara sang filter patigayunon ang kaangay nga operasyon agud malikawan ang epekto sa ikaayong lawas sang mga residente.
english: The group suggested that such operations be conducted in a safer area with a filter to avoid the impact on the health of the residents.

text: Nagabakho ang mga construction worker sa pungsod sa nangin epekto sang flood control scandal sa sektor sang konstruksyon partikular na sa trabaho sang small-time laborers.
english: Construction workers in the country are lamenting the impact of the flood control scandal on the construction sector particularly on the work of small-time laborers.

text: Lakip sa mga kabudlayan nga ginplastar amo ang pagpangita sang trabaho bangud nangin limitado na lamang ini subong sa pribado nga sektor.
english: Among the difficulties raised was finding a job as it has now become limited to the private sector.

text: Suno sa National Union of Building and Construction Workers, nag-partner na sila sa Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) kag sa Technical Education And Skills Development Authority (TESDA) agud nga mabuligan ang ila nga sector nga makatuon sang dugang nga skills kaangay sang welding, scaffolding, kag safety officers’ training bisan sang limitado nga budget.
english: According to the National Union of Building and Construction Workers, they have already partnered with the Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) and the Technical Education and Skills Development Authority (TESDA) to help their sector learn additional skills such as welding, scaffolding, and safety officers’ training despite the limited budget.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang rekord sang Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) nga ang construction industry amo ang may pinakadaku nga pagnubo sa employment sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: Earlier, Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) records showed that the construction industry had the biggest decline in employment last year.

text: Nagnubo ang numero sang workers sa 4.80 million sang December 2025 halin sa 5.35 million sang December 2024 ukon buot silingon may yara sang 550,000 job losses.
english: The number of workers fell to 4.80 million in December 2025 from 5.35 million in December 2024 or 550,000 job losses.

text:
Gina-angot ini sang PSA sa natabo nga eskandalo sang 2025 nga naangot sa flood control corruption.#

Photo: JOHN RYAN BALDEMOR
english:
The PSA links this to the 2025 scandal involving flood control corruption.

Photo: JOHN RYAN BALDEMOR

text: Balik byahe ang 100% unit sang Western Visayas Transport Cooperative subong nga adlaw, matapos nga 50% lamang sang ila units ang nagbyahe kahapon, Marso 25.
english: 100% of the units of the Western Visayas Transport Cooperative resumed operations today, after only 50% of their units operated yesterday, March 25.

text: Ini amo ang ila ginpatigayon matapos nga naobserbaran nga madamo ang mga pasahero subong nga adlaw bangud sa pila ka mga aktibidad sa siudad kaangay sang graduation kag transport strike.
english: This is after observing that there are many passengers today due to some activities in the city such as graduation and transport strike.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Raymundo Boyet Parcon, Chairman sang WVTC, iya ginpahayag nga ginalikawan nila nga magbyahe ang tanan nila nga units bangud dako na gid ang kaperdehan sang ila nga kooperatiba nga naglab-ot na sa P100,000 kada adlaw.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Raymundo Boyet Parcon, Chairman of the WVTC, said they are avoiding traveling with all their units because their cooperative is suffering huge losses of P100,000 per day.

text: Suno sa iya, dako gid ang epekto sang padayun nga pagtaas sang presyo sang gatong bangud halin sa P2,500 tubtob P2,700 nga gasto para sa krudo antes ang tension sa Middle East, yara na subong sa masobra P4,000 ang ila nga ginagasto para sa 40 ka litro nga diesel.
english: He said the impact of the continuous increase in fuel prices is huge because from P2,500 to P2,700 for crude oil before the tension in the Middle East, they now spend more than P4,000 for 40 liters of diesel.

text: Dugang pa sang natungdan, nagahulat sa gihapon sila sang igahatag nga fuel subsidy sang gobyerno, apang padayun man nga nagapati nga ang pagpatuman sang fare hike ang isa sa mangin solusyon agud nga indi man matam-an ang transport sector bangud sa krisis nga ginapangatubang sang pungsod sa produktong petrolyo.
english: He added that they are still waiting for the government's fuel subsidy, but still believe that the implementation of the fare hike is one of the solutions so that the transport sector will not be overwhelmed by the crisis facing the country in petroleum products.

text: Gin-report sang World Health Organization (WHO) nga na-verify na sini nga may 13 ka separado nga mga pagpang-atake ang Estados Unidos kag Israel sa mga health infrastructure sa Iran.
english: The World Health Organization (WHO) reported that it has verified that there have been 13 separate attacks by the United States and Israel on health infrastructure in Iran.

text: Magluwas sini, gina-check sini ang reports nga may apat ka medics nga napatay kag 25 nga napilasan.
english: In addition, it is checking reports that four medics were killed and 25 injured.

text: Suno kay WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, luwas sa Iran, may isa man ka pagpang-atake sa Lebanon.
english: According to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, in addition to Iran, there was also an attack in Lebanon.

text: Gindugang pa sang WHO nga apat pa ka ambulansya sa Iran ang nahalitan, kag naguba man ang mga ospital kag health sites bangud sang igo sang missiles malapit sa ginatindugan sang buildings.
english: The WHO added that four other ambulances in Iran were damaged, and hospitals and health sites were also destroyed by missiles near buildings.

text: Bangud sini, may isa ka ospital sa Tehran kun sa diin ginsaylo anay ang mga pasyente.
english: Because of this, there is a hospital in Tehran where patients were transferred.

text: Sa Dubai naman, temporaryo naman nga indi makahatag sang serbisyo ang WHO logistics hub bangud sang transport restrictions sa Middle East.
english: In Dubai, the WHO logistics hub will be temporarily unable to provide services due to transport restrictions in the Middle East.

text: Santo naman sa Iranian state media, nagsaka na sa 1,045 ang death toll kag 6,000 ang nakaangkon sang injuries sa lima ka adlaw nga mga serye sang atake sang US kag Israel.
english: According to Iranian state media, the death toll has risen to 1,045 and 6,000 were injured in the five-day series of attacks by the US and Israel.

text: Gin-akusaran man sang Ministry of Foreign Affairs sang Iran nga gin-igu man sang Tel Aviv kag Washington ang 33 civilian sites sa Tehran nga nagalakip sang mga ospital, eskwelahan, residential areas, Tehran Grand Bazaar kag historic nga Golestan Palace complex.#
english: Iran's Foreign Ministry also accused Tel Aviv and Washington of hitting 33 civilian sites in Tehran, including hospitals, schools, residential areas, the Tehran Grand Bazaar and the historic Golestan Palace complex.

text: Nagsanyog ang exportation sang prutas sang tuig 2025 suno sa Department of Agriculture.
english: Fruit exports will increase by 2025, according to the Department of Agriculture.

text: Ini amo ang nagbulig agud magnubo ang kakulangan sa agricultural trade sang Pilipinas bangud man sa mas hapos nga importation.
english: This has helped reduce the Philippines' agricultural trade deficit due to easier imports.

text: Base sa datos sang Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), nagdangat sa 884.77 milyon US Dollar ang agricultural export sang Pilipinas sang Disyembre 2025, nga nagsaka sang 19% kumpara sang nagligad nga tuig kag naga-representar sang 36% sang kabilugan nga agricultural trade sang pungsod.
english: Based on data from the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), the Philippines' agricultural exports reached 884.77 million US Dollars in December 2025, up 19% compared to last year and representing 36% of the country's total agricultural trade.

text: Samtang, ang agricultural import ang nagdangat sa 1.55 bilyon US Dollar ukon 64% sang kabuuan nga trade.Bangud sini, ang agricultural trade gap ang nagdangat sa 668.35 milyon US Dollar, nga 24% nga mas manubo kumpara sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: Meanwhile, agricultural imports amounted to 1.55 billion US Dollars or 64% of total trade. As a result, the agricultural trade gap amounted to 668.35 million US Dollars, which is 24% lower than last year.

text: Pinaka-dako nga export sang Pilipinas amo ang mga “edible fruits kag mga kararuton,” amo man ang mga citrus fruits, nga nagdangat sa 329.72 milyon US Dollar ukon 37% sang kabilugan nga agricultural export sang pungsod.
english: The Philippines' largest export was edible fruits and vegetables, as well as citrus fruits, which amounted to 329.72 million US Dollars or 37% of the country's total agricultural exports.

text: Nagpahayag si former Mayor Jerry Treñas nga ang matuod-tuod nga isyu subong indi ang mga proyekto nga iya sang una, kundi ang mga ginapatuman ni Cong.
english: Former Mayor Jerry Treñas said the real issue now is not the projects that belonged to him in the past, but those implemented by Cong.

text: Jamjam Baronda nga ginakabig sang mga residente nga palpak kag ‘delayed’.
english: Jamjam Baronda that residents consider failed and delayed.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay former Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas, suno sa iya, nagsugod ang kontrobersya bangud sang tatlo ka bagyo nga nagdala sang mabaskug nga ulan, nga nagtuga sang pagbaha sa mga lugar nga wala man ginabaha sang una.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, former Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas said the controversy started because of three typhoons that brought heavy rains, which caused flooding in areas that were not flooded before.

text: Ginatudlo sang mga residente nga ang mga flood control projects sa Jaro nga ginpatuman ni Cong.
english: Residents point out that the flood control projects in Jaro implemented by Cong.

text: Baronda amo ang rason sang pagbaha.
english: Baronda is the cause of the flooding.

text: Sang pagkadto ni President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: When President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.

text: sa syudad, ginpahayag man nga palpak kag delayed ang mga proyekto.
english: in the city, it was also reported that the projects were failed and delayed.

text: Ginsiling ni Treñas nga ang iya mga proyekto sa public markets padayon nga ginahimo, kag bisan may pagka-delayed, makita nga may aktuwal nga trabaho.
english: Treñas said his projects in the public markets continue to be implemented, and despite the delay, there is actual work.

text: Ginpabutyag niya nga indi ini “magic” kag indi pareho sa iban nga proyekto nga daw gina-magic lang ang resulta.
english: He expressed that it is not “magic” and unlike other projects where the results are magic.

text: Sa bahin sang demand ni Cong.
english: As for the demand of Cong.

text: Baronda nga irelease ang records sang mga proyekto ni Treñas, ginpahayag sang former mayor nga ang mga dokumento yara sa Iloilo City District Engineering Office (ICDEO) kag kabalo man siya sang sulod sini.
english: Baronda to release the records of Treñas' projects, the former mayor said that the documents are in the Iloilo City District Engineering Office (ICDEO) and he knows the contents.

text: Suno sa iya, indi na relevant ang pahayag ni Baronda bangud ang isyu subong amo ang mga proyekto ni Baronda mismo.
english: He said Baronda's statement is no longer relevant because the issue now is Baronda's own projects.

text: Dugang pa niya, nga ang presidente na mismo sang Pilipinas ang naghambal sang problema, gani dapat ipakita ni Cong.
english: He added that the president of the Philippines himself has spoken about the problem, so Cong.

text: Baronda nga indi palpak ang iya ginaubra.
english: Baronda that what he is doing is not wrong.

text: Ginsabat man ni Treñas ang akusasyon ni Baronda nga wala sang flood control planning sang iya administrasyon, kag uno sa iya, isa sa mga major nga proyekto nga iya ginpatuman amo ang “Iloilo flood way” nga nakabulig sa pagsolbar sang baha sa Jaro, La Paz, kag Mandurriao.
english: Treñas also responded to Baronda's accusation that his administration does not have flood control planning, and according to him, one of the major projects he implemented is the “Iloilo flood way” which helped solve the floods in Jaro, La Paz, and Mandurriao.

text: (Via Bombohanay Bigtime anchored by Bombo Donnie Degala)
english: (Via Bombohanay Bigtime anchored by Bombo Donnie Degala)

text: Padayun ang panawagan sang pila ka mga progresibo nga grupo halin sa transport sector sa siudad sang Iloilo sa ginpatigayon nga people’s strike subong nga adlaw.
english: Some progressive groups from the transport sector in Iloilo City continue to call for a people's strike today.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Elmer Forro, Secretary General sang Bayan Panay kag Lead Convenor sang No to PUV Phaseout Coalition Panay, iya ginpahayag nga kinahanglan na gid sang mga driver kag operators sang ayuda halin sa gobyerno, apang nagpahayag man ini nga indi sa gihapon isa ka long term solution ang ayuda sa krisis sa gatong.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Elmer Forro, Secretary General of Bayan Panay and Lead Convenor of the No to PUV Phaseout Coalition Panay, said that drivers and operators need assistance from the government, but he also said that assistance is not a long term solution to the fuel crisis.

text: Suno sa iya nga makatililingala nga wala sa gihapon sang ‘best time’ para kay President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: He said it is surprising that there is still no 'best time' for President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: agud suspendihon na ang excise tax sa mga produktong petrolyo.
english: to suspend the excise tax on petroleum products.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Forro nga subong nga wala pa sang suspension sa excise tax, ang gobyerno kag cartel lamang ang nagabenepisyo sa sitwasyon, samtang nagaantos naman ang publiko ilabi na ang mga imol.
english: Forro also said that as there is no suspension of the excise tax, only the government and cartels are benefiting from the situation, while the public especially the poor are suffering.

text: Dugang pa niya, posible nga magapatigayon sila liwat sang transport strike sa masunod nga semana bangud nga nagpalab-ot man ang pila ka drivers kag operators sa probinsya nga luyag nila nga mag-upod sa panawagan sa gobyerno.
english: He added that it is possible that they will conduct another transport strike next week because some drivers and operators in the province have also expressed their desire to join the call to the government.

text: Isa ka flight halin sa Savannah, Georgia padulong sa Miami, Florida ang nangin magamo samtang yara sa kahawaan matapos nangin bayolente ang isa ka pasahero, gin-atake ang mga flight attendants, kag nagtulon sang mga beads sang rosarito.
english: A flight from Savannah, Georgia to Miami, Florida turned chaotic while in the air after a passenger became violent, assaulted flight attendants, and swallowed rosarito beads.

text: Ang suspek amo si Delange Augustin, 31.
english: The suspect was identified as Delange Augustin, 31.

text: Hinali lang ini nagsinggitan sa eroplano nga American Airlines Flight 4162.
english: He suddenly screamed on American Airlines Flight 4162.

text: Suno sa mga pasahero, gindumdom sang isa ka flight attendant nga may medical emergency si Augustin gani gintinguhaan ini nga pakalmahon.
english: According to passengers, a flight attendant remembered that Augustin had a medical emergency and tried to calm him down.

text: Apang hinali lang sini ginsipa ang flight attendant kag madamo pa gid ini sang ginhimo nga gamo.
english: But he suddenly kicked the flight attendant and caused more trouble.

text: Bangud diri, nagdesisyon ang piloto nga ibalik sa ginhalinan nga airport ang eroplano.
english: As a result, the pilot decided to return the plane to the airport of origin.

text: Pag-abot sa airport, nag-atake pa gid ini sang iban nga tawo.
english: Upon arrival at the airport, he attacked another person.

text: Suno sa iya utod nga si Medjina Augustin, nga kaupod niya sa flight, pakadto sila sa Haiti agud malagyo gikan sa isa kag ‘spiritual attack’.
english: According to his sister Medjina Augustin, who was on the flight with him, they were on their way to Haiti to escape from a and ‘spiritual attack’.

text: Bag-o mangin bayolente si Delange, ginpahayag niya nga may nakit-an siya nga mga alagad ni Satanas sa eroplan kag ginapunggan siya nga makalab-ot sa Haiti.
english: Before Delange turned violent, he claimed to have seen servants of Satan on the plane and were preventing him from reaching Haiti.

text: Sa tunga-tunga sang komosyon, gintulon pa ni Delange ang isa kag rosarito nga amo ang pangontra niya batok sa malain nga mga espiritu.
english: In the midst of the commotion, Delange even swallowed a rosary that was his antidote to evil spirits.

text: Gindala naman ini sa ospital matapos gintulon ang rosarito.
english: He was taken to the hospital after swallowing the rosary.

text: Padayon man ang imbestigasyon sa insidente kag ginpasakaan sang kaso si Augustin sang kaso nga misdemeanor battery, misdemeanor obstruction of police, kag felony criminal pro­perty damage.
english: The investigation into the incident is ongoing and Augustin was charged with misdemeanor battery, misdemeanor obstruction of police, and felony criminal property damage.

text: LUYAG naton anay magtamyaw sa tanan sing: MERRY AND BLESSED CHRISTMAS TO ONE AND ALL!
english: We would like to greet everyone with: MERRY AND BLESSED CHRISTMAS TO ONE AND ALL!

text:
***

Nahibal-an naton kon ano ka makahalalit ang atomic bomb, nga nuclear bomb na kon tawgon sa karon, nga ang mga bersyon sini sa subong may mga 10 ka beses ang kusog.
english:
***

We know how devastating the atomic bomb is, which is a nuclear bomb today, whose versions today have about 10 times the power.

text: Indi pa malipat ang kalibutan sa paghulog sang duha ka atomic bomb, isa sa Hiroshima kag isa man sa Nagasaki, sa Japan sadtong WW2.
english: The world will never forget the dropping of two atomic bombs, one on Hiroshima and one on Nagasaki, on Japan during WW2.

text: Diri, halos 150,000 ang napatay nga tawo samtang ang mga nakaluas nag-sufrir sing tuman tubtub sa ila kamatayon.
english: Here, nearly 150,000 people died while the survivors suffered greatly until their death.

text: Nagpatay kag naghalit man ini sang madamo nga mga hayop kag tanom nga mabuhi lang liwat pagkaligad pa sa indi magkubos napulo ka tuig.
english: It also killed and damaged many animals and plants that would only come back to life after at least ten years.

text: Obviously, wala na seguro nga nasyon ang luyag matabo ang isa ka nuclear war sa tunga sang mga nasyon nuclear katulad sang US, Russia, China, India, kag North Korea, nga maglamita pa sa iban nga mga pungsod.
english: Obviously, no country would want a nuclear war between nuclear nations such as the US, Russia, China, India, and North Korea, to spread to other countries.

text: Luas lang seguro sang pungsod sa pagpamuno sang isa ka lain ulo nga diktador nga may sobra kaugot sa kaaway.
english: It's probably just a country led by a crazy dictator who has a lot of hatred for the enemy.

text: Katulad abe sa North Korea nga ang diktador sini nga si Kim Jong Un namahog gid nga paulanan sang nuclear missiles ang South Korea, nga pinahog naman balik sang US nga pulboson gid sini ang bug-os nga North Korea kon himuon ang pamahog sini.
english: Like North Korea, whose dictator Kim Jong Un threatened to rain nuclear missiles on South Korea, the US threatened to crush the whole of North Korea if it carried out its threat.

text: Pray lang nga indi subong kabuang ang isa ka diktador sang isa ka nasyon nuclear nga, unfortunately, may ara dira sa pila pa ka pungsod.
english: Just pray that a dictator of a nuclear nation is not as stupid as, unfortunately, there are in some other countries.

text: Nonetheless, posible gihapon ang conventional war, katulad sang natabo sa WW1 kag WW2, gamit ang mga ordinaryo lang nga mga armas.
english: Nonetheless, conventional war is still possible, as happened in WW1 and WW2, using ordinary weapons.

text: In fact, nagakatabo gani ini subong sa tunga sang pila ka mga nasyon, samtang nagapatigayon sang ila gyera sa iban nga fronts sa ila pagpaindis-indisanay sa pagpasanyog sang ila ekonomiya, social-cultural influence, kag geo-political concerns.
english: In fact, it is even happening today among some nations, while waging their war on other fronts in their competition to advance their economies, social-cultural influence, and geo-political concerns.

text:
***

Sa bahin sang mga gamay nga mga nasyon nga wala inugbato sa mga dalagku nga mga nasyon natural lang nga magsalig ini sila sa bulig sang mga kaalyado nga may ikasarang militar.
english:
***

On the part of small nations that are not at war with large nations, it is natural for them to rely on the help of allies with military capabilities.

text: Sa kaso sang Filipinas, may mutual defense treaty (MDT) kita sa United States, nga ginakilala nga “the most powerful nation” sa kalibutan sa karon.
english: In the case of the Philippines, we have a mutual defense treaty (MDT) with the United States, which is recognized as “the most powerful nation” in the world today.

text: Sa ini nga kasugtanan sa US komitido ang ulihi sa pagbulig sa Filipinas batok sa “armed aggression” sang China batok sa Filipinas.
english: In this agreement with the US, the latter is committed to helping the Philippines against China's armed aggression against the Philippines.

text: Samtang sige pa gihapon ang pang-bully sang China sa Filipinas bisan pa sa 200-nautical mile nga Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) nga gindaug ta sa international court sadtong 2016 batok sa China.
english: Meanwhile, China continues to bully the Philippines despite the 200-nautical mile Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) that we won in international court in 2016 against China.

text: Ginapilit ugaling sini gihapon ang iya indi legal nga hingyo sa pag-okupar sang EEZ naton sa idalom sang “Might is Right” nga prinsipyo sang mga malugos nga mga nasyon.
english: However, it still insists on its illegal demand to occupy our EEZ under the “Might is Right” principle of the oppressive nations.

text: Ginabombahan na gani sang China sang tubig ang mga salakyan naton nga nagapadala sing ayuda sa mga lugar nga sakop sang aton EEZ.
english: China is even bombarding our aid vehicles with water in our EEZ.

text: Pero daw indi pa kuno ini lakip sa “armed aggression” sa idalom sang sining kasugtanan agud maaktuhan na pang-militar ining “aggression” sang China.
english: However, it seems that this is not yet included in the “armed aggression” under this agreement so that this “aggression” of China can be acted upon militarily.

text: Gapati ugaling ang iban nga “act of war” na ato kay may nasamaran na nga mga barko sang Filipinas, kag dapat na mapatuman ang bagay ipatuman sa idalom sang MDT.
english: However, some believe that it is an act of war because there are already damaged Philippine ships, and the matter should be implemented under the MDT.

text: Apang indi kita kinahanglan mangin agresibo gid tungod lang sa pasalig sang US kay may yara man kita kaugalingon nga interes bilang mahuyang nga pungsod nga gustuhon lang dag-on ang aton kawsa nga indi kinahanglan mag-gyera.
english: But we don't have to be very aggressive just because of the US's assurance because we have our own interests as a weak country to want to win our cause without having to go to war.

text: Indi man naton luyag dabukan ang US agud makig-away na sa China kay basi mahulog ini sa nuclear war nga indi naton luyag matabo.
english: We also don't want to force the US to fight China because it might fall into a nuclear war that we don't want to happen.

text: Unless ang China na mismo ang magdabuk sini sa sige pang-garit-garit sini!
english: Unless China itself will burn it in its constant scratching!

text: Tungod sini, padayon lang kita mag-akto bilang isa ka “underdog” kag dag-on ang aton kawsa, as such, short of military aggression.
english: Therefore, let us continue to act as an “underdog” and win our cause, as such, short of military aggression.

text: Ang aton pagkig-away dapat katulad lang sa slingshot ni David batok kay Goliath nga ang bala amo lang ang malawig gihapon nga pasyensya kag mga paagi psychological, social-cultural, diplomasya, kag legal nga mga protesta agud makuha ang simpatiya sang iban nga nasyon sa international community of nations.
english: Our fight should be like the slingshot of David against Goliath whose only ammunition is long patience and psychological, social-cultural, diplomatic, and legal protests to win the sympathy of other nations in the international community of nations.

text: Angot dira, kinahanglan tindugan ta lang pirme ang Rule of International Law sa ining kawsa naton sa aton EEZ.
english: In this regard, we must always uphold the Rule of International Law in our cause in our EEZ.

text: Apang kon indi pa gid mapunggan ang pang-bully sang China kinahanglan ta na seguro pangabayon ang US kag iban nga mga kaalyado agud updan ang aton coastguard sa pagpatrolya dira sa kabug-usan sang aton EEZ agud makita sang China nga desidido kita sa pagtapna sang padayon sini nga pang-bully sa Filipinas sa aton EEZ./PN
english: But if China's bullying cannot be stopped, we must ask the US and other allies to accompany our coastguard in patrolling the entirety of our EEZ so that China can see that we are determined to stop its continued bullying of the Philippines in our EEZ.

text: Magadiretso sa bronze medal match ang Alas Pilipinas Women matapos gin-sweep sang Vietnam, 17-25, 14-25, 17-25, sa semifinals sang 33rd Southeast Asian (SEA) Games sa Indoor Stadium Huamark sa Bangkok, Thailand, Disyembre 14.
english: Alas Pilipinas Women will advance to the bronze medal match after being swept by Vietnam, 17-25, 14-25, 17-25, in the semifinals of the 33rd Southeast Asian (SEA) Games at the Indoor Stadium Huamark in Bangkok, Thailand, December 14.

text: Nagpakita sang potensyal ang Alas sa first set sa pagpanguna ni Angel Canino, apang nakabawi kag naglagas ang Vietnamese players tubtub nga gindominar na sini ang hampang.
english: Alas showed potential in the first set led by Angel Canino, but the Vietnamese players recovered and chased until they dominated the game.

text: Nanguna sa scoring sang national team si Alyssa Solomon nga may 10 points, samtang may nueve puntos naman si Canino kag may syete puntos si Eya Laure.
english: Alyssa Solomon led the national team in scoring with 10 points, while Canino had nine points and Eya Laure had seven points.

text: Sa Vietnam nga silver medalist sang nagligad nga edisyon, may game-high nga 15 puntos si Tran Thi Thanh Thuy.
english: In Vietnam the silver medalist of the previous edition, Tran Thi Thanh Thuy had a game-high 15 points.

text: Ini nga kalutusan ang nagdugang pa sa gold medal drought sang Pilipinas sa SEA Games.
english: This defeat added to the Philippines' gold medal drought in the SEA Games.

text: Ulihi ini nga nagpangibabaw sa biennial meet sa amo nga event sang 1993.
english: He last dominated the biennial meet at the same event in 1993.

text: May tyansa naman ang team nga matapos ang 20-year medal drought kun mag-atubang ini 4:00 buwas sa hapon (Philippine time) sa loser sa tunga sang Thailand-Indonesia semifinal.
english: The team has a chance to end its 20-year medal drought when it faces the loser of the Thailand-Indonesia semifinal at 4:00 pm tomorrow.

text: Ini na ang pang-lima nga sunod-sunod nga bronze medal match sang Pilipinas kag target sini nga malampuwasan na ang fourth-place hump subong nga edisyon.
english: This is the Philippines' fifth consecutive bronze medal match and it targets to overcome the fourth-place hump this edition.

text: Nagresulta sa pagbayluhanay sang mga ideya ang ginhiwat nga committee hearing sang Iloilo City Council natuhoy sa pagpalawig sang 40 porsyento nga reduction sang Real Property Tax sa syudad, matapos ginpunggan si Councilor Sheen Marie Mabilog sa pagpamangkot kag nag-walkout ang pila ka mga konsehal.
english: The committee hearing of the Iloilo City Council on the extension of the 40 percent reduction of the Real Property Tax in the city resulted in an exchange of ideas, after Councilor Sheen Marie Mabilog was stopped from asking questions and some councilors walked out.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Councilor Sheen Marie Mabilog, ginpahayag niya nga samtang nagapamangkot siya sa hearing, nakalungan gid siya sang kahigayunan nga magpahayag bangud duha lang ang pamangkot kag duha lang ka follow-up question ang ginatugot.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Councilor Sheen Marie Mabilog said that while she was asking questions during the hearing, she missed the opportunity to speak because there were only two questions and only two follow-up questions were allowed.

text: Suno kay Mabilog, kulang gid ini para matalakay sang husto ang isyu.
english: According to Mabilog, this is not enough to discuss the issue properly.

text: Ginsiling man niya nga kun indi ang pamangkot relevant, dapat ini i-point of order, kag indi lang basta hambalon nga para lang sa iya.
english: He also said that if the question is not relevant, it should be made a point of order, and not just say that it is for him.

text: Ginpabutyag man ni Mabilog nga suportado niya ang mga diskwento nga pwede mahatag sa publiko, apang kulang pa ang datos nga ginpresentar.
english: Mabilog also expressed his support for the discounts that can be given to the public, but the data presented is still insufficient.

text: Ginpahayag man nga may nagsiling nga indi man kuno beneficial sa syudad ang Real Property Tax reduction.
english: It was also reported that some said that the Real Property Tax reduction is not beneficial to the city.

text: Gin-adjourn ang hearing bisan wala pa siya natagaan sang chance nga magpadayon sa pagpamangkot.
english: The hearing was adjourned even though he was not given a chance to continue his questioning.

text: Antes pa sini, naguwa na una sanday Councilor Malabor kag Councilor Duron, kag nag-walkout ang pila pa ka konsehal bangud sang tensyon sa sulod sang sesyon.
english: Earlier, Councilor Malabor and Councilor Duron left, and several other councilors walked out due to tension during the session.

text: Ginpangunahan ang hearing ni Councilor Maria Irene Ong bilang chairman sang Committee on Ways and Means, kaupod sanday Councilor Nene Dela Llana kag Councilor Rex Marcus Sarabia.
english: The hearing was presided over by Councilor Maria Irene Ong as chairman of the Committee on Ways and Means, along with Councilor Nene Dela Llana and Councilor Rex Marcus Sarabia.

text: Yara man ang City Treasurer’s Office, City Assessor’s Office, City Accountant kag City Legal Office.
english: There is also the City Treasurer’s Office, City Assessor’s Office, City Accountant and City Legal Office.

text: Tinguhaan ni Iloilo Mayor City Raisa Treñas nga indi lang fuel subsidy ang igahatag sang city government sa mga transport sectors kun indi amo man ang rice subsidy.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas will try to ensure that the city government does not only give fuel subsidy to the transport sectors but also rice subsidy.

text: Ini amo ang kabahin sang mensahe ni Treñas matapos ang tagtaganay sang fuel subsidy coupon sa mga tricycle drivers sang City proper nga ginpatigayon sa City Hall, subong nga adlaw.
english: This is part of Treñas' message after the distribution of fuel subsidy coupons to tricycle drivers of the City proper held at the City Hall, today.

text: Suno sa iya, sa tion sang krisis, ubrahun gid niya ang iya masarangan agud mabuligan ang transport sector paagi sa paghatag sang nasambit nga subsidiya.
english: He said that in times of crisis, he will do his best to help the transport sector by providing the said subsidy.

text: Ginpakigbahin man sang alkalde nga gina-finalize na lang ang mga kinahanglanon nga mga dokumento bangud kabahin man sang fuel subsidy program sang Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) ang mga tricycle drivers nga una pagahatagan sang subsidya.
english: The mayor also shared that the necessary documents are being finalized because the fuel subsidy program of the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) is also part of the tricycle drivers who will be given the subsidy first.

text: Nag-alokar sang indi magkulang sa P300 million ang Department of Agriculture para sa tuig 2026 para palaparon ang climate-resilient farming sang mga high-value nga mga ulutanon kaangay sang kamatis, katumbal kag bell pepper.
english: The Department of Agriculture has allocated at least P300 million for 2026 to expand climate-resilient farming of high-value vegetables such as tomatoes, cucumbers and bell peppers.

text: Suno kay Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.
english: According to Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.

text: nga ang pondo gin-alokar sa mga basic greenhouse, drip irrigation, kag water-impounding systems agud siguraduhon ang insakto nga pag-dumala sang mga pananom kag mabuhinan ang halit nga dala sang pabag-o bag-o nga tyempo.
english: that funds have been allocated to basic greenhouses, drip irrigation, and water-impounding systems to ensure proper crop management and reduce damage caused by fluctuating weather.

text: Dugang pa ni Laurel ang katuyuan sang amo nga inisyatiba amo nga punggan ang liwat liwat nga pagtaas sang presyo sa ga balaklon bangud sa dala sang weather related nga pagaka-delay sang sa suplay.
english: Laurel added that the purpose of the initiative is to prevent the repeated increase in prices of goods due to weather related delays in supply.

text: Ini bangud kada tuig nagaka-eksperyensya sang tuman nga price swings ang mga high value nga mga utanon bangud sa mainit nga tyempo, mabaskog nga pag-ulan kag pagabaha nga nagaguba sa produksyon.
english: This is because every year high value vegetables experience severe price swings due to hot weather, heavy rains and floods that destroy production.

text: Sa idalom sang inisyatiba nga “White Revolution,” magabutang man ang DA sang mga rain shelter kag mas simple nga greenhouse structures para maproteksyunan batok sa mabaskog nga pag-ulan kag mabuhinan ang mga pagbaha kag halit sang peste sa mga panananom sang mga mangunguma.
english: Under the “White Revolution” initiative, the DA will also install rain shelters and simpler greenhouse structures to protect against heavy rains and reduce flooding and pest damage to farmers’ crops.

text: ANG MASUNOD personal ta lang nga pagpati, nga basi indi man magsantu sa inyo kaugalingon nga pagpati.
english: THE FOLLOWING is our personal belief, which may not be in line with your own.

text: Nagapadumdom ining pagpati naton sa problema nga ginhaboy sa aton sang abyan ko nga si Pedro.
english: This belief reminds us of the problem my friend Peter threw at us.

text: Sa padayon nga kinagamo nga nagakatabo sa mga dalanon angot sa Israeli-Hamas war, labi na gid sa mga Demokrasyahon nga mga pungsod, nagalibog gid ang ulo ni Pedro kon ngaa dapat tagaan pa sing lubos nga Kahilwayan ang kasubong nga mga pumuluyo sa ila subong ginahimo.
english: With the ongoing unrest in the streets over the Israeli-Hamas war, especially in democratic countries, Pedro is confused as to why such citizens should be given complete freedom as they are.

text: Daw ginaabusaran man lang gani nila ining ginahatag sa ila nga Kahilwayan nga nagahatag sing kakulba kag katalagman sa kabug-usan sa pagsalpukan sang duha ka bahin, indi bala?
english: They seem to be abusing this freedom that causes panic and danger to the whole in the conflict between the two sides, doesn't it?

text: Well, pwede man indi pag-abusaran sang mga pumuluyo ining Kahilwayan kay may Responsibilidad man sila sa malinong nga pagpautwas sang ila mga balatyagon.
english: Well, the people can not abuse this freedom because they also have a responsibility to peacefully express their feelings.

text: Kon abusaran nila ini, pwede naman sila punggan sang gobyerno sing nagakabagay.
english: If they abuse it, the government can stop them accordingly.

text: Sa mga Demokrasyahon nga mga pungsod, may nagakabagay man nga mga kasuguan angot dira, katulad sang yari diri sa Filipinas kag sa Estados Unidos, nga pwede naman mapatuman kon dapat na.
english: In democratic countries, there are also appropriate laws in this regard, such as those in the Philippines and the United States, which can be implemented when appropriate.

text:
***
