Remember nga indi naton ginpangayo ang Kahilwayan nga ini sa Diyos.
english:
***

Remember that we did not ask God for this Freedom.

text: Siya mismo  ang naghatag sini sa aton agud gamiton sa matarong nga paagi.
english: He himself gave it to us to use in a righteous way.

text: Saksi pa ang ginhatag nga Kahilwayan kay Adan kag Eba, nga gingamit nila ugaling sa pagsuay sa sugo sang Diyos nga indi magkaon sang ginadilian nga Prutas sang Kinaalam (Fruit of Knowledge of Good and Evil) sa Paraiso.
english: Another witness is the Freedom given to Adam and Eve, which they used to disobey God's command not to eat the forbidden Fruit of Knowledge of Good and Evil in Paradise.

text: Ining Kahilwayan nga ginhatag sa ila pagtilaw man gali sa ila kon tubtub gid diin mapakita nila ang ila lealtad sa Diyos.
english: This freedom given to them was also a test of their loyalty to God.

text: Tungod sa ila pagsuay sa sugo sang Diyos ginpalayas sila sa Paraiso.
english: Because of their disobedience to God's command they were expelled from Paradise.

text: Nakuhaan sng kabuhi nga walay katapusan.
english: Deprived of eternal life.

text: Nag-antos.
english: Suffered.

text: Kag nag-atubang sa madamo nga kabudlay kag katalagman sa gwa sang Paraiso upod sa ila kabataan kag kabikahan nga nagpatuman lang sang ila luyag sa ila pag-inupod.
english: And faced many hardships and dangers outside of Paradise with their children and descendants who simply enforced their will in their association.

text: Wala dira nagtapos, ugaling, ang pagtilaw sang Diyos sa tawo agud maseguro ang tuod-tuod gid nga lealtad nga mahatag nila sa Iya.
english: God's testing of man to ensure their genuine loyalty to Him did not end there, however.

text: Ginsugo sang Diyos si Abraham nga patyon ang iya anak kag ihalad ini sa Iya bilang sakripisyo.
english: God commanded Abraham to kill his son and offer him as a sacrifice to Him.

text: Apang, indi katulad ni Adan kag ni Eba, wala ginsuay ni Abraham ang luyag matabo sang Diyos nga ihalad ang kabuhi sang iya anak nga si Isaac bilang sakripisyo sa Diyos bisan pa ini tuman kasakit sa iya bilang amay.
english: However, unlike Adam and Eve, Abraham did not question God's will to offer the life of his son Isaac as a sacrifice to God even though it was very painful for him as a father.

text: Sang buot na kutlon ni Abraham ang kabuhi sang iya anak bilang sakripisyo, ginpunggan ini sang mga anghel sa sugo sang Diyos kay kumbinsido na Siya sa pagka-masinulundon sini sa Iya.
english: When Abraham was about to sacrifice his son's life, the angels stopped him at God's command because He was convinced of his obedience to Him.

text: Diri napamatud-an sang Diyos ang lealtad ni Abraham sa Iya, gani sa kabikahan ni Abraham ginpat-ud sang Diyos ang pagpatuman sang kaluwasan sang na-kondenar nga kabikahan ni Adan kag ni Eba kag buksan ang Kalangitan sa ila.
english: Here God proved Abraham's loyalty to Him, so in Abraham's seed God ensured the implementation of the salvation of the condemned seed of Adam and Eve and the opening of Heaven to them.

text: Sa pagpadayon sang panglakaton sang iya kabikahan, gintugyan na Niya ang Napulo nga Kasuguan (10 Commandments) sa kabug-san sang katauhan kay Moses, pagkatapos nga pangunahan sini ang pagluas sa pagka-ulipon sang mga Israelita sa idalom sang gahum sang hari (Pharaoh) sang Ehipto.
english: In continuing the journey of His lineage, He entrusted the Ten Commandments to all mankind to Moses, after which he led the deliverance of the Israelites from slavery under the power of the king (Pharaoh) of Egypt.

text: Sa gihapon wala ginkuha sang Diyos kay Moses ang Kahilwayan kon ano ang magpatuman sang Iya Napulo nga Kasuguan sa katauhan.
english: Still God did not take away from Moses the freedom to enforce His Ten Commandments on mankind.

text: Nangin sobra ka istrikto ugaling si Moses kag nagpatuman sang kasuguan nga “an eye for an eye”, kon diin kon makapatay ka kamatayon man ang imo silot kag ginpasugtan ang pagpatay sa “adulterous” nga babaye paagi sa paghaboy sang bato sa iya.
english: Moses, however, became too strict and enforced the law of “an eye for an eye”, where if you killed you were also punished with death and allowed the killing of an “adulterous” woman by throwing stones at her.

text: Wala sa sugo sang Diyos ang silot nga kamatayon sang mga tawo sa kamot sang kapareho nila nga tawo.
english: God does not command the death penalty for people at the hands of their fellow human beings.

text: Ang Diyos, nga nagtuga sa ila, lang ang makahimo sini kag maghatag sang dayon nga silot diri man sa duta kag sa pihak nga kabuhi.
english: Only God, who created them, can do this and give eternal punishment both here on earth and in the next life.

text: Kon matugutan man nga mahimo ini sang tawo ina agud lang sa pangpangamlig sa kaugalingon (self-defense), matarong nga pagpakig-away (just war), kag sa pagpangapin sa kay bisan sin-o man nga luyag patyon sang may kaugot sa iya.
english: If a person is allowed to do this, it is only for self-defense, just war, and to defend anyone who wants to be killed by someone who is angry with him.

text:
***

Indi nagustuhan sang Diyos ang mga silot nga kamatayon nga ginpatuman ni Moses kag ginpadala Niya si Hesukristo nga Iya anak paagi kay Maria agud mag-tindug sa Iya bug-os nga luyag para mapatigayon na sing pat-ud ang kaluwasan sang katauhan.
english:
***

God did not like the death sentences that Moses imposed and He sent His Son Jesus Christ through Mary to stand in His absolute will to bring about the salvation of mankind.

text: Ginbag-o ni Kristo ang silot nga kamatayon sa kamot sang tawo kag, sa lugar sini, ginpalapnag ang kapatawaran sang Diyos Amay sa sin-o man nga nagahinulsol sing hugot sang ila kasal-anan kag luyag magpanibag-o sang ila kabuhi.
english: Christ changed the penalty of death at the hands of man and, in its place, extended the forgiveness of God the Father to anyone who sincerely repents of their sins and wants to change their lives.

text: Nga sa karon amo na ang ginapatuman sang Kristiyanong katilingban./PN
english: Which is now what the Christian community is doing./PN

text: Na-diagnose si Kim Kardashian nga may yara sang brain aneurysm.
english: Kim Kardashian has been diagnosed with a brain aneurysm.

text:
Ginsapubliko sang 45-anyos nga American media personality ang diagnosis kadungan ang teaser para sa seventh season sang reality show nga “The Kardashians.”

Indi pa klaro kun naga-eksperyensya siya sang sintomas, apang base sa latest season sang amo nga show, makit-an si Kim nga nagapaidalom sa imaging scan.
english:
The 45-year-old American media personality made the diagnosis public alongside a teaser for the seventh season of the reality show “The Kardashians.”

It's not clear if she's experiencing symptoms, but based on the latest season of the show, Kim can be seen undergoing an imaging scan.

text: Sandig sa Mayo Clinic, ang brain aneurysm amo ang “bulge or ballooning” sa blood vessel sa utok sang tawo.
english: According to the Mayo Clinic, a brain aneurysm is a “bulge or ballooning” of a blood vessel in the human brain.

text:
Madamo nga sahi sang brain aneurysms nga may nagkalain-lain nga lebel kun ano kalala kag ginalaragway ini nga kondisyon bilang “common.”

“If the brain aneurysm leaks or ruptures, it causes bleeding in the brain, known as a hemorrhagic stroke,” suno sa Mayo Clinic.
english:
There are many types of brain aneurysms with varying degrees of severity and this condition is described as “common.”

“If the brain aneurysm leaks or ruptures, it causes bleeding in the brain, known as a hemorrhagic stroke,” according to the Mayo Clinic.

text: “Brain aneurysms are common.
english: “Brain aneurysms are common.

text: But most brain aneurysms aren’t serious, especially if they’re small.
english: But most brain aneurysms aren’t serious, especially if they’re small.

text:
Most brain aneurysms don’t rupture.”

Base sa mga pagtuon, pinaka-common ang brain aneurysms sa adults sa tunga-tunga sang edad nga 30 kag 60-anyos.#
english:
Most brain aneurysms don’t rupture.”

According to studies, brain aneurysms are most common in adults between the ages of 30 and 60 years old.

text: Isa ka 31-anyos nga abogado sa Bangalore, India ang nagdaug sa iya nga demanda batok sa isa ka dako nga movie theater chain matapos mauyang ang iya nga oras sa paglantaw sang mga pasayod bag-o ang mismo nga pelikula.
english: A 31-year-old lawyer in Bangalore, India won his lawsuit against a large movie theater chain after wasting his time watching advertisements before the movie itself.

text: Suno kay Abhishek M R, sang nagkadto siya sa sinehan, ginlauman niya ga magsugod ang pelikula sa husto nga oras base sa schedule.
english: According to Abhishek M R, when he went to the cinema, he expected the film to start on time based on the schedule.

text: Apang nagbag-o ang dalagan sang gab-i sang mabayluhan ang ginalauman nga pagsugod sang pelikula sang halos 30 minutos nga mga pasayod.
english: But the course of the evening changed when the anticipated start of the film was replaced by nearly 30 minutes of commercials.

text: Bangud diri, natapos ang pelikula sang isa ka oras nga late sa orihinal nga schedule, rason nga napaiway niya ang isa ka importante nga tawag sa trabaho.
english: As a result, the film ended an hour late to the original schedule, causing him to miss an important work call.

text: Suno kay Abhishek, isa ini ka halimbawa sang “unfair trade practice” kag gindeklarar nga nauyang lang ang iya oras kag nangin kabangdanan sang tuman nga stress.
english: Abhishek said this was an example of “unfair trade practice” and declared that it was a waste of his time and caused him a lot of stress.

text: Indi lamang basta reklamo ang iya ginpasaka bangud ginpursige niya ang kaso sa Bangalore District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission.
english: He did not just file a complaint as he pursued the case with the Bangalore District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission.

text: Matapos ang hearing, nagpagwa sang desisyon ang korte pabor kay Abhishek.
english: After the hearing, the court issued a verdict in favor of Abhishek.

text: Ginpabayad sang korte ang sinehan sang malapit 6 million pesos.
english: The court ordered the cinema to pay nearly 6 million pesos.

text: Ang kadalag-an ni Abhishek ang nagahatag sang importansya sa consumer rights sa amo nga pungsod.
english: Abhishek's victory highlights the importance of consumer rights in the country.

text: Gintambakan sang defending champion nga Gilas Pilipinas sang 25 puntos ang Malaysia, 83-58, sa imbukada sini nga hampang sa Southeast Asian (SEA) Games 2025.
english: Defending champion Gilas Pilipinas thrashed Malaysia by 25 points, 83-58, in its opening match of the Southeast Asian (SEA) Games 2025.

text: Ginpatigayon ang hampang sa Nimibutr Stadium sa Bangkok, Thailand subong nga adlaw, Disyembre 14.
english: The match was played at the Nimibutr Stadium in Bangkok, Thailand today, December 14.

text: 1-0 na ang Gilas sa Group A samtang nahulog naman ang Malaysia sa 1-1 card.
english: The Gilas are 1-0 in Group A while Malaysia fell to a 1-1 card.

text: Sa pagtakop sang first quarter, abanse pa ang Malaysians, 22-16, apang nagbawi ang Pilipinas sa pagpanguna ni oach Norman Black sa second quarter kun sa diin nakalab-ot sa 22-0 nga puntos ang ginbubo sang national team.
english: At the end of the first quarter, the Malaysians were still ahead, 22-16, but the Philippines recovered under the leadership of oach Norman Black in the second quarter where the national team poured 22-0 points.

text: Ang duha ka free throws ni Ray Parks Jr.
english: Both free throws by Ray Parks Jr.

text: ang nagpasaka pa sang abanse nga gindugangan pa sini sang tres puntos.
english: increased the lead by three points.

text: Sa halftime, may 42-26 na nga lead ang Pilipinas.
english: At halftime, the Philippines had a 42-26 lead.

text: Nagtinguha pa ang Malaysia nga makabawi sa third quarter, 39-46, apang nagbalos sang triple si Robert Bolick kag nagbulig man sanday Thirdy Ravena kag Justin Chua agud matapos ang frame nga may 62-51 lead.
english: Malaysia tried to rally in the third quarter, 39-46, but Robert Bolick hit back with a triple and Thirdy Ravena and Justin Chua also helped to finish the frame with a 62-51 lead.

text: Sa katapusan nga quarter, nagsaka pa sa 74-57 ang lead sang Pilipinas tubtub nga napadala ang statement win sa panugod nga kampanya sini agud madepensahan ang titulo sa Southeast Asia.
english: In the final quarter, the Philippines' lead rose to 74-57 until it sent a statement win in its opening campaign to defend the title in Southeast Asia.

text: 12:30 sa udto buwas (Philippine time), magaatubang ang Pilipinas sa Vietnam.
english: 12:30 noon tomorrow (Philippine time), the Philippines will face Vietnam.

text: Kun magdaog ang Gilas, makasulod na ang national team sa crossover semifinals sa Huwebes, Disyembre 18.
english: If the Gilas win, the national team will enter the crossover semifinals on Thursday, December 18.

text:
The scores:

Philippines 83 – Parks 18, Bolick 17, Ravena 13, Panopio 7, Malonzo 7, Erram 7, Wright 5, Chua 4, Pessumal 3, Tratter 2, Manzano 0, Pre 0.
english:
The scores:

Philippines 83 – Parks 18, Bolick 17, Ravena 13, Panopio 7, Malonzo 7, Erram 7, Wright 5, Chua 4, Pessumal 3, Tratter 2, Manzano 0, Pre 0.

text: Malaysia 58 – Ting 21, J.K.C. Wong 13, Chin 9, J.S.W.L. Lee 7, Mahadevan 3, Yong 3, J.H. Lee 2, De 0, Chang 0, Ooi 0, Wong 0.
english: Malaysia 58 – Ting 21, J.K.C. Wong 13, Chin 9, J.S.W.L. Lee 7, Mahadevan 3, Young 3, J.H. Lee 2, De 0, Chang 0, Ooi 0, Wong 0.

text: Indi pa mahambal sang sang isa ka eskperto nga madamo na ang na-edukar nahanungod sa mental health condition diri sa Pilipinas.
english: An expert cannot say that many have been educated about mental health conditions here in the Philippines.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Florence Matthew Besares, isa ka psychiatrist, iya ginpahayag nga nagapabilin sa gihapon ang “stigma” apisar nga amat-amat nga gina-edukar ang mga Pilipino kaangot sa mental nga bahin sang ikaayong-lawas.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Florence Matthew Besares, a psychiatrist, said the “stigma” persists despite the gradual education of Filipinos on the mental aspect of health.

text: Suno kay Besares, indi tanan nga concern sa mental health ang matawag nga “nabuang” nga masami man nga ginagamit nga terminolohiya sa mga tawo nga naga-eksperyensya sang psychological condition.
english: According to Besares, not all mental health concerns can be called “nabuang” which is also often used as a terminology for people experiencing psychological conditions.

text: Nagpanawagan man ini sa mga pamatan-on nga gamiton kag i-take advantage ang social media agud magamit bilang isa ka source agud nga mapalapnag ang kahulugan kag importansya sang mental health condition.
english: He also called on the youth to use and take advantage of social media to be used as a source to spread the meaning and importance of mental health conditions.

text: Ginaduso man sini ang tagsa ka indibidwal nga indi magkahadlok nga magpamangkot sa mga doktor kag eksperto nahanungod sa kondisyon sang mental health bangud indi ma-control ang nagasulod sa aton nga panghuna-huna.
english: It also encourages every individual not to be afraid to ask doctors and experts about mental health conditions because we cannot control what comes into our minds.

text: Mahimo lamang nga ma-control sang isa ka tawo ang iya nga pangginawe kaangay sang kon paano kita mag-istorya kag mag-akto.
english: A person can only control his or her behavior such as how we talk and act.

text: Gintumod man sang eksperto nga indi tanan nga eksperyensya nga naagyan sang isa ka tawo ang masarangan man sang sang isa pa ka tawo, rason man nga kinahanglan mangin “compassionate” sa himata ukon kapamilya.
english: The expert also pointed out that not all experiences that one person has gone through can be handled by another person, which is why it is necessary to be “compassionate” to relatives or family members.

text: Sa tunga sang kontrobersya sa baha nga nakaapekto sa anum ka distrito sa Iloilo City, gin-athag ni Councilor Nene Dela Llana nga wala sang pamolitika sa ginapatigayon nga investigation in aid of legislation sang konseho.
english: Amid the controversy over the floods that affected six districts in Iloilo City, Councilor Nene Dela Llana clarified that there is no politics in the council's ongoing investigation in aid of legislation.

text: Ginpabutyag niya nga ang tinutuyo sini amo ang transparency kag accountability sang mga ahensya nga may kaangtanan sa proyekto.
english: He expressed that the purpose of this is transparency and accountability of the agencies involved in the project.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo, ginpahayag ni Dela Llana nga nagpanawagan siya kay DPWH-Iloilo City District Engineering Office (ICDEO) Officer-in-Charge Roy Pacanan matapos ini wala nagtambong sa Quad Committee hearing sang konseho.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Dela Llana said he called DPWH-Iloilo City District Engineering Office (ICDEO) Officer-in-Charge Roy Pacanan after he did not attend the Quad Committee hearing of the council.

text: Suno sa iya, padal-an liwat sang imbitasyon ang ICDEO para sa masunod nga hearing bangud importante gid ang ila presensya.
english: He said the ICDEO will send an invitation again for the next hearing because their presence is very important.

text: Ginpunto niya nga indi ini pamolitika, kundi sabat sa reklamo sang pumuluyo nga naapektuhan sang baha.
english: He pointed out that this is not politics, but a response to the complaints of the people affected by the floods.

text: Ginsiling pa ni Dela Llana nga kun indi gid makatambong si Engr.
english: Dela Llana said that if Engr.

text: Pacanan, mahimo siya makapadala sang representante sa hearing.
english: Pacanan, he can send a representative to the hearing.

text: ANG nasyon nga nagapabilin nga uhaw sa daku nga kakulang sang mga matarong nga mga alagad sang pumuluyo sa panghimanwa nagpadungog sang sini lang kay anay Ilongga Senator Miriam Defensor-Santiago sang isa ka dakdalan sa Quezon City.
english: THE nation that remains thirsty for the great shortage of righteous servants of the people in the city recently honored former Ilongga Senator Miriam Defensor-Santiago of a city in Quezon City.

text: Ang ining dakdalan (avenue) ginahingadlan sa karon nga Senator Miriam Defensor-Santiago Avenue bulos sa magkasugpon nga mga dalanon sang Agham Road kag BIR Road.
english: This avenue is now named Senator Miriam Defensor-Santiago Avenue instead of the intersecting roads of Agham Road and BIR Road.

text: Gasugod ang kalawig sini sa North Avenue lusot sa Quezon Avenue tubtub sa East Avenue.
english: It runs from North Avenue through Quezon Avenue to East Avenue.

text: Formal ini nga ginhingadlan sadtong Nobyembre 11 sa isa ka seremonya sa pagpanguna ni VP kag Education Secretary Sara Z. Duterte upod sanday QC Mayor Joy Belmonte, QC 1st District Councilor Juan Carlos Atayde, kag Dra.
english: It was formally named on November 11 in a ceremony led by VP and Education Secretary Sara Z. Duterte along with QC Mayor Joy Belmonte, QC 1st District Councilor Juan Carlos Atayde, and Dra.

text: Linnea Defensor-Evangelista kag Abogado Narciso Santiago, utod kag bana ni Miriam.
english: Linnea Defensor-Evangelista and Lawyer Narciso Santiago, brother and husband of Miriam.

text: Ginpatuman ini nga paghingadlan kay Miriam sang sining avenue sa idalom sang RA 11963.
english: This avenue was named after Miriam under RA 11963.

text: Sa pagpadungog sini sa nagtaliwan nga senadora, siling ni  VP Duterte nga nagapahayag ini sang pagpasalamat sang pungsod sa iya legasiya sang kaisug sa pagpabutyag sang kamatuoran kag pinasahe nga kinaalam sa kasuguan (legal brilliance) samtang nagapakig-away sa kagarukan sa gobyerno.
english: In honoring the late senator, VP Duterte said it expresses the country's gratitude for her legacy of courage in expressing the truth and exceptional legal brilliance while fighting corruption in government.

text: Kabay ma-inspire man ang aton mga kabataan, siling ni VP Duterte, sa sining pinasahe nga legasiya ni Miriam sa ila man kaugalingon nga panglakaton padulong sa mabungahan kag matarong nga panghimanwa.
english: May our children, said VP Duterte, be inspired by this unique legacy of Miriam in their own journey towards a fruitful and just citizenship.

text: Tani diri man sa siyudad sang Iloilo may kasubong nga pagpadungog kay Miriam, nga tubo sang La Paz, Iloilo City, sa isa ka dalan ukon sang ano man nga building dira sa UP-Iloilo kon diin siya nagtapos sang political science bag-o magsaylo sa UP-Dilliman kon diin siya nagtapos sing abogasiya.
english: I hope here in Iloilo City there will be a similar honor for Miriam, a native of La Paz, Iloilo City, on a street or any building here in UP-Iloilo where she graduated from political science before moving to UP-Dilliman where she graduated from law.

text: Madumduman ko pa nga sang magtaliwan si Miriam ginhingadlan ini sang mga lokal nga pamalantaan nga “Best President we never had”.
english: I still remember that when Miriam passed away the local newspapers named her “Best President we never had”.

text: Nagdalagan ini sa pagka-presidente batok kay Fidel Ramos, nga naglutos sa iya sang wala pa isa ka milyon nga abanse halin sa mga 40 ka milyon nga botante.
english: He ran for president against Fidel Ramos, defeating him by less than a million lead out of about 40 million voters.

text: So, bagay seguro ang kasubong nga pagpadungog naton sa iya, indi bala?
english: So, it's probably appropriate that we honor him like this, right?

text:
***

Madugay na ini nga problema sang mga ginikanan diri sa amon sa Podco, Mandurriao.
english:
***

This has been a long-standing problem of parents here in Podco, Mandurriao.

text: Halin pa ining problema sang panahon pa sang Panay Electric Company (PECO).
english: This problem dates back to the time of the Panay Electric Company (PECO).

text: Sa isa ka poste diri sa atubangan sang Panay News Compound may nahamtang dira nga duha ka metro (electric meter) malapit gid sa duta.
english: On a pole here in front of the Panay News Compound there is a two meter (electric meter) very close to the ground.

text: Mga duha lang ka tapak halin sa duta.
english: Just about two feet off the ground.

text: Ang problema pa kay ang nagalaylay nga linya dira may mga sinugpunan nga posible makakas sa pirme lagsanay dira sang mga kabataan palibut sa poste.
english: The problem is that the hanging line has joints that could be removed from the children's constant chasing around the pole.

text: Tungod sini daku ang tsansa nga masalipay nila ang live wire nga indi mamaraspasan sang mga ginikanan kag ma-kuryente sila.
english: Because of this, there is a good chance that they will enjoy the live wire without being overwhelmed by their parents and electrocuted.

text: Sang sining ulihi lang – Nobyembre 22 bala ato, a las 9:00 sa aga – may nagbisita nga tinawo sang FRMC nga contractor sang power distributor sang ciudad nga may kaupod pa nga duha ka pulis.
english: Recently – on November 22, at 9:00 am – an FRMC employee, a contractor of the city's power distributor, visited with two policemen.

text: Suspetso sang pila diri, lakip man kita, nga basi may ginautod sila nga linya sang  wala makabayad sing ila bill.
english: Some here, including us, suspect that they may be cutting off the line of those who have not paid their bills.

text: Pero, wala man gali kag daw ginatan-aw man lang ang sitwasyon sang mga metro sa tupad nga poste kag wala man gani sing may ginhimo gid.
english: However, it turned out that there was nothing and it seemed that the situation of the meters on the adjacent pole was being monitored and nothing was done.

text: Natabuan nga yara ang pila ka ginikanan, lakip kita, kag ginmuno naton ining problema.
english: Some parents happened to be there, including us, and we raised this problem.

text: Nag-suhestyon kita nga kon pwede maplastar tani ang mga duha ka metro paibabaw nga indi malab-ut ang naglaylay nga linya sang kabataan.
english: We suggested that if possible, we should place them about two meters above the line of children.

text: Aba, suplado ining tinawo sang FRMC.
english: Oh, this FRMC employee is stubborn.

text: Siling niya, nga pabara-bara, nga indi kuno niya mahimo ina kay indi ina bahin sang iya ubra.
english: He said, jokingly, that he couldn't do that because it wasn't part of his job.

text: In other words, wala siya labot kon ano ang matabo sa mga kabataan nga indi mapunggan sa paghampang dira.
english: In other words, he doesn't care what happens to the children who can't be stopped from playing there.

text:
Naaburido ako sa iya panabat kag ginsingganan ko siya kon bala sabton niya kon ano ang matabo sa mga kabataan kon ikaso, siling niya: “Huo!” nga may katig-a.

Bisan matuod nga tinawo lang sya sang contractor, may labot man sila nga maamligan ang mga pumuluyo, indi bala?
english:
I was confused by his answer and asked him if he would answer what would happen to the children if he was prosecuted, he said: “Yes!” with hardness.

Even if it's true that he's just an employee of the contractor, they have something to do with protecting the people, right?

text: Tani nagsiling man lang siya nga pahibaluon niya ang nag-contract sa ila parti sining problema.
english: He should have said that he would inform the contractor about this problem.

text: Indi kay akuon niya ang ano man nga matabo sa mga kabataan kon ikaso, nga daw may ikasarang gid siya nga atubangon ang dapat salabton niya kon matabo ini.
english: Not that he would accept whatever happened to the children if he were to be prosecuted, as if he were capable of facing what he was responsible for if it did.

text: Wala kurtesiya!
english: No courtesy!

text: Wala pa konsyensya!/PN
english: Not yet conscious!/PN

text: Paano kun nagasakay ka sa eroplano tapos nahibaluan mo nga wala gali sang piloto?
english: What if you were on a plane and found out that there was no pilot?

text: Amo sini ang eksena sa isa ka flight nga may sakay nga 199 ka mga pasahero kag anum ka crew members.
english: Such was the scene on a flight with 199 passengers and six crew members on board.

text: Halin ini sa Frankfurt, Germany kag pakadto sa Seville, Spain.
english: It was from Frankfurt, Germany and on its way to Seville, Spain.

text: Suno sa Civil Aviation Accident and Incident Investigation Commission sang Espanya, nagguwa ang piloto sa cockpit kag nagkadto sa lavatory samtang ginbilin naman sini ang iya nga co-pilot.
english: According to Spain's Civil Aviation Accident and Incident Investigation Commission, the pilot left the cockpit and went to the lavatory while leaving his co-pilot behind.

text: Apang ano man nga kadimalason nga gulpi lang nga nalipong ang co-pilot samtang wala pa nakabalik ang iya upod.
english: But what a misfortune that the co-pilot suddenly passed out before his companion returned.

text: Base pa sa report sang komisyon, may mga nabatian pa sa voice recorder nga mga huni sang gulpi lang nga nalipong ang piloto nga yara sa cockpit.
english: According to the commission's report, there were still sounds heard on the voice recorder when the pilot suddenly fainted in the cockpit.

text: Nagtinguha ang air traffic controller sang tatlo ka beses agud nga malab-ot ang co-pilot apang wala gid sang nagasabat.
english: The air traffic controller tried three times to reach the co-pilot but no one answered.

text: Samtang, sang nakaguwa na halin sa bathroom, gintinguhaan sang isa ka piloto nga buksan ang puertahan sa cockpit sang lima gid ka beses gamit ang standard code apang indi ini magbukas.
english: Meanwhile, once out of the bathroom, a pilot tried to open the cockpit door exactly five times using the standard code but it wouldn’t open.

text: Bisan nga nagbutang na ang cockpit crew member sang intercom call sa flight deck, gina-deny sa gihapon ang access.
english: Even after the cockpit crew member placed an intercom call on the flight deck, access was still denied.

text: Bangud sini, gingamit na lang sang kapitan ang emergency code agud nga makakuha liwat sang access sa eroplano.
english: The captain used the emergency code to regain access to the plane.

text: Suno pa sa report sang komisyon, dali-dali man nga ginhatagan sang first aid ang co-pilot sa bulig sang crew kag doctor nga isa sa mga pasahero sa amo nga flight.
english: According to the commission's report, the co-pilot was immediately given first aid with the help of the crew and a doctor who was one of the passengers on the flight.

text: Halos dies minutos man nga naglupad ang eroplano nga wala sang piloto, apang maswerte lang nga wala sang malain nga natabo.
english: The plane also flew for almost ten minutes without a pilot, but luckily nothing bad happened.

text: Ginpahugpa anay ang eroplano sa lain nga lugar agud nga madala sa ospital ang co-pilot.
english: The plane was first landed at a different location so that the co-pilot could be taken to the hospital.

text: Sa pagpangusisa sang doctor, natukiban nga nalipong ang co-pilot bangud sa preexisting neurological condition nga wala siya nakahibalo nga gina-suprer niya ilabi na bangud wala man ini na-detect sa iya nga aeronautical medical examination.
english: Upon examination by the doctor, it was discovered that the co-pilot was dizzy due to a preexisting neurological condition that he did not know he was suffering from especially since it was not detected in his aeronautical medical examination.

text: Kasunod sang hitabo, ginsuspinde anay ang iya nga medical certificate.
english: Following the incident, his medical certificate was suspended.

text: Nagpasalig naman ang kumpaniya nga maga-kooperar ini sa imbestigasyon sang Spanish authorities, magluwas pa sa kaugalingon nga imbestigasyon sang ila nga safety department.
english: The company assured that it will cooperate with the investigation of the Spanish authorities, in addition to its own investigation by its safety department.

text: Ginklaro ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas nga siya ang healthy kag wala sang ano man nga ginabatyag subong.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas clarified that he is healthy and has no symptoms.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mayor Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga maayo gid ang kahimtangan sang iya nga ikaayong-lawas kag wala sang malain nga ginasuprer nga sakit.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mayor Treñas said he is in good health and is not suffering from any serious illness.

text: Suno kay Treñas, luwas sa iya nga sinusitis nga anay na nga gin-operahan, wala naman siya sang ginaproblema subong sa iya nga bahin sang health.
english: According to Treñas, besides his sinusitis which was previously operated on, he has no problems with his health.

text: Gintumod man sini nga may ginainom man siya nga bulong rason nga nagniwang ini.
english: He also pointed out that he was also taking medication that caused him to lose weight.

text: Gin-ako man sang alkalde nga ang bulong nga iya ginainom amo ang para sa diabetes, rason man nga gakadulaan siya sang gana magkaon.
english: The mayor also admitted that the medicine he is taking is for diabetes, which is why he loses his appetite.

text: Ini ang nangin rason man agud nga mag-lose sang 20 pounds si Mayor Treñas.
english: This also caused Mayor Treñas to lose 20 pounds.

text: Nagnubo ang produksyon sang palay sa Western Visayas sa katapusan sang 2025 suno sa Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), nga nagpakita sang 46.9% nga pagbuhin kumparar sa pareho nga quarter sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: Rice production in Western Visayas declined by the end of 2025 according to the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), which showed a 46.9% reduction compared to the same quarter last year.

text: Mas manubo man ang na-harvest sa kadutaan nga may yara lamang sang 36.8%, nga amo ang rason sang dako nga pagnubo sang produksyon.
english: The land was also harvested less with only 36.8%, which is the reason for the sharp decline in production.

text: Ang mga kabukiran naman nga nagasalig sa ulan ukon rainfed nga pagpanguma ang subong man apektado nga nagnubo sang 60.8%.
english: Mountainous areas that rely on rainfed agriculture were also affected, decreasing by 60.8%.

text: Samtang ang pagpanguma sang palay sa irigasyon ang nagnubo sang 21.2%.
english: Meanwhile, irrigated rice farming declined by 21.2%.

text: Nakuha naman sang Iloilo ang may pinakadako nga produksyon sang palay sa bilog nga rehiyon.
english: Iloilo has the highest rice production in the region.

text: Sa kabilugan, nagnubo ang suplay sang palay sa Western Visayas sa katapusan sang 2025, nga posible makaapekto sa presyo kag availability sini sa lokalidad.
english: Overall, the supply of rice in Western Visayas decreased by the end of 2025, which is likely to affect its price and availability in the locality.

text: Nagahingyo si Punong Barangay Felicitas Hortillosa sang Barangay San Isidro, La Paz, sang dugang nga magabantay nga police personnel sa ila lugar matapos ang nagluntad nga stabbing incident sang nagligad nga Marso 21, kun sa diin apat ang patay sa inaway sa tunga sang pamilya Muya kag pamilya Provido.
english: Punong Barangay Felicitas Hortillosa of Barangay San Isidro, La Paz, is requesting more police personnel to patrol their area after the stabbing incident that occurred last March 21, where four people were killed in a fight between the Muya family and the Provido family.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Hortillosa, iya ginpahayag nga nagakabalaka gid sila sa posibilidad nga liwat nga magluntad ang komosyon sa ila barangay, apisar nga wala naman sang baslanay nga natabo matapos ang pagbinun-anay sang duha ka pamilya.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Hortillosa said they are very concerned about the possibility of another commotion in their barangay, although there was no violence after the two families clashed.

text: Suno sa iya, nagpadala man siya sang request letter kay Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas agud nga mabuligan sila nga i-endorso sa Iloilo City Police Office kag La Paz PNP agud nga mabantayan gid ang lugar ilabi na kun mahaya na ang mga bangkay sang nagtaliwan nga myembro sang Pamilya Muya.
english: He said he also sent a request letter to Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas to help them endorse the Iloilo City Police Office and La Paz PNP so that the area can be guarded especially when the bodies of the deceased members of the Muya Family are buried.

text: Nahibaluan nga igahaya naman ang tatlo ka mga napatay nga myembro sang Pamilya Provido sa Brgy.
english: The three deceased members of the Provido Family will be buried in Brgy.

text: Lanit, Jaro, agud nga malikaw sa gamo ang tagsa ka pamilya.
english: Lanit, Jaro, so that each family can avoid violence.

text: Kabahin man sang tikang nga mangin mahilway ang barangay amo ang paglikaw anay sang mga residente nga mag-inom-inom sa higad sang dalan kun sa diin may magalibot man nga mga tanod agud nga masiguro nga wala sang magpasaway nga mga residente.
english: Part of the steps to make the barangay free is to avoid residents from drinking on the side of the road where there will also be tanods patrolling to ensure that no residents are disobedient.

text: Dakop sa isa ka drug buybust operation nga ginpatigayon sang Iloilo City Police Station 10 sa Brgy.
english: Arrested in a drug buybust operation conducted by Iloilo City Police Station 10 in Brgy.

text: San Rafael, Mandurriao ang isa ka ginpahayag street level individual.
english: San Rafael, Mandurriao is an alleged street level individual.

text: Ginkilala ang subject kay Alyas Mario, isa ka tricycle driver kag residente sang San Pedro, Jaro.
english: The subject was identified as Mario, a tricycle driver and resident of San Pedro, Jaro.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PCPT.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, PCPT.

text: Lester Oliveros, Officer-in-charge sang Police Station 10, iya ginpahayag nga posible nga ginagamit lang ang subject sang mas dalagko nga mga drug personalities.
english: Lester Oliveros, Officer-in-charge of Police Station 10, said it is possible that the subject is being used by bigger drug personalities.

text: Base man sa ila imbestigasyon, ginapaagi pa sang mga manugbakal ang ila bayad sa isa ka online payment.
english: Based on their investigation, buyers are still paying through an online payment.

text: Gin-ako man ni Alyas Mario nga masami sa Brgy.
english: Mario also admitted that often in Brgy.

text: Bakhaw ang ginahalinan sang supply sang iya droga.
english: Bakhaw is the source of his drug supply.

text: Nahibaluan nga yara sa 2 grams ang nakumpiskar nga droga kun sa diin may standard drug price ini nga P13,000.
english: It was learned that the seized drugs are about 2 grams with a standard drug price of P13,000.

text: Nadugangan pa ang gold medal collection sang Filipina wushu athlete nga si Agatha Wong sa Southeast Asian (SEA) Games.
english: Filipina wushu athlete Agatha Wong has added to her gold medal collection at the Southeast Asian (SEA) Games.

text: Nagpangibabaw siya sa women’s taijiquan-taijijian event sa 33rd SEA Games sa Ratthaprasasanphakdi Building Government Complex Chaeng Watthana sa Bangkok, Thailand subong nga adlaw, Disyembre 14.
english: She dominated the women’s taijiquan-taijijian event at the 33rd SEA Games at the Ratthaprasasanphakdi Building Government Complex Chaeng Watthana in Bangkok, Thailand today, December 14.

text: Ini na ang pang-anum niya nga SEA Games gold medal sa kabug-usan matapos nakadaog man sang tag-isa sang 2017, 2021, kag 2023, kag duha sadtong 2019.
english: This is her sixth SEA Games gold medal overall after winning one each in 2017, 2021, and 2023, and two in 2019.

text: Ang iya kadalag-an amo ang pang-16 nga bulawan nga medalya sang Pilipinas sa sini nga biennial meet.
english: His victory was the Philippines' 16th gold medal in this biennial meet.

text: As of press time, may 23 silver medals kag 53 bronze medals ang Pilipinas.
english: As of press time, the Philippines has 23 silver medals and 53 bronze medals.

text: Daog sa iya ikatatlo nga bulawan nga medalysa si Kayla Sanchez sa 33rd Southeast Asian Games matapos maka-recprd sang pinakamadasig nga oras nga 1:02.35 sa Women’s 100-meter Backstroke sa Hanoi, Vietnam sang Sabado.
english: Kayla Sanchez won her third gold medal at the 33rd Southeast Asian Games after recording the fastest time of 1:02.35 in the Women’s 100-meter Backstroke in Hanoi, Vietnam on Saturday.

text: Ginlutos niya si Mia Miller sang Thailand (1:02.52), samtang si Flarence Candrea sang Indonesia ang nagtapos sa pangatlo (1:02.60).
english: She beat Thailand’s Mia Miller (1:02.52), while Indonesia’s Flarence Candrea finished third (1:02.60).

text: Ang kadalag-an ni Sanchez ang naghatag sa Team Philippines ng ika-14 nga bulawan nga medalya para sa 2025 SEA Games.
english: Sanchez's victory gave Team Philippines its 14th gold medal for the 2025 SEA Games.

text: Siya man ang pinakamadamo nga medalya para sa pungsod sa kompetisyo nga ini, matapos madadaog san gold sa 4×100-meter relay kag 100-meter freestyle.
english: He also won the most medals for the country in this competition, after winning gold in the 4×100-meter relay and 100-meter freestyle.

text: Nagpauli man siya sang silver sa 50-meter backstroke matapos maka-record sang bag-o nga SEA Games record sa morning heat
english: She also took home silver in the 50-meter backstroke after recording a new SEA Games record in the morning heat

text: Nagapanawagan ang Malacañang sa publiko sang “pag-intindi kag pagsalig” sa gobyerno.
english: Malacañang calls on the public to “understand and trust” the government.

text: Ini sa tunga sang ginapatigayon nga mga tikang para buligan ang sektor sang transportasyon bangud sang nagapanglakaak nga presyo sang gatong.
english: This is amid the measures being implemented to help the transportation sector due to the rising fuel prices.

text: Kasunod man ini sang nationwide nga transport strike sang Pagkakaisa ng mga Samahan ng Tsuper at Opereytor Nationwide (PISTON) bangud sa padayon nga pagsaka sang presyo sang gatong.
english: This also follows the nationwide transport strike of the Union of Drivers and Operators Nationwide (PISTON) due to the continuous rise in fuel prices.

text: Suno kay Palace Press Officer Claire Castro, importante ang pagbinuligay kag kooperasyon sa sini nga tyempo agud matagaan sang nagakaigo nga solusyon ang epekto sang krisis sa Middle East nga nagakaapekto man sa presyo sang produktong petrolyo.
english: According to Palace Press Officer Claire Castro, cooperation is important at this time to provide an appropriate solution to the impact of the crisis in the Middle East that is also affecting the price of petroleum products.

text: Dugang sini, ginatinguhaan sang gobyerno ang paghatag man sang patas nga bulig para sa mga drivers kag amo man sa commuter paagi sa pinansyal nga bulig kag fuel subsidy.
english: He added that the government is trying to provide equal assistance to drivers as well as commuters through financial assistance and fuel subsidy.

text: Bag-o lang nakaabot sa Iloilo ang masobra duha ka kilo nga ginapasuni shabu nga nakumpiskar sang mga pulis sa isa ka high value individual sa Barangay Maya sa banwa sang Balasan kaina sang kaagahon.
english: More than two kilos of suspected shabu seized by police from a high value individual in Barangay Maya in Balasan town this morning have just arrived in Iloilo.

text: Nagadangat sa P14,008,000 ang balor sang amo nga droga nga nakuha sa possession sang main subject nga si alias Bimboy, 46, residente sang Barangay Gogo, Estancia, kag yara sa regional target priority list.
english: The value of the drugs was recovered from the possession of the main subject alias Bimboy, 46, resident of Barangay Gogo, Estancia, and is on the regional target priority list.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Dadjie Delima, head sang Provincial Drug Enforcement Unit sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office, iya ginpahayag nga kahapon sang kaagahon lang nag-abot ang suplay kag pahat-pahaton pa kuntani apang naabtan sang awtoridad.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Dadjie Delima, head of the Provincial Drug Enforcement Unit of the Iloilo Police Provincial Office, said the supply arrived yesterday morning and was about to be distributed but was caught by the authorities.

text: Suno kay De Lima, sa kinaandan, ang amo sini kadaku nga volume nagahalin sa guwa sang Western Visayas, apang indi pa subong matumod kun diin gid ang partikular ang source bangud wala pa nagakooperar ang suspek.
english: According to De Lima, usually, such a large volume comes from outside Western Visayas, but it is not yet clear where the specific source is because the suspect has not yet cooperated.

text: Magluwas kay alias Bimboy, arestado man sa amo nga drug buy bust pasado ala una kaina sang kaagahon sanday alias Domingo, 63, sang Barangay Maya, Balasan; alyas Jose, 22, sang Brgy.
english: Besides alias Bimboy, alias Domingo, 63, of Barangay Maya, Balasan; alias Jose, 22, of Brgy.

text: Poblacion Norte, Balasan; kag alias Concepcion, 21, residente sang Ipil, Balasan.
english: Population North, Balasan; and alias Concepcion, 21, resident of Ipil, Balasan.

text: Magluwas sa suspected shabu, na-recover man sang mga pulis ang 38 caliber revolver.
english: Besides the suspected shabu, police also recovered a 38 caliber revolver.

text: Suno kay De Lima, nadakpan na sang una si alias Bimboy bangud sa kaso nga kaangot man sa iligal nga droga.
english: According to De Lima, alias Bimboy was previously arrested for a case related to illegal drugs.

text: Sandig pa sa pulis, naga-operate ini kag nagahatag sang tag-kinilo-kilo nga droga sa Quinto Distrito kag sa porsyon sang probinsya sang Capiz.
english: According to the police, he operates and distributes kilos of drugs in the Fifth District and portions of Capiz province.

text: Naglawig sang apat ka bulan ang monitoring sang mga pulis antes dalayon nga nadakpan ang subject nga ginakabig madanlog sa awtoridad.
english: It took four months of police monitoring before the suspect was immediately arrested.

text: Nakahunong na ang ginaalegar nga mga durugista sa Balasan Municipal Police Station, kag natalana dal-on sa Regional Forensic Unit 6 para sa laboratory test kag pag-turn over sa nakumpiskar nga drug items.#
english: The alleged drug pushers are detained at the Balasan Municipal Police Station, and are scheduled to be taken to the Regional Forensic Unit 6 for laboratory test and turn over of the seized drug items.

text: GALIBOG gid ang ulo sang abyan naton nga si Pedro kon ngaa kinahanglan gid mapatay ang isa ka Muslim nga babaye tungod lang kay wala matabunan sing lubos sang hijab (headscarf) ang iya buhok.
english: OUR friend Pedro is very confused about why a Muslim woman had to die just because her hair was not completely covered by a hijab (headscarf).

text: Paathagan ta si Pedro parti sa pamangkot niya nga ini sandig sa aton research.
english: Let's explain to Pedro about his question based on our research.

text: Kag kon may kakulangan kita sing paghangop sa nabasahan naton angot diri, sorry po.
english: And if we have a lack of understanding of what we read about this, sorry.

text: Okey lang ini Frat Sis Sanchez?
english: Is this okay Frat Sis Sanchez?

text: Si Sis Sanchez (sa iya Christian name) isa ka converted Muslim.
english: Sis Sanchez (by her Christian name) is a converted Muslim.

text: Ang ginatumod diri ni Pedro nga kaso amo ang kaso ni Masha Amini, 22 anyos, nga isa ka Kurdish Iranian.
english: The case Pedro is referring to here is that of Masha Amini, 22, who is a Kurdish Iranian.

text: Gin-aresto siya sang morality police sa Tehran sadtong September 2022 tungod nakitaan siya sang pila ka nahot sang buhok nga nagagwa sa iya hijab.
english: She was arrested by the morality police in Tehran in September 2022 because she was found with a few strands of hair coming out of her hijab.

text: Masubo ang iya dinangatan.
english: His fate was sad.

text: Ginhunong siya sang mga ini kag nasapwan na gid lang nga nagahingalo sa kulungan kag napatay gid sa pag-abot sa ospital.
english: They stopped him and found him breathing in the cage and died on arrival at the hospital.

text: Sunu sa iya amay, may madamo nga mga pasa sa lawas ini nga sa iya pagpati tungod kay ginpatup-an siya sang hanot (police baton) bilang penalidad sa iya “inappropriate” kuno nga pagsuksok sang hijab.
english: According to her father, she had many bruises on her body that he believed were because she was beaten with a police baton as punishment for her “inappropriate” wearing of hijab.

text: Ginpanginwala ini sang gobyerno sang Iran.
english: The Iranian government has denied this.

text: Napatay si Amini kuno tungod sa “heart attack”, nga wala ugaling nagpaathag kon ngaa gin-heart attack ini.
english: Amini reportedly died of a heart attack, but did not explain why she had a heart attack.

text: Nagdabok ini sang balatyagon sang mga kababaehan sa Iran.
english: This inflamed the feelings of women in Iran.

text: Nag-rally ang madamo sa ila, lakip ang pila ka kalalakihan.
english: Many of them rallied, including some men.

text: May naghukas sang ila hijab kag ginhaboy sa kalayo.
english: Someone took off their hijab and threw it into the fire.

text: May naggunting sang ila mga buhok.
english: Someone cut their hair.

text: May nagasinggit sing “down with the dictator” nga tumod ang Supreme Leader nga clerico (may katupong nga posisyon sa isa ka pari sa  Simbahan Kristiyano) nga si Ali Khamenei.
english: Supreme Leader cleric Ali Khamenei is shouting “down with the dictator”.

text: In fact, padayon tubtub subong ang paghiwat sang mga protesta sang mga kababaehan sa Iran tungod sini.
english: In fact, women's protests in Iran continue to this day.

text: Although, indi man subong ka-istrikto ang iban nga Muslim countries sa ila mga kababaehan tungod lain-lain man ang pag-interpretar nila sang kaundan sang Quran, ang balaan nga libro sang mga Muslim, nga amo man ang ginabasehan sang kasuguan sang pang-gobyerno sa Iran, nga isa sini amo ang pagsuk-sok sang hijab.
english: Although, other Muslim countries are not as strict with their women because they interpret the contents of the Quran, the holy book of Muslims, which is also the basis of government law in Iran, one of which is the wearing of hijab.

text: May naga-interpretar sang Quran sing literal kag sa makuha halin sa kabug-san (in context) sang Quran sa iban nga bahin sini kag halin man sa pagtudlo sang pila ka iman (Muslim priests) kag Quran educators.
english: There are those who interpret the Quran literally and to get from the whole (in context) of the Quran with its other parts and also from the teachings of some iman (Muslim priests) and Quran educators.

text: Indi katulad sa Filipinas kag sang iban nga pungsod Kristiyano, kon diin may bulag nga kasuguan ang gobyerno sa iya sang Simbahan.
english: Unlike the Philippines and other Christian countries, where the government has a separate law from that of the Church.

text: Diri, ang mayor lang nga tutok sang Simbahan amo ang kalagnon nga kabuhi sang pumuluyo.
english: Here, the only major focus of the Church is the spiritual life of the people.

text: Ang gobyerno naman gapatuman sang kinamatarong sang kabug-usan nga pumuluyo sandig sa Universal Human Rights nga ginatindugan sang United Nations, nga gakilala sang patas nga kinamatarong sang tanan regardless kon ano man ang pagtuo sang kada isa.
english: The government enforces the rights of all citizens based on the Universal Human Rights Charter of the United Nations, which recognizes the equal rights of all regardless of their beliefs.

text:
***

Ang hijab, sunu sa Wikipedia, pwede gatabon lang sang ulo sang babaye nga Muslim.
english:
***

The hijab, according to Wikipedia, can only cover the head of a Muslim woman.

text: Ukon sang kabug-osan sang babaye halin sa ulo tubtub sa talapakan luas lang sa nawong kag mga kamot.
english: Or the whole woman from head to toe except face and hands.

text: Ukon lakip na ang nawong luas sa mata (labi na sa mga dalaga).
english: Or including the face outside the eyes (especially in girls).

text: Kag ina, sa nasiling ta na, depende sa kon ano ang pag-interpretar sang gobyerno sang nasulat sa Quran.
english: And that, as we have already said, depends on how the government interprets what is written in the Quran.

text: Inang pagka-istrikto sa pagpanapot sang Muslim woman ginapatuman agud mapakita nila ang “modesty”, ukon indi maiskandaloso nga panghulag, kag agud indi mangin tentasyon sa mga kalalakihan ang makita nila nga mga pribado nga bahin sang kalawasan (private parts) sang babaye, nga, of course, may pila man nga exception sa indi malikawan nga sitwasyon kag kahimtangan.
english: This strictness in Muslim women's dress is enforced so that they show modesty, or not scandalous behavior, and so that men do not become tempted by the private parts of women, which, of course, have some exceptions to unavoidable situations and circumstances.

text: In fact, ang buhok sang Muslim woman isa sa mga “private parts” nga indi dapat ipasayang-sayang sa publiko!
english: In fact, a Muslim woman's hair is one of the “private parts” that should not be wasted in public!

text: Kag amo gani nga natabo ato kay Amini.
english: And that's what happened to Amini.

text: Ti, ano ang matugda mo abyan Pedro?
english: Well, what do you suggest, friend Peter?

text: Nabulong na bala naton ang pagka-usisero mo?
english: Have we cured your curiosity?

text: Nagtango-tango si Pedro, ugaling nagsaligbat ini nga tani luyag man niya makita kon ano gid katahum ang mga dalaga nga mga Iranian nga naka-hijab tubtub sa nawong.
english: Pedro nodded, but he replied that he wanted to see how beautiful the Iranian girls were wearing hijabs up to their faces.

text: Indi bala “Beauty is a joy forever?” siling gani niya.
english: Isn’t “Beauty is a joy forever?” he said.

text: “Ti, ngaa did-an sang gobyerno nga makita sa publiko ining katahum sang mga Iranian girls sa pagtuga sang Diyos agud maghatag dugang nga katahum sa kalibutan kag makahatag kalipay sa mga katauhan nga makita sila sa mga dalanon?
english: “Well, why does the government forbid the public to see this beauty of Iranian girls in God's creation to give more beauty to the world and give joy to people to see them in the streets?

text: In fact, tugda pa ni Pedro, sa amo nga kadamo sang matahum nga Iranian maidens nga makita sa dalanon, ang makita lang sila daku na nga kalipayan sang ila pungsod.
english: In fact, Pedro added, with so many beautiful Iranian maidens seen on the streets, just seeing them is a great joy for their country.

text: Alamagon pa sila sang mga turista nga maluyagon sa mga matahum nga talan-awon, nga makapasanyog pa sang ila turismo, indi bala?/PN
english: They will be visited by tourists who love the beautiful scenery, which will promote their tourism, right?/PN

text: Nagpatigayon ang gobyerno sang Pilipinas sang virtual meeting kaupod ang Filipino community leaders sa Qatar agud mag-provide sang updates tuhoy sa developments sa tunga sang kinagamo sa Middle East.
english: The Philippine government held a virtual meeting with Filipino community leaders in Qatar to provide updates on developments amid the unrest in the Middle East.

text: Ang dayalogo gin-organisa agud masiguro nga suportado kag well-informed ang mga Overseas Filipino Workers (OFWs).
english: The dialogue was organized to ensure that Overseas Filipino Workers (OFWs) are supported and well-informed.

text: Ginpangunahan ini ni Labor Attaché Atty. Ed Ferrer kaupod ang iban pa nga senior government officials sang Department of Migrant Workers kag Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA), kag Philippine Embassy.
english: It was led by Labor Attaché Atty. Ed Ferrer along with other senior government officials of the Department of Migrant Workers and Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA), and the Philippine Embassy.
